# Kobra OS 7.1 - Asisten Suara dan Mata Kedua untuk Tunanetra

Aplikasi Android (Java, minSdk 28) yang mengendalikan HP lewat suara: membuka aplikasi dan chat, membaca layar,
membaca notifikasi dan SMS, menelepon, mengirim pesan, SOS dengan lokasi, mengenali KTP/warna/wajah, dan
menjawab pertanyaan dasar secara offline. Bagian ringan berjalan offline, bagian yang butuh internet memakai AI online,
dan pemilihannya otomatis.

> **Status jujur:** kode ini sudah lulus pengecekan sintaks, pengujian logika murni (70 kasus), dan pengecekan
> silang resource/manifest, tetapi **belum pernah dikompilasi dengan Android SDK dan belum diuji di HP**.
> Lihat `UJI_DI_HP.md` untuk urutan uji, dan bagian "Keterbatasan" di bawah.

## Cara memakai
1. Ucapkan **"Kobra"** lalu perintah, misalnya "Kobra buka WhatsApp". Setelah Kobra menjawab, 15 detik berikutnya
   Anda boleh bicara tanpa mengucap "Kobra" lagi.
2. Tombol mengambang di layar: ketuk untuk bicara; tahan lama untuk mematikan/menyalakan mikrofon.
   Warna: hijau siaga, kuning mendengarkan, biru Kobra bicara, abu-abu mati, merah izin kurang.
3. Perintah yang butuh konfirmasi (SOS, telepon, kirim pesan) dijawab dengan "iya" atau "batal".

## Daftar perintah suara (awali dengan "Kobra")
| Kelompok | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Membuka aplikasi | buka WhatsApp / buka WA / buka kamera / buka YouTube / buka Gojek. Nama mirip atau singkatan (wa, ig, fb, yt, peta, foto) dikenali; jika ada beberapa kandidat Kobra menyebut nomor, jawab "satu", "dua", dst. |
| Mencari aplikasi | cari aplikasi bank / berapa aplikasi / sebutkan aplikasi |
| Chat langsung | buka chat Ibu / chat ke Ibu / WhatsApp ke Ibu / Telegram ke Ibu / buka chat Ibu di Telegram |
| Pesan | kirim pesan ke Ibu (WhatsApp, dikonfirmasi) / kirim SMS ke Ibu / baca SMS / baca notifikasi |
| Notifikasi otomatis | matikan baca notifikasi / nyalakan baca notifikasi |
| Telepon | panggil Ibu / angkat telepon / tolak telepon |
| Baca layar dan tombol | baca layar / sebutkan tombol, lalu "tekan nomor 3" / tekan Simpan / ketik halo |
| Gerak layar | scroll bawah, scroll atas, geser kiri, geser kanan, ketuk layar, tahan layar |
| Sistem | kembali, beranda, aplikasi terbaru, notifikasi, pengaturan cepat, kunci layar, screenshot, menu daya |
| Perangkat | senter nyala/mati, volume naik/turun, mode getar, mode normal, baterai, jam berapa, tanggal |
| Alarm dan timer | timer lima menit, alarm jam enam tiga puluh |
| Pengaturan | buka pengaturan, buka pengaturan Bluetooth / lokasi / layar / suara / baterai / aksesibilitas |
| Web | buka situs detik titik com, cari resep nasi goreng, putar lagu X di YouTube, arahkan ke Stasiun Gambir |
| Mata kedua | baca KTP, baca uang, warna apa, ada orang berapa, apa di depan, lalu "scan" |
| Keselamatan | mode tongkat (lalu "mulai"/"berhenti"), tolong (SOS), TalkBack |
| Otak offline | hitung dua puluh lima kali empat, tersedak, luka berdarah, nomor darurat, teman ngobrol |
| Kontrol Kobra | bantuan, ulangi, diam, matikan mikrofon, nyalakan mikrofon |

## Offline dan online otomatis
| Fitur | Tanpa internet | Dengan internet |
|---|---|---|
| Perintah suara, baca layar, tombol, gestur, aplikasi, chat langsung, telepon, SMS, senter, volume, alarm | Jalan | Jalan |
| Baca KTP/KK | Jalan (ML Kit) | Jalan |
| Warna, hitung wajah | Jalan | Jalan |
| Lihat sekitar | Kategori benda umum | Deskripsi AI |
| Kalkulator dan pengetahuan dasar (pertolongan pertama, hiburan) | Jalan (OfflineBrain) | Jalan (didahulukan) |
| Baca uang | Tidak tersedia | AI gambar |
| Pertanyaan bebas, teman ngobrol | Hanya hal dasar | n8n lalu AI OpenRouter |
| Buka situs, cari di Google | Diberi tahu butuh internet | Jalan |

Urutan jawaban untuk perintah yang tidak dikenali: otak offline, lalu (jika online) webhook n8n, lalu AI OpenRouter.
Kobra mengumumkan lewat suara saat koneksi tersambung atau terputus.

## Pemasangan di HP
1. Buka aplikasi Kobra OS. Ikuti tombol 1 sampai 8 dari atas ke bawah:
   izin, aksesibilitas, akses notifikasi, pengaturan AI, kontak SOS, bebaskan dari hemat baterai,
   jalankan di latar belakang, jadikan layar utama (opsional).
2. API key OpenRouter (gratis di openrouter.ai) diisi di **Pengaturan AI**. Opsional; tanpa key, fitur offline tetap jalan.
3. Webhook n8n (opsional) diisi di tempat yang sama. n8n menerima JSON `{"perintah": "...", "sumber": "kobra-os"}`
   dan sebaiknya membalas JSON `{"balasan": "teks yang dibacakan"}`.

## Build
- **GitHub Actions**: push ke cabang `main`; workflow `.github/workflows/build-apk.yml` menjalankan uji logika lalu
  `gradle assembleDebug` dan mengunggah APK sebagai artifact.
- **Android Studio**: buka folder ini, tunggu sync Gradle, lalu Run. Berkas `gradlew` tidak disertakan
  (tidak bisa dibuat tanpa jaringan); Android Studio memakai Gradle miliknya atau menawarkan membuatnya.

## Struktur
```
app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/   25 kelas Java (lihat PROMPT_LANJUTAN.md untuk peta lengkap)
app/src/main/assets/kobra_kb.txt       basis pengetahuan offline (mudah diedit, format: kunci => jawaban)
app/src/main/res/                      layout, tema, ikon, konfigurasi aksesibilitas
tools/                                 pengujian logika murni (tanpa Android)
UJI_DI_HP.md                           urutan uji di HP dan cara melaporkan error
PROMPT_LANJUTAN.md                     prompt untuk melanjutkan proyek lewat AI lain
```

## Menguji logika murni (tanpa Android)
```
J=app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu
javac -encoding UTF-8 -d /tmp/ob $J/OfflineBrain.java $J/AppMatcher.java $J/PhoneFormat.java tools/*.java
java -cp /tmp/ob com.asisten.bantu.OfflineBrainCheck
java -cp /tmp/ob com.asisten.bantu.AppMatcherCheck
```

## Keterbatasan (jujur)
- **Belum dikompilasi dan belum diuji di HP.** Error build atau perilaku yang beda antar merek HP masih mungkin.
- **WiFi dan data seluler tidak dikendalikan** (keputusan pemilik proyek; Android 10 ke atas juga melarang aplikasi biasa).
- **TalkBack tidak bisa diaktifkan oleh aplikasi lain.** Kobra hanya membuka pengaturannya.
- **Mikrofon di latar belakang:** Android 11 ke atas membatasi akses mikrofon saat aplikasi tidak tampil. Kobra mencoba
  layanan foreground bertipe mikrofon; hasilnya berbeda per HP/versi Android. Cadangan: tombol mengambang.
- **Membuka aplikasi dari latar belakang** bisa diblokir sistem pada sebagian versi Android.
- **Chat langsung** memakai nomor di kontak. Grup atau nama yang tidak ada di kontak memakai cara cadangan (mengklik nama di daftar chat WhatsApp), yang bisa rusak jika tampilan WhatsApp berubah.
- **Angkat dan tolak telepon** memakai izin ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; sistem tidak memberi konfirmasi pasti.
- **Baca SMS dan QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES** tidak lolos kebijakan Google Play. Aplikasi ini untuk pemasangan manual (sideload).
- **Notifikasi dibacakan keras-keras**, termasuk isi pesan pribadi. Matikan dengan "Kobra matikan baca notifikasi" atau pakai earphone.
- **Otak offline bukan model bahasa besar.** Ia mencocokkan frasa dan menghitung ekspresi. Model bahasa di HP (misalnya Gemma lewat MediaPipe) belum disertakan karena butuh unduhan ratusan MB.
- **Model AI gratis OpenRouter bisa berganti atau penuh.** Daftar bawaan ada di `KobraConfig.java`; model bisa diganti di Pengaturan AI.
- **Pengenalan objek offline kasar** (kategori umum). Baca uang butuh internet.
- Aplikasi ini **alat bantu, bukan pengganti tongkat putih** atau pendamping. Uji SOS bersama kontak darurat sebelum diandalkan.

plugins { 
    id 'com.android.application' 
}

android {
    namespace 'com.asisten.bantu'
    compileSdk 36

    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "com.asisten.bantu"
        minSdk 28
        targetSdk 36
        versionCode 8
        versionName "7.1-KOBRA"
    }

    buildFeatures {
        buildConfig true
    }

    lint {
        abortOnError false
        checkReleaseBuilds false
    }

    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
            proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android-optimize.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
        }
    }

    packaging {
        resources {
            excludes += [
                '/META-INF/{AL2.0,LGPL2.1}',
                'META-INF/DEPENDENCIES',
                'META-INF/LICENSE',
                'META-INF/LICENSE.txt',
                'META-INF/license.txt',
                'META-INF/NOTICE',
                'META-INF/NOTICE.txt',
                'META-INF/notice.txt',
                'META-INF/ASL2.0'
            ]
        }
    }

    androidResources {
        noCompress 'task', 'tflite', 'bin', 'lite'
    }

    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
        targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
    }
}

dependencies {
    // AndroidX & Material Design
    implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
    implementation 'com.google.android.material:material:1.10.0'
    implementation 'androidx.constraintlayout:constraintlayout:2.1.4'
    implementation 'androidx.recyclerview:recyclerview:1.3.2'
    implementation 'androidx.core:core:1.12.0'

    // CameraX 1.3.1
    implementation 'androidx.camera:camera-core:1.3.1'
    implementation 'androidx.camera:camera-camera2:1.3.1'
    implementation 'androidx.camera:camera-lifecycle:1.3.1'
    implementation 'androidx.camera:camera-view:1.3.1'

    // Google ML Kit (Offline Vision, Barcode, Translation & Text Recognition)
    implementation 'com.google.mlkit:text-recognition:16.0.0'
    implementation 'com.google.mlkit:object-detection:16.0.0'
    implementation 'com.google.mlkit:face-detection:16.1.6'
    implementation 'com.google.mlkit:barcode-scanning:17.3.0'
    implementation 'com.google.mlkit:translate:17.0.3'

    // MediaPipe LLM Inference API (Pengolahan Bahasa Offline On-Device)
    implementation 'com.google.mediapipe:tasks-genai:0.10.14'

    // Pengujian
    testImplementation 'junit:junit:4.13.2'
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import java.util.ArrayList;

/**
 * Teman ngobrol Kobra. Suara ditangkap layanan utama (tidak ada mikrofon ganda).
 * Urutan jawaban: otak offline (kalkulator dan pengetahuan dasar), model LLM offline Gemma 3 on-device,
 * lalu AI online jika ada internet dan API key.
 */
public class AiChatActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    static volatile AiChatActivity current;

    private TextView tvHistory, tvModelStatusChat;
    private ScrollView scroll;
    private Button btnImportModelChat;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private KobraConfig config;
    private AiClient ai;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final StringBuilder transcript = new StringBuilder();
    private final ArrayList<String> recent = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_ai_chat);
        tvHistory = findViewById(R.id.tvChatHistory);
        tvModelStatusChat = findViewById(R.id.tvModelStatusChat);
        scroll = findViewById(R.id.scrollChat);
        btnImportModelChat = findViewById(R.id.btnImportModelChat);
        Button btnListen = findViewById(R.id.btnListenChat);
        Button btnResetSession = findViewById(R.id.btnResetChatSession);
        Button btnClose = findViewById(R.id.btnCloseChat);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        ai = new AiClient(config);

        btnListen.setOnClickListener(v -> AsistenAccessibilityService.requestListen());
        btnResetSession.setOnClickListener(v -> resetChatSession());
        btnClose.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        btnImportModelChat.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            speaker.speak("Membuka pengaturan AI untuk mengimpor model offline.");
            KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this, new Intent(this, SettingsActivity.class),
                    speaker, "Gagal membuka Pengaturan AI.");
        });

        checkModelStatus();

        LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        boolean hasLocal = engine.isModelPresent();
        String greeting;
        if (config.hasAi()) {
            greeting = "Halo. Saya Kobra, teman ngobrol Anda. Silakan bicara.";
        } else if (hasLocal && !engine.isSafeMode()) {
            greeting = engine.isInitialized()
                    ? "Halo. Saya Kobra. Mesin AI offline Gemma 3 1B aktif dan siap digunakan. Silakan bicara."
                    : "Halo. Saya Kobra. Model AI offline terpasang dan akan dimuat saat pesan pertama dikirim. Silakan bicara.";
        } else if (hasLocal) {
            greeting = "Halo. Saya Kobra dalam Mode Aman perintah lokal. " + engine.getLastError() + ". Silakan bicara.";
        } else {
            greeting = "Halo. Saya Kobra dalam Mode Aman. Belum ada API key AI online atau berkas model offline. Anda dapat mengimpor model offline .task atau mengisi API key di Pengaturan AI.";
        }
        append("Kobra", greeting);
        speaker.speak(greeting);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        current = this;
        checkModelStatus();
    }

    private void checkModelStatus() {
        LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        boolean hasModel = engine.isModelPresent();
        String styleInfo = "Gaya: " + config.getAssistantStyleLabel()
                + " | Memori: " + engine.getSessionTurnCount() + " giliran";
        if (hasModel) {
            long mb = engine.getModelFile().length() / (1024 * 1024);
            if (engine.isSafeMode()) {
                String err = engine.getLastError().isEmpty() ? LocalLlmEngine.CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : engine.getLastError();
                tvModelStatusChat.setText("⚠️ " + err + " (" + mb + " MB) • " + styleInfo);
                tvModelStatusChat.setTextColor(0xFFFFAB40);
                btnImportModelChat.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            } else if (engine.isInitialized()) {
                tvModelStatusChat.setText("🧠 Model offline aktif (" + mb + " MB) • " + styleInfo);
                tvModelStatusChat.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                btnImportModelChat.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            } else {
                tvModelStatusChat.setText("🧠 Model offline siap dimuat saat chat (" + mb + " MB) • " + styleInfo);
                tvModelStatusChat.setTextColor(0xFF38BDF8);
                btnImportModelChat.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
        } else {
            tvModelStatusChat.setText("⚠️ Mode Aman: Model offline (.task) belum terpasang • Gaya: " + config.getAssistantStyleLabel());
            tvModelStatusChat.setTextColor(0xFFFFEB3B);
            btnImportModelChat.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    private void resetChatSession() {
        LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this).clearSessionHistory();
        recent.clear();
        transcript.setLength(0);
        String msg = "Sesi percakapan baru dimulai. Konteks sebelumnya dibersihkan.";
        append("Kobra", msg);
        checkModelStatus();
        speaker.speak(msg);
    }

    @Override protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        if (current == this) current = null;
    }

    /** Dipanggil layanan utama ketika suara diterima saat halaman ini terbuka. */
    void onVoice(String text) {
        main.post(() -> {
            append("Anda", text);
            remember("Pengguna: " + text);

            String local = OfflineAi.get(this).answer(text);
            if (local != null) {
                respond(local);
                return;
            }
            LocalLlmEngine localLlm = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
            boolean hasLocalModel = localLlm.isModelPresent();

            if (!NetworkState.isOnline(this)) {
                if (hasLocalModel) {
                    askOfflineLlm(text, localLlm);
                    return;
                }
                respond("Mode Aman aktif karena internet terputus dan model offline belum dipasang. Anda tetap bisa memakai kalkulator suara dan perintah sistem.");
                return;
            }
            if (!config.hasAi()) {
                if (hasLocalModel) {
                    askOfflineLlm(text, localLlm);
                    return;
                }
                respond("Mode Aman aktif. Saya belum bisa menjawab pertanyaan bebas tanpa AI. Impor model offline .task atau isi API key di Pengaturan AI.");
                return;
            }
            respond("Sebentar, saya pikirkan dulu.");
            StringBuilder context = new StringBuilder();
            for (String line : recent) context.append(line).append("\n");
            ai.chat(AiClient.SYSTEM_TUNANETRA, context.toString(), new AiClient.Callback() {
                @Override public void onResult(String answer) { respond(answer); }
                @Override public void onError(String message) { respond(message); }
            });
        });
    }

    private void askOfflineLlm(String text, LocalLlmEngine localLlm) {
        if (localLlm.isSafeMode() && !localLlm.getLastError().isEmpty()) {
            fallbackSafeMode(localLlm.getLastError());
            return;
        }
        append("Kobra", "Sedang berpikir offline (Gemma 3)...");
        LocalLlmEngine.StreamingCallback cb = new LocalLlmEngine.StreamingCallback() {
            private final StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder();
            @Override public void onPartialResult(String partialText, boolean isComplete) {
                if (partialText != null) buffer.append(partialText);
                if (isComplete) {
                    String reply = buffer.toString().trim();
                    if (!reply.isEmpty()) {
                        remember("Kobra: " + reply);
                        append("Kobra", reply);
                        checkModelStatus();
                    }
                }
            }
            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                checkModelStatus();
                respond("Beralih ke Mode Aman perintah lokal: " + message);
            }
        };

        if (localLlm.isInitialized()) {
            localLlm.generateResponseAsync(text, speaker, cb);
        } else {
            new Thread(() -> {
                if (localLlm.initEngine()) {
                    localLlm.generateResponseAsync(text, speaker, cb);
                } else {
                    main.post(() -> {
                        checkModelStatus();
                        fallbackSafeMode(localLlm.getLastError());
                    });
                }
            }).start();
        }
    }

    private void fallbackSafeMode(String reason) {
        String detail = (reason == null || reason.isEmpty()) ? "Model tidak dapat dimuat" : reason;
        respond("Model offline tidak dapat dimuat (" + detail + "). Kobra beralih ke Mode Aman untuk perintah sistem dan kalkulator lokal.");
    }

    private void respond(String reply) {
        append("Kobra", reply);
        remember("Kobra: " + reply);
        speaker.speak(reply);
    }

    private void remember(String line) {
        recent.add(line);
        if (recent.size() > 16) recent.remove(0);
    }

    private void append(String who, String text) {
        transcript.append(who).append(": ").append(text).append("\n\n");
        tvHistory.setText(transcript.toString());
        scroll.post(() -> scroll.fullScroll(ScrollView.FOCUS_DOWN));
    }
}

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/AiClient.java
==========================================
package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Base64;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Klien OpenRouter (gratis). Mencoba beberapa model berurutan jika model sedang sibuk. */
public class AiClient {

    public interface Callback {
        void onResult(String text);
        void onError(String message);
    }

    public static final String SYSTEM_TUNANETRA =
            "Kamu adalah Kobra, asisten untuk tunanetra. Jawab dalam Bahasa Indonesia, singkat, jelas, "
            + "dan hangat. Jangan pakai format markdown, simbol, atau daftar bernomor karena jawabanmu "
            + "akan dibacakan lewat suara. Jika menyangkut keselamatan, sebutkan risikonya lebih dulu.";

    private static final String ENDPOINT = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions";
    private static final ExecutorService POOL = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static final Handler MAIN = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private final KobraConfig config;

    public AiClient(KobraConfig config) { this.config = config; }

    public void chat(String system, String userText, Callback cb) {
        List<String> models = new ArrayList<>();
        String pref = config.getModel();
        if (!pref.isEmpty()) models.add(pref);
        for (String m : KobraConfig.TEXT_MODELS) if (!models.contains(m)) models.add(m);
        String styledSystem = system + " " + config.getAssistantStyleSystemPrompt();
        run(models, styledSystem, userText, null, cb);
    }

    public void describeImage(String prompt, Bitmap image, Callback cb) {
        List<String> models = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String m : KobraConfig.VISION_MODELS) models.add(m);
        String styledSystem = SYSTEM_TUNANETRA + " " + config.getAssistantStyleSystemPrompt();
        run(models, styledSystem, prompt, image, cb);
    }

    private void run(List<String> models, String system, String user, Bitmap image, Callback cb) {
        final String key = config.getApiKey();
        if (key.isEmpty()) {
            post(cb, null, "API key AI belum diisi. Buka Kobra, lalu Pengaturan AI.");
            return;
        }
        POOL.execute(() -> {
            String error = "Koneksi AI gagal. Periksa koneksi internet.";
            for (String model : models) {
                try {
                    post(cb, request(key, model, system, user, image), null);
                    return;
                } catch (ApiException e) {
                    error = e.getMessage();
                    if (!e.retry) break;
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    error = "Koneksi AI gagal. Periksa koneksi internet.";
                }
            }
            post(cb, null, error);
        });
    }

    private static String request(String key, String model, String system, String user, Bitmap image)
            throws Exception {
        JSONArray messages = new JSONArray();
        messages.put(new JSONObject().put("role", "system").put("content", system));

        JSONObject userMsg = new JSONObject().put("role", "user");
        if (image == null) {
            userMsg.put("content", user);
        } else {
            JSONArray parts = new JSONArray();
            parts.put(new JSONObject().put("type", "text").put("text", user));
            JSONObject img = new JSONObject().put("url", "data:image/jpeg;base64," + toBase64(image));
            parts.put(new JSONObject().put("type", "image_url").put("image_url", img));
            userMsg.put("content", parts);
        }
        messages.put(userMsg);

        JSONObject body = new JSONObject()
                .put("model", model)
                .put("messages", messages)
                .put("max_tokens", 400);

        HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(ENDPOINT).openConnection();
        conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
        conn.setConnectTimeout(15000);
        conn.setReadTimeout(60000);
        conn.setDoOutput(true);
        conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
        conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + key);
        conn.setRequestProperty("HTTP-Referer", "https://github.com/adebojel/Asisten-bantu");
        conn.setRequestProperty("X-Title", "Kobra OS");
        try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
            os.write(body.toString().getBytes("UTF-8"));
        }

        int code = conn.getResponseCode();
        String raw = readAll(code / 100 == 2 ? conn.getInputStream() : conn.getErrorStream());
        if (code / 100 != 2) {
            if (code == 401) throw new ApiException("API key tidak valid. Periksa di Pengaturan AI.", false);
            boolean retry = code == 429 || code == 404 || code >= 500;
            throw new ApiException(retry ? "Model gratis sedang sibuk, saya coba model lain."
                    : "AI menolak permintaan, kode " + code, retry);
        }
        JSONObject json = new JSONObject(raw);
        return json.getJSONArray("choices").getJSONObject(0)
                .getJSONObject("message").getString("content").trim();
    }

    private static String toBase64(Bitmap src) {
        Bitmap bmp = src;
        int max = Math.max(src.getWidth(), src.getHeight());
        if (max > 1024) {
            float s = 1024f / max;
            bmp = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(src, Math.round(src.getWidth() * s), Math.round(src.getHeight() * s), true);
        }
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        bmp.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 80, out);
        return Base64.encodeToString(out.toByteArray(), Base64.NO_WRAP);
    }

    private static String readAll(InputStream is) throws Exception {
        if (is == null) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is, "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static void post(Callback cb, String text, String error) {
        MAIN.post(() -> {
            if (text != null) cb.onResult(text);
            else cb.onError(error);
        });
    }

    private static class ApiException extends Exception {
        final boolean retry;
        ApiException(String message, boolean retry) {
            super(message);
            this.retry = retry;
        }
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ResolveInfo;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/** Daftar semua aplikasi yang bisa dibuka di HP (yang punya ikon peluncur), terurut menurut nama. */
public final class AppLauncher {
    private AppLauncher() {}

    public static List<AppMatcher.App> installed(Context c) {
        PackageManager pm = c.getPackageManager();
        Intent main = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER);
        Map<String, AppMatcher.App> byPkg = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try {
            for (ResolveInfo ri : pm.queryIntentActivities(main, 0)) {
                String pkg = ri.activityInfo.packageName;
                if (byPkg.containsKey(pkg)) continue;
                CharSequence label = ri.loadLabel(pm);
                byPkg.put(pkg, new AppMatcher.App(label == null ? pkg : label.toString(), pkg));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        List<AppMatcher.App> out = new ArrayList<>(byPkg.values());
        Collections.sort(out, (a, b) -> a.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.label));
        return out;
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Mencocokkan nama aplikasi yang diucapkan dengan daftar aplikasi terpasang. Mengenali singkatan
 * (wa, ig, fb, yt), padanan nama (peta = Maps, foto = Galeri), dan salah dengar kecil (yutub = YouTube).
 * Java murni tanpa dependensi Android, sehingga bisa diuji di komputer.
 */
public final class AppMatcher {

    public static final class App {
        public final String label;
        public final String pkg;
        public App(String label, String pkg) {
            this.label = label;
            this.pkg = pkg;
        }
    }

    public static final class Match {
        public final App app;
        public final int score;
        Match(App app, int score) {
            this.app = app;
            this.score = score;
        }
    }

    private static final int MIN_SCORE = 40;
    private static final Map<String, String[]> ALIASES = new HashMap<>();

    private static void alias(String spoken, String... targets) { ALIASES.put(spoken, targets); }

    static {
        alias("wa", "whatsapp");
        alias("w a", "whatsapp");
        alias("ig", "instagram");
        alias("fb", "facebook");
        alias("yt", "youtube");
        alias("tele", "telegram");
        alias("tg", "telegram");
        alias("surel", "gmail");
        alias("email", "gmail", "email");
        alias("peta", "maps");
        alias("galeri", "galeri", "gallery", "foto", "photos");
        alias("foto", "foto", "photos", "galeri", "gallery");
        alias("kamera", "kamera", "camera");
        alias("kalender", "kalender", "calendar");
        alias("jam", "jam", "clock");
        alias("alarm", "jam", "clock");
        alias("kontak", "kontak", "contacts");
        alias("telepon", "telepon", "phone", "dialer");
        alias("telpon", "telepon", "phone", "dialer");
        alias("pesan", "pesan", "messages");
        alias("sms", "pesan", "messages");
        alias("pengaturan", "pengaturan", "settings", "setelan");
        alias("setelan", "pengaturan", "settings", "setelan");
        alias("kalkulator", "kalkulator", "calculator");
        alias("toko aplikasi", "play store");
        alias("playstore", "play store");
        alias("browser", "chrome", "browser", "internet");
        alias("internet", "chrome", "browser", "internet");
        alias("peramban", "chrome", "browser", "internet");
        alias("musik", "musik", "music", "spotify");
        alias("catatan", "catatan", "notes", "keep");
        alias("file", "file", "files", "berkas");
        alias("berkas", "file", "files", "berkas");
        alias("unduhan", "unduhan", "downloads");
        alias("perekam suara", "perekam suara", "recorder", "voice recorder");
        alias("senter", "senter", "flashlight");
    }

    private AppMatcher() {}

    static String normalize(String s) {
        return s == null ? "" : s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", " ").trim();
    }

    /** Hasil terurut dari yang paling cocok; kosong jika tidak ada yang cukup mirip. */
    public static List<Match> find(List<App> apps, String query, int max) {
        String q = normalize(query);
        List<Match> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (q.isEmpty()) return out;
        List<String> terms = new ArrayList<>();
        terms.add(q);
        String[] al = ALIASES.get(q);
        if (al != null) for (String a : al) if (!terms.contains(a)) terms.add(a);

        for (App app : apps) {
            int best = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < terms.size(); i++) {
                int s = scoreTerm(app, terms.get(i));
                if (i > 0) s = s * 9 / 10; // padanan nilainya sedikit di bawah nama yang diucapkan langsung
                best = Math.max(best, s);
            }
            if (best >= MIN_SCORE) out.add(new Match(app, best));
        }
        Collections.sort(out, (a, b) -> {
            if (a.score != b.score) return b.score - a.score;
            if (a.app.label.length() != b.app.label.length()) return a.app.label.length() - b.app.label.length();
            return a.app.label.compareToIgnoreCase(b.app.label);
        });
        return out.size() > max ? new ArrayList<>(out.subList(0, max)) : out;
    }

    /** Jelas jika ada satu pemenang yang unggul dari yang kedua; selain itu sebaiknya bertanya ke pengguna. */
    public static boolean isClear(List<Match> m) {
        if (m == null || m.isEmpty()) return false;
        if (m.get(0).score < 45) return false;
        return m.size() == 1 || m.get(0).score - m.get(1).score >= 10;
    }

    private static int scoreTerm(App app, String t) {
        String l = normalize(app.label);
        if (l.isEmpty() || t.isEmpty()) return 0;
        int score = 0;
        if (l.equals(t)) score = 100;
        else if (l.startsWith(t + " ")) score = 80;
        else if (t.length() >= 3 && l.startsWith(t)) score = 75;
        else if ((" " + l + " ").contains(" " + t + " ")) score = 70;
        else if (l.length() >= 4 && (" " + t + " ").contains(" " + l + " ")) score = 65;
        else if (t.length() >= 3 && l.contains(t)) score = 55;

        if (score < 50 && t.length() >= 3) {
            String compact = t.replace(" ", "");
            if (compact.length() >= 4 && app.pkg != null && app.pkg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(compact)) score = Math.max(score, 50);
        }
        if (score < 50 && t.length() >= 4) {
            if (close(l, t)) score = Math.max(score, 50);
            else if (l.contains(" ")) {
                for (String w : l.split(" ")) if (w.length() >= 4 && close(w, t)) score = Math.max(score, 40);
            }
        }
        return score;
    }

    private static boolean close(String a, String b) {
        int longest = Math.max(a.length(), b.length());
        int allowed = longest >= 7 ? 2 : (longest >= 5 ? 1 : 0);
        return allowed > 0 && distance(a, b) <= allowed;
    }

    static int distance(String a, String b) {
        int[] prev = new int[b.length() + 1];
        int[] cur = new int[b.length() + 1];
        for (int j = 0; j <= b.length(); j++) prev[j] = j;
        for (int i = 1; i <= a.length(); i++) {
            cur[0] = i;
            for (int j = 1; j <= b.length(); j++) {
                int cost = a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1;
                cur[j] = Math.min(Math.min(cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j] + 1), prev[j - 1] + cost);
            }
            int[] tmp = prev;
            prev = cur;
            cur = tmp;
        }
        return prev[b.length()];
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.app.DownloadManager;
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.provider.Settings;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Pemeriksa dan pengunduh pembaruan aplikasi mandiri (In-App OTA Updater)
 * melalui GitHub Releases API publik repositori Kobra OS.
 */
public final class AppUpdater {

    public static final String LATEST_RELEASE_API =
            "https://api.github.com/repos/adebojel/Asisten-bantu/releases/latest";

    public interface CheckCallback {
        void onUpdateAvailable(ReleaseInfo info);
        void onUpToDate(String currentVersion, String latestTag);
        void onError(String message);
    }

    public interface DownloadCallback {
        void onStarted(long downloadId, String fileName);
        void onCompleted(Uri apkUri, File apkFile);
        void onError(String message);
    }

    public static final class ReleaseInfo {
        public final String tagName;
        public final String title;
        public final String releaseNotesForSpeech;
        public final String apkDownloadUrl;
        public final String apkFileName;
        public final String htmlUrl;

        ReleaseInfo(String tagName, String title, String releaseNotesForSpeech,
                    String apkDownloadUrl, String apkFileName, String htmlUrl) {
            this.tagName = tagName;
            this.title = title;
            this.releaseNotesForSpeech = releaseNotesForSpeech;
            this.apkDownloadUrl = apkDownloadUrl;
            this.apkFileName = apkFileName;
            this.htmlUrl = htmlUrl;
        }
    }

    private final Context appContext;
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private BroadcastReceiver activeReceiver;
    private long activeDownloadId = -1L;

    public AppUpdater(Context context) {
        this.appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public void checkLatestRelease(CheckCallback callback) {
        if (!NetworkState.isOnline(appContext)) {
            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Tidak ada koneksi internet. Sambungkan Wi-Fi atau data seluler untuk cek pembaruan."));
            return;
        }
        new Thread(() -> {
            HttpURLConnection conn = null;
            try {
                URL url = new URL(LATEST_RELEASE_API);
                conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
                conn.setRequestMethod("GET");
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.setReadTimeout(15000);
                conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json");
                conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "KobraOS-Android");

                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                if (code == 404) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Belum ada rilis resmi yang dipublikasikan di repositori GitHub."));
                    return;
                }
                if (code < 200 || code >= 300) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Server GitHub mengembalikan kode " + code + "."));
                    return;
                }

                StringBuilder raw = new StringBuilder();
                try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                    String line;
                    while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                        raw.append(line).append("\n");
                    }
                }

                JSONObject json = new JSONObject(raw.toString());
                String tagName = json.optString("tag_name", "").trim();
                String title = json.optString("name", tagName).trim();
                String body = cleanReleaseNotes(json.optString("body", ""));
                String htmlUrl = json.optString("html_url", "");

                String apkUrl = "";
                String apkName = "";
                JSONArray assets = json.optJSONArray("assets");
                if (assets != null) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < assets.length(); i++) {
                        JSONObject asset = assets.optJSONObject(i);
                        if (asset == null) continue;
                        String n = asset.optString("name", "");
                        if (n.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".apk")) {
                            apkUrl = asset.optString("browser_download_url", "");
                            apkName = n;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                String currentVer = BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME;
                if (isNewerVersion(tagName, currentVer)) {
                    ReleaseInfo info = new ReleaseInfo(tagName, title, body, apkUrl, apkName, htmlUrl);
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onUpdateAvailable(info));
                } else {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onUpToDate(currentVer, tagName));
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                String msg = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : "kesalahan jaringan";
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Gagal memeriksa pembaruan: " + msg));
            } finally {
                if (conn != null) conn.disconnect();
            }
        }).start();
    }

    public void downloadAndInstall(ReleaseInfo info, DownloadCallback callback) {
        if (info == null || info.apkDownloadUrl == null || info.apkDownloadUrl.isEmpty()) {
            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Rilis " + (info != null ? info.tagName : "") + " belum melampirkan berkas APK."));
            return;
        }
        DownloadManager dm = (DownloadManager) appContext.getSystemService(Context.DOWNLOAD_SERVICE);
        if (dm == null) {
            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("DownloadManager tidak tersedia di perangkat ini."));
            return;
        }

        String safeFileName = (info.apkFileName != null && !info.apkFileName.isEmpty())
                ? info.apkFileName.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_")
                : "KobraOS-" + info.tagName.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]", "_") + ".apk";

        File dir = appContext.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS);
        if (dir == null) {
            mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Direktori unduhan perangkat tidak tersedia."));
            return;
        }
        File old = new File(dir, safeFileName);
        if (old.exists()) old.delete();
        final File targetFile = new File(dir, safeFileName);

        DownloadManager.Request req = new DownloadManager.Request(Uri.parse(info.apkDownloadUrl))
                .setTitle("Pembaruan Kobra OS " + info.tagName)
                .setDescription("Mengunduh paket pembaruan Kobra OS...")
                .setNotificationVisibility(DownloadManager.Request.VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_NOTIFY_COMPLETED)
                .setAllowedOverMetered(true)
                .setAllowedOverRoaming(true)
                .setDestinationInExternalFilesDir(appContext, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS, safeFileName);

        unregisterReceiver();
        activeDownloadId = dm.enqueue(req);
        final long expectedId = activeDownloadId;

        activeReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
            @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                long id = intent.getLongExtra(DownloadManager.EXTRA_DOWNLOAD_ID, -1L);
                if (id != expectedId) return;
                unregisterReceiver();

                DownloadManager.Query q = new DownloadManager.Query().setFilterById(expectedId);
                try (Cursor c = dm.query(q)) {
                    if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                        int statusIdx = c.getColumnIndex(DownloadManager.COLUMN_STATUS);
                        int status = statusIdx >= 0 ? c.getInt(statusIdx) : -1;
                        if (status == DownloadManager.STATUS_SUCCESSFUL && targetFile.exists()) {
                            try {
                                Uri contentUri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(
                                        appContext,
                                        appContext.getPackageName() + ".fileprovider",
                                        targetFile);
                                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onCompleted(contentUri, targetFile));
                            } catch (Exception e) {
                                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Gagal menyiapkan installer FileProvider: " + e.getMessage()));
                            }
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError("Unduhan APK gagal atau dibatalkan."));
            }
        };

        IntentFilter filter = new IntentFilter(DownloadManager.ACTION_DOWNLOAD_COMPLETE);
        ContextCompat.registerReceiver(appContext, activeReceiver, filter, ContextCompat.RECEIVER_EXPORTED);
        mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onStarted(expectedId, safeFileName));
    }

    public static boolean launchPackageInstaller(Context context, Uri apkContentUri) {
        if (context == null) return false;
        try {
            if (!context.getPackageManager().canRequestPackageInstalls()) {
                Intent permIntent = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES,
                        Uri.parse("package:" + context.getPackageName()));
                permIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(context, permIntent, null,
                        "Tidak dapat membuka izin instal aplikasi pada HP ini.");
                return false;
            }
            Intent install = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW);
            install.setDataAndType(apkContentUri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive");
            install.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
            return KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(context, install, null,
                    "Tidak dapat membuka pemasang paket APK.");
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public void unregisterReceiver() {
        if (activeReceiver != null) {
            try {
                appContext.unregisterReceiver(activeReceiver);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            activeReceiver = null;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isNewerVersion(String candidateTag, String currentVersion) {
        List<Integer> cand = extractVersionParts(candidateTag);
        List<Integer> curr = extractVersionParts(currentVersion);
        int max = Math.max(cand.size(), curr.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < max; i++) {
            int c = i < cand.size() ? cand.get(i) : 0;
            int k = i < curr.size() ? curr.get(i) : 0;
            if (c > k) return true;
            if (c < k) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static List<Integer> extractVersionParts(String raw) {
        List<Integer> parts = new ArrayList<>();
        if (raw == null) return parts;
        String[] tokens = raw.replaceAll("[^0-9.]+", ".").split("\\.");
        for (String t : tokens) {
            if (t.isEmpty()) continue;
            try {
                parts.add(Integer.parseInt(t));
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {}
        }
        return parts;
    }

    private static String cleanReleaseNotes(String body) {
        if (body == null || body.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return "Pembaruan sistem dan peningkatan stabilitas Kobra OS.";
        }
        String clean = body.replaceAll("[#*`>_~]", " ")
                .replaceAll("\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\([^)]+\\)", "$1")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();
        return clean.length() > 350 ? clean.substring(0, 350) + "..." : clean;
    }
}

    private String lastHourlyChimeKey = "";

    private static final class ActiveTimer {
        final int id;
        final String label;
        final long endAtMs;
        Runnable task;
        ActiveTimer(int id, String label, long endAtMs) {
            this.id = id;
            this.label = label;
            this.endAtMs = endAtMs;
        }
    }

    private static final class Pending {
        final String kind;
        final String a;
        final String b;
        final String c;
        final long at = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Pending(String kind, String a, String b) { this(kind, a, b, ""); }
        Pending(String kind, String a, String b, String c) { this.kind = kind; this.a = a; this.b = b; this.c = c; }
        boolean expired() { return System.currentTimeMillis() - at > CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS; }
    }

    public static AsistenAccessibilityService getInstance() { return instance; }

    public LocalLlmEngine getLocalLlmEngine() {
        return localLlmEngine != null ? localLlmEngine : LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
    }

    /** Dipanggil dari tombol di layar: langsung dengarkan satu perintah. */
    public static void requestListen() {
        AsistenAccessibilityService s = instance;
        if (s != null) s.onFloatingClick();
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- siklus hidup

    @Override protected void onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected();
        instance = this;
        main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        speaker.addListener(speechListener);

        // Lazy-load Mesin LLM Offline: cek crash-guard tanpa memuat model berat saat startup
        localLlmEngine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        if (localLlmEngine.isModelPresent() && localLlmEngine.isSafeMode() && main != null) {
            main.postDelayed(() -> speaker.speakQueued("Model AI offline berada di Mode Aman karena terlalu berat untuk RAM. Kobra tetap aktif dengan perintah sistem lokal."), 3000L);
        }

        networkCallback = NetworkState.watch(this, online -> main.post(() -> {
            if (online) {
                String type = NetworkState.connectionType(this);
                say("Koneksi " + type + " tersambung. Fitur online aktif.");
            } else {
                say("Koneksi Wi-Fi dan data seluler terputus. Fitur dasar tetap jalan offline.");
            }
        }));
        registerBatteryMonitor();
        registerBluetoothMonitor();
        registerPhoneStateMonitor();
        productivity = new ProductivityManager(this);
        tripMonitor = new TripMonitorHelper(this);
        initTorch();
        initHardwareSensors();
        setupFloatingButton();

        if (config.isPrivacyMode()) {
            micOn = false;
            setIndicator(COLOR_OFF, "🔒");
            speaker.speak("Kobra OS aktif dalam Mode Privasi Penuh. Mikrofon dan kamera dimatikan. Ketuk tombol Kobra untuk mengaktifkan kembali.");
        } else {
            speaker.speak("Kobra OS aktif. Sebut kata Kobra lalu perintah. Bilang Kobra bantuan untuk daftar perintah.");
            main.postDelayed(this::startListening, 2000);
        }
        main.postDelayed(this::checkLowStorageOnStart, 8000);
        main.postDelayed(medicationCheckerTick, 30_000L);
        main.postDelayed(hourlyReminderTick, 20_000L);
        main.postDelayed(watchdog, WATCHDOG_MS);
    }

    @Override public void onAccessibilityEvent(AccessibilityEvent event) {
        if (event != null && event.getPackageName() != null
                && "com.google.android.youtube".equals(event.getPackageName().toString())
                && main != null) {
            main.postDelayed(() -> KobraAccessibilityService.tryConsumeYoutubeAutoPlay(
                    getRootInActiveWindow(), "com.google.android.youtube"), 900L);
        }
    }

    @Override public void onInterrupt() { stopMic(); }

    @Override public void onDestroy() {
        instance = null;
        stopMic();
        destroyRecognizer();
        cancelFallCountdown(false);
        EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
        SystemUtilityHelper.stopLocalAudio(this);
        removeScreenCurtain(false);
        removePocketGuard();
        if (tripMonitor != null && tripMonitor.isActive()) {
            tripMonitor.stop(false);
        }
        if (main != null) {
            main.removeCallbacks(medicationCheckerTick);
            main.removeCallbacks(hourlyReminderTick);
            for (ActiveTimer t : activeTimers) {
                if (t.task != null) main.removeCallbacks(t.task);
            }
            activeTimers.clear();
        }
        if (sensorManager != null) {
            sensorManager.unregisterListener(hardwareSensorListener);
        }
        NetworkState.unwatch(this, networkCallback);
        networkCallback = null;
        if (batteryReceiverRegistered) {
            try { unregisterReceiver(batteryReceiver); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            batteryReceiverRegistered = false;
        }
        if (bluetoothReceiverRegistered) {
            try { unregisterReceiver(bluetoothReceiver); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            bluetoothReceiverRegistered = false;
        }
        if (phoneStateReceiverRegistered) {
            try { unregisterReceiver(phoneStateReceiver); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            phoneStateReceiverRegistered = false;
        }
        if (localLlmEngine != null) {
            localLlmEngine.close();
            localLlmEngine = null;
        }
        try {
            if (windowManager != null && floatingButton != null) windowManager.removeView(floatingButton);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override protected boolean onKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (event == null || event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
            return super.onKeyEvent(event);
        }
        int code = event.getKeyCode();
        if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_HEADSETHOOK || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE) {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            if (EmergencyBeacon.isSirenActive()) {
                EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
                say("Sirine dimatikan.");
            } else {
                onFloatingClick();
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_VOLUME_DOWN) {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            if (code == lastVolumeKeyCode && now - lastVolumePressAt <= 450L) {
                lastVolumePressAt = 0L;
                HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
                if (EmergencyBeacon.isSirenActive()) {
                    EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
                    say("Sirine dimatikan.");
                } else {
                    onFloatingClick();
                }
                return true;
            }
            lastVolumeKeyCode = code;
            lastVolumePressAt = now;
        }
        return super.onKeyEvent(event);
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- mikrofon

    private final Speaker.Listener speechListener = new Speaker.Listener() {
        @Override public void onSpeechStart() {
            stopMic();
            setIndicator(COLOR_SPEAK, "🔊");
        }
        @Override public void onSpeechEnd() {
            if (config != null && config.isPrivacyMode()) {
                setIndicator(COLOR_OFF, "🔒");
                return;
            }
            setIndicator(micOn ? COLOR_IDLE : COLOR_OFF, micOn ? "🐍" : "🔇");
            scheduleRetry(350);
        }
    };

    private final Runnable watchdog = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (micOn && !listening && !pocketLocked && (config == null || !config.isPrivacyMode())
                    && speaker != null && !speaker.isSpeaking()) {
                startListening();
            }
            main.postDelayed(this, WATCHDOG_MS);
        }
    };

    private void startListening() {
        main.post(() -> {
            if (!micOn || listening || pocketLocked || (config != null && config.isPrivacyMode())
                    || speaker == null || speaker.isSpeaking()) return;
            if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)) {
                setIndicator(COLOR_NO_PERM, "🎤✖");
                if (!warnedNoPermission) {
                    warnedNoPermission = true;
                    speaker.speak("Izin mikrofon belum aktif. Buka aplikasi Kobra, lalu tekan Izin.");
                }
                return;
            }
            warnedNoPermission = false;
            if (!SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable(this)) {
                setIndicator(COLOR_NO_PERM, "🎤✖");
                speaker.speak("Layanan pengenalan suara tidak tersedia di HP ini. Pasang Google atau aplikasi pengenalan suara.");
                micOn = false;
                return;
            }
            if (recognizer == null) createRecognizer();
            try {
                recognizer.startListening(recognizerIntent);
                listening = true;
                setIndicator(COLOR_LISTEN, "🎤");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.w(TAG, "Gagal mulai mendengarkan", e);
                destroyRecognizer();
                scheduleRetry(2000);
            }
        });
    }

    private void stopMic() {
        if (recognizer != null && listening) {
            try { recognizer.cancel(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        }
        listening = false;
    }

    private void scheduleRetry(long ms) {
        main.postDelayed(this::startListening, ms);
    }

    private void createRecognizer() {
        recognizer = SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(this);
        recognizer.setRecognitionListener(recognitionListener);
        recognizerIntent = new Intent(RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH);
        recognizerIntent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE_MODEL, RecognizerIntent.LANGUAGE_MODEL_FREE_FORM);
        recognizerIntent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE, "id-ID");
        recognizerIntent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PARTIAL_RESULTS, false);
        recognizerIntent.putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_CALLING_PACKAGE, getPackageName());
    }

    private void destroyRecognizer() {
        listening = false;
        if (recognizer != null) {
            try { recognizer.destroy(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        }
        recognizer = null;
    }

    private final RecognitionListener recognitionListener = new RecognitionListener() {
        @Override public void onReadyForSpeech(Bundle params) { setIndicator(COLOR_LISTEN, "🎤"); }
        @Override public void onBeginningOfSpeech() { }
        @Override public void onRmsChanged(float rmsdB) { }
        @Override public void onBufferReceived(byte[] buffer) { }
        @Override public void onEndOfSpeech() { listening = false; }
        @Override public void onPartialResults(Bundle partialResults) { }
        @Override public void onEvent(int eventType, Bundle params) { }

        @Override public void onError(int error) {
            listening = false;
            switch (error) {
                case SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY:
                case SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_CLIENT:
                    destroyRecognizer();
                    scheduleRetry(1500);
                    break;
                case SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS:
                    setIndicator(COLOR_NO_PERM, "🎤✖");
                    break;
                case SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_NO_MATCH:
                case SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT:
                    scheduleRetry(300);
                    break;
                default:
                    scheduleRetry(1500);
                    break;
            }
        }

        @Override public void onResults(Bundle results) {
            listening = false;
            ArrayList<String> matches = results.getStringArrayList(SpeechRecognizer.RESULTS_RECOGNITION);
            if (matches != null && !matches.isEmpty()) handleSpoken(matches.get(0));
            if (!speaker.isSpeaking()) scheduleRetry(300);
        }
    };

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- tombol mengambang

    private void setupFloatingButton() {
        try {
            windowManager = (WindowManager) getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE);
            floatingButton = new Button(this);
            floatingButton.setTextSize(14f);
            floatingButton.setTextColor(0xFF000000);
            floatingButton.setContentDescription("Tombol Kobra. Ketuk untuk bicara. Tahan lama untuk mematikan mikrofon.");
            floatingButton.setOnClickListener(v -> onFloatingClick());
            floatingButton.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
                micOn = !micOn;
                if (micOn) {
                    speaker.speak("Mikrofon aktif.");
                    startListening();
                } else {
                    stopMic();
                    setIndicator(COLOR_OFF, "🔇");
                    speaker.speak("Mikrofon mati. Ketuk tombol Kobra untuk bicara.");
                }
                return true;
            });
            WindowManager.LayoutParams p = new WindowManager.LayoutParams(
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE,
                    PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT);
            p.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.END;
            p.x = 10;
            p.y = 300;
            windowManager.addView(floatingButton, p);
            setIndicator(COLOR_IDLE, "🐍");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Tombol mengambang gagal", e);
        }
    }

    private void onFloatingClick() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (EmergencyBeacon.isSirenActive()) {
            EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
            say("Sirine bahaya dimatikan.");
            return;
        }
        if (config != null && config.isPrivacyMode()) {
            exitPrivacyMode();
            return;
        }
        micOn = true;
        if (speaker.isSpeaking()) speaker.stop();
        speaker.speak("Ya, saya dengarkan.");
        scheduleRetry(200);
    }

    private void setIndicator(int color, String label) {
        if (main == null) return;
        main.post(() -> {
            if (floatingButton == null) return;
            floatingButton.setBackgroundColor(color);
            floatingButton.setText(label);
        });
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- pemrosesan ucapan

    private void handleSpoken(String raw) {
        String text = raw.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) return;

        if (pending != null) {
            Pending p = pending;
            if ("med_confirm".equals(p.kind) && stripWake(text) != null
                    && !containsWord(text, YES) && !containsWord(text, NO)
                    && !has(text, "sudah", "minum", "diminum", "nanti", "tunda")) {
                pending = null;
            } else {
                pending = null;
                if (!p.expired()) {
                    handlePending(p, text);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        if (calcMode && handleCalcUtterance(text)) {
            conversationUntil = System.currentTimeMillis() + CONVERSATION_WINDOW_MS;
            return;
        }

        String cmd = stripWake(text);
        if (cmd == null) {
            if (AiChatActivity.current != null) {
                AiChatActivity.current.onVoice(text);
                return;
            }
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() > conversationUntil) return;
            cmd = text;
        }
        conversationUntil = System.currentTimeMillis() + CONVERSATION_WINDOW_MS;
        route(cmd);
    }

    private static String stripWake(String s) {
        String[] wakes = {"kobra os", "kobra", "cobra", "kobro", "kobr"};
        for (String w : wakes) {
            int i = s.indexOf(w);
            if (i >= 0) return s.substring(i + w.length()).trim();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void handlePending(Pending p, String text) {
        boolean yes = containsWord(text, YES);
        boolean no = containsWord(text, NO);
        switch (p.kind) {
            case "sos":
                if (yes && !no) triggerSos();
                else say("SOS dibatalkan.");
                break;
            case "fall_sos":
                if (no || has(text, "aman", "baik", "hentikan", "stop", "salah")) {
                    cancelFallCountdown(true);
                } else if (yes) {
                    cancelFallCountdown(false);
                    triggerSos();
                } else {
                    pending = p;
                }
                break;
            case "call_pick": {
                if (no) { say("Panggilan dibatalkan."); break; }
                String[] names = p.a.split("\n");
                String[] nums = p.b.split("\n");
                Integer n = OfflineBrain.firstNumber(text);
                if (n != null && n >= 1 && n <= names.length) {
                    pending = new Pending("call", names[n - 1], nums[n - 1]);
                    say("Telepon " + names[n - 1] + "? Bilang iya untuk melanjutkan.");
                } else {
                    say("Pilihan tidak cocok. Panggilan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            }
            case "call":
                if (yes && !no) {
                    if (config.isLayeredConfirmEnabled()) {
                        pending = new Pending("call_layer2", p.a, p.b);
                        say("Konfirmasi kedua. Yakin menelepon " + p.a + "? Bilang lanjut atau iya untuk menghubungi.");
                    } else {
                        placeCall(p.a, p.b);
                    }
                } else {
                    say("Panggilan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            case "call_layer2":
                if (yes && !no) placeCall(p.a, p.b);
                else say("Panggilan dibatalkan.");
                break;
            case "msg_body":
                if (no) {
                    say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                } else {
                    pending = new Pending("msg_confirm", p.a, text);
                    say("Pesan untuk " + p.a + ": " + text + ". Bilang iya untuk mengirim.");
                }
                break;
            case "msg_confirm":
                if (yes && !no) {
                    if (config.isLayeredConfirmEnabled()) {
                        pending = new Pending("msg_confirm2", p.a, p.b);
                        say("Konfirmasi kedua. Yakin mengirim WhatsApp ke " + p.a + "? Bilang lanjut atau iya.");
                    } else {
                        sendWhatsApp(p.a, p.b);
                    }
                } else {
                    say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            case "msg_confirm2":
                if (yes && !no) sendWhatsApp(p.a, p.b);
                else say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                break;
            case "app_pick":
                pickApp(p, text);
                break;
            case "sms_body":
                if (no) {
                    say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                } else {
                    pending = new Pending("sms_confirm", p.a, text, p.b);
                    say("SMS untuk " + p.a + ": " + text + ". Bilang iya untuk mengirim.");
                }
                break;
            case "sms_confirm":
                if (yes && !no) {
                    if (config.isLayeredConfirmEnabled()) {
                        pending = new Pending("sms_confirm2", p.a, p.b, p.c);
                        say("Konfirmasi kedua. Yakin mengirim SMS ke " + p.a + "? Bilang lanjut atau iya.");
                    } else {
                        sendSmsMessage(p.a, p.c, p.b);
                    }
                } else {
                    say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            case "sms_confirm2":
                if (yes && !no) sendSmsMessage(p.a, p.c, p.b);
                else say("Pesan dibatalkan.");
                break;
            case "notif_reply_body":
                if (no) {
                    say("Balasan dibatalkan.");
                } else {
                    pending = new Pending("notif_reply_confirm", p.a, text);
                    say("Balasan untuk " + p.a + ": " + text + ". Bilang iya untuk mengirim.");
                }
                break;
            case "notif_reply_confirm":
                if (yes && !no) {
                    if (config.isLayeredConfirmEnabled()) {
                        pending = new Pending("notif_reply_confirm2", p.a, p.b);
                        say("Konfirmasi kedua. Yakin mengirim balasan ini ke " + p.a + "? Bilang lanjut atau iya.");
                    } else {
                        boolean ok = KobraNotificationService.replyToLast(this, p.b);
                        say(ok ? "Balasan suara terkirim ke " + p.a + "." : "Gagal mengirim balasan otomatis.");
                    }
                } else {
                    say("Balasan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            case "notif_reply_confirm2":
                if (yes && !no) {
                    boolean ok = KobraNotificationService.replyToLast(this, p.b);
                    say(ok ? "Balasan suara terkirim ke " + p.a + "." : "Gagal mengirim balasan otomatis.");
                } else {
                    say("Balasan dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            case "med_confirm":
                if (yes || has(text, "sudah", "minum", "diminum")) {
                    if (productivity != null) productivity.markMedicationTaken(p.a);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                    say("Bagus, obat " + p.b + " dicatat sudah diminum hari ini.");
                } else if (no || has(text, "nanti", "tunda")) {
                    say("Baik, jadwal obat " + p.b + " belum ditandai diminum.");
                } else {
                    say("Pengingat obat " + p.b + " belum dikonfirmasi. Bilang Kobra sudah diminum jika sudah.");
                }
                break;
            case "pin_verify_change": {
                if (no) {
                    say("Perubahan PIN dibatalkan.");
                    break;
                }
                String entered = SecurityAndPinHelper.extractPinDigits(text);
                if (config.verifySecurityPin(entered)) {
                    if ("clear".equals(p.a)) {
                        config.setSecurityPin("");
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                        say("PIN keamanan berhasil dihapus.");
                    } else {
                        config.setSecurityPin(p.b);
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                        say("PIN keamanan baru berhasil dipasang.");
                    }
                } else {
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(this);
                    say("PIN lama salah. Perubahan PIN dibatalkan.");
                }
                break;
            }
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    private static boolean containsWord(String text, Set<String> words) {
        for (String w : text.split("\\s+")) if (words.contains(w)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean word(String s, String w) {
        for (String t : s.split("\\s+")) if (t.equals(w)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean has(String s, String... keys) {
        for (String k : keys) if (s.contains(k)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static String after(String s, String keyword) {
        int i = s.indexOf(keyword);
        return i < 0 ? "" : s.substring(i + keyword.length()).trim();
    }

    private void route(String c) {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (c.isEmpty()) { say("Ya, saya dengarkan."); return; }

        // Bantuan dan kontrol suara & privasi
        if (has(c, "bantuan", "bisa apa", "daftar perintah")) { say(HELP); return; }
        if (has(c, "matikan sirine", "henti sirine", "hentikan sirine", "stop sirine", "matikan alarm bahaya")) {
            EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
            say("Sirine bahaya dan siaran darurat dimatikan.");
            return;
        }
        if (word(c, "diam") || has(c, "berhenti bicara", "hentikan suara")) {
            EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
            speaker.stop();
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "ulangi")) { say(lastSpoken); return; }
        if (has(c, "matikan mode privasi", "keluar mode privasi", "nonaktifkan privasi")) { exitPrivacyMode(); return; }
        if (has(c, "mode privasi penuh", "mode privasi", "privasi penuh", "putus kamera mikrofon", "matikan kamera dan mikrofon")) {
            enterPrivacyMode();
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "cek mikrofon", "status mikrofon")) { say(micOn ? "Mikrofon aktif." : "Mikrofon mati."); return; }
        if (has(c, "matikan mikrofon")) { micOn = false; stopMic(); setIndicator(COLOR_OFF, "🔇"); say("Mikrofon dimatikan."); return; }
        if (has(c, "nyalakan mikrofon", "hidupkan mikrofon")) { micOn = true; say("Mikrofon aktif."); return; }
        if (has(c, "talkback")) { handleTalkback(c); return; }

        // Pencari HP (Find My Phone) & Layar Hitam (Screen Curtain) & Mode Bertahan Hidup
        if (has(c, "kamu di mana", "kobra di mana", "posisi hp", "cari hp", "hp di mana")) {
            EmergencyBeacon.ringFindMyPhone(this, torchId, speaker);
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "buka layar", "matikan layar hitam", "tampilkan layar", "keluar layar hitam")) {
            removeScreenCurtain(true);
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "layar hitam", "mode layar hitam", "hemat layar", "tutup layar", "matikan tampilan")) {
            showScreenCurtain(true);
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "mode bertahan hidup", "hemat baterai ekstrem")) {
            enterSurvivalMode(true);
            return;
        }

        // Keselamatan darurat: Sirine bahaya, Latihan SOS, Kartu Medis, Kompas, Lokasi, Rute Pulang
        if (has(c, "sirine bahaya", "bunyikan sirine", "nyalakan sirine")) {
            say("Menyalakan sirine bahaya, senter Morse SOS, dan siaran darurat Bluetooth.");
            main.postDelayed(() -> EmergencyBeacon.startDangerSiren(this, torchId), 2000L);
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "latihan sos", "simulasi sos", "tes sos", "uji sos")) {
            triggerSosSimulation();
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "kartu medis", "identitas medis", "data medis", "baca kartu medis")) {
            openMedicalCardAndRead();
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "buka kompas")) {
            launch(CompassActivity.class, null);
            say("Membuka kompas suara dan penanda rute.");
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "kompas", "arah mata angin", "menghadap mana", "arah mana")) {
            speakCompassHeading();
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "saya di mana", "posisi saya", "lokasi saya sekarang", "alamat saya", "di mana saya")) {
            speakWhereAmI();
            return;
        }
        if (c.startsWith("simpan lokasi ") || c.startsWith("tandai lokasi ")
                || c.startsWith("simpan tempat ") || c.startsWith("tandai tempat ")) {
            String place = afterAny(c, "simpan lokasi ", "tandai lokasi ", "simpan tempat ", "tandai tempat ");
            saveCurrentFavoritePlace(place);
            return;
        }
        if (has(c, "arahkan pulang", "rute pulang", "jalan pulang", "pandu pulang")) {
            guideToFavoritePlace("Rumah");
            return;
        }
        if (c.startsWith("pandu ke ") || c.startsWith("tuntun ke ")) {
            String targetPlace = afterAny(c, "pandu ke ", "tuntun ke ");
            if (config.getFavoritePlace(targetPlace) != null) {
                guideToFavoritePlace(targetPlace);
                return;
            }
        }

        // Mode yang sedang terbuka
        if (VisionActivity.current != null) {
            if (has(c, "scan", "foto", "ambil gambar", "jepret")) {
                VisionActivity.current.captureNow();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "reset", "nolkan", "ulangi hitungan", "hapus hitungan")) {
                VisionActivity.current.resetCounter();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "ringkas", "rangkum")) {
                VisionActivity.current.summarizeLastResult();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "terjemah")) {
                String dst = TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN;
                if (c.contains("inggris")) dst = TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH;
                else if (c.contains("arab")) dst = TranslateLanguage.ARABIC;
                VisionActivity.current.translateLastResult(dst);
                return;
            }
        }
        if (DocumentReaderActivity.current != null) {
            if (has(c, "jeda", "pause", "berhenti", "stop")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.pauseReading(true);
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "lanjut", "putar", "mulai", "baca lagi")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.resumeReading();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "ulangi")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.repeatParagraph();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "berikutnya", "selanjutnya", "maju")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.nextParagraph();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "sebelumnya", "mundur")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.prevParagraph();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "ringkas", "rangkum")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.summarizeDocument();
                return;
            }
            if (has(c, "terjemah")) {
                DocumentReaderActivity.current.translateCurrentParagraph();
                return;
            }
        }
        if (NavigationActivity.current != null && has(c, "mulai")) { NavigationActivity.current.startNavigation(); return; }
        if (NavigationActivity.current != null && has(c, "berhenti", "stop")) { NavigationActivity.current.stopNavigation(); return; }

        // Mata Kedua: KTP, penghitung uang, padu padan baju, layar digital, struk, barcode, cari benda, terjemahan kamera, warna, orang, deskripsi
        if (has(c, "baca ktp", "baca kk", "ktp saya")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "ktp"); return; }
        if (has(c, "hitung uang", "hitung lembar uang", "penghitung uang", "jumlahkan uang")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "money_count"); return; }
        if (has(c, "baca uang", "uang berapa", "duit")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "money"); return; }
        if (has(c, "cocokkan baju", "cocokkan pakaian", "padu padan", "cek warna baju", "pakaian cocok")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "outfit"); return; }
        if (has(c, "baca layar digital", "layar digital", "baca layar atm", "baca timbangan", "baca perangkat lain", "layar perangkat")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "digital_screen"); return; }
        if (has(c, "pindai struk", "baca struk", "bukti transfer", "mutasi transfer", "screenshot transfer", "struk transfer")) { launch(VisionActivity.class, "receipt"); return; }
