                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
                        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
                        PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT);
                windowManager.addView(v, p);
                pocketGuardView = v;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private void removePocketGuard() {
        if (windowManager == null || pocketGuardView == null) return;
        main.post(() -> {
            try {
                if (pocketGuardView != null && windowManager != null) {
                    windowManager.removeView(pocketGuardView);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            pocketGuardView = null;
        });
    }

    private void showScreenCurtain(boolean announce) {
        if (windowManager == null) return;
        main.post(() -> {
            if (screenCurtainView == null) {
                try {
                    View v = new View(this);
                    v.setBackgroundColor(0xFF000000);
                    v.setContentDescription("Mode layar hitam hemat daya aktif. Ketuk dua kali untuk membuka layar.");
                    v.setOnClickListener(view -> {
                        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                        if (now - lastCurtainTapAt <= 500L) {
                            lastCurtainTapAt = 0L;
                            removeScreenCurtain(true);
                        } else {
                            lastCurtainTapAt = now;
                        }
                    });
                    WindowManager.LayoutParams p = new WindowManager.LayoutParams(
                            WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                            WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY,
                            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
                            PixelFormat.OPAQUE);
                    windowManager.addView(v, p);
                    screenCurtainView = v;
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            if (announce) {
                HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                say("Mode layar hitam hemat daya aktif. Ketuk layar dua kali atau bilang Kobra buka layar untuk menonaktifkan.");
            }
        });
    }

    private void removeScreenCurtain(boolean announce) {
        main.post(() -> {
            try {
                if (screenCurtainView != null && windowManager != null) {
                    windowManager.removeView(screenCurtainView);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            screenCurtainView = null;
            if (announce) {
                HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
                say("Layar ditampilkan kembali.");
            }
        });
    }

    private void enterPrivacyMode() {
        config.setPrivacyMode(true);
        micOn = false;
        stopMic();
        destroyRecognizer();
        EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
        if (VisionActivity.current != null) {
            try { VisionActivity.current.finish(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (NavigationActivity.current != null) {
            try { NavigationActivity.current.finish(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        setIndicator(COLOR_OFF, "🔒");
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
        say("Mode privasi penuh aktif. Mikrofon dan kamera telah diputus seketika. Ketuk tombol Kobra untuk mengaktifkan kembali.");
    }

    private void exitPrivacyMode() {
        config.setPrivacyMode(false);
        micOn = true;
        setIndicator(COLOR_IDLE, "🐍");
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
        say("Mode privasi dimatikan. Mikrofon dan kamera aktif kembali.");
        scheduleRetry(300);
    }

    private void enterSurvivalMode(boolean manual) {
        if (survivalModeActive && !manual) return;
        survivalModeActive = true;
        EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, torchId);
        if (localLlmEngine != null) {
            localLlmEngine.close();
        }
        showScreenCurtain(false);
        HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(this);
        say("Mode bertahan hidup aktif karena baterai sangat kritis. Senter, layar, dan pemrosesan berat dimatikan agar telepon dan SOS tetap siap.");
    }

    private void registerBluetoothMonitor() {
        try {
            IntentFilter filter = new IntentFilter();
            filter.addAction(BluetoothDevice.ACTION_ACL_CONNECTED);
            filter.addAction(BluetoothDevice.ACTION_ACL_DISCONNECTED);
            filter.addAction(AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY);
            filter.addAction(BluetoothHeadset.ACTION_CONNECTION_STATE_CHANGED);
            registerReceiver(bluetoothReceiver, filter);
            bluetoothReceiverRegistered = true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal mendaftarkan pemantau headset Bluetooth", e);
        }
    }

    private final BroadcastReceiver bluetoothReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
        @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
            if (intent == null || intent.getAction() == null) return;
            String action = intent.getAction();
            boolean connected = BluetoothDevice.ACTION_ACL_CONNECTED.equals(action);
            boolean disconnected = AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY.equals(action)
                    || BluetoothDevice.ACTION_ACL_DISCONNECTED.equals(action);
            if (BluetoothHeadset.ACTION_CONNECTION_STATE_CHANGED.equals(action)) {
                int state = intent.getIntExtra(BluetoothProfile.EXTRA_STATE, -1);
                connected = (state == BluetoothProfile.STATE_CONNECTED);
                disconnected = (state == BluetoothProfile.STATE_DISCONNECTED);
            }
            if (connected) {
                if (config != null && config.isAutoPrivateOnBt() && !btAutoPrivateActive) {
                    btAutoPrivateActive = true;
                    showScreenCurtain(false);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                    say("Headset Bluetooth tersambung. Mode privat otomatis aktif: layar ditutup agar isi layar tetap terjaga.");
                }
            } else if (disconnected) {
                if (btAutoPrivateActive) {
                    btAutoPrivateActive = false;
                    removeScreenCurtain(false);
                }
                HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                say("Perhatian, headset Bluetooth terputus. Suara dialihkan ke speaker HP.");
            }
        }
    };

    private void registerPhoneStateMonitor() {
        try {
            registerReceiver(phoneStateReceiver, new IntentFilter(TelephonyManager.ACTION_PHONE_STATE_CHANGED));
            phoneStateReceiverRegistered = true;
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal mendaftarkan pemantau telepon masuk", e);
        }
    }

    private final BroadcastReceiver phoneStateReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
        @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
            try {
                if (intent == null || !TelephonyManager.ACTION_PHONE_STATE_CHANGED.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
                String state = intent.getStringExtra(TelephonyManager.EXTRA_STATE);
                if (!TelephonyManager.EXTRA_STATE_RINGING.equals(state)) return;
                @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
                String incomingNumber = intent.getStringExtra(TelephonyManager.EXTRA_INCOMING_NUMBER);
                if (incomingNumber == null || incomingNumber.trim().isEmpty()) return;
                String cleanNum = incomingNumber.trim();
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (cleanNum.equals(lastAnnouncedRingNumber) && now - lastAnnouncedRingAt < 10_000L) return;
                lastAnnouncedRingNumber = cleanNum;
                lastAnnouncedRingAt = now;

                String callerName = cleanNum;
                if (Perms.has(AsistenAccessibilityService.this, Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) {
                    try (Cursor cur = getContentResolver().query(
                            Uri.withAppendedPath(ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI, Uri.encode(cleanNum)),
                            new String[]{ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)) {
                        if (cur != null && cur.moveToFirst()) {
                            String n = cur.getString(0);
                            if (n != null && !n.trim().isEmpty()) callerName = n.trim();
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
                if (speaker != null) {
                    speaker.speakQueued("Telepon masuk dari " + callerName + ". Bilang Kobra angkat telepon atau tolak telepon.");
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    };

    private final Runnable medicationCheckerTick = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (productivity != null && (config == null || !config.isPrivacyMode())) {
                ProductivityManager.MedSchedule due = productivity.findDueMedicationNow();
                if (due != null) {
                    String day = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd", Locale.US).format(new Date());
                    String key = day + "_" + due.id + "_" + due.hour + ":" + due.minute;
                    if (!key.equals(lastMedRemindedKey)) {
                        lastMedRemindedKey = key;
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                        pending = new Pending("med_confirm", due.id, due.name);
                        say("Pengingat minum obat! Waktunya minum " + due.name + ". Jika sudah diminum, bilang sudah diminum.");
                    }
                }
            }
            if (main != null) {
                main.postDelayed(this, 60_000L);
            }
        }
    };

    private final Runnable hourlyReminderTick = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (config != null && config.isHourlyReminderEnabled()
                    && !config.isPrivacyMode() && !survivalModeActive) {
                Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
                int hour = cal.get(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
                int minute = cal.get(Calendar.MINUTE);
                boolean quietHours = (hour >= 22 || hour < 5);
                if (!quietHours && minute <= 1) {
                    String key = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HH", Locale.US).format(new Date());
                    if (!key.equals(lastHourlyChimeKey)) {
                        lastHourlyChimeKey = key;
                        playGentleHourlyTone();
                        speaker.speakQueued(String.format(new Locale("id", "ID"),
                                "Sekarang pukul %02d:00. Jangan lupa minum air putih dan regangkan tubuh sejenak.", hour));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (main != null) {
                main.postDelayed(this, 30_000L);
            }
        }
    };

    private void playGentleHourlyTone() {
        try {
            ToneGenerator tg = new ToneGenerator(AudioManager.STREAM_NOTIFICATION, 55);
            tg.startTone(ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP2, 320);
            if (main != null) {
                main.postDelayed(() -> {
                    try { tg.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                }, 500L);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private boolean handleCalcUtterance(String text) {
        if (has(text, "keluar kalkulator", "tutup kalkulator", "selesai hitung", "berhenti hitung")) {
            calcMode = false;
            calcHasValue = false;
            say("Keluar dari mode kalkulator.");
            return true;
        }
        if (has(text, "reset", "nolkan", "hapus hitungan")) {
            calcAcc = 0.0;
            calcHasValue = false;
            say("Kalkulator direset ke nol.");
            return true;
        }
        if (stripWake(text) != null && OfflineBrain.calculate(stripWake(text)) == null) {
            return false;
        }
        Double direct = OfflineBrain.calculate(text);
        if (direct != null) {
            if (direct.isNaN()) {
                say("Tidak bisa dibagi dengan nol.");
                return true;
            }
            calcAcc = direct;
            calcHasValue = true;
            say("Hasilnya " + formatCalcResult(calcAcc) + ". Lanjutkan dengan tambah, kurang, kali, atau bagi.");
            return true;
        }
        if (calcHasValue) {
            String trimmed = text.trim();
            String prefix = "";
            if (trimmed.startsWith("tambah ") || trimmed.startsWith("ditambah ") || trimmed.startsWith("+")) prefix = "+ ";
            else if (trimmed.startsWith("kurang ") || trimmed.startsWith("dikurangi ") || trimmed.startsWith("-")) prefix = "- ";
            else if (trimmed.startsWith("kali ") || trimmed.startsWith("dikali ") || trimmed.startsWith("x")) prefix = "* ";
            else if (trimmed.startsWith("bagi ") || trimmed.startsWith("dibagi ") || trimmed.startsWith("/")) prefix = "/ ";
            if (!prefix.isEmpty()) {
                String rhs = trimmed.replaceFirst("^(tambah|ditambah|kurang|dikurangi|kali|dikali|bagi|dibagi|[+\\-*/x])\\s*", "");
                Double next = OfflineBrain.calculate(formatCalcResult(calcAcc) + " " + prefix + rhs);
                if (next != null) {
                    if (next.isNaN()) { say("Tidak bisa dibagi dengan nol."); return true; }
                    calcAcc = next;
                    say("Hasilnya " + formatCalcResult(calcAcc) + ".");
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String formatCalcResult(double v) {
        if (Math.abs(v - Math.rint(v)) < 1e-9) return String.valueOf((long) Math.rint(v));
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", v).replaceAll("0+$", "").replaceAll("\\.$", "");
    }

    private void handleVoiceExpense(String body) {
        List<Integer> nums = OfflineBrain.numbers(body);
        if (nums.isEmpty() || nums.get(0) <= 0) {
            say("Berapa nominal pengeluarannya? Contoh: Kobra catat pengeluaran 25000 makan siang.");
            return;
        }
        long amount = nums.get(0);
        String note = body.replaceAll("\\b\\d+\\b", "").trim();
        if (note.isEmpty()) note = "pengeluaran";
        productivity.addExpense(amount, note);
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
        say("Pengeluaran " + amount + " rupiah untuk " + note + " dicatat.");
    }

    private void handleVoiceAddMedication(String body) {
        List<Integer> nums = OfflineBrain.numbers(body);
        if (nums.isEmpty()) {
            say("Sebutkan nama obat dan jamnya. Contoh: Kobra tambah jadwal obat vitamin jam 7 tiga puluh.");
            return;
        }
        int hour = nums.get(0);
        int minute = nums.size() > 1 ? nums.get(1) : 0;
        if (has(body, "sore", "malam") && hour < 12) hour += 12;
        if (hour > 23 || minute > 59) {
            say("Jam jadwal obat tidak valid.");
            return;
        }
        String name = body.replaceAll("\\b(jam|pukul|pagi|siang|sore|malam|\\d+)\\b", " ").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (name.isEmpty()) name = "Obat";
        productivity.addMedSchedule(name, hour, minute);
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
        say(String.format(Locale.US, "Jadwal minum %s pukul %02d:%02d ditambahkan.", name, hour, minute));
    }

    private void speakOfflinePrayerTimes() {
        CompassLocationHelper.fetchCurrentLocation(this, new CompassLocationHelper.LocationCallback() {
            @Override public void onLocation(Location loc, String addressText) {
                config.setSavedLocation(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                PrayerTimesHelper.PrayerTimes pt = PrayerTimesHelper.calculateToday(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                say(pt.toSpeechString());
            }
            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                double lat = Double.isNaN(config.getSavedLat()) ? -6.2088 : config.getSavedLat();
                double lon = Double.isNaN(config.getSavedLon()) ? 106.8456 : config.getSavedLon();
                PrayerTimesHelper.PrayerTimes pt = PrayerTimesHelper.calculateToday(lat, lon);
                say(pt.toSpeechString());
            }
        });
    }

    private void speakOfflineQibla() {
        CompassLocationHelper.fetchCurrentLocation(this, new CompassLocationHelper.LocationCallback() {
            @Override public void onLocation(Location loc, String addressText) {
                config.setSavedLocation(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                announceQiblaFromCoords(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
            }
            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                double lat = Double.isNaN(config.getSavedLat()) ? -6.2088 : config.getSavedLat();
                double lon = Double.isNaN(config.getSavedLon()) ? 106.8456 : config.getSavedLon();
                announceQiblaFromCoords(lat, lon);
            }
        });
    }

    private void announceQiblaFromCoords(double lat, double lon) {
        int qibla = PrayerTimesHelper.computeQiblaBearing(lat, lon);
        CompassLocationHelper.readHeadingOnce(this, new CompassLocationHelper.HeadingCallback() {
            @Override public void onHeading(int degrees, String cardinalName) {
                int diff = ((qibla - degrees + 540) % 360) - 180;
                int abs = Math.abs(diff);
                if (abs <= 10) {
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                    say("Arah kiblat " + qibla + " derajat. Anda sudah tepat menghadap kiblat.");
                } else {
                    String turn = diff > 0 ? "putar ke kanan " + abs : "putar ke kiri " + abs;
                    say("Arah kiblat " + qibla + " derajat. Saat ini Anda menghadap " + degrees + " derajat, silakan " + turn + " derajat.");
                }
            }
            @Override public void onUnavailable() {
                say("Arah kiblat dari lokasi Anda adalah " + qibla + " derajat, " + CompassLocationHelper.cardinalDirection(qibla) + ".");
            }
        });
    }

    private void handleVoicePinChange(String rawPin, boolean clearPin) {
        if (!clearPin) {
            String digits = SecurityAndPinHelper.extractPinDigits(rawPin);
            if (!digits.matches("\\d{4,6}")) {
                say("PIN harus terdiri dari empat hingga enam angka. Contoh: Kobra atur PIN 1234.");
                return;
            }
            if (config.hasSecurityPin()) {
                pending = new Pending("pin_verify_change", "set", digits);
                say("Sebutkan PIN lama Anda terlebih dahulu untuk mengganti PIN.");
            } else {
                config.setSecurityPin(digits);
                HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                say("PIN keamanan baru berhasil dipasang.");
            }
        } else {
            if (!config.hasSecurityPin()) {
                say("Saat ini belum ada PIN keamanan yang dipasang.");
                return;
            }
            pending = new Pending("pin_verify_change", "clear", "");
            say("Sebutkan PIN Anda saat ini untuk menghapus kunci PIN.");
        }
    }

    private void registerBatteryMonitor() {
        try {
            registerReceiver(batteryReceiver, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED));
            batteryReceiverRegistered = true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal mendaftarkan pemantau baterai", e);
        }
    }

    private final BroadcastReceiver batteryReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
        @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
            if (intent == null || !Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
            int level = intent.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1);
            int scale = intent.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, 100);
            int status = intent.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_STATUS, -1);
            int tempTenths = intent.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_TEMPERATURE, 0);

            if (tempTenths >= 430) {
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (now - lastHotBatteryWarnAt > 600_000L) {
                    lastHotBatteryWarnAt = now;
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                    say("Peringatan suhu baterai panas, mencapai " + (tempTenths / 10) + " derajat Celsius. Kurangi pemakaian berat atau lepas pengisi daya.");
                }
            }

            if (level < 0 || scale <= 0) return;

            int percent = (level * 100) / scale;
            boolean charging = status == BatteryManager.BATTERY_STATUS_CHARGING
                    || status == BatteryManager.BATTERY_STATUS_FULL;

            if (charging) {
                warnedLow20 = false;
                warnedCritical10 = false;
                if (survivalModeActive) {
                    survivalModeActive = false;
                    removeScreenCurtain(false);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (percent < 5 && !survivalModeActive) {
                warnedCritical10 = true;
                warnedLow20 = true;
                enterSurvivalMode(false);
            } else if (percent < 10 && !warnedCritical10) {
                warnedCritical10 = true;
                warnedLow20 = true;
                HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                say("Peringatan baterai kritis, tersisa " + percent + " persen. Segera sambungkan pengisi daya.");
            } else if (percent < 20 && !warnedLow20) {
                warnedLow20 = true;
                HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(AsistenAccessibilityService.this);
                say("Peringatan baterai lemah, tersisa " + percent + " persen. Sebaiknya segera isi daya HP.");
            }
        }
    };

    private void checkLowStorageOnStart() {
        try {
            StatFs stat = new StatFs(getFilesDir().getAbsolutePath());
            long availBytes = stat.getAvailableBytes();
            if (availBytes < 1024L * 1024L * 1024L) {
                long mb = availBytes / (1024L * 1024L);
                HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(this);
                say("Peringatan penyimpanan internal di bawah satu gigabita, tersisa " + mb + " megabita. Kosongkan ruang agar sistem dan model AI tetap lancar.");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal memeriksa sisa penyimpanan", e);
        }
    }

    private void diagnoseSystem() {
        StringBuilder missingPerms = new StringBuilder();
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)) missingPerms.append("mikrofon, ");
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)) missingPerms.append("kamera, ");
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)) missingPerms.append("lokasi, ");
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) missingPerms.append("kontak, ");
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE)) missingPerms.append("telepon, ");
        if (!Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.SEND_SMS)) missingPerms.append("SMS, ");

        String permReport = missingPerms.length() == 0
                ? "Semua izin utama aktif"
                : "Izin yang belum aktif: " + missingPerms.substring(0, missingPerms.length() - 2);

        String notifReport = KobraNotificationService.isConnected()
                ? "Akses notifikasi aktif"
                : "Akses notifikasi belum aktif";

        LocalLlmEngine llm = getLocalLlmEngine();
        String aiReport;
        if (llm != null && llm.isInitialized()) {
            aiReport = "Model AI offline Gemma 3 aktif";
        } else if (llm != null && llm.isModelPresent()) {
            aiReport = "AI offline dalam Mode Aman karena " + (llm.getLastError().isEmpty() ? "belum dimuat" : llm.getLastError());
        } else {
            aiReport = "Model AI offline belum diimpor, Mode Aman aktif";
        }

        String netType = NetworkState.connectionType(this);
        String netReport = NetworkState.isOnline(this)
                ? "Internet tersambung melalui " + netType
                : "Internet terputus, mode offline";

        BatteryManager bm = (BatteryManager) getSystemService(BATTERY_SERVICE);
        int bat = batteryPercent();
        boolean charging = bm != null && bm.isCharging();
        String batReport = bat >= 0
                ? "Baterai " + bat + " persen" + (charging ? " dan sedang mengisi daya" : "")
                : "Status baterai tidak terbaca";

        String storageReport;
        try {
            StatFs stat = new StatFs(getFilesDir().getAbsolutePath());
            long freeMb = stat.getAvailableBytes() / (1024L * 1024L);
            if (freeMb >= 1024) {
                storageReport = String.format(new Locale("id", "ID"), "Sisa penyimpanan %.1f gigabita", freeMb / 1024.0);
            } else {
                storageReport = "Peringatan, sisa penyimpanan rendah " + freeMb + " megabita";
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            storageReport = "Penyimpanan tidak terbaca";
        }

        String sosReport = config.hasSosContact()
                ? "Kontak darurat SOS sudah diatur"
                : "Kontak darurat SOS belum diatur, bawaan menghubungi 112";

        say("Laporan diagnostik sistem Kobra OS. "
                + permReport + ". "
                + notifReport + ". "
                + aiReport + ". "
                + netReport + ". "
                + batReport + ". "
                + storageReport + ". "
                + sosReport + ".");
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.appcompat.widget.SwitchCompat;

/**
 * Mode Pendamping (Caregiver Mode): antarmuka standar keluarga untuk mengatur PIN keamanan,
 * konfirmasi berlapis, mode privat Bluetooth, deteksi jatuh, jadwal obat, serta akses cepat SOS & cadangan data.
 */
public class CaregiverActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    public static final String EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED = "pin_unlocked";

    private KobraConfig config;
    private ProductivityManager productivity;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();

    private View rootView;
    private TextView tvPinStatus, tvCareMedList, tvCareSummary;
    private EditText etNewPin, etCareMedName, etCareMedTime;
    private SwitchCompat swLayeredConfirm, swAutoPrivateBt, swCareFall, swCarePocket;

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_caregiver);

        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        productivity = new ProductivityManager(this);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);

        rootView = findViewById(R.id.caregiverRoot);
        tvPinStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvPinStatus);
        tvCareMedList = findViewById(R.id.tvCareMedList);
        tvCareSummary = findViewById(R.id.tvCareSummary);

        etNewPin = findViewById(R.id.etNewPin);
        etCareMedName = findViewById(R.id.etCareMedName);
        etCareMedTime = findViewById(R.id.etCareMedTime);

        swLayeredConfirm = findViewById(R.id.swLayeredConfirm);
        swAutoPrivateBt = findViewById(R.id.swAutoPrivateBt);
        swCareFall = findViewById(R.id.swCareFall);
        swCarePocket = findViewById(R.id.swCarePocket);

        if (config.hasSecurityPin() && !getIntent().getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, false)) {
            rootView.setVisibility(View.INVISIBLE);
            SecurityAndPinHelper.requirePinIfSet(this, config, speaker, "Mode Pendamping",
                    new SecurityAndPinHelper.PinCallback() {
                        @Override public void onUnlocked() {
                            rootView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                            initUi();
                        }
                        @Override public void onCancelled() {
                            finish();
                        }
                    });
        } else {
            initUi();
        }
    }

    private void initUi() {
        swLayeredConfirm.setChecked(config.isLayeredConfirmEnabled());
        swAutoPrivateBt.setChecked(config.isAutoPrivateOnBt());
        swCareFall.setChecked(config.isFallDetectionEnabled());
        swCarePocket.setChecked(config.isPocketLockEnabled());

        swLayeredConfirm.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, v) -> config.setLayeredConfirmEnabled(v));
        swAutoPrivateBt.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, v) -> config.setAutoPrivateOnBt(v));
        swCareFall.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, v) -> config.setFallDetectionEnabled(v));
        swCarePocket.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, v) -> config.setPocketLockEnabled(v));

        findViewById(R.id.btnSetPin).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String pin = etNewPin.getText().toString().trim();
            if (!pin.matches("\\d{4,6}")) {
                toast("PIN harus 4 hingga 6 angka.");
                return;
            }
            config.setSecurityPin(pin);
            etNewPin.setText("");
            refreshSummary();
            toast("PIN keamanan disimpan.");
            speaker.speak("PIN keamanan berhasil dipasang.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnRemovePin).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            config.setSecurityPin("");
            refreshSummary();
            toast("PIN keamanan dihapus.");
            speaker.speak("Kunci PIN keamanan dinonaktifkan.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareAddMed).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String name = etCareMedName.getText().toString().trim();
            String time = etCareMedTime.getText().toString().trim();
            if (name.isEmpty() || !time.matches("\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}")) {
                toast("Isi nama obat dan jam (contoh: 08:00).");
                return;
            }
            String[] p = time.split(":");
            int h = Integer.parseInt(p[0]);
            int m = Integer.parseInt(p[1]);
            if (h > 23 || m > 59) {
                toast("Format jam tidak valid.");
                return;
            }
            productivity.addMedSchedule(name, h, m);
            etCareMedName.setText("");
            etCareMedTime.setText("");
            refreshSummary();
            toast("Jadwal obat ditambahkan.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareRemoveMed).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            productivity.removeMedSchedule(0);
            refreshSummary();
            toast("Jadwal obat pertama dihapus.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareClearMemos).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            productivity.clearMemos();
            refreshSummary();
            toast("Semua memo dibersihkan.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareClearExpenses).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            productivity.clearExpenses();
            refreshSummary();
            toast("Catatan pengeluaran direset.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareSos).setOnClickListener(v ->
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this,
                        new Intent(this, SosSetupActivity.class).putExtra(EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, true),
                        speaker, "Gagal membuka Kontak Darurat SOS."));

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareMedCard).setOnClickListener(v ->
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this,
                        new Intent(this, MedicalCardActivity.class).putExtra(EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, true),
                        speaker, "Gagal membuka Kartu Medis."));

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareSettings).setOnClickListener(v ->
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this,
                        new Intent(this, SettingsActivity.class).putExtra(EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, true),
                        speaker, "Gagal membuka Pengaturan AI."));

        findViewById(R.id.btnCareBack).setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        refreshSummary();
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (rootView != null && rootView.getVisibility() == View.VISIBLE) {
            refreshSummary();
        }
    }

    private void refreshSummary() {
        tvPinStatus.setText(config.hasSecurityPin()
                ? "Status PIN: AKTIF (" + config.getSecurityPin().length() + " digit mengunci menu sensitif)"
                : "Status PIN: Belum diatur (menu sensitif terbuka tanpa PIN)");
        tvCareMedList.setText(productivity.listMedSchedulesSpeech());
        tvCareSummary.setText(
                productivity.readMemos(3) + "\n\n"
                        + productivity.listAllItems() + "\n\n"
                        + productivity.getExpenseSummary());
    }

    private void toast(String msg) {
        Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.hardware.Sensor;
import android.hardware.SensorEvent;
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener;
import android.hardware.SensorManager;
import android.location.Location;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Kompas Suara Offline (Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR), pembaca alamat GPS (LocationManager + Geocoder),
 * serta penyimpan dan pemandu arah jarum jam menuju lokasi favorit (Rumah, Masjid, dll.).
 */
public class CompassActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements SensorEventListener {

    private SensorManager sensorManager;
    private Sensor rotationSensor;
    private TextView tvHeading, tvLocationResult, tvSavedPlaces;
    private EditText etPlaceLabel;
    private KobraConfig config;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private int currentHeading = -1;
    private String currentCardinal = "";

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_compass);

        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        try {
            sensorManager = (SensorManager) getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE);
            if (sensorManager != null) {
                rotationSensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR);
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            rotationSensor = null;
        }

        tvHeading = findViewById(R.id.tvCompassHeading);
        tvLocationResult = findViewById(R.id.tvLocationResult);
        tvSavedPlaces = findViewById(R.id.tvSavedPlaces);
        etPlaceLabel = findViewById(R.id.etPlaceLabel);

        if (rotationSensor == null) {
            tvHeading.setText("Sensor kompas tidak tersedia di HP ini.");
        }

        findViewById(R.id.btnSpeakCompass).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            if (currentHeading >= 0) {
                speaker.speak("Anda menghadap " + currentCardinal + ", " + currentHeading + " derajat.");
            } else {
                speaker.speak("Sensor kompas belum siap atau tidak tersedia di HP ini.");
            }
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnWhereAmI).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            tvLocationResult.setText("Mencari koordinat GPS saat ini...");
            speaker.speak("Mencari lokasi Anda sekarang.");
            CompassLocationHelper.fetchCurrentLocation(this, new CompassLocationHelper.LocationCallback() {
                @Override public void onLocation(Location loc, String addressText) {
                    String msg;
                    if (!addressText.isEmpty()) {
                        msg = "Anda berada di sekitar " + addressText + ". Akurasi " + Math.round(loc.getAccuracy()) + " meter.";
                    } else {
                        msg = String.format(Locale.US, "Koordinat Anda: lintang %.5f, bujur %.5f.", loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                    }
                    tvLocationResult.setText(msg);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(msg);
                }
                @Override public void onError(String message) {
                    tvLocationResult.setText(message);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(message);
                }
            });
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnSavePlace).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            String label = etPlaceLabel.getText().toString().trim();
            if (label.isEmpty()) label = "Rumah";
            final String placeName = label;
            tvLocationResult.setText("Menyimpan koordinat untuk " + placeName + "...");
            CompassLocationHelper.fetchCurrentLocation(this, new CompassLocationHelper.LocationCallback() {
                @Override public void onLocation(Location loc, String addressText) {
                    config.saveFavoritePlace(placeName, loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude());
                    refreshSavedPlaces();
                    String msg = "Lokasi " + placeName + " berhasil disimpan."
                            + (addressText.isEmpty() ? "" : " Sekitar " + addressText + ".");
                    tvLocationResult.setText(msg);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(msg);
                }
                @Override public void onError(String message) {
                    tvLocationResult.setText(message);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(message);
                }
            });
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnGuidePlace).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            String label = etPlaceLabel.getText().toString().trim();
            if (label.isEmpty()) label = "Rumah";
            double[] coords = config.getFavoritePlace(label);
            if (coords == null) {
                String msg = "Lokasi " + label + " belum disimpan. Simpan koordinat dulu di sini atau lewat suara.";
                tvLocationResult.setText(msg);
                speaker.speak(msg);
                return;
            }
            String resolvedLabel = config.getFavoritePlaceLabel(label);
            tvLocationResult.setText("Menghitung jarak dan arah ke " + resolvedLabel + "...");
            CompassLocationHelper.fetchCurrentLocation(this, new CompassLocationHelper.LocationCallback() {
                @Override public void onLocation(Location loc, String addressText) {
                    String guide = CompassLocationHelper.buildRouteGuidance(
                            resolvedLabel, loc, coords[0], coords[1], currentHeading);
                    tvLocationResult.setText(guide);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(guide);
                }
                @Override public void onError(String message) {
                    tvLocationResult.setText(message);
                    HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(CompassActivity.this);
                    speaker.speak(message);
                }
            });
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnBackCompass).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            finish();
        });

        refreshSavedPlaces();
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        try {
            if (sensorManager != null && rotationSensor != null) {
                sensorManager.registerListener(this, rotationSensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI);
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            if (tvHeading != null) tvHeading.setText("Izin atau akses sensor kompas dibatasi.");
        }
        refreshSavedPlaces();
    }

    @Override protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        try {
            if (sensorManager != null) {
                sensorManager.unregisterListener(this);
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    @Override public void onSensorChanged(SensorEvent event) {
        try {
            if (event == null || event.sensor == null
                    || event.sensor.getType() != Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR
                    || event.values == null || event.values.length < 3) {
                return;
            }
            currentHeading = CompassLocationHelper.rotationVectorToDegrees(event.values);
            currentCardinal = CompassLocationHelper.cardinalDirection(currentHeading);
            if (tvHeading != null) {
                tvHeading.setText(currentCardinal + " (" + currentHeading + "°)");
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    @Override public void onAccuracyChanged(Sensor sensor, int accuracy) {}

    private void refreshSavedPlaces() {
        List<String> places = config.listFavoritePlaceLabels();
        if (places.isEmpty()) {
            tvSavedPlaces.setText("Lokasi tersimpan: belum ada");
        } else {
            tvSavedPlaces.setText("Lokasi tersimpan: " + String.join(", ", places));
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }
}

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/CompassLocationHelper.java

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Context;
import android.hardware.Sensor;
import android.hardware.SensorEvent;
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener;
import android.hardware.SensorManager;
import android.location.Address;
import android.location.Geocoder;
import android.location.Location;
import android.location.LocationListener;
import android.location.LocationManager;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Pembantu kompas suara offline (Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR), penentuan alamat GPS (Geocoder),
 * serta panduan jarak dan arah jarum jam menuju lokasi favorit (Rumah, Masjid, dll.).
 */
public final class CompassLocationHelper {

    public interface HeadingCallback {
        void onHeading(int degrees, String cardinalName);
        void onUnavailable();
    }

    public interface LocationCallback {
        void onLocation(Location location, String addressText);
        void onError(String message);
    }

    private CompassLocationHelper() {}

    public static String cardinalDirection(int deg) {
        int d = ((deg % 360) + 360) % 360;
        if (d >= 338 || d < 23) return "Utara";
        if (d < 68) return "Timur Laut";
        if (d < 113) return "Timur";
        if (d < 158) return "Tenggara";
        if (d < 203) return "Selatan";
        if (d < 248) return "Barat Daya";
        if (d < 293) return "Barat";
        return "Barat Laut";
    }

    /** Mengonversi sudut relatif (-180..180 atau 0..360) menjadi arah jarum jam 1..12. */
    public static int toClockHour(float relativeBearingDeg) {
        float norm = ((relativeBearingDeg % 360f) + 360f) % 360f;
        int hour = Math.round(norm / 30f);
        if (hour == 0 || hour == 12) return 12;
        return hour;
    }

    /** Membaca kompas sekali lewat Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR secara offline. */
    public static void readHeadingOnce(Context context, HeadingCallback callback) {
        if (callback == null) return;
        if (context == null) {
            callback.onUnavailable();
            return;
        }
        try {
            SensorManager sm = (SensorManager) context.getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE);
            if (sm == null) {
                callback.onUnavailable();
                return;
            }
            Sensor rot = sm.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR);
            if (rot == null) {
                callback.onUnavailable();
                return;
            }
            Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
            final boolean[] delivered = {false};
            SensorEventListener listener = new SensorEventListener() {
                @Override public void onSensorChanged(SensorEvent event) {
                    try {
                        if (delivered[0] || event == null || event.sensor == null
                                || event.sensor.getType() != Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR
                                || event.values == null || event.values.length < 3) {
                            return;
                        }
                        delivered[0] = true;
                        try { sm.unregisterListener(this); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                        int deg = rotationVectorToDegrees(event.values);
                        callback.onHeading(deg, cardinalDirection(deg));
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                        if (!delivered[0]) {
                            delivered[0] = true;
                            try { sm.unregisterListener(this); } catch (Throwable ignored2) {}
                            callback.onUnavailable();
                        }
                    }
                }
                @Override public void onAccuracyChanged(Sensor sensor, int accuracy) {}
            };
            boolean registered = sm.registerListener(listener, rot, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI);
            if (!registered) {
                callback.onUnavailable();
                return;
            }
            main.postDelayed(() -> {
                if (!delivered[0]) {
                    delivered[0] = true;
                    try { sm.unregisterListener(listener); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                    callback.onUnavailable();
                }
            }, 1800L);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            callback.onUnavailable();
        }
    }

    public static int rotationVectorToDegrees(float[] values) {
        if (values == null || values.length < 3) return 0;
        try {
            float[] rotationMatrix = new float[9];
            float[] orientation = new float[3];
            SensorManager.getRotationMatrixFromVector(rotationMatrix, values);
            SensorManager.getOrientation(rotationMatrix, orientation);
            int deg = (int) Math.round(Math.toDegrees(orientation[0]));
            return ((deg % 360) + 360) % 360;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    /** Mengambil lokasi terbaik (atau permintaan GPS aktif) dan menerjemahkan ke alamat via Geocoder. */
    public static void fetchCurrentLocation(Context context, LocationCallback callback) {
        if (!Perms.has(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
                && !Perms.has(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)) {
            callback.onError("Izin lokasi belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Beri Izin.");
            return;
        }
        LocationManager lm = (LocationManager) context.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE);
        if (lm == null) {
            callback.onError("Layanan lokasi tidak tersedia di HP ini.");
            return;
        }

        Location best = getBestLastKnown(lm);
        if (best != null && (System.currentTimeMillis() - best.getTime() < 90_000L)) {
            resolveAddressAsync(context, best, callback);
            return;
        }

        Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        final boolean[] done = {false};
        LocationListener oneShot = new LocationListener() {
            @Override public void onLocationChanged(Location location) {
                if (done[0]) return;
                done[0] = true;
                try { lm.removeUpdates(this); } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
                resolveAddressAsync(context, location, callback);
            }
            @Override public void onStatusChanged(String provider, int status, Bundle extras) {}
            @Override public void onProviderEnabled(String provider) {}
            @Override public void onProviderDisabled(String provider) {}
        };

        boolean requested = false;
        try {
            if (lm.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)) {
                lm.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 0, 0, oneShot, Looper.getMainLooper());
                requested = true;
            }
            if (lm.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)) {
                lm.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, 0, 0, oneShot, Looper.getMainLooper());
                requested = true;
            }
        } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}

        if (!requested) {
            if (best != null) resolveAddressAsync(context, best, callback);
            else callback.onError("GPS atau lokasi HP belum dinyalakan.");
            return;
        }

        main.postDelayed(() -> {
            if (done[0]) return;
            done[0] = true;
            try { lm.removeUpdates(oneShot); } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
            Location fallback = getBestLastKnown(lm);
            if (fallback != null) resolveAddressAsync(context, fallback, callback);
            else callback.onError("Sinyal GPS belum ditemukan. Coba di area yang lebih terbuka.");
        }, 5000L);
    }

    public static Location getBestLastKnown(LocationManager lm) {
        Location best = null;
        for (String provider : new String[]{LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER}) {
            try {
                Location l = lm.getLastKnownLocation(provider);
                if (l != null && (best == null || l.getTime() > best.getTime())) best = l;
            } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
        }
        return best;
    }

    private static void resolveAddressAsync(Context context, Location loc, LocationCallback callback) {
        Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        new Thread(() -> {
            String addrText = "";
            if (Geocoder.isPresent()) {
                try {
                    Geocoder geocoder = new Geocoder(context.getApplicationContext(), new Locale("id", "ID"));
                    List<Address> list = geocoder.getFromLocation(loc.getLatitude(), loc.getLongitude(), 1);
                    if (list != null && !list.isEmpty()) {
                        Address a = list.get(0);
                        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                        if (a.getThoroughfare() != null) sb.append(a.getThoroughfare()).append(", ");
                        if (a.getSubLocality() != null) sb.append(a.getSubLocality()).append(", ");
                        if (a.getLocality() != null) sb.append(a.getLocality()).append(", ");
                        if (a.getSubAdminArea() != null) sb.append(a.getSubAdminArea());
                        addrText = sb.toString().replaceAll(", $", "").trim();
                        if (addrText.isEmpty() && a.getAddressLine(0) != null) {
                            addrText = a.getAddressLine(0);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            final String finalAddr = addrText;
            main.post(() -> callback.onLocation(loc, finalAddr));
        }).start();
    }

    /** Menghitung panduan jarak meter dan arah jarum jam menuju koordinat tujuan. */
    public static String buildRouteGuidance(String placeLabel, Location current, double targetLat, double targetLon, int currentHeadingDeg) {
        Location dest = new Location("kobra_fav");
        dest.setLatitude(targetLat);
        dest.setLongitude(targetLon);

        long meters = Math.round(current.distanceTo(dest));
        float targetBearing = current.bearingTo(dest); // -180..180 from North
        int targetDeg = Math.round(((targetBearing % 360f) + 360f) % 360f);
        String cardinal = cardinalDirection(targetDeg);

        if (meters <= 15) {
            return "Anda sudah sangat dekat dengan " + placeLabel + ", berjarak sekitar " + meters + " meter.";
        }

        if (currentHeadingDeg >= 0) {
            float rel = targetBearing - currentHeadingDeg;
            int clockHour = toClockHour(rel);
            return placeLabel + " berjarak " + meters + " meter, di arah jam " + clockHour
                    + " Anda (arah " + cardinal + ").";
        }
        return placeLabel + " berjarak " + meters + " meter ke arah " + cardinal + " (" + targetDeg + " derajat).";
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipboardManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

/**
 * Layar pemulihan ringan ketika terjadi uncaught exception di aplikasi.
 * Menampilkan penyebab error serta menyediakan tombol Salin Log Error dan Kembali ke Beranda.
 */
public class CrashRecoveryActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    public static final String EXTRA_CRASH_SUMMARY = "extra_crash_summary";
    public static final String EXTRA_CRASH_LOG = "extra_crash_log";

    private String fullLog = "";

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_crash_recovery);

        if (getSupportActionBar() != null) {
            getSupportActionBar().setTitle("Pemulihan Kobra OS");
        }

        TextView tvSummary = findViewById(R.id.tvCrashSummary);
        TextView tvDetails = findViewById(R.id.tvCrashDetails);
        Button btnCopy = findViewById(R.id.btnCopyCrashLog);
        Button btnHome = findViewById(R.id.btnReturnHome);

        String summary = getIntent() != null ? getIntent().getStringExtra(EXTRA_CRASH_SUMMARY) : null;
        String passedLog = getIntent() != null ? getIntent().getStringExtra(EXTRA_CRASH_LOG) : null;
        if (passedLog == null || passedLog.trim().isEmpty()) {
            try {
                passedLog = new KobraConfig(this).getLastCrashLog();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        fullLog = (passedLog != null && !passedLog.trim().isEmpty())
                ? passedLog
                : "Tidak ada detail stacktrace yang tersimpan.";

        if (summary == null || summary.trim().isEmpty()) {
            summary = "Terjadi error tak terduga. Silakan lihat log di bawah atau kembali ke beranda.";
        }

        if (tvSummary != null) tvSummary.setText(summary);
        if (tvDetails != null) tvDetails.setText(fullLog);

        try {
            Speaker.get(this).speak("Kobra OS mengalami kendala tak terduga dan membuka layar pemulihan. Tekan Kembali ke Beranda atau Salin Log Error.");
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

        if (btnCopy != null) {
            btnCopy.setOnClickListener(v -> copyLog());
        }
        if (btnHome != null) {
            btnHome.setOnClickListener(v -> returnHome());
        }
    }

    private void copyLog() {
        try {
            ClipboardManager cm = (ClipboardManager) getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE);
            if (cm != null) {
                cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("KobraCrashLog", fullLog));
                Toast.makeText(this, "Log error disalin ke clipboard.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                try {
                    Speaker.get(this).speak("Log error berhasil disalin.");
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Gagal menyalin log: " + t.getMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
    }

    private void returnHome() {
        try {
            Intent i = new Intent(this, MainActivity.class);
            i.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
            startActivity(i);
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        finish();
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.accessibilityservice.GestureDescription;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.util.DisplayMetrics;

/** Gestur layar lewat layanan aksesibilitas: geser dan ketuk di posisi relatif layar. */
public final class DeviceControl {
    private DeviceControl() {}

    /** Arah adalah arah gerak jari: kiri, kanan, atas, atau bawah. */
    public static boolean swipe(AccessibilityService s, String direction) {
        DisplayMetrics dm = s.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        float w = dm.widthPixels, h = dm.heightPixels;
        float x1 = w / 2f, y1 = h / 2f, x2 = x1, y2 = y1;
        switch (direction) {
            case "kiri": x1 = w * 0.8f; x2 = w * 0.2f; break;
            case "kanan": x1 = w * 0.2f; x2 = w * 0.8f; break;
            case "atas": y1 = h * 0.7f; y2 = h * 0.3f; break;
            case "bawah": y1 = h * 0.3f; y2 = h * 0.7f; break;
            default: return false;
        }
        Path p = new Path();
        p.moveTo(x1, y1);
        p.lineTo(x2, y2);
        return dispatch(s, p, 320);
    }

    /** fx dan fy antara 0 dan 1 (posisi relatif layar). */
    public static boolean tap(AccessibilityService s, float fx, float fy, long durationMs) {
        DisplayMetrics dm = s.getResources().getDisplayMetrics();
        Path p = new Path();
        p.moveTo(dm.widthPixels * fx, dm.heightPixels * fy);
        return dispatch(s, p, durationMs);
    }

    private static boolean dispatch(AccessibilityService s, Path path, long duration) {
        try {
            GestureDescription g = new GestureDescription.Builder()
                    .addStroke(new GestureDescription.StrokeDescription(path, 0, duration))
                    .build();
            return s.dispatchGesture(g, null, null);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

/**
 * Pembaca dokumen .txt dan PDF (menggunakan Android PdfRenderer + ML Kit OCR)
 * dengan kontrol suara & tombol jeda, lanjut, ulangi paragraf, ringkasan Gemma 3, dan terjemahan offline.
 */
public class DocumentReaderActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    static volatile DocumentReaderActivity current;

    private TextView tvStatus, tvParagraph;
    private Button btnPlayPause;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private AiClient aiClient;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final List<String> paragraphs = new ArrayList<>();
    private int currentIndex = 0;
    private boolean isPlaying = false;
    private boolean awaitingParagraphEnd = false;

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> docPickerLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                if (uri != null) {
                    loadDocument(uri);
                }
            });

    private final Speaker.Listener speechListener = new Speaker.Listener() {
        @Override public void onSpeechStart() {}
        @Override public void onSpeechEnd() {
            if (isPlaying && awaitingParagraphEnd) {
                awaitingParagraphEnd = false;
                main.postDelayed(() -> {
                    if (!isPlaying) return;
                    if (currentIndex + 1 < paragraphs.size()) {
                        currentIndex++;
                        speakCurrentParagraph();
                    } else {
                        isPlaying = false;
                        updatePlayButton();
                        tvStatus.setText("Pembacaan dokumen selesai (" + paragraphs.size() + " paragraf).");
                        speaker.speak("Pembacaan dokumen selesai.");
                    }
                }, 250L);
            }
        }
    };

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_document_reader);

        tvStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvDocStatus);
        tvParagraph = findViewById(R.id.tvDocParagraph);
        btnPlayPause = findViewById(R.id.btnDocPlayPause);

        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        aiClient = new AiClient(new KobraConfig(this));
        speaker.addListener(speechListener);

        findViewById(R.id.btnPickDocument).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            pauseReading(false);
            speaker.speak("Membuka pemilih dokumen. Pilih file teks atau PDF.");
            try {
                docPickerLauncher.launch(new String[]{"text/plain", "application/pdf", "*/*"});
            } catch (Exception e) {
                speaker.speak("Gagal membuka pemilih dokumen di HP ini.");
            }
        });

        btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> togglePlayPause());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocNext).setOnClickListener(v -> nextParagraph());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocPrev).setOnClickListener(v -> prevParagraph());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocRepeat).setOnClickListener(v -> repeatParagraph());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocSummarize).setOnClickListener(v -> summarizeDocument());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocTranslate).setOnClickListener(v -> translateCurrentParagraph());
        findViewById(R.id.btnDocBack).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            pauseReading(false);
            finish();
        });

        speaker.speak("Pembaca dokumen siap. Tekan Pilih Dokumen untuk membuka file teks atau PDF.");
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        current = this;
    }

    @Override protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        if (current == this) current = null;
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        isPlaying = false;
        awaitingParagraphEnd = false;
        speaker.removeListener(speechListener);
        executor.shutdown();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    public void togglePlayPause() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen yang dimuat.");
            return;
        }
        if (isPlaying) {
            pauseReading(true);
        } else {
            resumeReading();
        }
    }

    public void pauseReading(boolean announce) {
        isPlaying = false;
        awaitingParagraphEnd = false;
        speaker.stop();
        updatePlayButton();
        if (announce) {
            tvStatus.setText("Dijeda pada paragraf " + (currentIndex + 1) + " dari " + paragraphs.size());
            speaker.speak("Dijeda.");
        }
    }

    public void resumeReading() {
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen yang dimuat.");
            return;
        }
        isPlaying = true;
        updatePlayButton();
        speakCurrentParagraph();
    }

    public void repeatParagraph() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen yang dimuat.");
            return;
        }
        isPlaying = true;
        updatePlayButton();
        speakCurrentParagraph();
    }

    public void nextParagraph() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen.");
            return;
        }
        if (currentIndex + 1 < paragraphs.size()) {
            currentIndex++;
            isPlaying = true;
            updatePlayButton();
            speakCurrentParagraph();
        } else {
            speaker.speak("Sudah berada di paragraf terakhir.");
        }
    }

    public void prevParagraph() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen.");
            return;
        }
        if (currentIndex > 0) {
            currentIndex--;
            isPlaying = true;
            updatePlayButton();
            speakCurrentParagraph();
        } else {
            speaker.speak("Sudah berada di paragraf pertama.");
        }
    }

    public void summarizeDocument() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada dokumen untuk diringkas.");
            return;
        }
        pauseReading(false);
        StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
        for (String p : paragraphs) {
            joined.append(p).append("\n");
            if (joined.length() >= 1500) break;
        }
        tvStatus.setText("Meringkas dokumen...");
        speaker.speak("Sebentar, saya ringkas isi dokumen.");
        LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this).summarizeText("dokumen", joined.toString(), aiClient, speaker, summary -> {
            tvStatus.setText("Ringkasan dokumen:");
            tvParagraph.setText(summary);
            speaker.speak(summary);
        });
    }

    public void translateCurrentParagraph() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak("Belum ada paragraf untuk diterjemahkan.");
            return;
        }
        pauseReading(false);
        String p = paragraphs.get(currentIndex);
        OfflineTranslatorHelper.translate(this, p, TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH, TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN,
                new OfflineTranslatorHelper.Callback() {
                    @Override public void onTranslated(String translatedText, String targetLangLabel) {
                        tvStatus.setText("Terjemahan paragraf " + (currentIndex + 1) + ":");
                        tvParagraph.setText(translatedText);
                        speaker.speak(translatedText);
                    }
                    @Override public void onStatus(String statusMessage) {
                        tvStatus.setText(statusMessage);
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String message) {
                        tvStatus.setText(message);
                        speaker.speak(message);
                    }
                });
    }

    private void speakCurrentParagraph() {
        if (paragraphs.isEmpty() || currentIndex < 0 || currentIndex >= paragraphs.size()) return;
        String text = paragraphs.get(currentIndex);
        tvStatus.setText("Paragraf " + (currentIndex + 1) + " dari " + paragraphs.size());
        tvParagraph.setText(text);
        awaitingParagraphEnd = true;
        speaker.speak(text);
    }

    private void updatePlayButton() {
        btnPlayPause.setText(isPlaying ? "⏸ JEDA" : "▶ PUTAR");
    }

    private void loadDocument(Uri uri) {
        String name = queryFileName(uri);
        String mime = getContentResolver().getType(uri);
        boolean isPdf = (mime != null && mime.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("pdf"))
                || name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".pdf");

        tvStatus.setText("Memuat dokumen: " + name + "...");
        speaker.speak("Memuat dokumen " + name + ". Harap tunggu.");
        paragraphs.clear();
        currentIndex = 0;

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String extracted = isPdf ? extractPdfText(uri) : extractTxtText(uri);
                List<String> split = splitIntoParagraphs(extracted);
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    paragraphs.addAll(split);
                    if (paragraphs.isEmpty()) {
                        tvStatus.setText("Dokumen kosong atau tidak berisi teks yang terbaca.");
                        tvParagraph.setText("");
                        speaker.speak("Dokumen tidak berisi teks yang dapat dibaca.");
                    } else {
                        isPlaying = true;
                        updatePlayButton();
                        speaker.speak("Dokumen dimuat, terdapat " + paragraphs.size() + " paragraf. Memulai pembacaan.");
                        main.postDelayed(this::speakCurrentParagraph, 2400L);
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                String err = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : "Kesalahan membaca berkas";
                main.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    tvStatus.setText("Gagal memuat dokumen: " + err);
                    speaker.speak("Gagal memuat dokumen. " + err);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private String extractTxtText(Uri uri) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
             BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                sb.append(line).append("\n");
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String extractPdfText(Uri uri) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        TextRecognizer recognizer = TextRecognition.getClient(TextRecognizerOptions.DEFAULT_OPTIONS);
        try (ParcelFileDescriptor pfd = getContentResolver().openFileDescriptor(uri, "r")) {
            if (pfd == null) throw new IllegalStateException("File PDF tidak dapat dibuka.");
            try (PdfRenderer renderer = new PdfRenderer(pfd)) {
                int pageCount = Math.min(renderer.getPageCount(), 35);
                for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
                    try (PdfRenderer.Page page = renderer.openPage(i)) {
                        int w = Math.min(1600, Math.max(800, page.getWidth() * 2));
                        int h = (int) ((double) page.getHeight() * w / Math.max(1, page.getWidth()));
                        Bitmap bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(w, h, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
                        bmp.eraseColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
                        page.render(bmp, null, null, PdfRenderer.Page.RENDER_MODE_FOR_DISPLAY);
                        Text res = Tasks.await(recognizer.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0)));
                        bmp.recycle();
                        if (res.getText() != null && !res.getText().trim().isEmpty()) {
                            sb.append(res.getText().trim()).append("\n\n");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try { recognizer.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static List<String> splitIntoParagraphs(String text) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (text == null || text.trim().isEmpty()) return out;
        String[] blocks = text.split("\\r?\\n\\s*\\r?\\n+");
        for (String b : blocks) {
            String clean = b.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
            if (clean.isEmpty()) continue;
            // Pecah blok yang sangat panjang agar nyaman dijeda/diulangi
            while (clean.length() > 380) {
                int cut = clean.lastIndexOf('.', 380);
                if (cut < 120) cut = clean.lastIndexOf(' ', 380);
                if (cut < 80) cut = 380;
                out.add(clean.substring(0, cut + 1).trim());
                clean = clean.substring(cut + 1).trim();
            }
            if (!clean.isEmpty()) out.add(clean);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private String queryFileName(Uri uri) {
        String result = null;
        if ("content".equals(uri.getScheme())) {
            try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null)) {
                if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    int col = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                    if (col >= 0) result = cursor.getString(col);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (result == null && uri.getPath() != null) {
            int cut = uri.getPath().lastIndexOf('/');
            result = cut != -1 ? uri.getPath().substring(cut + 1) : uri.getPath();
        }
        return result != null ? result : "dokumen";
    }
}
