package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothAdapter;
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothManager;
import android.bluetooth.le.AdvertiseCallback;
import android.bluetooth.le.AdvertiseData;
import android.bluetooth.le.AdvertiseSettings;
import android.bluetooth.le.BluetoothLeAdvertiser;
import android.content.Context;
import android.hardware.camera2.CameraManager;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.AudioFormat;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.AudioTrack;
import android.net.wifi.p2p.WifiP2pManager;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

/**
 * Pengelola sirine bahaya keras, kedip senter Morse SOS, pencari HP (Find My Phone),
 * dan siaran darurat tanpa sinyal seluler ("DARURAT-KOBRA-SOS").
 */
public final class EmergencyBeacon {

    private static final String TAG = "KobraBeacon";
    public static final String EMERGENCY_BROADCAST_NAME = "DARURAT-KOBRA-SOS";

    private static volatile boolean sirenActive = false;
    private static volatile boolean findPhoneActive = false;
    private static Thread sirenThread;
    private static Thread torchThread;
    private static AudioTrack activeTrack;
    private static String savedBtName;
    private static BluetoothLeAdvertiser activeAdvertiser;
    private static AdvertiseCallback activeAdvCallback;
    private static WifiP2pManager.Channel wifiChannel;
    private static int savedAlarmVol = -1;
    private static int savedMusicVol = -1;

    private EmergencyBeacon() {}

    public static boolean isSirenActive() {
        return sirenActive;
    }

    /**
     * Menyalakan sirine bahaya (volume 100%, AudioTrack USAGE_ALARM),
     * kedip senter Morse SOS (... --- ...), getaran Morse, dan siaran darurat offline.
     */
    public static void startDangerSiren(Context context, String torchId) {
        stopAll(context, torchId);
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        sirenActive = true;

        boostAlarmAndMediaVolume(app);
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSosMorse(app, true);
        startEmergencyBroadcast(app);

        sirenThread = new Thread(() -> runAlarmToneLoop(true), "KobraSirenAudio");
        sirenThread.start();

        if (torchId != null) {
            torchThread = new Thread(() -> runMorseTorchLoop(app, torchId), "KobraMorseTorch");
            torchThread.start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Mode Find My Phone: membunyikan nada panggil keras melalui channel alarm
     * meskipun HP dalam mode senyap, disertai kedip senter singkat dan getaran.
     */
    public static void ringFindMyPhone(Context context, String torchId, Speaker speaker) {
        if (sirenActive) return;
        stopFindPhone(context, torchId);
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        findPhoneActive = true;

        boostAlarmAndMediaVolume(app);
        HapticFeedback.vibrateWarning(app);

        Thread ringThread = new Thread(() -> {
            long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
            playFindPhoneChime();
            while (findPhoneActive && System.currentTimeMillis() - start < 4500L) {
                try { Thread.sleep(150); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) { break; }
            }
            findPhoneActive = false;
            restoreVolumes(app);
            new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post(() -> {
                if (speaker != null) {
                    speaker.speak("Saya di sini! HP Anda ada di sini!");
                }
            });
        }, "KobraFindPhone");
        ringThread.start();

        if (torchId != null) {
            new Thread(() -> blinkTorchTimes(app, torchId, 4), "KobraFindPhoneTorch").start();
        }
    }

    public static void stopFindPhone(Context context, String torchId) {
        findPhoneActive = false;
        stopAudioTrack();
        setTorchSafe(context, torchId, false);
    }

    public static void stopAll(Context context, String torchId) {
        sirenActive = false;
        findPhoneActive = false;
        stopAudioTrack();
        if (sirenThread != null) {
            sirenThread.interrupt();
            sirenThread = null;
        }
        if (torchThread != null) {
            torchThread.interrupt();
            torchThread = null;
        }
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        HapticFeedback.stop(app);
        setTorchSafe(app, torchId, false);
        stopEmergencyBroadcast(app);
        restoreVolumes(app);
    }

    /**
     * Mengaktifkan siaran identifikasi darurat Bluetooth & Wi-Fi Direct "DARURAT-KOBRA-SOS"
     * saat sinyal seluler tidak tersedia atau dalam kondisi darurat.
     */
    public static void startEmergencyBroadcast(Context context) {
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        startBluetoothBroadcast(app);
        startWifiDirectBeacon(app);
    }

    public static void stopEmergencyBroadcast(Context context) {
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        try {
            if (activeAdvertiser != null && activeAdvCallback != null) {
                boolean hasAdv = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 || Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE);
                if (hasAdv) {
                    activeAdvertiser.stopAdvertising(activeAdvCallback);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        activeAdvertiser = null;
        activeAdvCallback = null;

        try {
            if (savedBtName != null) {
                boolean hasConn = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 || Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT);
                BluetoothAdapter adapter = getBluetoothAdapter(app);
                if (adapter != null && hasConn) {
                    adapter.setName(savedBtName);
                }
                savedBtName = null;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

        try {
            if (wifiChannel != null) {
                WifiP2pManager manager = (WifiP2pManager) app.getSystemService(Context.WIFI_P2P_SERVICE);
                if (manager != null) {
                    manager.removeGroup(wifiChannel, null);
                }
                wifiChannel = null;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    private static void startBluetoothBroadcast(Context app) {
        try {
            BluetoothAdapter adapter = getBluetoothAdapter(app);
            if (adapter == null || !adapter.isEnabled()) return;

            boolean hasConn = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 || Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT);
            if (hasConn) {
                String currentName = adapter.getName();
                if (currentName != null && !EMERGENCY_BROADCAST_NAME.equals(currentName)) {
                    savedBtName = currentName;
                }
                adapter.setName(EMERGENCY_BROADCAST_NAME);
            }

            boolean hasAdv = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 31 || Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE);
            BluetoothLeAdvertiser advertiser = adapter.getBluetoothLeAdvertiser();
            if (advertiser != null && hasAdv) {
                AdvertiseSettings settings = new AdvertiseSettings.Builder()
                        .setAdvertiseMode(AdvertiseSettings.ADVERTISE_MODE_LOW_LATENCY)
                        .setTxPowerLevel(AdvertiseSettings.ADVERTISE_TX_POWER_HIGH)
                        .setConnectable(false)
                        .build();
                AdvertiseData data = new AdvertiseData.Builder()
                        .setIncludeDeviceName(true)
                        .build();
                activeAdvCallback = new AdvertiseCallback() {
                    @Override public void onStartSuccess(AdvertiseSettings settingsInEffect) {
                        Log.i(TAG, "Siaran BLE darurat aktif: " + EMERGENCY_BROADCAST_NAME);
                    }
                    @Override public void onStartFailure(int errorCode) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "Siaran BLE darurat gagal kode: " + errorCode);
                    }
                };
                activeAdvertiser = advertiser;
                advertiser.startAdvertising(settings, data, activeAdvCallback);
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Izin Bluetooth darurat belum diberikan", se);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal memulai siaran Bluetooth darurat", t);
        }
    }

    private static void startWifiDirectBeacon(Context app) {
        try {
            boolean hasWifiPerm = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                    ? Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES)
                    : Perms.has(app, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION);
            if (!hasWifiPerm) return;

            WifiP2pManager manager = (WifiP2pManager) app.getSystemService(Context.WIFI_P2P_SERVICE);
            if (manager == null) return;
            wifiChannel = manager.initialize(app, Looper.getMainLooper(), null);
            if (wifiChannel != null) {
                manager.createGroup(wifiChannel, new WifiP2pManager.ActionListener() {
                    @Override public void onSuccess() {
                        Log.i(TAG, "Wi-Fi Direct darurat aktif.");
                    }
                    @Override public void onFailure(int reason) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "Wi-Fi Direct darurat gagal kode: " + reason);
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Izin Wi-Fi Direct darurat belum diberikan", se);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Gagal mengaktifkan Wi-Fi Direct darurat", t);
        }
    }

    private static BluetoothAdapter getBluetoothAdapter(Context app) {
        BluetoothManager bm = (BluetoothManager) app.getSystemService(Context.BLUETOOTH_SERVICE);
        return bm != null ? bm.getAdapter() : BluetoothAdapter.getDefaultAdapter();
    }

    private static void boostAlarmAndMediaVolume(Context app) {
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) app.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am == null) return;
            if (savedMusicVol < 0) savedMusicVol = am.getStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC);
            if (savedAlarmVol < 0) savedAlarmVol = am.getStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM);
            am.setStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, am.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC), 0);
            am.setStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM, am.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM), 0);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Tidak bisa menaikkan volume penuh", e);
        }
    }

    private static void restoreVolumes(Context app) {
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) app.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am == null) return;
            if (savedMusicVol >= 0) {
                am.setStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, savedMusicVol, 0);
                savedMusicVol = -1;
            }
            if (savedAlarmVol >= 0) {
                am.setStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_ALARM, savedAlarmVol, 0);
                savedAlarmVol = -1;
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void runAlarmToneLoop(boolean isSiren) {
        final int sampleRate = 16000;
        final int chunkSamples = sampleRate / 10; // 100ms chunks
        short[] pcm = new short[chunkSamples];
        try {
            AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                    .build();
            AudioFormat format = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                    .setSampleRate(sampleRate)
                    .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                    .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                    .build();
            int minBuf = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(sampleRate, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
            AudioTrack track = new AudioTrack(attrs, format, Math.max(minBuf, chunkSamples * 2), AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE);
            activeTrack = track;
            track.play();

            double phase = 0.0;
            int step = 0;
            while (sirenActive && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
                double freq = (step % 8 < 4) ? 1480.0 : 960.0;
                double inc = 2.0 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
                for (int i = 0; i < chunkSamples; i++) {
                    pcm[i] = (short) (Math.sin(phase) * 31000.0);
                    phase += inc;
                }
                if (!sirenActive) break;
                track.write(pcm, 0, chunkSamples);
                step++;
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Sirine audio berhenti", t);
        } finally {
            stopAudioTrack();
        }
    }

    private static void playFindPhoneChime() {
        final int sampleRate = 16000;
        final int chunkSamples = sampleRate / 10;
        short[] pcm = new short[chunkSamples];
        try {
            AudioAttributes attrs = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ALARM)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                    .build();
            AudioFormat format = new AudioFormat.Builder()
                    .setSampleRate(sampleRate)
                    .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                    .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                    .build();
            int minBuf = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(sampleRate, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT);
            AudioTrack track = new AudioTrack(attrs, format, Math.max(minBuf, chunkSamples * 2), AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM, AudioManager.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_GENERATE);
            activeTrack = track;
            track.play();

            double phase = 0.0;
            double[] notes = {880.0, 1174.66, 1567.98, 0.0, 880.0, 1174.66, 1567.98, 0.0};
            for (int r = 0; r < 4 && findPhoneActive; r++) {
                for (double freq : notes) {
                    if (!findPhoneActive) break;
                    double inc = 2.0 * Math.PI * freq / sampleRate;
                    for (int i = 0; i < chunkSamples; i++) {
                        pcm[i] = freq == 0.0 ? 0 : (short) (Math.sin(phase) * 30000.0);
                        phase += inc;
                    }
                    track.write(pcm, 0, chunkSamples);
                }
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Find My Phone audio selesai/gagal", t);
        } finally {
            stopAudioTrack();
        }
    }

    private static synchronized void stopAudioTrack() {
        if (activeTrack != null) {
            try {
                activeTrack.pause();
                activeTrack.flush();
                activeTrack.stop();
                activeTrack.release();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            activeTrack = null;
        }
    }

    private static void runMorseTorchLoop(Context app, String torchId) {
        // Pola Morse SOS: ... --- ...
        int[] onDurations = {180, 180, 180, 500, 500, 500, 180, 180, 180};
        int[] offDurations = {150, 150, 320, 150, 150, 320, 150, 150, 900};
        try {
            while (sirenActive && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) {
                for (int i = 0; i < onDurations.length && sirenActive; i++) {
                    setTorchSafe(app, torchId, true);
                    Thread.sleep(onDurations[i]);
                    setTorchSafe(app, torchId, false);
                    Thread.sleep(offDurations[i]);
                }
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
        } finally {
            setTorchSafe(app, torchId, false);
        }
    }

    private static void blinkTorchTimes(Context app, String torchId, int count) {
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < count && findPhoneActive; i++) {
                setTorchSafe(app, torchId, true);
                Thread.sleep(180);
                setTorchSafe(app, torchId, false);
                Thread.sleep(160);
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {
        } finally {
            setTorchSafe(app, torchId, false);
        }
    }

    private static void setTorchSafe(Context context, String torchId, boolean on) {
        if (torchId == null || context == null) return;
        try {
            CameraManager cm = (CameraManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CAMERA_SERVICE);
            if (cm != null) cm.setTorchMode(torchId, on);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.VibrationEffect;
import android.os.Vibrator;
import android.os.VibratorManager;

/**
 * Pengelola getaran taktil berpola (aksi, sukses, peringatan, dan Morse SOS).
 */
public final class HapticFeedback {

    private HapticFeedback() {}

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private static Vibrator getVibrator(Context context) {
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
            VibratorManager vm = (VibratorManager) app.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_MANAGER_SERVICE);
            if (vm != null) return vm.getDefaultVibrator();
        }
        return (Vibrator) app.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE);
    }

    /** Getaran singkat untuk setiap aksi suara atau ketukan tombol. */
    public static void vibrateAction(Context context) {
        vibrateOneShot(context, 45);
    }

    /** Getaran ganda untuk konfirmasi berhasil. */
    public static void vibrateSuccess(Context context) {
        vibratePattern(context, new long[]{0, 55, 70, 55}, -1);
    }

    /** Getaran tiga kali untuk peringatan sistem/sensor. */
    public static void vibrateWarning(Context context) {
        vibratePattern(context, new long[]{0, 140, 90, 140, 90, 140}, -1);
    }

    /** Getaran pola Morse SOS (... --- ...) untuk keadaan darurat atau tempat bising. */
    public static void vibrateSosMorse(Context context, boolean repeat) {
        long[] sosTimings = new long[]{
                0,
                150, 110, 150, 110, 150, // S (...)
                250,
                420, 120, 420, 120, 420, // O (---)
                250,
                150, 110, 150, 110, 150, // S (...)
                900
        };
        vibratePattern(context, sosTimings, repeat ? 0 : -1);
    }

    public static void stop(Context context) {
        try {
            Vibrator v = getVibrator(context);
            if (v != null) v.cancel();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private static void vibrateOneShot(Context context, long ms) {
        try {
            Vibrator v = getVibrator(context);
            if (v == null || !v.hasVibrator()) return;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                v.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(ms, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE));
            } else {
                v.vibrate(ms);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private static void vibratePattern(Context context, long[] timings, int repeatIndex) {
        try {
            Vibrator v = getVibrator(context);
            if (v == null || !v.hasVibrator()) return;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
                v.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(timings, repeatIndex));
            } else {
                v.vibrate(timings, repeatIndex);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityGestureEvent;
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService;
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityServiceInfo;
import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipboardManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityManager;
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Pembaca Layar Global Opsional untuk Kobra OS.
 * Membacakan tombol, menu, atau judul jendela di aplikasi pihak ketiga (di luar Kobra OS)
 * dengan TTS terpisah yang otomatis diam saat TTS internal Kobra (Speaker) sedang berbicara,
 * serta mendukung gestur dua jari pada Android 11+ (API 30+).
 */
public class KobraAccessibilityService extends AccessibilityService {

    private static volatile KobraAccessibilityService instance;
    private static final Object YT_LOCK = new Object();
    private static volatile long pendingYoutubeUntilMs = 0L;
    private static volatile String pendingYoutubeQuery = "";

    private TextToSpeech externalTts;
    private boolean ttsReady = false;
    private Speaker internalSpeaker;
    private KobraConfig config;
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private String lastSpokenText = "";
    private long lastSpokenAt = 0L;

    public static KobraAccessibilityService getInstance() {
        return instance;
    }

    public static void markPendingYoutubeAutoPlay(String query) {
        synchronized (YT_LOCK) {
            pendingYoutubeQuery = query == null ? "" : query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            pendingYoutubeUntilMs = System.currentTimeMillis() + 12_000L;
        }
        KobraAccessibilityService svc = instance;
        if (svc != null) {
            svc.scheduleYoutubeAutoPlayCheck();
        }
    }

    private final Speaker.Listener internalSpeechListener = new Speaker.Listener() {
        @Override public void onSpeechStart() {
            stopExternalTts();
        }
        @Override public void onSpeechEnd() {}
    };

    @Override
    protected void onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected();
        instance = this;
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        internalSpeaker = Speaker.get(this);
        internalSpeaker.addListener(internalSpeechListener);

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30) {
            try {
                AccessibilityServiceInfo info = getServiceInfo();
                if (info != null) {
                    info.flags |= AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_REQUEST_MULTI_FINGER_GESTURES;
                    setServiceInfo(info);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }

        externalTts = new TextToSpeech(this, status -> {
            if (status != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS || externalTts == null) return;
            ttsReady = true;
            int r = externalTts.setLanguage(new Locale("id", "ID"));
            if (r == TextToSpeech.LANG_MISSING_DATA || r == TextToSpeech.LANG_NOT_SUPPORTED) {
                externalTts.setLanguage(Locale.getDefault());
            }
            applyTtsSettings();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onAccessibilityEvent(AccessibilityEvent event) {
        if (event == null) return;
        CharSequence pkgCs = event.getPackageName();
        String pkg = pkgCs != null ? pkgCs.toString() : "";

        // Tangani pemutaran otomatis YouTube jika ada pencarian suara yang baru dibuka (#67)
        if ("com.google.android.youtube".equals(pkg) && System.currentTimeMillis() <= pendingYoutubeUntilMs) {
            main.postDelayed(() -> {
                try {
                    tryConsumeYoutubeAutoPlay(getRootInActiveWindow(), "com.google.android.youtube");
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }, 900L);
        }

        // Jangan bacakan UI internal Kobra OS atau saat TTS internal sedang berbicara
        if (pkg.isEmpty() || getPackageName().equals(pkg)) return;
        if (internalSpeaker != null && internalSpeaker.isSpeaking()) return;
        if (isAnotherSpokenServiceActive()) return;

        int type = event.getEventType();
        if (type != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED
                && type != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_CLICKED
                && type != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_SELECTED
                && type != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_HOVER_ENTER
                && type != AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED) {
            return;
        }

        String phrase = extractSpokenPhrase(event, pkg, type);
        if (phrase.isEmpty()) return;

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (phrase.equals(lastSpokenText) && now - lastSpokenAt < 900L) return;
        lastSpokenText = phrase;
        lastSpokenAt = now;

        speakExternal(phrase);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onGesture(AccessibilityGestureEvent gestureEvent) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30 && gestureEvent != null) {
            int id = gestureEvent.getGestureId();
            if (id == GESTURE_2_FINGER_SWIPE_DOWN) {
                stopExternalTts();
                HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
                String msg = KobraNotificationService.summary(12);
                if (internalSpeaker != null) internalSpeaker.speak(msg);
                return true;
            }
            if (id == GESTURE_2_FINGER_SWIPE_UP) {
                stopExternalTts();
                if (internalSpeaker != null) internalSpeaker.stop();
                EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(this, null);
                HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
                return true;
            }
            if (id == GESTURE_DOUBLE_TAP) {
                stopExternalTts();
                HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
                AsistenAccessibilityService.requestListen();
                return true;
            }
        }
        return super.onGesture(gestureEvent);
    }

    @Override
    public void onInterrupt() {
        stopExternalTts();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        instance = null;
        if (internalSpeaker != null) {
            internalSpeaker.removeListener(internalSpeechListener);
        }
        if (externalTts != null) {
            try {
                externalTts.stop();
                externalTts.shutdown();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            externalTts = null;
            ttsReady = false;
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private void applyTtsSettings() {
        if (externalTts == null || !ttsReady || config == null) return;
        try {
            externalTts.setSpeechRate(config.getSpeechRate());
            externalTts.setPitch(config.getSpeechPitch());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void speakExternal(String text) {
        if (text == null || text.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        if (internalSpeaker != null && internalSpeaker.isSpeaking()) return;
        main.post(() -> {
            if (!ttsReady || externalTts == null) return;
            if (internalSpeaker != null && internalSpeaker.isSpeaking()) return;
            applyTtsSettings();
            try {
                externalTts.speak(text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "kobra_ext_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private void stopExternalTts() {
        if (externalTts != null) {
            try {
                externalTts.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private boolean isAnotherSpokenServiceActive() {
        try {
            AccessibilityManager am = (AccessibilityManager) getSystemService(ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE);
            if (am == null) return false;
            List<AccessibilityServiceInfo> list = am.getEnabledAccessibilityServiceList(AccessibilityServiceInfo.FEEDBACK_SPOKEN);
            if (list == null) return false;
            for (AccessibilityServiceInfo info : list) {
                String id = info.getId();
                if (id != null && !id.startsWith(getPackageName() + "/")) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return false;
    }

    private String extractSpokenPhrase(AccessibilityEvent event, String pkg, int eventType) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (eventType == AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED) {
            String appName = resolveAppLabel(pkg);
            String title = joinCharSequences(event.getText());
            if (!title.isEmpty()) {
                return appName.isEmpty() || title.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(appName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))
                        ? title : appName + ", " + title;
            }
            return appName.isEmpty() ? "" : "Membuka " + appName;
        }

        AccessibilityNodeInfo src = event.getSource();
        if (src != null) {
            try {
                CharSequence desc = src.getContentDescription();
                CharSequence txt = src.getText();
                if (desc != null && desc.toString().trim().length() > 0) {
                    sb.append(desc.toString().trim());
                } else if (txt != null && txt.toString().trim().length() > 0) {
                    sb.append(txt.toString().trim());
                }
                if (sb.length() > 0) {
                    CharSequence cls = src.getClassName();
                    if (cls != null) {
                        String c = cls.toString();
                        if (c.contains("Button") && !c.contains("RadioButton")) {
                            sb.append(", tombol");
                        } else if (c.contains("CheckBox") || c.contains("Switch")) {
                            sb.append(src.isChecked() ? ", aktif" : ", mati");
                        } else if (c.contains("EditText")) {
                            sb.append(", kolom teks");
                        }
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                try { src.recycle(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (sb.length() == 0 && event.getContentDescription() != null) {
            sb.append(event.getContentDescription().toString().trim());
        }
        if (sb.length() == 0) {
            sb.append(joinCharSequences(event.getText()));
        }
        String out = sb.toString().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (out.length() > 180) out = out.substring(0, 180);
        return out;
    }

    private static String joinCharSequences(List<CharSequence> list) {
        if (list == null || list.isEmpty()) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (CharSequence cs : list) {
            if (cs != null) {
                String t = cs.toString().trim();
                if (!t.isEmpty()) {
                    if (sb.length() > 0) sb.append(", ");
                    sb.append(t);
                }
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private String resolveAppLabel(String pkg) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();
            return pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #66 Universal Voice-Click & Scroll Global
    // =========================================================================

    public boolean clickByNameGlobal(String targetName) {
        return clickNodeByName(getRootInActiveWindow(), targetName);
    }

    public boolean scrollGlobal(boolean forward) {
        AccessibilityNodeInfo root = getRootInActiveWindow();
        if (root == null) return false;
        AccessibilityNodeInfo scrollable = findScrollableNode(root, true);
        if (scrollable == null) scrollable = findScrollableNode(root, false);
        if (scrollable == null) return false;
        return scrollable.performAction(forward
                ? AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SCROLL_FORWARD
                : AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SCROLL_BACKWARD);
    }

    public boolean performGlobalNavAction(int globalAction) {
        return performGlobalAction(globalAction);
    }

    public static boolean clickNodeByName(AccessibilityNodeInfo root, String targetName) {
        if (root == null || targetName == null || targetName.trim().isEmpty()) return false;
        String q = targetName.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        AccessibilityNodeInfo node = findNodeByLabel(root, q, true);
        if (node == null) {
            node = findNodeByLabel(root, q, false);
        }
        AccessibilityNodeInfo cur = node;
        while (cur != null && !cur.isClickable()) {
            cur = cur.getParent();
        }
        return cur != null && cur.isEnabled() && cur.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK);
    }

    private static AccessibilityNodeInfo findNodeByLabel(AccessibilityNodeInfo node, String q, boolean exact) {
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.isVisibleToUser()) {
            CharSequence t = node.getText();
            CharSequence d = node.getContentDescription();
            if (matchesLabel(t, q, exact) || matchesLabel(d, q, exact)) {
                return node;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount(); i++) {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo found = findNodeByLabel(node.getChild(i), q, exact);
            if (found != null) return found;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean matchesLabel(CharSequence cs, String q, boolean exact) {
        if (cs == null) return false;
        String s = cs.toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (s.isEmpty()) return false;
        return exact ? s.equals(q) : s.contains(q);
    }

    private static AccessibilityNodeInfo findScrollableNode(AccessibilityNodeInfo node, boolean visibleOnly) {
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.isScrollable() && (!visibleOnly || node.isVisibleToUser())) {
            return node;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount(); i++) {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo r = findScrollableNode(node.getChild(i), visibleOnly);
            if (r != null) return r;
        }
        return null;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #67 YouTube Voice Search & Auto-Play
    // =========================================================================

    private void scheduleYoutubeAutoPlayCheck() {
        main.postDelayed(() -> tryConsumeYoutubeAutoPlay(getRootInActiveWindow(), "com.google.android.youtube"), 1600L);
        main.postDelayed(() -> tryConsumeYoutubeAutoPlay(getRootInActiveWindow(), "com.google.android.youtube"), 3000L);
    }

    public static boolean tryConsumeYoutubeAutoPlay(AccessibilityNodeInfo root, String pkg) {
        if (root == null) return false;
        String query;
        synchronized (YT_LOCK) {
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() > pendingYoutubeUntilMs) return false;
            CharSequence rootPkg = root.getPackageName();
            String activePkg = rootPkg != null ? rootPkg.toString() : (pkg == null ? "" : pkg);
            if (!activePkg.contains("youtube")) return false;
            query = pendingYoutubeQuery;
        }

        AccessibilityNodeInfo videoNode = findFirstYoutubeVideoNode(root, query, true);
        if (videoNode == null) {
            videoNode = findFirstYoutubeVideoNode(root, query, false);
        }
        if (videoNode == null) return false;

        synchronized (YT_LOCK) {
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() > pendingYoutubeUntilMs) return false;
            pendingYoutubeUntilMs = 0L;
        }
        return videoNode.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK);
    }

    private static AccessibilityNodeInfo findFirstYoutubeVideoNode(AccessibilityNodeInfo node, String query, boolean strict) {
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.isClickable() && node.isVisibleToUser() && node.isEnabled()) {
            Rect bounds = new Rect();
            node.getBoundsInScreen(bounds);
            if (bounds.top >= 180 && bounds.width() >= 260 && bounds.height() >= 140) {
                String label = collectNodeSummary(node).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (!label.isEmpty() && !isYoutubeChromeLabel(label)) {
                    if (!strict) {
                        if (label.length() >= 12) return node;
                    } else {
                        boolean looksLikeVideo = label.length() >= 20
                                || label.contains("menit") || label.contains("detik") || label.contains("jam")
                                || label.contains("minute") || label.contains("second")
                                || label.contains("ditonton") || label.contains("views")
                                || label.contains("buka channel") || label.contains("go to channel")
                                || (!query.isEmpty() && containsAnyWord(label, query));
                        if (looksLikeVideo) return node;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount(); i++) {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo r = findFirstYoutubeVideoNode(node.getChild(i), query, strict);
            if (r != null) return r;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isYoutubeChromeLabel(String lower) {
        String[] chrome = {
                "telusuri", "search", "penelusuran suara", "voice search",
                "kembali", "navigate up", "back", "filter", "beranda", "home",
                "shorts", "subscription", "anda", "you", "koleksi", "library",
                "transmisikan", "cast", "notifikasi", "notifications", "akun", "account",
                "opsi lainnya", "more options", "menu tindakan", "buat", "create",
                "semua", "all", "video", "unwatched", "belum ditonton", "terbaru", "live"
        };
        for (String c : chrome) {
            if (lower.equals(c)) return true;
        }
        return lower.startsWith("filter ") || lower.startsWith("telusuri ");
    }

    private static boolean containsAnyWord(String text, String query) {
        for (String w : query.split("\\s+")) {
            if (w.length() >= 3 && text.contains(w)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static String collectNodeSummary(AccessibilityNodeInfo node) {
        if (node == null) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (node.getContentDescription() != null && node.getContentDescription().length() > 0) {
            sb.append(node.getContentDescription()).append(" ");
        }
        if (node.getText() != null && node.getText().length() > 0) {
            sb.append(node.getText()).append(" ");
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount() && sb.length() < 120; i++) {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo ch = node.getChild(i);
            if (ch != null) {
                if (ch.getText() != null && ch.getText().length() > 0) {
                    sb.append(ch.getText()).append(" ");
                } else if (ch.getContentDescription() != null && ch.getContentDescription().length() > 0) {
                    sb.append(ch.getContentDescription()).append(" ");
                }
            }
        }
        return sb.toString().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #68 Global Voice Typing (ACTION_SET_TEXT + Clipboard Paste Fallback)
    // =========================================================================

    public boolean typeGlobalText(String text) {
        return typeTextInRoot(this, getRootInActiveWindow(), text);
    }

    public static boolean typeTextInRoot(Context context, AccessibilityNodeInfo root, String text) {
        if (text == null) return false;
        if (context != null) {
            try {
                ClipboardManager cm = (ClipboardManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE);
                if (cm != null) {
                    cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Kobra OS", text));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (root == null) return false;
        AccessibilityNodeInfo field = root.findFocus(AccessibilityNodeInfo.FOCUS_INPUT);
        if (field == null || !field.isEditable()) {
            field = findEditableNode(root);
        }
        if (field == null) return false;

        try {
            field.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_FOCUS);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        Bundle args = new Bundle();
        args.putCharSequence(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE, text);
        if (field.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_SET_TEXT, args)) {
            return true;
        }
        return field.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_PASTE);
    }

    private static AccessibilityNodeInfo findEditableNode(AccessibilityNodeInfo node) {
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.isEditable() && node.isVisibleToUser()) return node;
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount(); i++) {
            AccessibilityNodeInfo r = findEditableNode(node.getChild(i));
            if (r != null) return r;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.app.Application;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Process;
import android.util.Log;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Titik masuk aplikasi Kobra OS dengan Global Uncaught Exception Handler.
 * Menangkap error tak terduga di main thread maupun background thread,
 * menyimpannya secara sinkron ke KobraConfig (last_crash_log), dan membuka layar pemulihan.
 */
public class KobraApplication extends Application {

    private static final String TAG = "KobraCrashShield";
    private static volatile boolean handlingCrash = false;
    private Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler defaultHandler;

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();
        defaultHandler = Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();

        Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, throwable) -> {
            if (handlingCrash) {
                if (defaultHandler != null) {
                    defaultHandler.uncaughtException(thread, throwable);
                }
                return;
            }
            handlingCrash = true;

            String threadName = thread != null ? thread.getName() : "unknown";
            String summary = buildCrashSummary(threadName, throwable);
            String fullLog = buildFullCrashLog(threadName, summary, throwable);

            try {
                new KobraConfig(getApplicationContext()).saveLastCrashLog(fullLog);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

            try {
                Log.e(TAG, fullLog);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

            try {
                Intent recovery = new Intent(getApplicationContext(), CrashRecoveryActivity.class);
                recovery.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK
                        | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK
                        | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NO_ANIMATION);
                recovery.putExtra(CrashRecoveryActivity.EXTRA_CRASH_SUMMARY, summary);
                recovery.putExtra(CrashRecoveryActivity.EXTRA_CRASH_LOG, fullLog);
                startActivity(recovery);
            } catch (Throwable launchErr) {
                if (defaultHandler != null) {
                    defaultHandler.uncaughtException(thread, throwable);
                    return;
                }
            }

            try {
                Thread.sleep(250L);
            } catch (InterruptedException ignored) {}

            Process.killProcess(Process.myPid());
            System.exit(10);
        });
    }

    static String buildCrashSummary(String threadName, Throwable throwable) {
        if (throwable == null) {
            return "Terjadi kesalahan tidak dikenal pada thread " + threadName + ".";
        }
        Throwable root = throwable;
        while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) {
            root = root.getCause();
        }
        String type = root.getClass().getSimpleName();
        String msg = root.getMessage() != null ? root.getMessage() : "(tanpa pesan)";

        StackTraceElement appFrame = findRelevantFrame(root);
        if (appFrame == null) {
            appFrame = findRelevantFrame(throwable);
        }
        String location = appFrame != null
                ? appFrame.getClassName() + "." + appFrame.getMethodName()
                    + "(" + appFrame.getFileName() + ":" + appFrame.getLineNumber() + ")"
                : "lokasi baris tidak tersedia";

        return "Jenis Error: " + type
                + "\nPesan: " + msg
                + "\nLokasi: " + location
                + "\nThread: " + threadName;
    }

    private static StackTraceElement findRelevantFrame(Throwable t) {
        if (t == null) return null;
        StackTraceElement[] stack = t.getStackTrace();
        if (stack == null || stack.length == 0) return null;
        for (StackTraceElement el : stack) {
            if (el != null && el.getClassName().startsWith("com.asisten.bantu")) {
                return el;
            }
        }
        return stack[0];
    }

    private static String buildFullCrashLog(String threadName, String summary, Throwable throwable) {
        String time = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(new Date());
        String trace = throwable != null ? Log.getStackTraceString(throwable) : "";
        return "=== KOBRA OS CRASH REPORT ===\n"
                + "Waktu: " + time + "\n"
                + "Versi: " + BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME + "\n"
                + summary + "\n\n"
                + "--- STACKTRACE ---\n"
                + trace;
    }
}

            default:
                return "Jawab dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang hangat, ramah, jelas, dan bersahabat tanpa format markdown atau simbol.";
        }
    }

    public void saveFavoritePlace(String label, double lat, double lon) {
        if (label == null || label.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        String cleanLabel = label.trim();
        String key = cleanLabel.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        try {
            JSONObject map = new JSONObject(prefs.getString("favorite_places", "{}"));
            JSONObject item = new JSONObject();
            item.put("label", cleanLabel);
            item.put("lat", lat);
            item.put("lon", lon);
            map.put(key, item);
            prefs.edit().putString("favorite_places", map.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Mengembalikan {lat, lon} untuk label tempat favorit, atau null jika belum ada. */
    public double[] getFavoritePlace(String query) {
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) return null;
        String q = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        try {
            JSONObject map = new JSONObject(prefs.getString("favorite_places", "{}"));
            if (map.has(q)) {
                JSONObject item = map.getJSONObject(q);
                return new double[]{item.getDouble("lat"), item.getDouble("lon")};
            }
            Iterator<String> it = map.keys();
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                String k = it.next();
                if (q.contains(k) || k.contains(q)) {
                    JSONObject item = map.getJSONObject(k);
                    return new double[]{item.getDouble("lat"), item.getDouble("lon")};
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return null;
    }

    public String getFavoritePlaceLabel(String query) {
        if (query == null) return "";
        String q = query.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        try {
            JSONObject map = new JSONObject(prefs.getString("favorite_places", "{}"));
            if (map.has(q)) return map.getJSONObject(q).optString("label", query.trim());
            Iterator<String> it = map.keys();
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                String k = it.next();
                if (q.contains(k) || k.contains(q)) {
                    return map.getJSONObject(k).optString("label", k);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return query.trim();
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- Pedometer Offline (#71)

    public synchronized void onStepCounterEvent(int sensorTotal) {
        String today = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US).format(new Date());
        String savedDay = prefs.getString("pedometer_day", "");
        int lastSensor = prefs.getInt("pedometer_last_sensor", -1);
        int todaySteps = today.equals(savedDay) ? prefs.getInt("pedometer_steps", 0) : 0;

        if (!today.equals(savedDay)) {
            todaySteps = 0;
            lastSensor = sensorTotal;
        } else if (lastSensor < 0 || sensorTotal < lastSensor) {
            lastSensor = sensorTotal;
        } else {
            int delta = sensorTotal - lastSensor;
            if (delta > 0 && delta < 50000) {
                todaySteps += delta;
            }
            lastSensor = sensorTotal;
        }
        prefs.edit()
                .putString("pedometer_day", today)
                .putInt("pedometer_steps", todaySteps)
                .putInt("pedometer_last_sensor", lastSensor)
                .apply();
    }

    public synchronized void addDailySteps(int delta) {
        if (delta <= 0) return;
        String today = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US).format(new Date());
        String savedDay = prefs.getString("pedometer_day", "");
        int todaySteps = today.equals(savedDay) ? prefs.getInt("pedometer_steps", 0) : 0;
        todaySteps += delta;
        prefs.edit()
                .putString("pedometer_day", today)
                .putInt("pedometer_steps", todaySteps)
                .apply();
    }

    public synchronized int getTodaySteps() {
        String today = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd", Locale.US).format(new Date());
        if (!today.equals(prefs.getString("pedometer_day", ""))) return 0;
        return Math.max(0, prefs.getInt("pedometer_steps", 0));
    }

    public synchronized int getTodayDistanceMeters() {
        return Math.round(getTodaySteps() * 0.7f);
    }

    }

    public synchronized void addPlannerItem(int id, int hour, int minute, String title, long triggerAtMs) {
        if (title == null || title.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("planner_json", "[]"));
            JSONObject obj = new JSONObject();
            obj.put("id", id);
            obj.put("hour", hour);
            obj.put("minute", minute);
            obj.put("title", title.trim());
            obj.put("trigger_at", triggerAtMs);
            arr.put(obj);
            while (arr.length() > 40) arr.remove(0);
            prefs.edit().putString("planner_json", arr.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    public synchronized java.util.List<Integer> getPlannerIds() {
        java.util.List<Integer> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("planner_json", "[]"));
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                ids.add(arr.getJSONObject(i).optInt("id", 0));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return ids;
    }

    public synchronized String listPlannerSpeech() {
        try {
            JSONArray arr = new JSONArray(prefs.getString("planner_json", "[]"));
            if (arr.length() == 0) return "";
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject o = arr.getJSONObject(i);
                int h = o.optInt("hour", 0);
                int m = o.optInt("minute", 0);
                String t = o.optString("title", "");
                if (t.isEmpty()) continue;
                count++;
                sb.append("Agenda ").append(count).append(", pukul ")
                        .append(String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", h, m))
                        .append(", ").append(t).append(". ");
            }
            return sb.toString().trim();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    public synchronized void clearPlannerItems() {
        prefs.edit().putString("planner_json", "[]").apply();
    }

    private static float clampTts(float v) {
        return Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, v));
    }

    /**
     * Mengekspor seluruh data SharedPreferences (kobra_config & kobra_sos) beserta tipe datanya ke JSON.
     * Tidak menyertakan berkas model .task.
     */
    public String exportBackupJson() throws Exception {
        JSONObject root = new JSONObject();
        root.put("app", "KobraOS");
        root.put("backup_version", 1);
        root.put("exported_at", new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(new Date()));

        JSONObject stores = new JSONObject();
        stores.put(PREFS_CONFIG, serializePrefs(prefs));
        stores.put(PREFS_SOS, serializePrefs(sos));
        root.put("prefs", stores);
        return root.toString(2);
    }

    /**
     * Memulihkan seluruh data SharedPreferences dari JSON hasil cadangan dengan menjaga tipe data asli.
     */
    public int importBackupJson(String jsonText) throws Exception {
        if (jsonText == null || jsonText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Berkas cadangan kosong.");
        }
        JSONObject root = new JSONObject(jsonText);
        if (!"KobraOS".equals(root.optString("app")) || !root.has("prefs")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Format berkas bukan cadangan resmi Kobra OS.");
        }
        JSONObject stores = root.getJSONObject("prefs");
        int restoredCount = 0;
        if (stores.has(PREFS_CONFIG)) {
            restoredCount += restorePrefs(prefs, stores.getJSONObject(PREFS_CONFIG));
        }
        if (stores.has(PREFS_SOS)) {
            restoredCount += restorePrefs(sos, stores.getJSONObject(PREFS_SOS));
        }
        return restoredCount;
    }

    private static JSONObject serializePrefs(SharedPreferences sp) throws Exception {
        JSONObject out = new JSONObject();
        Map<String, ?> all = sp.getAll();
        for (Map.Entry<String, ?> entry : all.entrySet()) {
            Object val = entry.getValue();
            if (val == null) continue;
            JSONObject item = new JSONObject();
            if (val instanceof String) {
                item.put("type", "string");
                item.put("value", val);
            } else if (val instanceof Boolean) {
                item.put("type", "boolean");
                item.put("value", val);
            } else if (val instanceof Integer) {
                item.put("type", "int");
                item.put("value", val);
            } else if (val instanceof Long) {
                item.put("type", "long");
                item.put("value", val);
            } else if (val instanceof Float) {
                item.put("type", "float");
                item.put("value", ((Float) val).doubleValue());
            } else if (val instanceof Set<?>) {
                JSONArray arr = new JSONArray();
                for (Object s : (Set<?>) val) {
                    if (s != null) arr.put(s.toString());
                }
                item.put("type", "stringset");
                item.put("value", arr);
            } else {
                continue;
            }
            out.put(entry.getKey(), item);
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static int restorePrefs(SharedPreferences sp, JSONObject data) throws Exception {
        SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sp.edit();
        editor.clear();
        int count = 0;
        Iterator<String> keys = data.keys();
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
            String key = keys.next();
            JSONObject item = data.getJSONObject(key);
            String type = item.optString("type", "string");
            switch (type) {
                case "string":
                    editor.putString(key, item.optString("value", ""));
                    count++;
                    break;
                case "boolean":
                    editor.putBoolean(key, item.optBoolean("value", false));
                    count++;
                    break;
                case "int":
                    editor.putInt(key, item.optInt("value", 0));
                    count++;
                    break;
                case "long":
                    editor.putLong(key, item.optLong("value", 0L));
                    count++;
                    break;
                case "float":
                    editor.putFloat(key, (float) item.optDouble("value", 0.0));
                    count++;
                    break;
                case "stringset":
                    JSONArray arr = item.optJSONArray("value");
                    Set<String> set = new HashSet<>();
                    if (arr != null) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                            set.add(arr.optString(i, ""));
                        }
                    }
                    editor.putStringSet(key, set);
                    count++;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
        editor.apply();
        return count;
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.IBinder;
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat;

/**
 * Menjaga Kobra tetap hidup di latar belakang. Mencoba tipe mikrofon agar Android mengizinkan
 * pengenalan suara saat layar mati; jika sistem menolak, jatuh ke tipe penggunaan khusus.
 */
public class KobraForegroundService extends Service {
    private static final String CHANNEL_ID = "kobra_v7";
    private static final int NOTIF_ID = 1001;

    public static void start(Context c) {
        Intent i = new Intent(c, KobraForegroundService.class);
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) c.startForegroundService(i);
            else c.startService(i);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    @Override public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            NotificationChannel ch = new NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "Kobra OS", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW);
            ch.setDescription("Kobra OS tetap aktif");
            getSystemService(NotificationManager.class).createNotificationChannel(ch);
        }
    }

    @Override public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        PendingIntent open = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0,
                new Intent(this, KobraLauncherActivity.class), PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        Notification n = new NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
                .setContentTitle("Kobra OS aktif")
                .setContentText("Ucapkan Kobra lalu perintah Anda")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_btn_speak_now)
                .setContentIntent(open)
                .setOngoing(true)
                .build();
        if (!tryStart(n, true) && !tryStart(n, false)) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        return START_STICKY;
    }

    private boolean tryStart(Notification n, boolean withMic) {
        try {
            boolean mic = withMic && Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
                int type = ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE;
                if (mic) type |= ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE;
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n, type);
            } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30 && mic) {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MICROPHONE);
            } else {
                startForeground(NOTIF_ID, n);
            }
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }
}

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

/** Layar utama Kobra: tombol besar dan daftar aplikasi, semuanya bisa dijalankan lewat suara. */
public class KobraLauncherActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextView tvClock, tvListen, tvScreenReader;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final Runnable clockTick = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            tvClock.setText(new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm - EEEE, dd MMMM", new Locale("id", "ID")).format(new Date()));
            handler.postDelayed(this, 30000);
        }
    };

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_launcher);
        tvClock = findViewById(R.id.tvClock);
        tvListen = findViewById(R.id.tvListen);
        tvScreenReader = findViewById(R.id.tvScreenReader);

        RecyclerView rv = findViewById(R.id.rvApps);
        rv.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
        rv.setAdapter(new AppAdapter(loadApps()));

        findViewById(R.id.btnReadScreen).setOnClickListener(v -> readScreen());
        findViewById(R.id.btnMic).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (AsistenAccessibilityService.getInstance() == null) speak("Aktifkan aksesibilitas Kobra dulu di menu Setup.");
            else AsistenAccessibilityService.requestListen();
        });
        findViewById(R.id.btnVisionMoney).setOnClickListener(v -> openVision("money"));
        findViewById(R.id.btnVisionColor).setOnClickListener(v -> openVision("color"));
        findViewById(R.id.btnVisionFace).setOnClickListener(v -> openVision("face"));
        findViewById(R.id.btnVisionKtp).setOnClickListener(v -> openVision("ktp"));
        findViewById(R.id.btnNavStick).setOnClickListener(v ->
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this, new Intent(this, NavigationActivity.class), Speaker.get(this), "Gagal membuka Mode Tongkat."));
        findViewById(R.id.btnAiChat).setOnClickListener(v ->
                KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this, new Intent(this, AiChatActivity.class), Speaker.get(this), "Gagal membuka Teman Ngobrol AI."));
        findViewById(R.id.btnSosEmergency).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            AsistenAccessibilityService s = AsistenAccessibilityService.getInstance();
            if (s == null) speak("Aktifkan aksesibilitas Kobra dulu di menu Setup.");
            else s.triggerSos();
        });

        if (!Perms.hasAll(this, Perms.required())) ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, Perms.required(), 100);
        KobraForegroundService.start(this);
        handler.post(clockTick);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, Speaker.get(this))) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, Speaker.get(this))) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(clockTick);
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private void readScreen() {
        AsistenAccessibilityService s = AsistenAccessibilityService.getInstance();
        if (s == null) { speak("Aktifkan aksesibilitas Kobra dulu di menu Setup."); return; }
        String text = s.readScreenText();
        tvScreenReader.setText(text);
        speak(text);
    }

    private void openVision(String mode) {
        Intent i = new Intent(this, VisionActivity.class);
        i.putExtra("mode", mode);
        KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this, i, Speaker.get(this), "Gagal membuka kamera Mata Kedua.");
    }

    private void speak(String text) {
        tvListen.setText("🗣️ " + text);
        Speaker.get(this).speak(text);
    }

    private List<ApplicationInfo> loadApps() {
        PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();
        List<ApplicationInfo> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (ApplicationInfo ai : pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)) {
            if (pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(ai.packageName) != null) out.add(ai);
        }
        Collections.sort(out, (a, b) -> pm.getApplicationLabel(a).toString()
                .compareToIgnoreCase(pm.getApplicationLabel(b).toString()));
        return out;
    }

    private class AppAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AppAdapter.VH> {
        private final List<ApplicationInfo> items;
        private final PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();

        AppAdapter(List<ApplicationInfo> items) { this.items = items; }

        @Override public VH onCreateViewHolder(ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
            View v = getLayoutInflater().inflate(R.layout.item_app, parent, false);
            return new VH(v);
        }

        @Override public void onBindViewHolder(VH holder, int position) {
            ApplicationInfo app = items.get(position);
            String label = pm.getApplicationLabel(app).toString();
            holder.tv.setText(label);
            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                Intent i = pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(app.packageName);
                if (i != null && KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(KobraLauncherActivity.this, i,
                        Speaker.get(KobraLauncherActivity.this), "Tidak dapat membuka " + label + ".")) {
                    speak("Membuka " + label);
                }
            });
        }

        @Override public int getItemCount() { return items.size(); }

        class VH extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
            final TextView tv;
            VH(View v) {
                super(v);
                tv = v.findViewById(R.id.tvAppName);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.RemoteInput;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.provider.ContactsContract;
import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService;
import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Membacakan notifikasi masuk (pesan, panggilan masuk/Caller ID TTS, dan lainnya),
 * menyaring tautan phishing/penipuan, dan menyimpan aksi RemoteInput untuk Balas Pesan Suara
 * langsung pada WhatsApp/SMS tanpa membuka aplikasi.
 */
public class KobraNotificationService extends NotificationListenerService {

    private static final int MAX_RECENT = 12;
    private static final int MAX_SPOKEN = 280;
    private static final List<String> RECENT = new ArrayList<>();
    private static final Map<String, String> LAST_BY_KEY = new HashMap<>();
    private static volatile boolean connected = false;
    private static volatile ReplyTarget lastReplyTarget = null;

    private static final class ReplyTarget {
        final PendingIntent actionIntent;
        final RemoteInput[] remoteInputs;
        final String sender;
        final String appName;

        ReplyTarget(PendingIntent actionIntent, RemoteInput[] remoteInputs, String sender, String appName) {
            this.actionIntent = actionIntent;
            this.remoteInputs = remoteInputs;
            this.sender = sender;
            this.appName = appName;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isConnected() { return connected; }

    public static boolean hasReplyTarget() {
        return lastReplyTarget != null;
    }

    public static String getLastReplySender() {
        ReplyTarget t = lastReplyTarget;
        return t != null ? t.sender : "";
    }

    public static String getLastReplyApp() {
        ReplyTarget t = lastReplyTarget;
        return t != null ? t.appName : "";
    }

    /** Membalas notifikasi pesan terakhir menggunakan RemoteInput secara langsung. */
    public static boolean replyToLast(Context context, String message) {
        ReplyTarget target = lastReplyTarget;
        if (target == null || message == null || message.trim().isEmpty()) return false;
        try {
            Intent intent = new Intent();
            Bundle results = new Bundle();
            for (RemoteInput ri : target.remoteInputs) {
                results.putCharSequence(ri.getResultKey(), message.trim());
            }
            RemoteInput.addResultsToIntent(target.remoteInputs, intent, results);
            target.actionIntent.send(context, 0, intent);
            return true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static synchronized String summary(int count) {
        if (!connected) return "Akses notifikasi belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Akses notifikasi.";
        if (RECENT.isEmpty()) return "Belum ada notifikasi baru.";
        int n = Math.min(count, RECENT.size());
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sb.append("Notifikasi ").append(i + 1).append(". ")
                    .append(RECENT.get(RECENT.size() - 1 - i)).append(" ");
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    public static synchronized int getRecentCount() {
        return RECENT.size();
    }

    public static synchronized String getJoinedRecentNotifications(int maxCount) {
        if (RECENT.isEmpty()) return "";
        int n = Math.min(maxCount, RECENT.size());
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sb.append(RECENT.get(RECENT.size() - 1 - i)).append("\n");
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private static synchronized void remember(String line) {
        RECENT.add(line);
        while (RECENT.size() > MAX_RECENT) RECENT.remove(0);
    }

    @Override public void onListenerConnected() { connected = true; }

    @Override public void onListenerDisconnected() {
        connected = false;
        try {
            requestRebind(new ComponentName(this, KobraNotificationService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    @Override public void onNotificationPosted(StatusBarNotification sbn) {
        try {
            handle(sbn);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
    }

    private void handle(StatusBarNotification sbn) {
        if (sbn == null || getPackageName().equals(sbn.getPackageName())) return;
        Notification n = sbn.getNotification();
        if (n == null || n.extras == null) return;
        if ((n.flags & Notification.FLAG_GROUP_SUMMARY) != 0) return;
        boolean call = Notification.CATEGORY_CALL.equals(n.category);
        if (sbn.isOngoing() && !call) return;

        Bundle ex = n.extras;
        String title = str(ex.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE));
        String text = str(ex.getCharSequence(Notification.EXTRA_TEXT));
        if (title.isEmpty() && text.isEmpty()) return;

        String content = title + "|" + text;
        synchronized (KobraNotificationService.class) {
            if (content.equals(LAST_BY_KEY.get(sbn.getKey()))) return;
            LAST_BY_KEY.put(sbn.getKey(), content);
            if (LAST_BY_KEY.size() > 100) LAST_BY_KEY.clear();
        }

        String appName = appLabel(sbn.getPackageName());

        if (!call) {
            captureReplyAction(n, title.isEmpty() ? appName : title, appName);
        }

        SystemUtilityHelper.FinancialParseResult fin = call ? null
                : SystemUtilityHelper.parseFinancialNotification(sbn.getPackageName(), appName, title, text);
        if (fin != null && fin.fromFinancialSource) {
            if (fin.isSpamOrPromo) {
                // Abaikan promosi / iklan aplikasi bank atau e-wallet tanpa transaksi nyata
                return;
            }
            if (!fin.summary.isEmpty()) {
                new KobraConfig(this).setLastFinancialTx(fin.summary);
                String finPhish = SecurityAndPinHelper.inspectForPhishing(title + " " + text);
                String finSpoken = finPhish.isEmpty() ? fin.summary : finPhish + " " + fin.summary;
                remember(finSpoken);
                Speaker.get(this).speakQueued(finSpoken);
                return;
            }
        }

        String displayTitle = call ? resolveCallerDisplay(title) : title;
        String body = displayTitle.isEmpty() ? text : (text.isEmpty() ? displayTitle : displayTitle + ". " + text);

        String phishWarning = call ? "" : SecurityAndPinHelper.inspectForPhishing(title + " " + text);
        String spoken;
        if (call) {
            spoken = "Telepon masuk dari " + displayTitle + ". Bilang Kobra angkat telepon atau tolak telepon.";
        } else {
            spoken = appName + ". " + body;
        }
        if (spoken.length() > MAX_SPOKEN) spoken = spoken.substring(0, MAX_SPOKEN);
        if (!phishWarning.isEmpty()) {
            spoken = phishWarning + " Isi pesan: " + spoken;
        }
        remember(spoken);

        if (!phishWarning.isEmpty() || new KobraConfig(this).isReadNotifications()) {
            Speaker.get(this).speakQueued(spoken);
        }
    }

    private void captureReplyAction(Notification n, String sender, String appName) {
        if (n.actions == null) return;
        for (Notification.Action action : n.actions) {
            if (action == null || action.actionIntent == null) continue;
            RemoteInput[] ris = action.getRemoteInputs();
            if (ris != null && ris.length > 0) {
                lastReplyTarget = new ReplyTarget(action.actionIntent, ris, sender, appName);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    private String resolveCallerDisplay(String rawTitle) {
        if (rawTitle == null || rawTitle.trim().isEmpty()) return "penelepon tidak dikenal";
        String trimmed = rawTitle.trim();
        if (!trimmed.matches(".*\\d{4,}.*") || !Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) {
            return trimmed;
        }
        try (Cursor cur = getContentResolver().query(
                Uri.withAppendedPath(ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI, Uri.encode(trimmed)),
                new String[]{ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)) {
            if (cur != null && cur.moveToFirst()) {
                String name = cur.getString(0);
                if (name != null && !name.trim().isEmpty()) return name.trim();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return trimmed;
    }

    private static String str(CharSequence cs) { return cs == null ? "" : cs.toString().trim(); }

    private String appLabel(String pkg) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getPackageManager();
            return pm.getApplicationLabel(pm.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0)).toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return pkg;
        }
    }
}
