package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.CompoundButton;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Pengendali terpadu untuk seluruh layar Kobra OS:
 * 1) Navigasi tombol fisik eksternal / keyboard Bluetooth (DPAD_UP, DPAD_DOWN, ENTER, BACK)
 *    disertai pembacaan fokus lewat Speaker.
 * 2) Gestur layar:
 *    - Usap dua jari ke bawah: baca semua notifikasi terbaru.
 *    - Usap dua jari ke atas: hentikan suara & sirine seketika.
 *    - Ketuk dua kali di mana saja: mulai mendengarkan perintah suara.
 */
public final class KobraScreenHelper {

    public static boolean safeStartActivity(Context ctx, Intent intent, Speaker speaker, String fallbackMsg) {
        if (ctx == null || intent == null) {
            notifyLaunchError(ctx, speaker, fallbackMsg);
            return false;
        }
        try {
            if (!(ctx instanceof Activity)) {
                intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
            }
            ctx.startActivity(intent);
            return true;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            notifyLaunchError(ctx, speaker, fallbackMsg);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static void notifyLaunchError(Context ctx, Speaker speaker, String fallbackMsg) {
        String msg = (fallbackMsg != null && !fallbackMsg.trim().isEmpty())
                ? fallbackMsg
                : "Halaman atau aplikasi tersebut tidak tersedia di perangkat ini.";
        if (ctx != null) {
            try {
                Toast.makeText(ctx, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
        if (speaker != null) {
            try {
                speaker.speak(msg);
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private boolean twoFingerActive = false;
    private float startTwoFingerY = 0f;
    private boolean swipeTriggered = false;
    private long lastTapDownAt = 0L;
    private float lastTapX = 0f;
    private float lastTapY = 0f;
    private boolean singleFingerMoved = false;

    public boolean handleKeyEvent(Activity activity, KeyEvent event, Speaker speaker) {
        if (activity == null || event == null) return false;
        if (event.getAction() != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN) return false;

        int code = event.getKeyCode();
        if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN) {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(activity);
            mainHandler.postDelayed(() -> announceCurrentFocus(activity, speaker), 60L);
            return false; // Biarkan sistem memindahkan fokus, lalu baca elemen fokusnya
        }
        if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER) {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(activity);
            return false;
        }
        if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK || code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(activity);
            if (speaker != null) {
                speaker.stop();
            }
            if (code == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) {
                if (activity instanceof androidx.activity.ComponentActivity) {
                    ((androidx.activity.ComponentActivity) activity).getOnBackPressedDispatcher().onBackPressed();
                } else {
                    activity.finish();
                }
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean handleTouchEvent(Activity activity, MotionEvent ev, Speaker speaker) {
        if (activity == null || ev == null) return false;
        float density = activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        float swipeThreshold = 90f * density;
        float doubleTapSlop = 56f * density;

        int action = ev.getActionMasked();
        switch (action) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                singleFingerMoved = false;
                if (ev.getPointerCount() == 1) {
                    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    float dx = ev.getX() - lastTapX;
                    float dy = ev.getY() - lastTapY;
                    if (now - lastTapDownAt <= 320L && (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= (doubleTapSlop * doubleTapSlop)) {
                        lastTapDownAt = 0L;
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(activity);
                        AsistenAccessibilityService.requestListen();
                        return true;
                    }
                    lastTapDownAt = now;
                    lastTapX = ev.getX();
                    lastTapY = ev.getY();
                }
                break;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN:
                if (ev.getPointerCount() == 2) {
                    twoFingerActive = true;
                    swipeTriggered = false;
                    startTwoFingerY = (ev.getY(0) + ev.getY(1)) / 2f;
                }
                break;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                if (ev.getPointerCount() == 1) {
                    float dx = Math.abs(ev.getX() - lastTapX);
                    float dy = Math.abs(ev.getY() - lastTapY);
                    if (dx > 18f * density || dy > 18f * density) {
                        singleFingerMoved = true;
                    }
                } else if (twoFingerActive && !swipeTriggered && ev.getPointerCount() >= 2) {
                    float curY = (ev.getY(0) + ev.getY(1)) / 2f;
                    float deltaY = curY - startTwoFingerY;
                    if (deltaY > swipeThreshold) {
                        swipeTriggered = true;
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(activity);
                        String notif = KobraNotificationService.summary(12);
                        if (speaker != null) speaker.speak(notif);
                        return true;
                    } else if (deltaY < -swipeThreshold) {
                        swipeTriggered = true;
                        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(activity);
                        if (speaker != null) speaker.stop();
                        EmergencyBeacon.stopAll(activity, null);
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                break;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                if (singleFingerMoved) {
                    lastTapDownAt = 0L;
                }
                if (ev.getPointerCount() <= 1 || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                    boolean consumed = swipeTriggered;
                    twoFingerActive = false;
                    swipeTriggered = false;
                    if (consumed) return true;
                }
                break;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void announceCurrentFocus(Activity activity, Speaker speaker) {
        if (speaker == null || activity.isFinishing() || activity.isDestroyed()) return;
        View v = activity.getCurrentFocus();
        if (v == null) return;
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        CharSequence desc = v.getContentDescription();
        if (desc != null && desc.toString().trim().length() > 0) {
            sb.append(desc.toString().trim());
        } else if (v instanceof TextView) {
            CharSequence txt = ((TextView) v).getText();
            if (txt != null) sb.append(txt.toString().trim());
        }
        if (v instanceof CompoundButton) {
            sb.append(((CompoundButton) v).isChecked() ? ", aktif" : ", mati");
        }
        String label = sb.toString().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (!label.isEmpty()) {
            speaker.speak(label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).length() > 140 ? label.substring(0, 140) : label);
        }
    }
}

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/LocalLlmEngine.java

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.genai.llminference.LlmInference;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Pengelola Mesin LLM Offline (MediaPipe LLM Inference API 0.10.14) untuk Kobra OS.
 * Menggunakan model Gemma 3 1B terkuantisasi dari direktori internal HP,
 * lengkap dengan memori konteks 5-8 giliran percakapan, dukungan gaya bahasa asisten,
 * serta ringkasan otomatis notifikasi menumpuk dan teks OCR panjang.
 */
public class LocalLlmEngine {

    private static final String TAG = "KobraLocalLLM";
    private static final int MAX_HISTORY_TURNS = 8;
    private static final int MAX_PROMPT_CHARS = 2400;

    // Nama berkas model Gemma 3 1B di penyimpanan internal (/data/data/com.asisten.bantu/files/)
    public static final String MODEL_FILENAME = "gemma3-1b-it-int4.task";
    public static final String CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON =
            "Mode Aman: Model lokal terlalu berat untuk RAM perangkat (Gunakan model int4 256/512 token atau hapus model)";

    public interface StreamingCallback {
        void onPartialResult(String partialText, boolean isComplete);
        void onError(String error);
    }

    public interface SummaryCallback {
        void onSummary(String summary);
    }

    private static final class ChatTurn {
        final String user;
        final String assistant;

        ChatTurn(String user, String assistant) {
            this.user = user;
            this.assistant = assistant;
        }
    }

    private static volatile LocalLlmEngine sInstance;

    private LlmInference llmInference;
    private boolean isInitialized = false;
    private boolean safeMode = false;
    private String lastError = "";
    private final Context context;
    private final Handler mainHandler;
    private Speaker activeSpeaker;
    private StreamingCallback activeCallback;
    private final StringBuilder sentenceBuffer = new StringBuilder();
    private final StringBuilder fullResponseBuffer = new StringBuilder();
    private final List<ChatTurn> sessionHistory = new ArrayList<>();
    private String pendingHistoryUserPrompt = "";
    private boolean shouldRecordHistory = false;

    public static synchronized LocalLlmEngine getInstance(Context context) {
        if (sInstance == null) {
            sInstance = new LocalLlmEngine(context.getApplicationContext());
        }
        return sInstance;
    }

    public LocalLlmEngine(Context context) {
        this.context = context.getApplicationContext();
        this.mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        syncCrashGuardState();
    }

    private synchronized void syncCrashGuardState() {
        KobraConfig cfg = new KobraConfig(context);
        cfg.checkAndHandlePreviousLlmCrash();
        if (cfg.isLlmSafeMode()) {
            this.safeMode = true;
            String savedReason = cfg.getLlmSafeReason();
            this.lastError = savedReason.isEmpty() ? CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : savedReason;
        }
    }

    /** Mengembalikan objek File untuk model internal. */
    public File getModelFile() {
        return new File(context.getFilesDir(), MODEL_FILENAME);
    }

    /** Memeriksa apakah mesin LLM sudah berhasil diinisialisasi dan siap di memori. */
    public synchronized boolean isInitialized() {
        return isInitialized && llmInference != null && !safeMode;
    }

    /** True jika aplikasi berjalan di Mode Aman karena model belum tersedia atau crash/memori penuh. */
    public synchronized boolean isSafeMode() {
        syncCrashGuardState();
        return safeMode || !isModelPresent();
    }

    public synchronized String getLastError() {
        syncCrashGuardState();
        return lastError;
    }

    /** Memeriksa keberadaan berkas model terkuantisasi di penyimpanan internal. */
    public boolean isModelPresent() {
        File modelFile = getModelFile();
        return modelFile.exists() && modelFile.length() > 1024 * 1024;
    }

    /** Menghapus memori konteks percakapan sesi aktif. */
    public synchronized void clearSessionHistory() {
        sessionHistory.clear();
        pendingHistoryUserPrompt = "";
    }

    /** Mengembalikan jumlah giliran percakapan yang tersimpan dalam sesi saat ini (maks 8). */
    public synchronized int getSessionTurnCount() {
        return sessionHistory.size();
    }

    public synchronized void addSessionTurn(String userText, String assistantReply) {
        if (userText == null || userText.trim().isEmpty()
                || assistantReply == null || assistantReply.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        sessionHistory.add(new ChatTurn(userText.trim(), assistantReply.trim()));
        while (sessionHistory.size() > MAX_HISTORY_TURNS) {
            sessionHistory.remove(0);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Memuat model bahasa offline ke memori secara on-demand. Dipanggil pada thread latar belakang.
     * Menggunakan Native Crash-Guard (llm_crash_guard) agar proses tidak mengalami crash-loop SIGSEGV/OOM.
     */
    public synchronized boolean initEngine() {
        return initEngineInternal(false);
    }

    /** Mereset status Mode Aman crash-guard dan mencoba memuat model secara manual atas permintaan pengguna. */
    public synchronized boolean forceInitEngine() {
        close();
        new KobraConfig(context).clearLlmSafeMode();
        this.safeMode = false;
        this.lastError = "";
        return initEngineInternal(true);
    }

    private synchronized boolean initEngineInternal(boolean ignoreExistingSafeMode) {
        if (isInitialized && llmInference != null) {
            safeMode = false;
            return true;
        }

        KobraConfig cfg = new KobraConfig(context);
        if (!ignoreExistingSafeMode && (cfg.checkAndHandlePreviousLlmCrash() || cfg.isLlmSafeMode())) {
            safeMode = true;
            String savedReason = cfg.getLlmSafeReason();
            lastError = savedReason.isEmpty() ? CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : savedReason;
            Log.w(TAG, "Melewati pemuatan otomatis LLM karena Native Crash-Guard aktif: " + lastError);
            return false;
        }

        File modelFile = getModelFile();
        if (!modelFile.exists() || modelFile.length() <= 1024 * 1024) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Berkas model Gemma 3 1B belum ditemukan di: " + modelFile.getAbsolutePath());
            safeMode = true;
            lastError = "Model belum terpasang";
            return false;
        }

        try {
            Log.d(TAG, "Mulai menginisialisasi Gemma 3 1B dari: " + modelFile.getAbsolutePath());

            LlmInference.LlmInferenceOptions options = LlmInference.LlmInferenceOptions.builder()
                    .setModelPath(modelFile.getAbsolutePath())
                    .setMaxTokens(512)
                    .setTopK(40)
                    .setTemperature(0.3f)
                    .setResultListener((partialResult, done) -> {
                        if (activeCallback != null) {
                            final StreamingCallback cb = activeCallback;
                            mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onPartialResult(partialResult, done));
                        }

                        if (partialResult != null && !partialResult.isEmpty()) {
                            sentenceBuffer.append(partialResult);
                            fullResponseBuffer.append(partialResult);

                            String currentText = sentenceBuffer.toString();
                            if (currentText.contains(".") || currentText.contains(",") || currentText.contains("\n")) {
                                String textToSpeak = cleanTextForTts(currentText);
                                sentenceBuffer.setLength(0);

                                if (!textToSpeak.isEmpty() && activeSpeaker != null) {
                                    final Speaker spk = activeSpeaker;
                                    mainHandler.post(() -> spk.speakQueued(textToSpeak));
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (done) {
                            String remainingText = cleanTextForTts(sentenceBuffer.toString());
                            sentenceBuffer.setLength(0);
                            if (!remainingText.isEmpty() && activeSpeaker != null) {
                                final Speaker spk = activeSpeaker;
                                mainHandler.post(() -> spk.speakQueued(remainingText));
                            }
                            String fullReply = cleanTextForTts(fullResponseBuffer.toString());
                            fullResponseBuffer.setLength(0);
                            if (shouldRecordHistory && !pendingHistoryUserPrompt.isEmpty() && !fullReply.isEmpty()) {
                                addSessionTurn(pendingHistoryUserPrompt, fullReply);
                            }
                            pendingHistoryUserPrompt = "";
                            shouldRecordHistory = false;
                            Log.d(TAG, "Generasi respons Gemma 3 1B selesai.");
                        }
                    })
                    .setErrorListener(e -> {
                        Log.e(TAG, "Galat saat streaming inferensi LLM offline", e);
                        pendingHistoryUserPrompt = "";
                        shouldRecordHistory = false;
                        if (activeCallback != null) {
                            final StreamingCallback cb = activeCallback;
                            mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onError(e != null ? e.getMessage() : "Galat inferensi"));
                        }
                        if (activeSpeaker != null) {
                            final Speaker spk = activeSpeaker;
                            mainHandler.post(() -> spk.speak("Terjadi kendala saat memproses jawaban offline. Beralih ke Mode Aman."));
                        }
                    })
                    .build();

            // Simpan flag crash-guard secara sinkron sebelum JNI native createFromOptions dipanggil
            cfg.setLlmInitPending(true);
            llmInference = LlmInference.createFromOptions(context, options);
            cfg.clearLlmSafeMode();

            isInitialized = true;
            safeMode = false;
            lastError = "";
            Log.i(TAG, "Mesin LLM Offline (Gemma 3 1B) berhasil diinisialisasi.");
            return true;

        } catch (OutOfMemoryError oom) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Memori penuh (OOM) saat memuat model LLM offline. Masuk ke Mode Aman.", oom);
            cleanupPartialInference();
            safeMode = true;
            lastError = CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON;
            cfg.setLlmInitPending(false);
            cfg.setLlmSafeMode(true);
            cfg.setLlmSafeReason(CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON);
            return false;
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Gagal menginisialisasi MediaPipe LLM Inference. Masuk ke Mode Aman.", t);
            cleanupPartialInference();
            safeMode = true;
            String errMsg = t.getMessage() != null ? t.getMessage() : CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON;
            lastError = errMsg;
            cfg.setLlmInitPending(false);
            cfg.setLlmSafeMode(true);
            cfg.setLlmSafeReason(errMsg);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void cleanupPartialInference() {
        if (llmInference != null) {
            try { llmInference.close(); } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            llmInference = null;
        }
        isInitialized = false;
    }

    /** Memuat ulang mesin bahasa offline (misal setelah model baru diimpor). */
    public synchronized boolean reloadEngine() {
        return forceInitEngine();
    }

    /** Menghapus berkas model lokal .task dari penyimpanan internal dan mereset Mode Aman. */
    public synchronized boolean deleteLocalModel() {
        close();
        clearSessionHistory();
        File modelFile = getModelFile();
        File tempFile = new File(context.getFilesDir(), MODEL_FILENAME + ".tmp");
        if (tempFile.exists()) {
            tempFile.delete();
        }
        boolean deleted = !modelFile.exists() || modelFile.delete();
        new KobraConfig(context).clearLlmSafeMode();
        this.safeMode = false;
        this.lastError = "";
        return deleted;
    }

    /**
     * Mengirimkan instruksi/pertanyaan pengguna ke model offline dengan memori konteks percakapan.
     */
    public void generateResponseAsync(String prompt, Speaker speaker) {
        generateResponseAsync(prompt, speaker, null, true);
    }

    public void generateResponseAsync(String prompt, Speaker speaker, StreamingCallback callback) {
        generateResponseAsync(prompt, speaker, callback, true);
    }

    /**
     * Mengirimkan instruksi ke model offline dengan dukungan memori sesi (5-8 giliran terakhir)
     * serta gaya bahasa asisten dari KobraConfig.
     */
    public synchronized void generateResponseAsync(String prompt, Speaker speaker, StreamingCallback callback, boolean useHistory) {
        if (!isInitialized || llmInference == null || safeMode) {
            safeMode = true;
            String msg = "Model AI offline belum tersedia atau memori penuh. Beralih ke Mode Aman perintah sistem lokal.";
            if (speaker != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> speaker.speak(msg));
            }
            if (callback != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError(msg));
            }
            return;
        }

        try {
            this.activeSpeaker = speaker;
            this.activeCallback = callback;
            this.sentenceBuffer.setLength(0);
            this.fullResponseBuffer.setLength(0);
            this.shouldRecordHistory = useHistory;
            this.pendingHistoryUserPrompt = useHistory && prompt != null ? prompt.trim() : "";

            String formattedPrompt = buildContextualPrompt(prompt, useHistory);
            llmInference.generateResponseAsync(formattedPrompt);
        } catch (OutOfMemoryError oom) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Memori penuh saat inferensi LLM offline", oom);
            cleanupPartialInference();
            safeMode = true;
            lastError = "Memori penuh saat inferensi";
            String msg = "Memori HP penuh saat memproses model offline. Beralih ke Mode Aman perintah sistem lokal.";
            if (speaker != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> speaker.speak(msg));
            }
            if (callback != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError(msg));
            }
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Galat saat mengeksekusi inferensi LLM offline", t);
            safeMode = true;
            lastError = t.getMessage() != null ? t.getMessage() : "Kesalahan inferensi";
            String msg = "Model offline mengalami kendala. Beralih ke Mode Aman perintah sistem lokal.";
            if (speaker != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> speaker.speak(msg));
            }
            if (callback != null) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onError(msg));
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Meringkas notifikasi menumpuk atau teks OCR/dokumen panjang menggunakan Gemma 3 1B offline,
     * AI online bila tersedia, atau ringkasan ekstraktif lokal (Safe Mode).
     */
    public void summarizeText(String title, String longText, AiClient onlineFallback, Speaker speaker, SummaryCallback cb) {
        if (longText == null || longText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onSummary("Tidak ada teks atau notifikasi untuk diringkas."));
            return;
        }
        String trimmed = longText.trim();
        final String finalClipped = trimmed.length() > 1500 ? trimmed.substring(0, 1500) : trimmed;
        final String finalInstruction = "Ringkas " + title + " berikut menjadi 2 hingga 3 kalimat Bahasa Indonesia yang jelas, "
                + "sebutkan inti pesan, nama pengirim, atau angka pentingnya tanpa format markdown:\n\n" + finalClipped;

        if (isInitialized()) {
            runSummaryOnGemma(finalInstruction, title, finalClipped, speaker, cb);
            return;
        }

        if (isModelPresent() && !isSafeMode()) {
            new Thread(() -> {
                if (initEngine()) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> runSummaryOnGemma(finalInstruction, title, finalClipped, speaker, cb));
                } else {
                    fallbackSummarize(finalInstruction, title, finalClipped, onlineFallback, cb);
                }
            }).start();
            return;
        }

        fallbackSummarize(finalInstruction, title, finalClipped, onlineFallback, cb);
    }

    private void runSummaryOnGemma(String instruction, String title, String rawText, Speaker speaker, SummaryCallback cb) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        generateResponseAsync(instruction, speaker, new StreamingCallback() {
            @Override public void onPartialResult(String partialText, boolean isComplete) {
                if (partialText != null) out.append(partialText);
                if (isComplete) {
                    String clean = cleanTextForTts(out.toString());
                    cb.onSummary(clean.isEmpty() ? buildOfflineExtractiveSummary(title, rawText) : clean);
                }
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                cb.onSummary(buildOfflineExtractiveSummary(title, rawText));
            }
        }, false);
    }

    private void fallbackSummarize(String instruction, String title, String rawText, AiClient onlineFallback, SummaryCallback cb) {
        KobraConfig cfg = new KobraConfig(context);
        if (onlineFallback != null && NetworkState.isOnline(context) && cfg.hasAi()) {
            onlineFallback.chat(AiClient.SYSTEM_TUNANETRA, instruction, new AiClient.Callback() {
                @Override public void onResult(String text) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onSummary(cleanTextForTts(text)));
                }
                @Override public void onError(String message) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onSummary(buildOfflineExtractiveSummary(title, rawText)));
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        mainHandler.post(() -> cb.onSummary(buildOfflineExtractiveSummary(title, rawText)));
    }

    public static String buildOfflineExtractiveSummary(String title, String rawText) {
        String clean = rawText == null ? "" : rawText.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return "Tidak ada isi untuk diringkas.";
        String[] lines = rawText.split("\\n+");
        if (lines.length >= 3) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("Ringkasan " + title + " (" + lines.length + " bagian). ");
            int limit = Math.min(3, lines.length);
            for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                String l = lines[i].trim();
                if (!l.isEmpty()) {
                    if (l.length() > 110) l = l.substring(0, 110) + "...";
                    sb.append(l).append(". ");
                }
            }
            return sb.toString().trim();
        }
        String[] sentences = clean.split("(?<=[.!?])\\s+");
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("Ringkasan " + title + ". ");
        int count = 0;
        for (String s : sentences) {
            String t = s.trim();
            if (t.isEmpty()) continue;
            sb.append(t).append(" ");
            count++;
            if (count >= 3 || sb.length() > 260) break;
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private synchronized String buildContextualPrompt(String userPrompt, boolean useHistory) {
        KobraConfig cfg = new KobraConfig(context);
        String systemPrompt = "Kamu adalah Kobra, asisten suara untuk penyandang tunanetra. "
                + cfg.getAssistantStyleSystemPrompt();

        List<ChatTurn> included = new ArrayList<>();
        if (useHistory && !sessionHistory.isEmpty()) {
            int budget = MAX_PROMPT_CHARS - systemPrompt.length() - (userPrompt == null ? 0 : userPrompt.length()) - 120;
            for (int i = sessionHistory.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                ChatTurn t = sessionHistory.get(i);
                int cost = t.user.length() + t.assistant.length() + 45;
                if (budget - cost < 0) break;
                included.add(0, t);
                budget -= cost;
            }
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (included.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("<start_of_turn>user\n")
              .append(systemPrompt).append("\n\n")
              .append(userPrompt == null ? "" : userPrompt.trim())
              .append("<end_of_turn>\n<start_of_turn>model\n");
            return sb.toString();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < included.size(); i++) {
            ChatTurn t = included.get(i);
            sb.append("<start_of_turn>user\n");
            if (i == 0) {
                sb.append(systemPrompt).append("\n\n");
            }
            sb.append(t.user).append("<end_of_turn>\n");
            sb.append("<start_of_turn>model\n").append(t.assistant).append("<end_of_turn>\n");
        }
        sb.append("<start_of_turn>user\n")
          .append(userPrompt == null ? "" : userPrompt.trim())
          .append("<end_of_turn>\n<start_of_turn>model\n");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Membersihkan simbol markdown dan karakter khusus agar pengucapan TTS tidak terganggu. */
    private String cleanTextForTts(String text) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        return text.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", " ")
                   .replaceAll("[*#_`~\\-]", "")
                   .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                   .trim();
    }

    /** Membebaskan memori sistem saat service dihentikan. */
    public synchronized void close() {
        cleanupPartialInference();
        activeSpeaker = null;
        activeCallback = null;
        Log.i(TAG, "Sumber daya LLM Offline berhasil dibebaskan.");
    }
}

    private void selectTab(int index) {
        activeTab = index;
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        if (sectionMain != null) sectionMain.setVisibility(index == 0 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (sectionSetup != null) sectionSetup.setVisibility(index == 1 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (sectionUtils != null) sectionUtils.setVisibility(index == 2 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (sectionVoice != null) sectionVoice.setVisibility(index == 3 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);

        styleTab(tabMain, index == 0);
        styleTab(tabSetup, index == 1);
        styleTab(tabUtils, index == 2);
        styleTab(tabVoice, index == 3);

        if (mainScroll != null) {
            mainScroll.post(() -> mainScroll.scrollTo(0, 0));
        }
    }

    private void styleTab(Button tab, boolean selected) {

        tab.setBackgroundResource(selected ? R.drawable.bg_tab_active : R.drawable.bg_tab_inactive);
        tab.setTextColor(selected ? 0xFF10B981 : 0xFF94A3B8);
    }

    private void showStatus() {
        KobraConfig c = new KobraConfig(this);
        LocalLlmEngine llm = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);

        boolean micOk = Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO);
        boolean camOk = Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA);
        boolean accOk = AsistenAccessibilityService.getInstance() != null;
        boolean notifOk = KobraNotificationService.isConnected();

        int bat = -1;
        boolean charging = false;
        try {
            BatteryManager bm = (BatteryManager) getSystemService(BATTERY_SERVICE);
            if (bm != null) {
                bat = bm.getIntProperty(BatteryManager.BATTERY_PROPERTY_CAPACITY);
                charging = bm.isCharging();
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

        String freeText = "--";
        try {
            StatFs stat = new StatFs(getFilesDir().getAbsolutePath());
            long freeMb = stat.getAvailableBytes() / (1024L * 1024L);
            freeText = freeMb >= 1024
                    ? String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f GB", freeMb / 1024.0)
                    : freeMb + " MB";
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

        // Pill 1: Suara & Izin
        if (tvPillVoice != null) {
            if (micOk && camOk && accOk) {
                tvPillVoice.setText("🎤 Suara Siap");
                tvPillVoice.setTextColor(0xFF10B981);
            } else {
                tvPillVoice.setText("🎤 Perlu Izin");
                tvPillVoice.setTextColor(0xFFF59E0B);
            }
        }

        // Pill 2: Otak AI Offline / Online
        boolean crashSafe = c.isLlmSafeMode() || (llm.isModelPresent() && llm.isSafeMode());
        if (tvPillAi != null) {
            if (llm.isInitialized()) {
                tvPillAi.setText("🧠 AI Aktif");
                tvPillAi.setTextColor(0xFF10B981);
            } else if (crashSafe) {
                tvPillAi.setText("⚠️ Mode Aman");
                tvPillAi.setTextColor(0xFFF59E0B);
            } else if (llm.isModelPresent()) {
                tvPillAi.setText("🧠 AI Siap");
                tvPillAi.setTextColor(0xFF38BDF8);
            } else if (c.hasAi()) {
                tvPillAi.setText("☁️ AI Online");
                tvPillAi.setTextColor(0xFF38BDF8);
            } else {
                tvPillAi.setText("🧠 Mode Lokal");
                tvPillAi.setTextColor(0xFF94A3B8);
            }
        }

        // Pill 3: Baterai & Sinyal
        if (tvPillSignal != null) {
            String netLabel = NetworkState.isOnline(this) ? NetworkState.connectionType(this) : "Offline";
            String batLabel = bat >= 0 ? bat + "%" + (charging ? "⚡" : "") : "--";
            tvPillSignal.setText("🔋 " + batLabel + " • " + netLabel);
            tvPillSignal.setTextColor(bat >= 0 && bat < 20 && !charging ? 0xFFEF4444 : 0xFFF8FAFC);
        }

        // Ringkasan 1 baris Hero + status crash guard bila aktif
        if (tvStatus != null) {
            if (crashSafe) {
                String err = llm.getLastError().isEmpty() ? LocalLlmEngine.CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : llm.getLastError();
                tvStatus.setText(err);
                tvStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFBBF24);
            } else {
                String aiLabel = llm.isInitialized() ? "AI Lokal Aktif"
                        : (llm.isModelPresent() ? "AI Lokal Lazy-Load" : (c.hasAi() ? "AI Online Siap" : "Perintah Lokal"));
                tvStatus.setText(aiLabel + " • Notif: " + (notifOk ? "Aktif" : "Mati") + " • Sisa ruang: " + freeText);
                tvStatus.setTextColor(0xFFE2E8F0);
            }
        }
        if (btnResetAiSafeMode != null) {
            btnResetAiSafeMode.setVisibility(crashSafe ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }

        String sosText = c.hasSosContact() ? "Kontak SOS diatur" : "Belum diatur (Default: 112)";
        String privText = c.isPrivacyMode() ? "Mode Privasi AKTIF" : "Privasi Normal";
        if (tvQuickMeta != null) {
            tvQuickMeta.setText("SOS: " + sosText + " • " + privText + " • Gaya: " + c.getAssistantStyleLabel());
        }
        if (tvPedometerCardSub != null) {
            tvPedometerCardSub.setText(c.getTodaySteps() + " langkah (" + c.getTodayDistanceMeters() + " m)");
        }
    }

    private void askBatteryExemption() {
        try {
            PowerManager pm = (PowerManager) getSystemService(POWER_SERVICE);
            if (pm != null && pm.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(getPackageName())) {
                toast("Kobra sudah bebas dari pembatasan baterai.");
                return;
            }
            Intent i = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS,
                    Uri.parse("package:" + getPackageName()));
            launchScreen(i, "Pengaturan optimasi baterai tidak didukung langsung di HP ini.");
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            toast("Gagal memeriksa optimasi baterai.");
        }
    }

    private void toast(String s) { Toast.makeText(this, s, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.TextView;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

/**
 * Layar Kartu Identitas Medis Darurat kontras tinggi (nama, golongan darah, alergi, kontak keluarga)
 * yang langsung dibacakan keras saat dipanggil oleh pengguna atau penolong.
 */
public class MedicalCardActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    public static final String EXTRA_AUTO_SPEAK = "auto_speak";

    private KobraConfig config;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private EditText etName, etBlood, etAllergy, etCondition, etFamily;
    private TextView tvSummary;

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_medical_card);
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);

        boolean autoSpeak = getIntent().getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_AUTO_SPEAK, false);
        final android.view.View contentRoot = ((android.view.ViewGroup) findViewById(android.R.id.content)).getChildAt(0);
        if (config.hasSecurityPin() && !autoSpeak && !getIntent().getBooleanExtra(CaregiverActivity.EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, false)) {
            if (contentRoot != null) contentRoot.setVisibility(android.view.View.INVISIBLE);
            SecurityAndPinHelper.requirePinIfSet(this, config, speaker, "Kartu Medis Darurat",
                    new SecurityAndPinHelper.PinCallback() {
                        @Override public void onUnlocked() {
                            if (contentRoot != null) contentRoot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                        @Override public void onCancelled() {
                            finish();
                        }
                    });
        }

        tvSummary = findViewById(R.id.tvMedSummary);
        etName = findViewById(R.id.etMedName);
        etBlood = findViewById(R.id.etMedBlood);
        etAllergy = findViewById(R.id.etMedAllergy);
        etCondition = findViewById(R.id.etMedCondition);
        etFamily = findViewById(R.id.etMedFamily);

        loadFields();

        findViewById(R.id.btnSaveMed).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            saveFields();
            updateSummary();
            HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
            speaker.speak("Kartu identitas medis darurat berhasil disimpan.");
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnSpeakMed).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            saveFields();
            updateSummary();
            speakLoudly();
        });

        findViewById(R.id.btnBackMed).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            finish();
        });

        if (getIntent().getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_AUTO_SPEAK, false)) {
            speakLoudly();
        }
    }

    private void loadFields() {
        etName.setText(config.getMedName());
        etBlood.setText(config.getMedBlood());
        etAllergy.setText(config.getMedAllergy());
        etCondition.setText(config.getMedCondition());
        etFamily.setText(config.getMedFamily());
        updateSummary();
    }

    private void saveFields() {
        config.setMedName(etName.getText().toString());
        config.setMedBlood(etBlood.getText().toString());
        config.setMedAllergy(etAllergy.getText().toString());
        config.setMedCondition(etCondition.getText().toString());
        config.setMedFamily(etFamily.getText().toString());
    }

    private void updateSummary() {
        tvSummary.setText(config.getMedicalCardSpeech());
    }

    private void speakLoudly() {
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am != null) {
                int max = am.getStreamMaxVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC);
                int cur = am.getStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC);
                if (cur < (max * 8) / 10) {
                    am.setStreamVolume(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, max, 0);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        speaker.speak(config.getMedicalCardSpeech());
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.provider.ContactsContract;
import android.provider.Telephony;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

/** Membaca SMS masuk terbaru untuk dibacakan lewat suara. */
public final class MessageReader {
    private MessageReader() {}

    public static String latestSms(Context c, int count) {
        if (!Perms.has(c, Manifest.permission.READ_SMS)) {
            return "Izin membaca SMS belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Izin.";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int n = 0;
        SimpleDateFormat fmt = new SimpleDateFormat("d MMMM, HH:mm", new Locale("id", "ID"));
        try (Cursor cur = c.getContentResolver().query(
                Telephony.Sms.Inbox.CONTENT_URI,
                new String[]{Telephony.Sms.ADDRESS, Telephony.Sms.BODY, Telephony.Sms.DATE},
                null, null, Telephony.Sms.DATE + " DESC")) {
            while (cur != null && cur.moveToNext() && n < count) {
                String from = nameFor(c, cur.getString(0));
                String body = cur.getString(1) == null ? "" : cur.getString(1).trim();
                String phishWarning = SecurityAndPinHelper.inspectForPhishing(body);
                if (body.length() > 300) body = body.substring(0, 300) + ". Masih ada lanjutannya.";
                n++;
                sb.append("SMS ").append(n).append(" dari ").append(from)
                        .append(", ").append(fmt.format(new Date(cur.getLong(2))))
                        .append(". ");
                if (!phishWarning.isEmpty()) {
                    sb.append(phishWarning).append(" ");
                }
                sb.append(body).append(" ");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "SMS tidak bisa dibaca di HP ini.";
        }
        return n == 0 ? "Tidak ada SMS masuk." : sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private static String nameFor(Context c, String number) {
        if (number == null || number.isEmpty()) return "pengirim tidak dikenal";
        if (!Perms.has(c, Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) return number;
        try (Cursor cur = c.getContentResolver().query(
                Uri.withAppendedPath(ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI, Uri.encode(number)),
                new String[]{ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)) {
            if (cur != null && cur.moveToFirst()) return cur.getString(0);
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return number;
    }
}

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/MoneyAndReceiptParser.java

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import java.text.NumberFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Pengurai cerdas offline untuk Mata Kedua:
 * - Nominal lembaran uang Rupiah (untuk penghitung lembar uang tunai berurutan)
 * - Pembaca angka/teks layar perangkat digital (ATM, timbangan, tensimeter, meteran)
 * - Pemindai struk & tangkapan layar transfer bank / dompet digital Indonesia
 */
public final class MoneyAndReceiptParser {

    public static final class BillResult {
        public final long amount;
        public final boolean confidentOcr;
        public final String explanation;

        BillResult(long amount, boolean confidentOcr, String explanation) {
            this.amount = amount;
            this.confidentOcr = confidentOcr;
            this.explanation = explanation;
        }
    }

    private static final long[] VALID_RUPIAH = {
            100_000L, 50_000L, 20_000L, 10_000L, 5_000L, 2_000L, 1_000L, 500L, 200L, 100L
    };

    private static final String[] BANK_PROVIDERS = {
            "BCA", "BRI", "BNI", "MANDIRI", "BSI", "CIMB", "PERMATA", "DANAMON",
            "SEABANK", "JAGO", "BTN", "MEGA", "OCBC", "PANIN",
            "DANA", "OVO", "GOPAY", "SHOPEEPAY", "LINKAJA", "QRIS", "BI-FAST"
    };

    private static final Pattern RP_AMOUNT = Pattern.compile(
            "(?:RP\\.?|IDR)\\s*([0-9]{1,3}(?:[.,][0-9]{3})+|[0-9]{4,9})(?:[.,]00)?",
            Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);

    private MoneyAndReceiptParser() {}

    /** Memformat angka rupiah agar mudah dibaca layar dan TTS. */
    public static String formatRupiah(long amount) {
        NumberFormat nf = NumberFormat.getInstance(new Locale("id", "ID"));
        return nf.format(amount) + " rupiah";
    }

    /** Mengenali nominal lembaran uang Rupiah dari teks OCR kamera dan warna dominan bila perlu. */
    public static BillResult parseRupiahBill(String ocrText, Bitmap bmp) {
        String text = ocrText == null ? "" : ocrText;
        String upper = text.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String digitsOnly = upper.replace(".", "").replace(",", "").replace("O", "0");

        if (upper.contains("SERATUS RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("100000")) {
            return new BillResult(100_000L, true, "Seratus ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("LIMA PULUH RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("50000")) {
            return new BillResult(50_000L, true, "Lima puluh ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("DUA PULUH RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("20000")) {
            return new BillResult(20_000L, true, "Dua puluh ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("SEPULUH RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("10000")) {
            return new BillResult(10_000L, true, "Sepuluh ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("LIMA RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("5000")) {
            return new BillResult(5_000L, true, "Lima ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("DUA RIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("2000")) {
            return new BillResult(2_000L, true, "Dua ribu rupiah");
        }
        if (upper.contains("SERIBU") || digitsOnly.contains("1000")) {
            return new BillResult(1_000L, true, "Seribu rupiah");
        }

        // Jika teks uang terdeteksi sebagian tetapi angkanya buram, gunakan ciri warna dominan Rupiah
        if (bmp != null && (upper.contains("BANK INDONESIA") || upper.contains("RUPIAH") || upper.contains("NKRI"))) {
            String color = OfflineVision.colorName(bmp);
            switch (color) {
                case "merah":
                case "merah muda":
                    return new BillResult(100_000L, false, "Kemungkinan seratus ribu rupiah dari warna merah");
                case "biru":
                    return new BillResult(50_000L, false, "Kemungkinan lima puluh ribu rupiah dari warna biru");
                case "hijau":
                    return new BillResult(20_000L, false, "Kemungkinan dua puluh ribu rupiah dari warna hijau");
                case "ungu":
                    return new BillResult(10_000L, false, "Kemungkinan sepuluh ribu rupiah dari warna ungu");
                case "cokelat":
                case "oranye":
                case "kuning":
                    return new BillResult(5_000L, false, "Kemungkinan lima ribu rupiah dari warna kuning kecokelatan");
                case "abu-abu":
                    return new BillResult(2_000L, false, "Kemungkinan dua ribu rupiah dari warna abu-abu");
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
        return new BillResult(0L, false, "");
    }

    /** Mengekstrak nominal rupiah dari jawaban teks AI online (misal "Uang kertas Rp 50.000"). */
    public static long parseAiNominal(String aiText) {
        if (aiText == null || aiText.trim().isEmpty()) return 0L;
        String lower = aiText.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String compact = lower.replace(".", "").replace(",", "");
        for (long val : VALID_RUPIAH) {
            if (compact.contains(String.valueOf(val))) {
                return val;
            }
        }
        if (lower.contains("seratus ribu")) return 100_000L;
        if (lower.contains("lima puluh ribu")) return 50_000L;
        if (lower.contains("dua puluh ribu")) return 20_000L;
        if (lower.contains("sepuluh ribu")) return 10_000L;
        if (lower.contains("lima ribu")) return 5_000L;
        if (lower.contains("dua ribu")) return 2_000L;
        if (lower.contains("seribu")) return 1_000L;
        if (lower.contains("lima ratus")) return 500L;
        if (lower.contains("dua ratus")) return 200L;
        if (lower.contains("seratus")) return 100L;
        return 0L;
    }

    /** Mengurai pembacaan layar perangkat digital (ATM, timbangan, termometer, meteran, tensimeter). */
    public static String parseDigitalScreen(String ocrText) {
        if (ocrText == null || ocrText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return "Layar digital belum terbaca. Dekatkan kamera dan hindari pantulan cahaya.";
        }
        String cleaned = ocrText.replaceAll("[|]+", " ").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        // Perbaiki huruf O di antara angka agar terbaca sebagai 0
        cleaned = cleaned.replaceAll("(?<=\\d)[Oo](?=\\d)", "0")
                         .replaceAll("(?<=\\d)[Oo]\\b", "0");

        StringBuilder units = new StringBuilder();
        String lower = cleaned.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (lower.contains("kg")) units.append("Satuan kilogram terdeteksi. ");
        else if (lower.contains("mmhg")) units.append("Pembacaan tekanan darah terdeteksi. ");
        else if (lower.contains("kwh")) units.append("Pembacaan meteran listrik terdeteksi. ");
        else if (lower.contains("rp") || lower.contains("saldo") || lower.contains("pin")) {
            units.append("Pembacaan layar transaksi terdeteksi. ");
        }

        if (cleaned.length() > 320) {
            cleaned = cleaned.substring(0, 320) + ". Masih ada teks lainnya.";
        }
        return units + "Terbaca di layar: " + cleaned;
    }

    /** Memindai struk kertas EDC/ATM atau tangkapan layar transfer bank & dompet digital. */
    public static String parseBankTransferReceipt(String ocrText) {
        if (ocrText == null || ocrText.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return "Struk atau tangkapan layar transfer tidak terbaca. Pastikan tulisan jelas dan tidak terpotong.";
        }

        String[] rawLines = ocrText.split("\\r?\\n");
        String upperAll = ocrText.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);

        String bank = "";
        for (String b : BANK_PROVIDERS) {
            if (upperAll.contains(b)) {
                bank = b;
                break;
            }
        }

        String status = "";
        if (upperAll.contains("BERHASIL") || upperAll.contains("SUKSES") || upperAll.contains("SUCCESS")) {
            status = "Transfer berhasil";
        } else if (upperAll.contains("GAGAL") || upperAll.contains("FAILED")) {
            status = "Transaksi gagal";
        } else if (upperAll.contains("PENDING") || upperAll.contains("DIPROSES")) {
            status = "Transaksi masih diproses";
        }

        String nominal = extractTransferAmount(ocrText, rawLines);
        String sender = extractParty(rawLines, "PENGIRIM", "DARI", "SUMBER DANA", "REKENING ASAL", "PEMILIK");
        String recipient = extractParty(rawLines, "PENERIMA", "KEPADA", "TUJUAN", "NAMA PENERIMA", "REKENING TUJUAN", "KE ");
        String dateLine = extractDateLine(rawLines);

        if (nominal.isEmpty() && sender.isEmpty() && recipient.isEmpty() && bank.isEmpty()) {
            String snippet = ocrText.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
            if (snippet.length() > 240) snippet = snippet.substring(0, 240);
            return "Bukti transfer belum dapat dikenali formatnya. Teks yang terbaca: " + snippet;
        }

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("Hasil pindai bukti transfer");
        if (!bank.isEmpty()) sb.append(" ").append(bank);
        sb.append(". ");
        if (!status.isEmpty()) sb.append(status).append(". ");
        if (!nominal.isEmpty()) sb.append("Nominal ").append(nominal).append(". ");
        else sb.append("Nominal belum terbaca jelas. ");
        if (!sender.isEmpty()) sb.append("Pengirim: ").append(sender).append(". ");
        if (!recipient.isEmpty()) sb.append("Penerima: ").append(recipient).append(". ");
        if (!dateLine.isEmpty()) sb.append("Waktu: ").append(dateLine).append(".");
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private static String extractTransferAmount(String fullText, String[] lines) {
        // Prioritaskan baris dengan kata kunci nominal / total / jumlah
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            String u = lines[i].toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (u.contains("NOMINAL") || u.contains("JUMLAH") || u.contains("TOTAL") || u.contains("TRANSFER")) {
                String candidate = matchRpValue(lines[i]);
                if (!candidate.isEmpty()) return candidate;
                if (i + 1 < lines.length) {
                    candidate = matchRpValue(lines[i + 1]);
                    if (!candidate.isEmpty()) return candidate;
                }
            }
        }
        // Fallback: ambil nilai Rp terbesar yang masuk akal (>= 1000)
        Matcher m = RP_AMOUNT.matcher(fullText);
        long best = 0L;
        while (m.find()) {
            long val = parseDigitsSafe(m.group(1));
            if (val >= 1000L && val > best) {
                best = val;
            }
        }
        return best > 0L ? formatRupiah(best) : "";
    }

    private static String matchRpValue(String line) {
        Matcher m = RP_AMOUNT.matcher(line);
        if (m.find()) {
            long v = parseDigitsSafe(m.group(1));
            if (v > 0) return formatRupiah(v);
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static long parseDigitsSafe(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return 0L;
        String d = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", "").trim();
        try {
            return Long.parseLong(d);
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return 0L;
        }
    }

    private static String extractParty(String[] lines, String... keys) {
        List<String> normalized = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String l : lines) {
            String t = l.trim();
            if (!t.isEmpty()) normalized.add(t);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < normalized.size(); i++) {
            String line = normalized.get(i);
            String u = line.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            for (String k : keys) {
                if (u.contains(k)) {
                    int colon = line.indexOf(':');
                    if (colon >= 0 && colon + 1 < line.length()) {
                        String after = line.substring(colon + 1).trim();
                        if (!after.isEmpty() && !after.matches("[0-9*xX\\- ]{4,}")) {
                            return after;
                        }
                    }
                    String stripped = u.replace(k.trim(), "").replace(":", "").trim();
                    if (stripped.length() >= 3 && !stripped.matches("[0-9*xX\\- ]+")) {
                        return line.replaceFirst("(?i)^.*?" + Pattern.quote(k.trim()) + "[:\\s]*", "").trim();
                    }
                    if (i + 1 < normalized.size()) {
                        String next = normalized.get(i + 1);
                        if (!next.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("RP") && !next.matches("[0-9*xX\\- ]{4,}")) {
                            return next;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String extractDateLine(String[] lines) {
        for (String l : lines) {
            String t = l.trim();
            if (t.matches(".*\\b\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{1,2}[/-]\\d{2,4}\\b.*")
                    || t.matches(".*\\b\\d{1,2}\\s+(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|Mei|May|Jun|Jul|Agu|Aug|Sep|Okt|Oct|Nov|Des|Dec)[a-z]*\\s+\\d{2,4}.*")) {
                return t;
            }
        }
        return "";
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/**
 * Mengirim perintah yang tidak dikenali ke webhook n8n milik pengguna (opsional).
 * n8n bisa meneruskannya ke AI, Google Sheet, atau otomatisasi lain, lalu mengirim balasan teks.
 */
public final class N8nClient {

    public interface Callback {
        void onResult(String text);
        void onError(String message);
    }

    private static final ExecutorService POOL = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static final Handler MAIN = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private N8nClient() {}

    public static void send(String webhookUrl, String command, Callback cb) {
        if (webhookUrl == null || webhookUrl.trim().isEmpty()) {
            post(cb, null, "Webhook n8n belum diatur.");
            return;
        }
        POOL.execute(() -> {
            try {
                JSONObject body = new JSONObject().put("perintah", command).put("sumber", "kobra-os");
                HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(webhookUrl.trim()).openConnection();
                conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
                conn.setConnectTimeout(10000);
                conn.setReadTimeout(30000);
                conn.setDoOutput(true);
                conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
                try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
                    os.write(body.toString().getBytes("UTF-8"));
                }
                int code = conn.getResponseCode();
                if (code / 100 != 2) {
                    post(cb, null, "Webhook n8n menjawab kode " + code + ".");
                    return;
                }
                String raw = readAll(conn.getInputStream()).trim();
                String reply = raw;
                try {
                    JSONObject j = new JSONObject(raw);
                    reply = j.optString("balasan", raw);
                } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                post(cb, reply.isEmpty() ? "Perintah diterima." : reply, null);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                post(cb, null, "Tidak bisa terhubung ke n8n. Periksa internet dan alamat webhook.");
            }
        });
    }

    private static String readAll(InputStream is) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        try (BufferedReader r = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(is, "UTF-8"))) {
            String line;
            while ((line = r.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static void post(Callback cb, String text, String error) {
        MAIN.post(() -> {
            if (text != null) cb.onResult(text);
            else cb.onError(error);
        });
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.VibrationEffect;
import android.os.Vibrator;
import android.util.Size;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.TextView;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.camera.core.CameraSelector;
import androidx.camera.core.ImageAnalysis;
import androidx.camera.core.Preview;
import androidx.camera.lifecycle.ProcessCameraProvider;
import androidx.camera.view.PreviewView;
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import com.google.common.util.concurrent.ListenableFuture;
import com.google.mlkit.vision.common.InputImage;
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.DetectedObject;
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.ObjectDetection;
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.ObjectDetector;
import com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.defaults.ObjectDetectorOptions;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Mode tongkat: mendeteksi benda besar di depan dan memberi peringatan dengan suara dan getaran. */
public class NavigationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    static volatile NavigationActivity current;

    private static final long SPEAK_COOLDOWN_MS = 2500L;
    private static final double NEAR_RATIO = 0.25;

    private PreviewView previewView;
    private TextView tvStatus, tvObstacle;
    private Button btnStart, btnStop;
    private ObjectDetector detector;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private Vibrator vibrator;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private final ExecutorService analyzerExec = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private volatile boolean navigating = false;
    private volatile boolean processing = false;
    private long lastSpeakAt = 0L;

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_navigation);
        previewView = findViewById(R.id.previewViewNav);
        tvStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvNavStatus);
        tvObstacle = findViewById(R.id.tvObstacle);
        btnStart = findViewById(R.id.btnStartNav);
        btnStop = findViewById(R.id.btnStopNav);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        vibrator = (Vibrator) getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE);

        if (new KobraConfig(this).isPrivacyMode()) {
            tvStatus.setText("Mode Privasi Penuh Aktif");
            speaker.speak("Mode privasi penuh sedang aktif. Kamera tidak dapat dibuka sebelum mode privasi dimatikan.");
            btnStart.setEnabled(false);
            btnStop.setEnabled(false);
            return;
        }

        ObjectDetectorOptions options = new ObjectDetectorOptions.Builder()
                .setDetectorMode(ObjectDetectorOptions.STREAM_MODE)
                .enableMultipleObjects()
                .enableClassification()
                .build();
        detector = ObjectDetection.getClient(options);

        btnStart.setOnClickListener(v -> startNavigation());
        btnStop.setOnClickListener(v -> stopNavigation());

        speaker.speak("Mode tongkat siap. Bilang Kobra mulai untuk mulai, atau Kobra berhenti.");
        if (Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)) startCamera();
        else ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, new String[]{Manifest.permission.CAMERA}, 202);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        current = this;
    }

    @Override protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        if (current == this) current = null;
        stopNavigation();
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        navigating = false;
        analyzerExec.shutdown();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, @NonNull String[] permissions, @NonNull int[] grantResults) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
        if (requestCode == 202 && grantResults.length > 0 && grantResults[0] == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            startCamera();
        } else {
            speaker.speak("Izin kamera belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Izin.");
        }
    }

    private void startCamera() {
        ListenableFuture<ProcessCameraProvider> future = ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(this);
        future.addListener(() -> {
            try {
                ProcessCameraProvider provider = future.get();
                Preview preview = new Preview.Builder().build();
                preview.setSurfaceProvider(previewView.getSurfaceProvider());

                ImageAnalysis analysis = new ImageAnalysis.Builder()
                        .setTargetResolution(new Size(640, 480))
                        .setBackpressureStrategy(ImageAnalysis.STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST)
                        .build();
                analysis.setAnalyzer(analyzerExec, this::analyzeFrame);

                provider.unbindAll();
                provider.bindToLifecycle(this, CameraSelector.DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA, preview, analysis);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                speaker.speak("Kamera tidak bisa dibuka.");
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    private void analyzeFrame(androidx.camera.core.ImageProxy proxy) {
        if (!navigating || processing || proxy.getImage() == null) {
            proxy.close();
            return;
        }
        processing = true;
        InputImage img = InputImage.fromMediaImage(proxy.getImage(), proxy.getImageInfo().getRotationDegrees());
        detector.process(img)
                .addOnSuccessListener(this::onObjects)
                .addOnCompleteListener(t -> {
                    processing = false;
                    proxy.close();
                });
    }

    private void onObjects(List<DetectedObject> objects) {
        if (!navigating) return;
        DetectedObject nearest = null;
        double nearestRatio = 0;
        for (DetectedObject o : objects) {
            double w = o.getBoundingBox().width();
            double h = o.getBoundingBox().height();
            double ratio = Math.max(w, h) / 640.0;
            if (ratio > nearestRatio) {
                nearestRatio = ratio;
                nearest = o;
            }
        }
        if (nearest == null) {
            tvObstacle.setText("Jalan di depan terlihat aman");
            return;
        }
        String label = "halangan";
        if (!nearest.getLabels().isEmpty()) label = nearest.getLabels().get(0).getText().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        boolean close = nearestRatio >= NEAR_RATIO;
        tvObstacle.setText((close ? "Ada " + label + " dekat di depan" : "Ada " + label + " di depan, masih jauh"));

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (close && now - lastSpeakAt > SPEAK_COOLDOWN_MS) {
            lastSpeakAt = now;
            speaker.speak("Awas, ada " + label + " dekat di depan. Berhenti atau pelan-pelan.");
            vibrate();
        }
    }

    private void vibrate() {
        if (vibrator == null) return;
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createOneShot(300, VibrationEffect.DEFAULT_AMPLITUDE));
        } else {
            vibrator.vibrate(300);
        }
    }

    public void startNavigation() {
        navigating = true;
        tvStatus.setText("Mode tongkat aktif");
        speaker.speak("Mode tongkat aktif. Saya bantu awasi halangan di depan.");
    }

    public void stopNavigation() {
        if (!navigating) return;
        navigating = false;
        tvStatus.setText("Mode tongkat berhenti");
        speaker.speak("Mode tongkat berhenti.");
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.net.ConnectivityManager;
import android.net.Network;
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities;
import android.net.NetworkRequest;

/** Mengecek dan memantau koneksi internet. Dipakai untuk memutuskan offline atau online secara otomatis. */
public final class NetworkState {

    public interface Listener { void onChange(boolean online); }

    private NetworkState() {}

    public static boolean isOnline(Context c) {
        ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) c.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
        if (cm == null) return false;
        Network n = cm.getActiveNetwork();
        if (n == null) return false;
        NetworkCapabilities caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(n);
        return caps != null
                && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
                && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED);
    }

    public static String connectionType(Context c) {
        ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) c.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
        if (cm == null) return "Terputus";
        Network n = cm.getActiveNetwork();
        if (n == null) return "Terputus";
        NetworkCapabilities caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(n);
        if (caps == null || !caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)) {
            return "Terputus";
        }
        if (caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI)) return "Wi-Fi";
        if (caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_CELLULAR)) return "Data Seluler";
        return "Tersambung";
    }

    /** Memanggil listener hanya ketika status berubah (bukan saat pertama kali dicek). */
    public static ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback watch(Context c, Listener listener) {
        ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) c.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
        if (cm == null) return null;
        final Boolean[] last = {null};
        NetworkRequest request = new NetworkRequest.Builder()
                .addCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
                .build();
        ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback callback = new ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback() {
            @Override public void onAvailable(Network network) {
                NetworkCapabilities caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(network);
                boolean online = caps != null && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED);
                if (online) report(true, listener, last);
            }
            @Override public void onCapabilitiesChanged(Network network, NetworkCapabilities caps) {
                report(caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED), listener, last);
            }
            @Override public void onLost(Network network) {
                report(isOnline(c), listener, last);
            }
        };
        cm.registerNetworkCallback(request, callback);
        return callback;
    }

    public static void unwatch(Context c, ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback callback) {
        if (callback == null) return;
        try {
            ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) c.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
            if (cm != null) cm.unregisterNetworkCallback(callback);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private static void report(boolean online, Listener listener, Boolean[] last) {
        if (last[0] != null && last[0] == online) return;
        boolean first = last[0] == null;
        last[0] = online;
        if (!first) listener.onChange(online);
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/** Memuat basis pengetahuan offline dari assets/kobra_kb.txt dan menyediakan satu OfflineBrain bersama. */
public final class OfflineAi {
    private static OfflineBrain brain;

    private OfflineAi() {}

    public static synchronized OfflineBrain get(Context c) {
        if (brain == null) {
            String text = "";
            try (InputStream is = c.getApplicationContext().getAssets().open("kobra_kb.txt")) {
                ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                byte[] buf = new byte[4096];
                int n;
                while ((n = is.read(buf)) > 0) out.write(buf, 0, n);
                text = new String(out.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            brain = OfflineBrain.fromText(text);
        }
        return brain;
    }
}

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/OfflineBrain.java
