import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Pengaturan API key, model AI offline .task, kontrol suara TTS, kontras, catatan, dan cadangan data JSON. */
public class SettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private EditText etKey, etModel, etN8n, etNotes;
    private TextView tvStatus, tvModelStatus, tvImportProgress, tvSpeechRate, tvSpeechPitch, tvBackupStatus, tvUpdateStatus;
    private Button btnImportModel, btnDeleteModel, btnLoadModel, btnTestTts, btnBackupData, btnRestoreData, btnCheckUpdate, btnViewCrashLog;
    private ProgressBar pbImportModel;
    private SeekBar sbSpeechRate, sbSpeechPitch;
    private SwitchCompat swHighContrast;
    private RadioGroup rgAssistantStyle;
    private RadioButton rbStyleRingkas, rbStyleRamah, rbStyleDaerah;
    private boolean loadingFields = false;
    private KobraConfig config;
    private Speaker speaker;
    private AppUpdater appUpdater;
    private Uri pendingInstallUri = null;
    private final KobraScreenHelper screenHelper = new KobraScreenHelper();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> modelPickerLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                if (uri != null) {
                    processSelectedModelFile(uri);
                }
            });

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String> backupLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json"), uri -> {
                if (uri != null) {
                    exportBackupToUri(uri);
                }
            });

    private final ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> restoreLauncher =
            registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(), uri -> {
                if (uri != null) {
                    importBackupFromUri(uri);
                }
            });

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_settings);
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);

        final View contentRoot = ((android.view.ViewGroup) findViewById(android.R.id.content)).getChildAt(0);
        if (config.hasSecurityPin() && !getIntent().getBooleanExtra(CaregiverActivity.EXTRA_PIN_UNLOCKED, false)) {
            if (contentRoot != null) contentRoot.setVisibility(View.INVISIBLE);
            SecurityAndPinHelper.requirePinIfSet(this, config, speaker, "Pengaturan AI & Cadangan",
                    new SecurityAndPinHelper.PinCallback() {
                        @Override public void onUnlocked() {
                            if (contentRoot != null) contentRoot.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                        }
                        @Override public void onCancelled() {
                            finish();
                        }
                    });
        }

        etKey = findViewById(R.id.etApiKey);
        etModel = findViewById(R.id.etModel);
        etN8n = findViewById(R.id.etN8nUrl);
        etNotes = findViewById(R.id.etNotes);
        tvStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvSettingsStatus);
        tvModelStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvModelStatus);
        tvImportProgress = findViewById(R.id.tvImportProgress);
        tvSpeechRate = findViewById(R.id.tvSpeechRate);
        tvSpeechPitch = findViewById(R.id.tvSpeechPitch);
        tvBackupStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvBackupStatus);
        btnImportModel = findViewById(R.id.btnImportModel);
        btnDeleteModel = findViewById(R.id.btnDeleteModel);
        btnLoadModel = findViewById(R.id.btnLoadModel);
        pbImportModel = findViewById(R.id.pbImportModel);
        sbSpeechRate = findViewById(R.id.sbSpeechRate);
        sbSpeechPitch = findViewById(R.id.sbSpeechPitch);
        swHighContrast = findViewById(R.id.swHighContrast);
        rgAssistantStyle = findViewById(R.id.rgAssistantStyle);
        rbStyleRingkas = findViewById(R.id.rbStyleRingkas);
        rbStyleRamah = findViewById(R.id.rbStyleRamah);
        rbStyleDaerah = findViewById(R.id.rbStyleDaerah);
        btnTestTts = findViewById(R.id.btnTestTts);
        btnBackupData = findViewById(R.id.btnBackupData);
        btnRestoreData = findViewById(R.id.btnRestoreData);
        btnCheckUpdate = findViewById(R.id.btnCheckUpdate);
        btnViewCrashLog = findViewById(R.id.btnViewCrashLog);
        tvUpdateStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvUpdateStatus);
        appUpdater = new AppUpdater(this);
        tvUpdateStatus.setText("Versi terpasang: " + BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME);

        loadFieldsFromConfig();

        sbSpeechRate.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar seekBar, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                float rate = progressToTtsValue(progress);
                tvSpeechRate.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "Kecepatan Suara (Rate): %.1fx", rate));
                if (fromUser) {
                    config.setSpeechRate(rate);
                    speaker.applyVoiceSettings();
                }
            }
            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}
            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}
        });

        sbSpeechPitch.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar seekBar, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                float pitch = progressToTtsValue(progress);
                tvSpeechPitch.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "Nada Suara (Pitch): %.1fx", pitch));
                if (fromUser) {
                    config.setSpeechPitch(pitch);
                    speaker.applyVoiceSettings();
                }
            }
            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}
            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}
        });

        swHighContrast.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
            config.setHighContrast(isChecked);
            applyHighContrastVisual(isChecked);
        });

        rgAssistantStyle.setOnCheckedChangeListener((group, checkedId) -> {
            if (loadingFields) return;
            String style = styleFromCheckedId(checkedId);
            config.setAssistantStyle(style);
            speaker.speak("Gaya bahasa asisten diatur ke mode " + config.getAssistantStyleLabel() + ".");
        });

        btnTestTts.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            saveFields();
            speaker.speak("Ini contoh suara asisten Kobra OS dengan kecepatan dan nada yang Anda pilih.");
        });

        Button save = findViewById(R.id.btnSaveSettings);
        Button test = findViewById(R.id.btnTestAi);
        Button back = findViewById(R.id.btnBackSettings);

        save.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            saveFields();
            tvStatus.setText("Pengaturan tersimpan.");
            speaker.speak("Seluruh pengaturan, suara asisten, dan catatan tersimpan.");
        });

        test.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            saveFields();
            tvStatus.setText("Menguji koneksi AI...");
            new AiClient(config).chat(AiClient.SYSTEM_TUNANETRA,
                    "Perkenalkan dirimu dalam satu kalimat singkat.", new AiClient.Callback() {
                        @Override public void onResult(String text) {
                            tvStatus.setText("AI menjawab: " + text);
                            speaker.speak(text);
                        }
                        @Override public void onError(String message) {
                            tvStatus.setText("Gagal: " + message);
                        }
                    });
        });

        btnImportModel.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            // Membuka pemilih berkas SAF Android dengan tipe */* agar berkas .task tidak terblokir
            speaker.speak("Membuka pengelola berkas. Pilih berkas model berakhiran titik task.");
            try {
                modelPickerLauncher.launch(new String[]{"*/*"});
            } catch (Exception e) {
                tvImportProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                tvImportProgress.setText("Gagal membuka pemilih berkas: " + e.getMessage());
                speaker.speak("Gagal membuka pemilih berkas di HP ini.");
            }
        });

        btnDeleteModel.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmDeleteLocalModel());
        btnLoadModel.setOnClickListener(v -> loadOrTestLocalModel());

        btnBackupData.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            saveFields();
            String dateStr = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd", Locale.US).format(new Date());
            String fileName = "KobraOS_Backup_" + dateStr + ".json";
            speaker.speak("Pilih lokasi penyimpanan untuk berkas cadangan data.");
            try {
                backupLauncher.launch(fileName);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                tvBackupStatus.setText("Gagal membuka penyimpanan: " + e.getMessage());
                speaker.speak("Gagal membuka penyimpanan untuk mencadangkan data.");
            }
        });

        btnRestoreData.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            speaker.speak("Pilih berkas cadangan Kobra OS berakhiran titik j s o n.");
            try {
                restoreLauncher.launch(new String[]{"application/json", "*/*"});
            } catch (Exception e) {
                tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                tvBackupStatus.setText("Gagal membuka pemilih berkas: " + e.getMessage());
                speaker.speak("Gagal membuka pemilih berkas cadangan.");
            }
        });

        btnCheckUpdate.setOnClickListener(v -> startOtaUpdateCheck());

        if (btnViewCrashLog != null) {
            btnViewCrashLog.setOnClickListener(v -> showLastCrashLogDialog());
        }

        back.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            saveFields();
            finish();
        });
    }

    private void showLastCrashLogDialog() {
        String log = config != null ? config.getLastCrashLog() : "";
        if (log == null || log.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String msg = "Belum ada catatan crash error yang terekam. Aplikasi berjalan normal.";
            Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            speaker.speak(msg);
            new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle("Log Crash Terakhir")
                    .setMessage(msg)
                    .setPositiveButton("Tutup", null)
                    .show();
            return;
        }
        speaker.speak("Menampilkan catatan log crash terakhir.");
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Log Crash Terakhir")
                .setMessage(log)
                .setPositiveButton("Salin Log Error", (d, w) -> {
                    try {
                        ClipboardManager cm = (ClipboardManager) getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE);
                        if (cm != null) {
                            cm.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("KobraCrashLog", log));
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Log error disalin ke clipboard.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            speaker.speak("Log error berhasil disalin.");
                        }
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                })
                .setNeutralButton("Hapus Log", (d, w) -> {
                    config.clearLastCrashLog();
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Log crash dibersihkan.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    speaker.speak("Log crash telah dibersihkan.");
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Tutup", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void startOtaUpdateCheck() {
        btnCheckUpdate.setEnabled(false);
        tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvUpdateStatus.setText("Memeriksa rilis terbaru Kobra OS (versi saat ini " + BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME + ")...");
        speaker.speak("Memeriksa pembaruan Kobra OS dari GitHub.");

        appUpdater.checkLatestRelease(new AppUpdater.CheckCallback() {
            @Override public void onUpdateAvailable(AppUpdater.ReleaseInfo info) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                btnCheckUpdate.setEnabled(true);
                tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                tvUpdateStatus.setText("Tersedia versi baru: " + info.tagName + " — " + info.releaseNotesForSpeech);
                speaker.speak("Pembaruan Kobra OS tersedia, versi " + info.tagName
                        + ". Catatan rilis: " + info.releaseNotesForSpeech);

                new AlertDialog.Builder(SettingsActivity.this)
                        .setTitle("Pembaruan Kobra OS " + info.tagName)
                        .setMessage("Versi baru " + info.tagName + " tersedia.\n\nCatatan rilis:\n" + info.releaseNotesForSpeech)
                        .setPositiveButton("Unduh & Pasang", (d, w) -> beginApkDownload(info))
                        .setNegativeButton("Nanti", null)
                        .show();
            }

            @Override public void onUpToDate(String currentVersion, String latestTag) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                btnCheckUpdate.setEnabled(true);
                tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                String msg = "Kobra OS sudah menggunakan versi terbaru (" + currentVersion
                        + (latestTag.isEmpty() ? "" : ", rilis: " + latestTag) + ").";
                tvUpdateStatus.setText(msg);
                speaker.speak(msg);
            }

            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                btnCheckUpdate.setEnabled(true);
                tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                tvUpdateStatus.setText(message);
                speaker.speak(message);
            }
        });
    }

    private void beginApkDownload(AppUpdater.ReleaseInfo info) {
        tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvUpdateStatus.setText("Mengunduh APK " + info.tagName + "...");
        appUpdater.downloadAndInstall(info, new AppUpdater.DownloadCallback() {
            @Override public void onStarted(long downloadId, String fileName) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                tvUpdateStatus.setText("Mengunduh " + fileName + " lewat DownloadManager...");
                speaker.speak("Mengunduh paket pembaruan Kobra OS. Harap tunggu hingga unduhan selesai.");
            }

            @Override public void onCompleted(Uri apkUri, File apkFile) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                tvUpdateStatus.setText("Unduhan selesai. Membuka installer paket...");
                boolean launched = AppUpdater.launchPackageInstaller(SettingsActivity.this, apkUri);
                if (!launched) {
                    pendingInstallUri = apkUri;
                    tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFAB40);
                    tvUpdateStatus.setText("Aktifkan izin instal aplikasi untuk Kobra OS lalu kembali ke halaman ini.");
                    speaker.speak("Aktifkan izin instal aplikasi dari sumber ini untuk Kobra OS, lalu kembali untuk melanjutkan pemasangan.");
                } else {
                    pendingInstallUri = null;
                    speaker.speak("Installer pembaruan Kobra OS dibuka.");
                }
            }

            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                tvUpdateStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                tvUpdateStatus.setText(message);
                speaker.speak(message);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        updateModelStatus();
        if (pendingInstallUri != null && getPackageManager().canRequestPackageInstalls()) {
            Uri uri = pendingInstallUri;
            pendingInstallUri = null;
            AppUpdater.launchPackageInstaller(this, uri);
        }
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        if (appUpdater != null) appUpdater.unregisterReceiver();
        executor.shutdown();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private void loadFieldsFromConfig() {
        loadingFields = true;
        etKey.setText(config.getApiKey());
        etModel.setText(config.getModel());
        etN8n.setText(config.getN8nUrl());
        etNotes.setText(config.getNotes());

        float rate = config.getSpeechRate();
        float pitch = config.getSpeechPitch();
        sbSpeechRate.setProgress(ttsValueToProgress(rate));
        sbSpeechPitch.setProgress(ttsValueToProgress(pitch));
        tvSpeechRate.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "Kecepatan Suara (Rate): %.1fx", rate));
        tvSpeechPitch.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "Nada Suara (Pitch): %.1fx", pitch));

        String style = config.getAssistantStyle();
        if (KobraConfig.STYLE_RINGKAS.equals(style)) {
            rbStyleRingkas.setChecked(true);
        } else if (KobraConfig.STYLE_DAERAH.equals(style)) {
            rbStyleDaerah.setChecked(true);
        } else {
            rbStyleRamah.setChecked(true);
        }

        boolean hc = config.isHighContrast();
        swHighContrast.setChecked(hc);
        applyHighContrastVisual(hc);
        loadingFields = false;
    }

    private String styleFromCheckedId(int checkedId) {
        if (checkedId == R.id.rbStyleRingkas) return KobraConfig.STYLE_RINGKAS;
        if (checkedId == R.id.rbStyleDaerah) return KobraConfig.STYLE_DAERAH;
        return KobraConfig.STYLE_RAMAH;
    }

    private void applyHighContrastVisual(boolean highContrast) {
        View root = findViewById(android.R.id.content);
        if (root != null) {
            root.setBackgroundColor(highContrast ? 0xFF000000 : 0xFF0A0A0A);
        }
        int textColor = highContrast ? 0xFFFFFF00 : 0xFFFFFFFF;
        etKey.setTextColor(textColor);
        etModel.setTextColor(textColor);
        etN8n.setTextColor(textColor);
        etNotes.setTextColor(textColor);
        tvSpeechRate.setTextColor(textColor);
        tvSpeechPitch.setTextColor(textColor);
        rbStyleRingkas.setTextColor(textColor);
        rbStyleRamah.setTextColor(textColor);
        rbStyleDaerah.setTextColor(textColor);
    }

    private static float progressToTtsValue(int progress) {
        return Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, 0.5f + (progress * 0.1f)));
    }

    private static int ttsValueToProgress(float value) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(15, Math.round((value - 0.5f) * 10f)));
    }

    private void updateModelStatus() {
        LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        File modelFile = engine.getModelFile();
        boolean exists = modelFile.exists() && modelFile.length() > 1024 * 1024;
        btnDeleteModel.setEnabled(modelFile.exists());
        btnDeleteModel.setAlpha(modelFile.exists() ? 1.0f : 0.45f);
        btnLoadModel.setEnabled(exists);
        btnLoadModel.setAlpha(exists ? 1.0f : 0.45f);

        if (exists) {
            long mb = modelFile.length() / (1024 * 1024);
            if (engine.isInitialized()) {
                tvModelStatus.setText("Status model: Aktif & Siap (" + mb + " MB, " + LocalLlmEngine.MODEL_FILENAME + ")");
                tvModelStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
            } else if (engine.isSafeMode()) {
                String err = engine.getLastError().isEmpty() ? LocalLlmEngine.CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : engine.getLastError();
                tvModelStatus.setText("Status model: " + err + " (" + mb + " MB)");
                tvModelStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFAB40);
            } else {
                tvModelStatus.setText("Status model: Terpasang (" + mb + " MB, lazy-load hemat RAM)");
                tvModelStatus.setTextColor(0xFF38BDF8);
            }
        } else {
            tvModelStatus.setText("Status model: Belum terpasang / Mode Aman (Pilih berkas .task dari HP)");
            tvModelStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFEB3B);
        }
    }

    private void confirmDeleteLocalModel() {
        LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        File modelFile = engine.getModelFile();
        if (!modelFile.exists()) {
            speaker.speak("Tidak ada berkas model lokal yang tersimpan.");
            updateModelStatus();
            return;
        }
        long mb = modelFile.length() / (1024 * 1024);
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Hapus Model Lokal?")
                .setMessage("Hapus berkas model " + LocalLlmEngine.MODEL_FILENAME + " (" + mb + " MB) dari penyimpanan internal dan reset Mode Aman?")
                .setPositiveButton("Hapus", (d, w) -> {
                    boolean deleted = engine.deleteLocalModel();
                    updateModelStatus();
                    tvImportProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    if (deleted) {
                        tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                        tvImportProgress.setText("Model lokal berhasil dihapus. Ruang penyimpanan dibebaskan.");
                        speaker.speak("Berkas model lokal berhasil dihapus dan Mode Aman direset.");
                    } else {
                        tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                        tvImportProgress.setText("Gagal menghapus berkas model lokal.");
                        speaker.speak("Gagal menghapus berkas model lokal.");
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Batal", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void loadOrTestLocalModel() {
        LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this);
        if (!engine.isModelPresent()) {
            speaker.speak("Berkas model lokal belum terpasang. Impor berkas titik task terlebih dahulu.");
            updateModelStatus();
            return;
        }
        btnLoadModel.setEnabled(false);
        btnImportModel.setEnabled(false);
        pbImportModel.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        pbImportModel.setIndeterminate(true);
        tvImportProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvImportProgress.setText("Memuat model lokal (batas 512 token, dengan Crash-Guard aktif)...");
        speaker.speak("Mencoba memuat model lokal ke memori dengan perlindungan crash guard.");

        executor.execute(() -> {
            boolean ready = engine.forceInitEngine();
            mainHandler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                btnImportModel.setEnabled(true);
                pbImportModel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                updateModelStatus();
                if (ready) {
                    tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                    tvImportProgress.setText("Model lokal berhasil dimuat dan siap digunakan (512 token).");
                    speaker.speak("Model AI offline berhasil dimuat dan siap digunakan.");
                } else {
                    String err = engine.getLastError().isEmpty() ? LocalLlmEngine.CRASH_SAFE_MODE_REASON : engine.getLastError();
                    tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFFAB40);
                    tvImportProgress.setText(err);
                    speaker.speak("Model tidak dapat dimuat ke RAM. Kobra tetap aman di Mode Aman.");
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void exportBackupToUri(Uri uri) {
        tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvBackupStatus.setText("Mengekspor cadangan data...");
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                String json = config.exportBackupJson();
                try (OutputStream os = getContentResolver().openOutputStream(uri)) {
                    if (os == null) throw new IOException("Tidak dapat menulis ke berkas tujuan.");
                    os.write(json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                    os.flush();
                }
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                    tvBackupStatus.setText("Cadangan JSON berhasil disimpan (tanpa berkas .task).");
                    speaker.speak("Cadangan data Kobra OS berhasil disimpan.");
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                String msg = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : "Kesalahan ekspor";
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                    tvBackupStatus.setText("Gagal mencadangkan data: " + msg);
                    speaker.speak("Gagal mencadangkan data. " + msg);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void importBackupFromUri(Uri uri) {
        String name = queryFileName(uri);
        if (!name.isEmpty() && !name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".json")) {
            tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
            tvBackupStatus.setText("Berkas bukan JSON: " + name);
            speaker.speak("Berkas yang dipilih bukan berkas cadangan JSON.");
            return;
        }
        tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvBackupStatus.setText("Memulihkan data dari berkas cadangan...");
        executor.execute(() -> {
            try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
                if (is == null) throw new IOException("Berkas cadangan tidak dapat dibuka.");
                ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
                int len;
                while ((len = is.read(buf)) != -1) {
                    baos.write(buf, 0, len);
                }
                String json = new String(baos.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                int count = config.importBackupJson(json);
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    loadFieldsFromConfig();
                    speaker.applyVoiceSettings();
                    tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                    tvBackupStatus.setText("Berhasil memulihkan " + count + " entri pengaturan dan kontak darurat.");
                    speaker.speak("Data cadangan berhasil dipulihkan sebanyak " + count + " pengaturan.");
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                String msg = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : "Format tidak valid";
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    tvBackupStatus.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                    tvBackupStatus.setText("Gagal memulihkan data: " + msg);
                    speaker.speak("Gagal memulihkan data cadangan. " + msg);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void processSelectedModelFile(Uri uri) {
        String fileName = queryFileName(uri);

        // Validasi ekstensi .task
        if (!fileName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".task")) {
            speaker.speak("Berkas yang dipilih bukan berkas model titik task. Silakan pilih berkas yang berakhiran titik task.");
            tvImportProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
            tvImportProgress.setText("Gagal: Berkas bukan bertipe .task (" + (!fileName.isEmpty() ? fileName : "format tidak dikenal") + ").");
            return;
        }

        long fileSize = queryFileSize(uri);
        final long finalFileSize = fileSize;

        speaker.speak("Memulai penyalinan model titik task dari penyimpanan HP. Harap tunggu sebentar.");
        btnImportModel.setEnabled(false);
        pbImportModel.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        pbImportModel.setProgress(0);
        tvImportProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFFFF00);
        tvImportProgress.setText("Menyiapkan penyalinan: " + fileName);

        executor.execute(() -> {
            File filesDir = getFilesDir();
            File destFile = new File(filesDir, LocalLlmEngine.MODEL_FILENAME);
            File tempFile = new File(filesDir, LocalLlmEngine.MODEL_FILENAME + ".tmp");

            if (tempFile.exists()) {
                tempFile.delete();
            }

            try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri);
                 FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(tempFile)) {

                if (is == null) {
                    throw new IOException("Tidak dapat membaca data berkas yang dipilih.");
                }

                byte[] buffer = new byte[65536]; // Buffer 64 KB untuk penyalinan cepat & hemat memori
                int read;
                long totalRead = 0;
                long lastUpdateTime = 0;

                while ((read = is.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                    fos.write(buffer, 0, read);
                    totalRead += read;

                    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    if (now - lastUpdateTime > 350) {
                        lastUpdateTime = now;
                        final int percent = finalFileSize > 0 ? (int) ((totalRead * 100) / finalFileSize) : -1;
                        final long mb = totalRead / (1024 * 1024);
                        mainHandler.post(() -> {
                            if (percent >= 0) {
                                pbImportModel.setIndeterminate(false);
                                pbImportModel.setProgress(percent);
                                tvImportProgress.setText("Menyalin: " + percent + "% (" + mb + " MB)");
                            } else {
                                pbImportModel.setIndeterminate(true);
                                tvImportProgress.setText("Menyalin: " + mb + " MB...");
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
                fos.flush();

                // Hapus berkas tujuan lama terlebih dahulu untuk mencegah penumpukan ruang penyimpanan
                if (destFile.exists()) {
                    destFile.delete();
                }

                // Ganti nama berkas sementara menjadi nama resmi yang dibaca LocalLlmEngine
                if (!tempFile.renameTo(destFile)) {
                    copyFile(tempFile, destFile);
                    tempFile.delete();
                }

                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    btnImportModel.setEnabled(true);
                    pbImportModel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    LocalLlmEngine engine = LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(SettingsActivity.this);
                    engine.close();
                    config.clearLlmSafeMode();
                    updateModelStatus();
                    long mb = destFile.length() / (1024 * 1024);
                    tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFF00E676);
                    tvImportProgress.setText("Model tersimpan (" + mb + " MB). Ketuk Muat / Uji Model Lokal atau langsung pakai di AI Chat.");
                    speaker.speak("Penyalinan model offline selesai. Model siap dimuat saat Anda membuka obrolan atau menekan tombol Muat Model Lokal.");
                });

            } catch (Exception e) {
                if (tempFile.exists()) tempFile.delete();
                final String err = e.getMessage() != null ? e.getMessage() : "Kesalahan sistem";
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                    btnImportModel.setEnabled(true);
                    pbImportModel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                    tvImportProgress.setTextColor(0xFFFF5252);
                    tvImportProgress.setText("Gagal mengimpor model: " + err);
                    speaker.speak("Gagal mengimpor model offline. " + err);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private String queryFileName(Uri uri) {
        String result = null;
        if ("content".equals(uri.getScheme())) {
            try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null)) {
                if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    int col = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
                    if (col >= 0) {
                        result = cursor.getString(col);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (result == null && uri.getPath() != null) {
            int cut = uri.getPath().lastIndexOf('/');
            result = cut != -1 ? uri.getPath().substring(cut + 1) : uri.getPath();
        }
        return result != null ? result : "";
    }

    private long queryFileSize(Uri uri) {
        long size = -1;
        if ("content".equals(uri.getScheme())) {
            try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, null, null, null, null)) {
                if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    int col = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.SIZE);
                    if (col >= 0) {
                        size = cursor.getLong(col);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return size;
    }

    private void copyFile(File src, File dst) throws IOException {
        try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(src); OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(dst)) {
            byte[] buf = new byte[65536];
            int len;
            while ((len = in.read(buf)) > 0) {
                out.write(buf, 0, len);
            }
        }
    }

    private void saveFields() {
        config.setApiKey(etKey.getText().toString());
        config.setModel(etModel.getText().toString());
        config.setN8nUrl(etN8n.getText().toString());
        config.setNotes(etNotes.getText().toString());
        config.setSpeechRate(progressToTtsValue(sbSpeechRate.getProgress()));
        config.setSpeechPitch(progressToTtsValue(sbSpeechPitch.getProgress()));
        config.setHighContrast(swHighContrast.isChecked());
        config.setAssistantStyle(styleFromCheckedId(rgAssistantStyle.getCheckedRadioButtonId()));
        speaker.applyVoiceSettings();
    }
}

            if (!p1.isEmpty() && !p1.matches("[0-9+ ]{6,}") || !p2.isEmpty() && !p2.matches("[0-9+ ]{6,}")) {
                tvStatus.setText("Nomor telepon hanya boleh angka, spasi, atau tanda +.");
                return;
            }
            config.setSos("name1", etName1.getText().toString());
            config.setSos("phone1", p1);
            config.setSos("name2", etName2.getText().toString());
            config.setSos("phone2", p2);
            updateStatusText(config, tvStatus);
            HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
            Toast.makeText(this, "Kontak SOS disimpan", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            Speaker.get(this).speak("Kontak darurat disimpan.");
        });

        btnPractice.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateSosMorse(this, false);
            String target = config.hasSosContact()
                    ? (config.getSos("name1").isEmpty() ? config.getSos("phone1") : config.getSos("name1"))
                    : "nomor darurat 112";
            String simMsg = "Mode Latihan SOS aktif. Ini hanya simulasi, tidak ada SMS atau panggilan telepon asli yang dikirim. "
                    + "Pada keadaan darurat nyata, Kobra akan mengirim SMS koordinat GPS Google Maps ke " + target
                    + ", menyalakan getaran Morse SOS, lalu menelepon secara otomatis.";
            tvStatus.setText("Simulasi Latihan SOS selesai (tidak mengirim SMS/telepon asli).");
            Speaker.get(this).speak(simMsg);
        });

        btnMedical.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
            KobraScreenHelper.safeStartActivity(this, new Intent(this, MedicalCardActivity.class),
                    Speaker.get(this), "Gagal membuka Kartu Medis.");
        });
    }

    private void updateStatusText(KobraConfig config, TextView tvStatus) {
        String n1 = config.getSos("name1");
        String p1 = config.getSos("phone1");
        String n2 = config.getSos("name2");
        String p2 = config.getSos("phone2");
        if (p1.isEmpty() && p2.isEmpty()) {
            tvStatus.setText("Belum diatur (Default: 112)");
        } else {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("Tersimpan: ");
            if (!p1.isEmpty()) {
                sb.append(n1.isEmpty() ? "Kontak 1" : n1).append(" (").append(p1).append(")");
            }
            if (!p2.isEmpty()) {
                if (!p1.isEmpty()) sb.append(", ");
                sb.append(n2.isEmpty() ? "Kontak 2" : n2).append(" (").append(p2).append(")");
            }
            tvStatus.setText(sb.toString());
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, Speaker.get(this))) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, Speaker.get(this))) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

FILE: Asisten-bantu/app/src/main/java/com/asisten/bantu/Speaker.java

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.content.Context;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech;
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;

public class Speaker implements TextToSpeech.OnInitListener {

    public interface Listener {
        void onSpeechStart();
        void onSpeechEnd();
    }

    private static volatile Speaker sInstance;

    private final Context context;
    private final Handler mainHandler;
    private TextToSpeech tts;
    private boolean ready = false;
    private volatile boolean sedangBicara = false;
    private Runnable onEndCallback = null;
    private final List<Listener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();

    public static synchronized Speaker get(Context ctx) {
        if (sInstance == null) {
            sInstance = new Speaker(ctx.getApplicationContext());
        }
        return sInstance;
    }

    public Speaker(Context ctx) {
        this.context = ctx.getApplicationContext();
        this.mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        this.tts = new TextToSpeech(context, this);
    }

    public synchronized void addListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null && !listeners.contains(l)) {
            listeners.add(l);
        }
    }

    public synchronized void removeListener(Listener l) {
        if (l != null) {
            listeners.remove(l);
        }
    }

    private synchronized void notifySpeechStart() {
        sedangBicara = true;
        for (Listener l : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
            try {
                l.onSpeechStart();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private synchronized void notifySpeechEnd() {
        sedangBicara = false;
        if (onEndCallback != null) {
            Runnable cb = onEndCallback;
            onEndCallback = null;
            cb.run();
        }
        for (Listener l : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
            try {
                l.onSpeechEnd();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onInit(int status) {
        if (status != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) return;
        if (tts == null) return;
        ready = true;
        int r = tts.setLanguage(new Locale("id", "ID"));
        if (r == TextToSpeech.LANG_MISSING_DATA || r == TextToSpeech.LANG_NOT_SUPPORTED) {
            tts.setLanguage(Locale.getDefault());
        }
        applyVoiceSettings();
        tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(new UtteranceProgressListener() {
            @Override
            public void onStart(String utteranceId) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> notifySpeechStart());
            }

            @Override
            public void onDone(String utteranceId) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> notifySpeechEnd());
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String utteranceId) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> notifySpeechEnd());
            }
        });
    }

    public void applyVoiceSettings() {
        KobraConfig cfg = new KobraConfig(context);
        updateVoiceSettings(cfg.getSpeechRate(), cfg.getSpeechPitch());
    }

    public void updateVoiceSettings(float speechRate, float pitch) {
        if (tts != null && ready) {
            try {
                tts.setSpeechRate(Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, speechRate)));
                tts.setPitch(Math.max(0.5f, Math.min(2.0f, pitch)));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public void speak(String teks) {
        if (teks == null || teks.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        // Tandai sedang bicara sejak pemanggilan untuk mencegah loop mikrofon
        notifySpeechStart();
        if (tts != null) {
            try {
                tts.stop();
                tts.speak(teks, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, "kobra_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                notifySpeechEnd();
            }
        }
    }

    public void speakQueued(String teks) {
        if (teks == null || teks.trim().isEmpty()) return;
        if (tts != null) {
            try {
                tts.speak(teks, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_ADD, null, "kobra_q_" + System.currentTimeMillis());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    public void stop() {
        if (tts != null) {
            try {
                tts.stop();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        notifySpeechEnd();
    }

    public boolean isSpeaking() {
        return sedangBicara || (tts != null && tts.isSpeaking());
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        try {
            if (tts != null) {
                tts.stop();
                tts.shutdown();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        tts = null;
        ready = false;
        sedangBicara = false;
    }

    public void setOnEnd(Runnable r) {
        this.onEndCallback = r;
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.AlarmManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;

/**
 * Kumpulan utilitas sistem offline untuk Kobra OS:
 * - Pembaca Notifikasi Finansial Cerdas (#72)
 * - Penjadwal Offline Daily Planner via AlarmManager (#73)
 * - Pengendali Media Universal & Pemutar Audio Lokal (#74)
 * - Monitor Sinyal Seluler, Operator, & Wi-Fi (#75)
 */
public final class SystemUtilityHelper {

    private SystemUtilityHelper() {}

    // =========================================================================
    // #72. Smart Financial Notification Reader
    // =========================================================================

    private static final Set<String> BANK_PACKAGES = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            "com.bri.brimo", "id.co.bri.brimo",
            "com.bca", "com.bca.mybca.omni.android",
            "com.bankmandiri.mandirionline", "id.bmri.livin",
            "src.com.bni", "id.co.bni", "id.co.bni.wondr",
            "co.id.bankbsi.bsimobile", "id.co.bankbsi.byond",
            "id.dana", "com.gojek.app", "com.gopay.app",
            "ovo.id", "com.shopee.id", "com.shopeepay.id",
            "com.telkom.mwallet", "id.co.seabank.seabank", "com.jago.digitalbanking"
    ));

    private static final Pattern RUPIAH_PATTERN =
            Pattern.compile("(?:rp\\.?|idr)\\s*([0-9][0-9.,]*)", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);

    public static final class FinancialParseResult {
        public final boolean fromFinancialSource;
        public final boolean isSpamOrPromo;
        public final String summary;

        FinancialParseResult(boolean fromFinancialSource, boolean isSpamOrPromo, String summary) {
            this.fromFinancialSource = fromFinancialSource;
            this.isSpamOrPromo = isSpamOrPromo;
            this.summary = summary;
        }
    }

    public static FinancialParseResult parseFinancialNotification(String pkg, String appName, String title, String text) {
        String pLower = pkg == null ? "" : pkg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String aLower = appName == null ? "" : appName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String combined = ((title == null ? "" : title) + " " + (text == null ? "" : text)).trim();
        String cLower = combined.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        boolean sourceMatch = BANK_PACKAGES.contains(pLower)
                || containsAny(pLower, "brimo", "mybca", "bca", "mandiri", "livin", "bni", "wondr",
                        "bsi", "byond", "dana", "gopay", "ovo", "shopeepay", "linkaja", "seabank", "jago")
                || containsAny(aLower, "brimo", "bri", "bca", "mybca", "mandiri", "livin", "bni", "wondr",
                        "bsi", "byond", "dana", "gopay", "ovo", "shopeepay", "linkaja", "seabank", "jago");

        boolean strongTx = containsAny(cLower,
                "transfer masuk", "dana masuk", "uang masuk", "transfer berhasil",
                "pembayaran berhasil", "pembelian berhasil", "mutasi", "qris",
                "top up berhasil", "topup berhasil", "berhasil diterima", "transaksi berhasil");

        if (!sourceMatch && !strongTx) {
            return new FinancialParseResult(false, false, "");
        }

        Matcher m = RUPIAH_PATTERN.matcher(combined);
        String nominal = "";
        if (m.find()) {
            String digits = m.group(1);
            if (digits != null) {
                // Bersihkan koma desimal akhir seperti ",00"
                digits = digits.replaceAll(",00$", "").replaceAll("\\.00$", "");
                nominal = digits + " rupiah";
            }
        }

        boolean hasPromoWords = containsAny(cLower,
                "promo", "diskon", "voucher", "cashback hingga", "gratis ongkir",
                "undian", "cicilan 0%", "flash sale", "klaim sekarang", "kode promo",
                "penawaran spesial", "ajukan pinjaman", "limit hingga", "hadiah langsung");

        boolean hasConfirmedTxWords = containsAny(cLower,
                "berhasil", "diterima", "masuk", "keluar", "pembayaran", "bayar",
                "transfer", "mutasi", "top up", "topup", "debit", "kredit",
                "tarik tunai", "pembelian", "terkirim", "selesai", "sukses");

        if (hasPromoWords && (!hasConfirmedTxWords || nominal.isEmpty())) {
            return new FinancialParseResult(true, true, "");
        }
        if (nominal.isEmpty() && !hasConfirmedTxWords) {
            return new FinancialParseResult(true, true, "");
        }

        String bankLabel = resolveFinancialLabel(pLower, aLower, appName);
        String direction = "Transaksi";
        if (containsAny(cLower, "masuk", "diterima", "kredit", "top up berhasil", "topup berhasil", "menerima")) {
            direction = "Transaksi masuk";
        } else if (containsAny(cLower, "keluar", "pembayaran", "bayar", "transfer ke", "kirim", "debit", "pembelian", "tarik tunai")) {
            direction = "Transaksi keluar";
        }

        String cleanDetail = combined.replaceAll("https?://\\S+", "").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (cleanDetail.length() > 160) cleanDetail = cleanDetail.substring(0, 160);

        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(bankLabel).append(". ").append(direction);
        if (!nominal.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append(" sebesar ").append(nominal);
        }
        sb.append(". ").append(cleanDetail);
        return new FinancialParseResult(true, false, sb.toString().trim());
    }

    private static String resolveFinancialLabel(String pkg, String appLower, String fallback) {
        if (pkg.contains("bri") || appLower.contains("brimo")) return "BRImo";
        if (pkg.contains("bca") || appLower.contains("bca")) return "BCA";
        if (pkg.contains("mandiri") || pkg.contains("bmri") || appLower.contains("livin") || appLower.contains("mandiri")) return "Mandiri";
        if (pkg.contains("bni") || appLower.contains("bni") || appLower.contains("wondr")) return "BNI";
        if (pkg.contains("bsi") || appLower.contains("bsi") || appLower.contains("byond")) return "BSI";
        if (pkg.contains("dana") || appLower.contains("dana")) return "DANA";
        if (pkg.contains("gojek") || pkg.contains("gopay") || appLower.contains("gopay")) return "GoPay";
        if (pkg.contains("ovo") || appLower.contains("ovo")) return "OVO";
        if (pkg.contains("shopee") || appLower.contains("shopee")) return "ShopeePay";
        if (pkg.contains("mwallet") || appLower.contains("linkaja")) return "LinkAja";
        if (pkg.contains("seabank") || appLower.contains("seabank")) return "SeaBank";
        if (pkg.contains("jago") || appLower.contains("jago")) return "Bank Jago";
        return (fallback == null || fallback.trim().isEmpty()) ? "Keuangan" : fallback.trim();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #73. Offline Daily Planner via AlarmManager
    // =========================================================================

    public static String schedulePlannerFromVoice(Context context, KobraConfig config, String body) {
        if (body == null || body.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return "Sebutkan jam dan agendanya. Contoh: Kobra ingatkan jam 16.00 minum vitamin.";
        }
        String raw = body.trim();
        int hour = -1;
        int minute = 0;
        String title = "";

        Matcher explicitTime = Pattern.compile("(?:^|\\s)(?:jam|pukul)?\\s*(\\d{1,2})[.:](\\d{2})(?:\\s*(pagi|siang|sore|malam))?(?=\\s|$)",
                Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(raw);
        if (explicitTime.find()) {
            hour = parseIntSafe(explicitTime.group(1), -1);
            minute = parseIntSafe(explicitTime.group(2), 0);
            String period = explicitTime.group(3) != null ? explicitTime.group(3).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) : "";
            hour = adjustPeriod(hour, period, raw);
            title = (raw.substring(0, explicitTime.start()) + " " + raw.substring(explicitTime.end())).replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        } else {
            List<Integer> nums = OfflineBrain.numbers(raw);
            if (!nums.isEmpty()) {
                hour = nums.get(0);
                minute = nums.size() > 1 && nums.get(1) >= 0 && nums.get(1) <= 59 ? nums.get(1) : 0;
                hour = adjustPeriod(hour, "", raw);
                title = raw.replaceFirst("^.*?(?:jam|pukul)\\s*", "")
                        .replaceAll("\\b(jam|pukul|pagi|siang|sore|malam|lewat|kurang|tengah|nol|satu|dua|tiga|empat|lima|enam|tujuh|delapan|sembilan|sepuluh|sebelas|belas|puluh|\\d+)\\b", " ")
                        .replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
                if (title.isEmpty()) {
                    title = raw.replaceAll("\\d+", "").trim();
                }
            }
        }

        if (hour < 0 || hour > 23 || minute < 0 || minute > 59) {
            return "Waktu agenda tidak dikenali. Contoh: Kobra ingatkan jam 16.00 minum vitamin.";
        }
        if (title.isEmpty()) {
            title = "Pengingat agenda";
        }
        title = title.replaceFirst("^(untuk|buat)\\s+", "").trim();
        if (title.isEmpty()) title = "Pengingat agenda";

        Calendar target = Calendar.getInstance();
        target.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, hour);
        target.set(Calendar.MINUTE, minute);
        target.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        target.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        boolean tomorrow = false;
        if (target.getTimeInMillis() <= System.currentTimeMillis() + 5000L) {
            target.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
            tomorrow = true;
        }

        int id = config.nextPlannerId();
        long triggerMs = target.getTimeInMillis();
        config.addPlannerItem(id, hour, minute, title, triggerMs);

        boolean exactOrFallbackScheduled = scheduleAlarm(context, id, hour, minute, title, triggerMs);
        String timeStr = String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:%02d", hour, minute);
        if (!exactOrFallbackScheduled) {
            return "Agenda dicatat untuk pukul " + timeStr + ", namun izin alarm tepat belum aktif di HP ini.";
        }
        return "Agenda dicatat dan pengingat dipasang untuk "
                + (tomorrow ? "besok " : "") + "pukul " + timeStr + ": " + title + ".";
    }

    private static int adjustPeriod(int hour, String period, String full) {
        String lower = full.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        boolean pm = "sore".equals(period) || "malam".equals(period) || "siang".equals(period)
                || lower.contains(" sore") || lower.contains(" malam") || (lower.contains(" siang") && hour < 6);
        if (pm && hour >= 1 && hour <= 11) {
            return hour + 12;
        }
        if (("malam".equals(period) || lower.contains(" malam")) && hour == 12) {
            return 0;
        }
        return hour;
    }

    private static int parseIntSafe(String s, int fallback) {
        try { return Integer.parseInt(s); } catch (Exception e) { return fallback; }
    }

    private static boolean scheduleAlarm(Context context, int id, int hour, int minute, String title, long triggerMs) {
        try {
            AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) context.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
            if (am == null) return false;
            Intent intent = new Intent(context, PlannerAlarmReceiver.class);
            intent.putExtra(PlannerAlarmReceiver.EXTRA_ID, id);
            intent.putExtra(PlannerAlarmReceiver.EXTRA_TITLE, title);
            intent.putExtra(PlannerAlarmReceiver.EXTRA_HOUR, hour);
            intent.putExtra(PlannerAlarmReceiver.EXTRA_MINUTE, minute);
            PendingIntent pi = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                    context, id, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
            try {
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) {
                    if (am.canScheduleExactAlarms()) {
                        am.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerMs, pi);
                    } else {
                        am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerMs, pi);
                    }
                } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 23) {
                    am.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerMs, pi);
                } else {
                    am.setExact(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerMs, pi);
                }
                return true;
            } catch (SecurityException se) {
                try {
                    am.setAndAllowWhileIdle(AlarmManager.RTC_WAKEUP, triggerMs, pi);
                    return true;
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (Throwable ignored) {
                return false;
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static String cancelAllPlannerAlarms(Context context, KobraConfig config) {
        AlarmManager am = (AlarmManager) context.getSystemService(Context.ALARM_SERVICE);
        List<Integer> ids = config.getPlannerIds();
        if (am != null) {
            for (Integer id : ids) {
                if (id == null || id <= 0) continue;
                try {
                    Intent intent = new Intent(context, PlannerAlarmReceiver.class);
                    PendingIntent pi = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
                            context, id, intent, PendingIntent.FLAG_NO_CREATE | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
                    if (pi != null) {
                        am.cancel(pi);
                        pi.cancel();
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        config.clearPlannerItems();
        return "Semua agenda pengingat harian telah dihapus.";
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #74. Universal Media & Local Audio Controller
    // =========================================================================

    private static final class AudioTrack {
        final Uri uri;
        final String title;
        AudioTrack(Uri uri, String title) {
            this.uri = uri;
            this.title = title;
        }
    }

    private static MediaPlayer localPlayer;
    private static final List<AudioTrack> localPlaylist = new ArrayList<>();
    private static int localIndex = 0;

    public static synchronized boolean hasLocalAudioActive() {
        return localPlayer != null;
    }

    public static synchronized String playLocalAudio(Context context, Speaker speaker) {
        String perm = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33
                ? Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
                : Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE;
        if (!Perms.has(context, perm)) {
            return "Izin penyimpanan audio belum aktif. Buka Kobra lalu tekan Beri Izin.";
        }

        localPlaylist.clear();
        ContentResolver cr = context.getContentResolver();
        String[] proj = {
                MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                MediaStore.Audio.Media.DISPLAY_NAME
        };
        try (Cursor c = cr.query(
                MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,
                proj,
                null,
                null,
                MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATE_ADDED + " DESC")) {
            while (c != null && c.moveToNext() && localPlaylist.size() < 100) {
                long id = c.getLong(0);
                String title = c.getString(1);
                String name = c.getString(2);
                String lowerName = name != null ? name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT) : "";
                if (!lowerName.isEmpty() && !(lowerName.endsWith(".mp3") || lowerName.endsWith(".m4a") || lowerName.endsWith(".wav") || lowerName.endsWith(".ogg"))) {
                    continue;
                }
                String label = (title != null && !title.trim().isEmpty())
                        ? title.trim()
                        : (name != null ? name.replaceAll("\\.[^.]+$", "") : "Musik Lokal");
                Uri uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, id);
                localPlaylist.add(new AudioTrack(uri, label));
            }
        } catch (SecurityException se) {
            return "Izin akses musik lokal ditolak sistem. Berikan izin audio terlebih dahulu.";
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            return "Gagal memindai berkas musik di penyimpanan HP.";
        }

        if (localPlaylist.isEmpty()) {
            return "Tidak ditemukan berkas audio mp3, m4a, atau wav di penyimpanan HP.";
        }
        localIndex = 0;
        return startTrackAt(context.getApplicationContext(), speaker, 0);
    }

    private static synchronized String startTrackAt(Context appCtx, Speaker speaker, int index) {
        if (localPlaylist.isEmpty()) return "Daftar putar lokal kosong.";
        localIndex = ((index % localPlaylist.size()) + localPlaylist.size()) % localPlaylist.size();
        AudioTrack track = localPlaylist.get(localIndex);
        releaseLocalPlayerLocked();
        try {
            localPlayer = new MediaPlayer();
            localPlayer.setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                    .build());
            localPlayer.setDataSource(appCtx, track.uri);
            localPlayer.setOnCompletionListener(mp -> {
                synchronized (SystemUtilityHelper.class) {
                    if (!localPlaylist.isEmpty()) {
                        startTrackAt(appCtx, speaker, localIndex + 1);
                    }
                }
            });
            localPlayer.prepare();
            localPlayer.start();
            return "Memutar musik lokal: " + track.title + ".";
        } catch (Exception e) {
            releaseLocalPlayerLocked();
            return "Gagal memutar berkas audio " + track.title + ".";
        }
    }

    public static synchronized String pauseOrResumeMusic(Context context, boolean pause) {
        if (localPlayer != null) {
            try {
                if (pause && localPlayer.isPlaying()) {
                    localPlayer.pause();
                    return "Musik lokal dijeda.";
                } else if (!pause && !localPlayer.isPlaying()) {
                    localPlayer.start();
                    return "Melanjutkan musik lokal.";
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        dispatchMediaKey(context, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PLAY_PAUSE);
        return pause ? "Perintah jeda musik dikirim." : "Perintah lanjut putar musik dikirim.";
    }

    public static synchronized String nextTrack(Context context, Speaker speaker) {
        if (localPlayer != null && !localPlaylist.isEmpty()) {
            return startTrackAt(context.getApplicationContext(), speaker, localIndex + 1);
        }
        dispatchMediaKey(context, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_NEXT);
        return "Beralih ke lagu berikutnya.";
    }

    public static synchronized String previousTrack(Context context, Speaker speaker) {
        if (localPlayer != null && !localPlaylist.isEmpty()) {
            return startTrackAt(context.getApplicationContext(), speaker, localIndex - 1);
        }
        dispatchMediaKey(context, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_PREVIOUS);
        return "Beralih ke lagu sebelumnya.";
    }

    public static synchronized String stopLocalAudio(Context context) {
        boolean wasLocal = localPlayer != null;
        releaseLocalPlayerLocked();
        localPlaylist.clear();
        if (wasLocal) return "Pemutar musik lokal dihentikan.";
        if (context != null) {
            dispatchMediaKey(context, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MEDIA_STOP);
        }
        return "Musik dihentikan.";
    }

    private static void releaseLocalPlayerLocked() {
        if (localPlayer != null) {
            try { localPlayer.stop(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try { localPlayer.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            localPlayer = null;
        }
    }

    public static void dispatchMediaKey(Context context, int keyCode) {
        if (context == null) return;
        try {
            AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
            if (am == null) return;
            long now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis();
            am.dispatchMediaKeyEvent(new KeyEvent(now, now, KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN, keyCode, 0));
            am.dispatchMediaKeyEvent(new KeyEvent(now, now, KeyEvent.ACTION_UP, keyCode, 0));
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // #75. Signal & Carrier Monitor
    // =========================================================================

    public static String buildSignalAndCarrierReport(Context context) {
        if (context == null) return "Konteks sistem tidak tersedia.";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("Status sinyal dan jaringan. ");

        // 1. Operator & status seluler
        try {
            TelephonyManager tm = (TelephonyManager) context.getSystemService(Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE);
            if (tm != null) {
                String operator = "";
                try {
                    operator = tm.getNetworkOperatorName();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                if (operator == null || operator.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        operator = tm.getSimOperatorName();
                    } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
                }
                int simState = TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN;
                try {
                    simState = tm.getSimState();
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}

                if (simState == TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_ABSENT) {
                    sb.append("Kartu SIM tidak terpasang. ");
                } else if (operator != null && !operator.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    sb.append("Operator seluler: ").append(operator.trim()).append(". ");
                } else {
                    sb.append("Operator seluler belum terdeteksi. ");
                }

                try {
                    int dataState = tm.getDataState();
                    if (dataState == TelephonyManager.DATA_CONNECTED) {
                        sb.append("Data seluler tersambung. ");
                    } else if (dataState == TelephonyManager.DATA_DISCONNECTED) {
                        sb.append("Data seluler tidak aktif. ");
                    }
                } catch (Throwable ignored) {}
            }
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
            sb.append("Status operator seluler belum dapat dibaca karena pembatasan izin. ");
        }

        // 2. Status Wi-Fi dan kekuatan sinyal
        boolean wifiConnected = false;
        boolean cellConnected = false;
        try {
            ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
            if (cm != null) {
                Network active = cm.getActiveNetwork();
                NetworkCapabilities caps = active != null ? cm.getNetworkCapabilities(active) : null;
                if (caps != null) {
                    wifiConnected = caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI);
                    cellConnected = caps.hasTransport(NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_CELLULAR);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        try {
            WifiManager wm = (WifiManager) context.getApplicationContext().getSystemService(Context.WIFI_SERVICE);
            if (wm != null) {
                if (!wm.isWifiEnabled()) {
                    sb.append("Wi-Fi sedang mati. ");
                } else {
                    WifiInfo info = wm.getConnectionInfo();
                    int rssi = info != null ? info.getRssi() : -127;
                    if (wifiConnected || (info != null && info.getNetworkId() != -1 && rssi > -120)) {
                        String ssid = info.getSSID();
                        String cleanSsid = (ssid != null && !ssid.equals("<unknown ssid>"))
                                ? ssid.replace("\"", "").trim() : "";
                        String quality = describeRssi(rssi);
                        sb.append("Wi-Fi tersambung");
                        if (!cleanSsid.isEmpty()) sb.append(" ke ").append(cleanSsid);
                        sb.append(" dengan kekuatan sinyal ").append(quality)
                                .append(" (").append(rssi).append(" dBm). ");
                    } else {
                        sb.append("Wi-Fi menyala tetapi belum tersambung ke jaringan mana pun. ");
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        if (wifiConnected) {
            sb.append("Koneksi internet aktif melalui Wi-Fi.");
        } else if (cellConnected) {
            sb.append("Koneksi internet aktif melalui data seluler.");
        } else {
            sb.append("Saat ini internet terputus.");
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private static String describeRssi(int rssi) {
        if (rssi >= -55) return "sangat kuat";
        if (rssi >= -67) return "kuat";
        if (rssi >= -75) return "sedang";
        return "lemah";
    }

    private static boolean containsAny(String haystack, String... needles) {
        if (haystack == null || haystack.isEmpty()) return false;
        for (String n : needles) {
            if (haystack.contains(n)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Context;
import android.location.Location;
import android.location.LocationListener;
import android.location.LocationManager;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Looper;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Pemantau kecepatan dan jarak rute perjalanan GPS secara real-time untuk tunanetra.
 */
public final class TripMonitorHelper {

    public interface Callback {
        void onAnnouncement(String message);
    }

    private final Context context;
    private LocationManager locationManager;
    private Callback callback;
    private boolean active = false;
    private Location lastLocation;
    private double totalDistanceMeters = 0.0;
    private long startedAtMs = 0L;
    private float currentSpeedKmh = 0f;
    private double lastAnnouncedDistance = 0.0;
    private boolean warnedHighSpeed = false;

    public TripMonitorHelper(Context context) {
        this.context = context.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public String start(Callback cb) {
        if (!Perms.has(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)) {
            return "Izin lokasi belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Beri Izin.";
        }
        locationManager = (LocationManager) context.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE);
        if (locationManager == null) return "Layanan GPS tidak tersedia di HP ini.";

        stop(false);
        this.callback = cb;
        this.active = true;
        this.totalDistanceMeters = 0.0;
        this.lastAnnouncedDistance = 0.0;
        this.currentSpeedKmh = 0f;
        this.warnedHighSpeed = false;
        this.lastLocation = CompassLocationHelper.getBestLastKnown(locationManager);
        this.startedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();

        try {
            if (locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)) {
                locationManager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 3000L, 5f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper());
            }
            if (locationManager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)) {
                locationManager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, 4000L, 10f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper());
            }
        } catch (SecurityException e) {
            active = false;
            return "Gagal memulai pemantau GPS karena izin lokasi ditolak.";
        }
        return "Pemantau perjalanan dan kecepatan GPS dimulai. Saya akan melaporkan jarak dan kecepatan Anda secara berkala.";
    }

    public String stop(boolean buildSummary) {
        active = false;
        if (locationManager != null) {
            try {
                locationManager.removeUpdates(listener);
            } catch (SecurityException ignored) {}
        }
        if (!buildSummary) return "";
        return "Pemantau perjalanan dihentikan. " + statusSummary();
    }

    public String statusSummary() {
        long minutes = Math.max(0, (System.currentTimeMillis() - startedAtMs) / 60000L);
        String distText = totalDistanceMeters >= 1000
                ? String.format(new Locale("id", "ID"), "%.2f kilometer", totalDistanceMeters / 1000.0)
                : Math.round(totalDistanceMeters) + " meter";
        return String.format(new Locale("id", "ID"),
                "Kecepatan saat ini sekitar %.0f kilometer per jam. Total jarak tempuh %s dalam waktu %d menit.",
                currentSpeedKmh, distText, minutes);
    }

    private final LocationListener listener = new LocationListener() {
        @Override public void onLocationChanged(Location location) {
            if (!active || location == null) return;
            if (location.hasSpeed()) {
                currentSpeedKmh = location.getSpeed() * 3.6f;
            }
            if (lastLocation != null) {
                float delta = lastLocation.distanceTo(location);
                if (delta >= 3f && delta <= 500f) {
                    totalDistanceMeters += delta;
                    if (!location.hasSpeed()) {
                        long dtSec = Math.max(1L, (location.getTime() - lastLocation.getTime()) / 1000L);
                        currentSpeedKmh = (delta / dtSec) * 3.6f;
                    }
                }
            }
            lastLocation = location;

            if (callback != null) {
                if (currentSpeedKmh > 80f && !warnedHighSpeed) {
                    warnedHighSpeed = true;
                    callback.onAnnouncement(String.format(new Locale("id", "ID"),
                            "Kendaraan melaju kencang, kecepatan mencapai %.0f kilometer per jam.", currentSpeedKmh));
                } else if (currentSpeedKmh < 60f) {
                    warnedHighSpeed = false;
                }
                if (totalDistanceMeters - lastAnnouncedDistance >= 500.0) {
                    lastAnnouncedDistance = totalDistanceMeters;
                    callback.onAnnouncement(statusSummary());
                }
            }
        }
        @Override public void onStatusChanged(String provider, int status, Bundle extras) {}
        @Override public void onProviderEnabled(String provider) {}
        @Override public void onProviderDisabled(String provider) {}
    };
}
