        tvStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvVisionStatus);
        btnScan = findViewById(R.id.btnScanVision);
        btnBack = findViewById(R.id.btnBackVision);
        btnReset = findViewById(R.id.btnResetVision);
        btnPickImage = findViewById(R.id.btnPickImageVision);
        btnSummarize = findViewById(R.id.btnSummarizeVision);
        btnTranslate = findViewById(R.id.btnTranslateVision);

        String m = getIntent().getStringExtra("mode");
        mode = m == null ? "describe" : m;
        speaker = Speaker.get(this);
        config = new KobraConfig(this);
        ai = new AiClient(config);
        sensorManager = (SensorManager) getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE);
        if (sensorManager != null) {
            lightSensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_LIGHT);
        }
        try {
            toneGenerator = new ToneGenerator(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, 80);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}

        if (config.isPrivacyMode()) {
            tvStatus.setText("Mode Privasi Penuh Aktif");
            speak("Mode privasi penuh sedang aktif. Kamera tidak dapat dibuka sebelum mode privasi dimatikan.");
            btnScan.setEnabled(false);
            btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
            return;
        }

        btnScan.setOnClickListener(v -> captureNow());
        btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        btnReset.setOnClickListener(v -> resetCounter());
        btnPickImage.setOnClickListener(v -> openGalleryPicker());
        btnSummarize.setOnClickListener(v -> summarizeLastResult());
        btnTranslate.setOnClickListener(v -> translateLastResult(TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN));

        tvStatus.setText("Mode: " + modeLabel());
        speaker.speak(intro());

        if (Perms.has(this, Manifest.permission.CAMERA)) startCamera();
        else ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, new String[]{Manifest.permission.CAMERA}, 201);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent event) {
        if (screenHelper.handleKeyEvent(this, event, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(event);
    }

    @Override public boolean dispatchTouchEvent(MotionEvent ev) {
        if (screenHelper.handleTouchEvent(this, ev, speaker)) return true;
        return super.dispatchTouchEvent(ev);
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        current = this;
        if (!config.isPrivacyMode() && sensorManager != null && lightSensor != null) {
            autoTorchChecked = false;
            sensorManager.registerListener(lightListener, lightSensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI);
        }
    }

    @Override protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        if (current == this) current = null;
        if (sensorManager != null) {
            sensorManager.unregisterListener(lightListener);
        }
        disableTorch();
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        disableTorch();
        if (toneGenerator != null) {
            try { toneGenerator.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            toneGenerator = null;
        }
        try { ocr.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (barcodeScanner != null) {
            try { barcodeScanner.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        if (streamObjectDetector != null) {
            try { streamObjectDetector.close(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        cameraExec.shutdown();
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    private final SensorEventListener lightListener = new SensorEventListener() {
        @Override public void onSensorChanged(SensorEvent event) {
            if (event.sensor.getType() != Sensor.TYPE_LIGHT || autoTorchChecked || boundCamera == null) return;
            float lux = event.values[0];
            autoTorchChecked = true;
            if (sensorManager != null) {
                sensorManager.unregisterListener(this);
            }
            if (lux < 12.0f && boundCamera.getCameraInfo().hasFlashUnit()) {
                boundCamera.getCameraControl().enableTorch(true);
                autoTorchEnabled = true;
                tvStatus.setText("Mode: " + modeLabel() + " (Senter otomatis nyala)");
                speak("Tempat gelap terdeteksi, senter dinyalakan otomatis.");
            }
        }
        @Override public void onAccuracyChanged(Sensor sensor, int accuracy) {}
    };

    private void disableTorch() {
        if (autoTorchEnabled && boundCamera != null) {
            try {
                boundCamera.getCameraControl().enableTorch(false);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            autoTorchEnabled = false;
        }
    }

    @Override public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, @NonNull String[] permissions, @NonNull int[] grantResults) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
        if (requestCode == 201 && grantResults.length > 0 && grantResults[0] == android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            startCamera();
        } else {
            speak("Izin kamera belum aktif. Buka Kobra, lalu tekan Izin.");
        }
    }

    private boolean isLiveStreamMode() {
        return "digital_screen".equals(mode) || "barcode".equals(mode) || "find_object".equals(mode);
    }

    private void startCamera() {
        ListenableFuture<ProcessCameraProvider> future = ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance(this);
        future.addListener(() -> {
            try {
                ProcessCameraProvider provider = future.get();
                Preview preview = new Preview.Builder().build();
                preview.setSurfaceProvider(previewView.getSurfaceProvider());
                imageCapture = new ImageCapture.Builder()
                        .setCaptureMode(ImageCapture.CAPTURE_MODE_MINIMIZE_LATENCY)
                        .build();
                provider.unbindAll();

                if (isLiveStreamMode()) {
                    if ("barcode".equals(mode) && barcodeScanner == null) {
                        barcodeScanner = BarcodeScanning.getClient();
                    }
                    if ("find_object".equals(mode) && streamObjectDetector == null) {
                        streamObjectDetector = ObjectDetection.getClient(new ObjectDetectorOptions.Builder()
                                .setDetectorMode(ObjectDetectorOptions.STREAM_MODE)
                                .enableMultipleObjects()
                                .enableClassification()
                                .build());
                    }
                    ImageAnalysis analysis = new ImageAnalysis.Builder()
                            .setTargetResolution(new Size(640, 480))
                            .setBackpressureStrategy(ImageAnalysis.STRATEGY_KEEP_ONLY_LATEST)
                            .build();
                    analysis.setAnalyzer(cameraExec, this::analyzeLiveFrame);
                    boundCamera = provider.bindToLifecycle(this, CameraSelector.DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA, preview, imageCapture, analysis);
                } else {
                    boundCamera = provider.bindToLifecycle(this, CameraSelector.DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA, preview, imageCapture);
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                speak("Kamera tidak bisa dibuka.");
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    private void analyzeLiveFrame(ImageProxy proxy) {
        if (busy || liveProcessing || proxy.getImage() == null) {
            proxy.close();
            return;
        }
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if ("find_object".equals(mode)) {
            if (streamObjectDetector == null) { proxy.close(); return; }
            liveProcessing = true;
            int rot = proxy.getImageInfo().getRotationDegrees();
            int w = (rot == 90 || rot == 270) ? proxy.getHeight() : proxy.getWidth();
            int h = (rot == 90 || rot == 270) ? proxy.getWidth() : proxy.getHeight();
            InputImage img = InputImage.fromMediaImage(proxy.getImage(), rot);
            streamObjectDetector.process(img)
                    .addOnSuccessListener(objs -> handleLiveObjects(objs, w, h))
                    .addOnCompleteListener(t -> { liveProcessing = false; proxy.close(); });
        } else if ("barcode".equals(mode)) {
            if (now - lastLiveSpeakAt < 2200L || barcodeScanner == null) { proxy.close(); return; }
            liveProcessing = true;
            InputImage img = InputImage.fromMediaImage(proxy.getImage(), proxy.getImageInfo().getRotationDegrees());
            barcodeScanner.process(img)
                    .addOnSuccessListener(barcodes -> {
                        if (!barcodes.isEmpty()) {
                            String msg = formatBarcodeResults(barcodes);
                            if (!msg.equals(lastLiveText)) {
                                lastLiveText = msg;
                                lastLiveSpeakAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                                lastCapturedRawText = msg;
                                HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
                                playBeep(true);
                                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                    tvResult.setText(msg);
                                    speak(msg);
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .addOnCompleteListener(t -> { liveProcessing = false; proxy.close(); });
        } else if ("digital_screen".equals(mode)) {
            if (now - lastLiveSpeakAt < 2500L) { proxy.close(); return; }
            liveProcessing = true;
            InputImage img = InputImage.fromMediaImage(proxy.getImage(), proxy.getImageInfo().getRotationDegrees());
            ocr.process(img)
                    .addOnSuccessListener(res -> {
                        String raw = res.getText() != null ? res.getText().trim() : "";
                        if (raw.length() >= 2 && !raw.equals(lastLiveText)) {
                            lastLiveText = raw;
                            lastLiveSpeakAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
                            lastCapturedRawText = raw;
                            String parsed = MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseDigitalScreen(raw);
                            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                                tvResult.setText(parsed);
                                if (!speaker.isSpeaking()) {
                                    speak(parsed);
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    })
                    .addOnCompleteListener(t -> { liveProcessing = false; proxy.close(); });
        } else {
            proxy.close();
        }
    }

    private void handleLiveObjects(List<com.google.mlkit.vision.objects.DetectedObject> objs, int w, int h) {
        OfflineVision.ObjectGuidance g = OfflineVision.findNearestObject(objs, w, h);
        if (g == null) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> tvStatus.setText("Mode: Cari Objek (memindai sekitar...)"));
            return;
        }
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long beepInterval = g.closeness > 0.65 ? 300L : (g.closeness > 0.30 ? 650L : 1100L);
        if (now - lastLiveBeepAt >= beepInterval) {
            lastLiveBeepAt = now;
            playBeep(g.closeness > 0.55);
        }
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            tvStatus.setText("Terdeteksi: " + g.label + " (" + g.direction + ")");
            tvResult.setText(g.spokenText);
        });
        if (now - lastLiveSpeakAt >= 3200L && !speaker.isSpeaking()) {
            lastLiveSpeakAt = now;
            speak(g.spokenText);
        }
    }

    private void playBeep(boolean highUrgency) {
        if (toneGenerator == null) return;
        try {
            toneGenerator.startTone(
                    highUrgency ? ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP2 : ToneGenerator.TONE_PROP_BEEP,
                    highUrgency ? 120 : 75);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    /** Dipanggil dari tombol SCAN atau dari perintah suara "Kobra scan". */
    public void captureNow() {
        if (imageCapture == null) { speak("Kamera belum siap."); return; }
        if (busy) return;
        busy = true;
        tvStatus.setText("Memotret...");
        imageCapture.takePicture(cameraExec, new ImageCapture.OnImageCapturedCallback() {
            @Override public void onCaptureSuccess(@NonNull ImageProxy image) {
                Bitmap bmp = toBitmap(image);
                image.close();
                runOnUiThread(() -> analyze(bmp));
            }
            @Override public void onError(@NonNull ImageCaptureException e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    busy = false;
                    speak("Gagal memotret. Coba lagi.");
                });
            }
        });
    }

    public void resetCounter() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        runningCashTotal = 0L;
        billCount = 0;
        firstOutfitColor = null;
        lastLiveText = "";
        tvResult.setText("Hitungan / perbandingan direset.");
        speak("Hitungan dan sesi pemindaian direset.");
    }

    private void openGalleryPicker() {
        HapticFeedback.vibrateAction(this);
        speak("Pilih gambar atau tangkapan layar transfer dari galeri HP.");
        try {
            imagePickerLauncher.launch(new String[]{"image/*"});
        } catch (Exception e) {
            speak("Gagal membuka galeri gambar di HP ini.");
        }
    }

    private void processGalleryImage(Uri uri) {
        busy = true;
        tvStatus.setText("Membaca gambar dari galeri...");
        cameraExec.execute(() -> {
            try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
                Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(is);
                runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    if (bmp == null) {
                        done("Gambar tidak dapat dibuka.");
                        return;
                    }
                    if ("receipt".equals(mode) || "describe".equals(mode) || "digital_screen".equals(mode)) {
                        analyzeReceiptOrScreen(bmp, "receipt".equals(mode) || "describe".equals(mode));
                    } else {
                        analyze(bmp);
                    }
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                runOnUiThread(() -> done("Gagal membaca gambar dari galeri."));
            }
        });
    }

    public void summarizeLastResult() {
        String source = !lastCapturedRawText.isEmpty() ? lastCapturedRawText : tvResult.getText().toString();
        if (source == null || source.trim().isEmpty()) {
            speak("Belum ada hasil bacaan untuk diringkas.");
            return;
        }
        tvStatus.setText("Meringkas bacaan...");
        speak("Sebentar, saya ringkas hasil bacaannya.");
        LocalLlmEngine.getInstance(this).summarizeText("hasil kamera", source, ai, speaker, summary -> {
            tvStatus.setText("Ringkasan selesai.");
            tvResult.setText(summary);
            speak(summary);
        });
    }

    public void translateLastResult(String targetLang) {
        String source = !lastCapturedRawText.isEmpty() ? lastCapturedRawText : tvResult.getText().toString();
        if (source == null || source.trim().isEmpty()) {
            speak("Belum ada teks yang terbaca untuk diterjemahkan.");
            return;
        }
        String srcLang = TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN.equals(targetLang)
                ? TranslateLanguage.ENGLISH : TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN;
        OfflineTranslatorHelper.translate(this, source, srcLang, targetLang, new OfflineTranslatorHelper.Callback() {
            @Override public void onTranslated(String translatedText, String targetLangLabel) {
                tvStatus.setText("Terjemahan (" + targetLangLabel + "):");
                tvResult.setText(translatedText);
                speak("Terjemahan dalam bahasa " + targetLangLabel + ": " + translatedText);
            }
            @Override public void onStatus(String statusMessage) {
                tvStatus.setText(statusMessage);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                tvStatus.setText(message);
                speak(message);
            }
        });
    }

    private static Bitmap toBitmap(ImageProxy image) {
        ByteBuffer buf = image.getPlanes()[0].getBuffer();
        byte[] bytes = new byte[buf.remaining()];
        buf.get(bytes);
        Bitmap bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.length);
        if (bmp == null) return null;
        int rot = image.getImageInfo().getRotationDegrees();
        if (rot == 0) return bmp;
        Matrix m = new Matrix();
        m.postRotate(rot);
        return Bitmap.createBitmap(bmp, 0, 0, bmp.getWidth(), bmp.getHeight(), m, true);
    }

    private void analyze(Bitmap bmp) {
        if (bmp == null) { done("Foto tidak bisa dibaca. Coba lagi."); return; }
        switch (mode) {
            case "ktp":
                readKtp(bmp);
                return;
            case "color":
                done("Warnanya " + OfflineVision.detailedColorName(bmp) + ".");
                return;
            case "outfit":
                analyzeOutfit(bmp);
                return;
            case "face":
                OfflineVision.countFaces(bmp, this::done);
                return;
            case "money":
                analyzeMoneySingle(bmp);
                return;
            case "money_count":
                analyzeMoneySequential(bmp);
                return;
            case "digital_screen":
                analyzeReceiptOrScreen(bmp, false);
                return;
            case "receipt":
                analyzeReceiptOrScreen(bmp, true);
                return;
            case "barcode":
                analyzeBarcodeAndPackage(bmp);
                return;
            case "translate_ocr":
                analyzeAndTranslateOcr(bmp);
                return;
            case "find_object":
                if (canUseAi()) askAi(bmp, "Sebutkan benda utama seperti kursi, pintu, meja, atau tangga dan arah posisinya (kiri, tengah, kanan) secara singkat.");
                else OfflineVision.describe(bmp, this::done);
                return;
            default:
                if (canUseAi()) askAi(bmp, promptFor("describe"));
                else OfflineVision.describe(bmp, this::done);
        }
    }

    private void analyzeOutfit(Bitmap bmp) {
        String centerColor = OfflineVision.detailedColorName(bmp);
        if (firstOutfitColor == null) {
            firstOutfitColor = centerColor;
            String singleFrameSummary = OfflineVision.analyzeOutfitHarmony(bmp);
            done("Pakaian pertama (atasan) berwarna " + centerColor + ". "
                    + "Sekarang scan pakaian kedua (bawahan) untuk cek kecocokan, atau tekan RESET. "
                    + "Analisis cepat satu frame: " + singleFrameSummary);
        } else {
            String first = firstOutfitColor;
            firstOutfitColor = null;
            String verdict = OfflineVision.evaluateOutfitMatch(first, centerColor);
            done("Pakaian pertama berwarna " + first + ", pakaian kedua berwarna " + centerColor + ". " + verdict);
        }
    }

    private void analyzeMoneySingle(Bitmap bmp) {
        ocr.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0))
                .addOnSuccessListener(res -> {
                    String raw = res.getText();
                    MoneyAndReceiptParser.BillResult bill = MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseRupiahBill(raw, bmp);
                    if (bill.amount > 0 && bill.confidentOcr) {
                        done("Uang " + MoneyAndReceiptParser.formatRupiah(bill.amount) + ".");
                    } else if (canUseAi()) {
                        askAi(bmp, promptFor("money"));
                    } else if (bill.amount > 0) {
                        done(bill.explanation + ".");
                    } else {
                        done("Nominal uang belum terbaca jelas. Dekatkan kamera ke angka uang dan pastikan cahaya cukup.");
                    }
                })
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> {
                    if (canUseAi()) askAi(bmp, promptFor("money"));
                    else done("Gagal membaca uang.");
                });
    }

    private void analyzeMoneySequential(Bitmap bmp) {
        ocr.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0))
                .addOnSuccessListener(res -> {
                    MoneyAndReceiptParser.BillResult bill = MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseRupiahBill(res.getText(), bmp);
                    if (bill.amount > 0 && bill.confidentOcr) {
                        addBillToTotal(bill.amount, "");
                    } else if (canUseAi()) {
                        tvStatus.setText("Membaca nominal uang dengan AI...");
                        ai.describeImage(promptFor("money"), bmp, new AiClient.Callback() {
                            @Override public void onResult(String text) {
                                long parsed = MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseAiNominal(text);
                                if (parsed > 0) {
                                    addBillToTotal(parsed, text);
                                } else {
                                    done("Nominal belum pasti, tidak ditambahkan ke total. " + text);
                                }
                            }
                            @Override public void onError(String message) {
                                if (bill.amount > 0) addBillToTotal(bill.amount, bill.explanation);
                                else done(message);
                            }
                        });
                    } else if (bill.amount > 0) {
                        addBillToTotal(bill.amount, bill.explanation);
                    } else {
                        done("Nominal lembaran uang belum terbaca. Posisikan angka uang di tengah lalu scan lagi.");
                    }
                })
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> done("Gagal memindai uang."));
    }

    private void addBillToTotal(long amount, String note) {
        billCount++;
        runningCashTotal += amount;
        HapticFeedback.vibrateSuccess(this);
        String spoken = "Lembar ke-" + billCount + ": " + MoneyAndReceiptParser.formatRupiah(amount)
                + ". Total sementara: " + MoneyAndReceiptParser.formatRupiah(runningCashTotal) + ".";
        done(note != null && !note.isEmpty() ? spoken + " (" + note + ")" : spoken);
    }

    private void analyzeReceiptOrScreen(Bitmap bmp, boolean isReceipt) {
        ocr.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0))
                .addOnSuccessListener(res -> {
                    String raw = res.getText() != null ? res.getText().trim() : "";
                    lastCapturedRawText = raw;
                    if (raw.isEmpty() && canUseAi()) {
                        askAi(bmp, isReceipt
                                ? "Baca bukti transfer bank ini: sebutkan bank/aplikasi, status transaksi, nominal transfer rupiah, nama pengirim, dan nama penerima."
                                : "Baca seluruh angka dan teks yang tampil di layar perangkat digital ini secara jelas.");
                        return;
                    }
                    String parsed = isReceipt
                            ? MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseBankTransferReceipt(raw)
                            : MoneyAndReceiptParser.parseDigitalScreen(raw);
                    done(parsed);
                })
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> done("Gagal membaca teks pada layar atau struk."));
    }

    private void analyzeBarcodeAndPackage(Bitmap bmp) {
        if (barcodeScanner == null) barcodeScanner = BarcodeScanning.getClient();
        InputImage img = InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0);
        barcodeScanner.process(img)
                .addOnSuccessListener(barcodes -> ocr.process(img)
                        .addOnSuccessListener(ocrRes -> {
                            String ocrTxt = ocrRes.getText() == null ? "" : ocrRes.getText().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
                            lastCapturedRawText = ocrTxt;
                            String barStr = barcodes.isEmpty() ? "Barcode tidak terlihat di foto." : formatBarcodeResults(barcodes);
                            if (!ocrTxt.isEmpty()) {
                                if (ocrTxt.length() > 160) ocrTxt = ocrTxt.substring(0, 160) + "...";
                                done(barStr + " Teks kemasan terbaca: " + ocrTxt);
                            } else {
                                done(barStr);
                            }
                        })
                        .addOnFailureListener(e -> done(barcodes.isEmpty()
                                ? "Barcode maupun teks kemasan belum terbaca."
                                : formatBarcodeResults(barcodes))))
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> done("Gagal memindai barcode."));
    }

    private void analyzeAndTranslateOcr(Bitmap bmp) {
        ocr.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0))
                .addOnSuccessListener(res -> {
                    String raw = res.getText() == null ? "" : res.getText().trim();
                    lastCapturedRawText = raw;
                    if (raw.isEmpty()) {
                        done("Tidak ada teks yang terbaca untuk diterjemahkan.");
                        return;
                    }
                    tvResult.setText("Teks asli: " + raw);
                    translateLastResult(TranslateLanguage.INDONESIAN);
                    busy = false;
                })
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> done("Gagal membaca teks kamera."));
    }

    private static String formatBarcodeResults(List<Barcode> barcodes) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(2, barcodes.size()); i++) {
            Barcode b = barcodes.get(i);
            String val = b.getRawValue() != null ? b.getRawValue() : "";
            int type = b.getValueType();
            if (type == Barcode.TYPE_URL || val.startsWith("http://") || val.startsWith("https://")) {
                String warn = SecurityAndPinHelper.inspectForPhishing(val);
                sb.append("QR Tautan: ").append(val).append(". ");
                if (!warn.isEmpty()) sb.append(warn).append(" ");
            } else if (type == Barcode.TYPE_PRODUCT || type == Barcode.TYPE_ISBN) {
                sb.append("Barcode produk: ").append(val).append(". ");
            } else {
                sb.append("Kode terbaca: ").append(val).append(". ");
            }
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    private boolean canUseAi() {
        return config.hasAi() && NetworkState.isOnline(this);
    }

    private void askAi(Bitmap bmp, String prompt) {
        tvStatus.setText("Menganalisis dengan AI online...");
        speak("Sebentar, saya analisis gambarnya.");
        ai.describeImage(prompt, bmp, new AiClient.Callback() {
            @Override public void onResult(String text) {
                lastCapturedRawText = text;
                done(text);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String message) { done(message); }
        });
    }

    /** Baca KTP offline dengan ML Kit. Tidak butuh internet. */
    private void readKtp(Bitmap bmp) {
        ocr.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bmp, 0))
                .addOnSuccessListener(result -> {
                    lastCapturedRawText = result.getText();
                    done(parseKtp(result.getText()));
                })
                .addOnFailureListener(e -> done("Dokumen gagal dibaca. Dekatkan kamera dan pastikan cahaya cukup."));
    }

    static String parseKtp(String text) {
        String nik = null, nama = null, ttl = null, alamat = null;
        Matcher m = NIK.matcher(text);
        if (m.find()) nik = m.group();
        for (String raw : text.split("\n")) {
            String line = raw.trim();
            String low = line.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (low.startsWith("nama")) nama = valueOf(line);
            else if (low.contains("lahir")) ttl = valueOf(line);
            else if (low.startsWith("alamat")) alamat = valueOf(line);
        }
        if (nik == null && nama == null) {
            return "Dokumen ini tidak terbaca sebagai KTP. Dekatkan kamera dan pastikan cahaya cukup.";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        if (text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("kartu keluarga")) sb.append("Ini Kartu Keluarga. ");
        else sb.append("Ini KTP. ");
        if (nik != null) sb.append("Nomor induk kependudukan ").append(nik.replaceAll("(?<=\\d)(?=\\d)", " ")).append(". ");
        if (nama != null && !nama.isEmpty()) sb.append("Nama ").append(nama).append(". ");
        if (ttl != null && !ttl.isEmpty()) sb.append("Tempat tanggal lahir ").append(ttl).append(". ");
        if (alamat != null && !alamat.isEmpty()) sb.append("Alamat ").append(alamat).append(".");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String valueOf(String line) {
        int i = line.indexOf(':');
        return i < 0 ? "" : line.substring(i + 1).trim();
    }

    private void done(String text) {
        busy = false;
        tvStatus.setText("Selesai. Tekan SCAN untuk foto berikutnya.");
        tvResult.setText(text);
        speak(text);
    }

    private void speak(String text) { speaker.speak(text); }

    private String modeLabel() {
        switch (mode) {
            case "ktp": return "Baca KTP dan KK (offline)";
            case "money": return "Baca uang";
            case "money_count": return "Penghitung Lembar Uang Tunai";
            case "color": return "Deteksi warna rinci (offline)";
            case "outfit": return "Padu Padan Warna Pakaian";
            case "face": return "Hitung wajah (offline)";
            case "digital_screen": return "Pembaca Layar Digital Real-Time";
            case "receipt": return "Pemindai Struk & Screenshot Transfer";
            case "barcode": return "Pemindai Barcode & QR Offline";
            case "find_object": return "Cari Objek (Bip Kamera Offline)";
            case "translate_ocr": return "Penerjemah Teks Kamera Offline";
            default: return "Lihat sekitar (online jika tersedia, offline otomatis)";
        }
    }

    private String intro() {
        switch (mode) {
            case "ktp": return "Mode baca KTP. Dekatkan KTP ke kamera, lalu bilang Kobra scan atau tekan SCAN.";
            case "money": return "Mode baca uang. Arahkan kamera ke uang, lalu bilang Kobra scan.";
            case "money_count": return "Mode penghitung lembar uang tunai. Scan satu per satu lembar uang, Kobra akan menjumlahkannya secara otomatis.";
            case "color": return "Mode warna. Arahkan kamera ke benda, lalu bilang Kobra scan.";
            case "outfit": return "Mode padu padan pakaian. Scan baju atasan dulu lalu scan bawahan, atau foto keduanya sekaligus.";
            case "face": return "Mode hitung orang. Arahkan kamera, lalu bilang Kobra scan.";
            case "digital_screen": return "Mode pembaca layar perangkat digital aktif. Arahkan ke layar ATM, timbangan, atau meteran.";
            case "receipt": return "Mode pemindai struk dan bukti transfer bank. Tekan SCAN untuk memotret struk atau tekan GALERI untuk memilih screenshot transfer.";
            case "barcode": return "Mode pemindai barcode dan QR offline aktif. Arahkan ke kemasan obat atau kode QR.";
            case "find_object": return "Mode deteksi objek aktif. Bunyi bip akan lebih cepat saat objek dekat atau di tengah layar.";
            case "translate_ocr": return "Mode penerjemah kamera. Arahkan ke teks asing lalu tekan SCAN.";
            default: return "Mode lihat sekitar. Arahkan kamera ke depan, lalu bilang Kobra scan.";
        }
    }

    private static String promptFor(String mode) {
        switch (mode) {
            case "money":
                return "Ini uang kertas atau koin apa? Sebutkan nominal rupiahnya dengan jelas. "
                        + "Jika tidak yakin, katakan tidak yakin dan sarankan cara memotret yang lebih baik.";
            case "color":
                return "Sebutkan warna utama benda di tengah gambar dalam satu kalimat singkat.";
            case "face":
                return "Berapa orang yang terlihat di gambar? Jelaskan posisinya singkat: kiri, tengah, kanan, dekat atau jauh. "
                        + "Jika tidak ada orang, katakan tidak ada.";
            default:
                return "Jelaskan apa yang ada di depan kamera secara singkat. Sebutkan jika ada bahaya seperti "
                        + "tangga, lubang, kendaraan, kaca, atau halangan di depan.";
        }
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Pengujian logika murni AppMatcher dan PhoneFormat. */
public class AppMatcherCheck {
    static int fail = 0, pass = 0;

    static void eq(String name, Object actual, Object expected) {
        boolean ok = expected == null ? actual == null : expected.equals(actual);
        if (ok) pass++; else { fail++; System.out.println("GAGAL " + name + ": dapat <" + actual + ">, harapan <" + expected + ">"); }
    }

    static List<AppMatcher.App> apps() {
        String[][] a = {
            {"Kamera", "com.sec.android.app.camera"}, {"Galeri", "com.sec.android.gallery3d"}, {"Pesan", "com.samsung.android.messaging"},
            {"Telepon", "com.samsung.android.dialer"}, {"Kontak", "com.samsung.android.contacts"}, {"WhatsApp", "com.whatsapp"},
            {"WhatsApp Business", "com.whatsapp.w4b"}, {"Instagram", "com.instagram.android"}, {"Facebook", "com.facebook.katana"},
            {"Messenger", "com.facebook.orca"}, {"Telegram", "org.telegram.messenger"}, {"YouTube", "com.google.android.youtube"},
            {"YouTube Music", "com.google.android.apps.youtube.music"}, {"Google Maps", "com.google.android.apps.maps"},
            {"Chrome", "com.android.chrome"}, {"Gmail", "com.google.android.gm"}, {"Play Store", "com.android.vending"},
            {"Pengaturan", "com.android.settings"}, {"Jam", "com.sec.android.app.clockpackage"}, {"Kalender", "com.samsung.android.calendar"},
            {"Kalkulator", "com.sec.android.app.popupcalculator"}, {"Gojek", "com.gojek.app"}, {"Grab", "com.grabtaxi.passenger"},
            {"Shopee", "com.shopee.id"}, {"Tokopedia", "com.tokopedia.tkpd"}, {"DANA", "id.dana"}, {"Google Foto", "com.google.android.apps.photos"},
            {"Google Play Games", "com.google.android.play.games"}
        };
        List<AppMatcher.App> l = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String[] x : a) l.add(new AppMatcher.App(x[0], x[1]));
        return l;
    }

    /** Label pemenang jika jelas, "?" jika ambigu, "-" jika tidak ada. */
    static String pick(String q) {
        List<AppMatcher.Match> m = AppMatcher.find(apps(), q, 4);
        if (m.isEmpty()) return "-";
        return AppMatcher.isClear(m) ? m.get(0).app.label : "?";
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        eq("whatsapp", pick("whatsapp"), "WhatsApp");
        eq("WhatsApp huruf besar", pick("WhatsApp"), "WhatsApp");
        eq("wa", pick("wa"), "WhatsApp");
        eq("whatsapp bisnis", pick("whatsapp business"), "WhatsApp Business");
        eq("ig", pick("ig"), "Instagram");
        eq("fb", pick("fb"), "Facebook");
        eq("insta", pick("insta"), "Instagram");
        eq("tele", pick("tele"), "Telegram");
        eq("yt", pick("yt"), "YouTube");
        eq("salah dengar yutub", pick("yutub"), "YouTube");
        eq("youtube music", pick("youtube music"), "YouTube Music");
        eq("maps", pick("maps"), "Google Maps");
        eq("peta", pick("peta"), "Google Maps");
        eq("google maps", pick("google maps"), "Google Maps");
        eq("foto tanpa aplikasi Foto, padanan Galeri", pick("foto"), "Galeri");
        List<AppMatcher.App> withFoto = apps();
        withFoto.add(new AppMatcher.App("Foto", "com.example.foto"));
        List<AppMatcher.Match> fm = AppMatcher.find(withFoto, "foto", 4);
        eq("foto dengan aplikasi Foto", AppMatcher.isClear(fm) ? fm.get(0).app.label : "?", "Foto");
        eq("galeri", pick("galeri"), "Galeri");
        eq("kamera", pick("kamera"), "Kamera");
        eq("telepon", pick("telepon"), "Telepon");
        eq("pesan", pick("pesan"), "Pesan");
        eq("kontak", pick("kontak"), "Kontak");
        eq("jam", pick("jam"), "Jam");
        eq("kalkulator", pick("kalkulator"), "Kalkulator");
        eq("toko aplikasi", pick("toko aplikasi"), "Play Store");
        eq("browser", pick("browser"), "Chrome");
        eq("setelan", pick("setelan"), "Pengaturan");
        eq("dana", pick("dana"), "DANA");
        eq("gojek", pick("gojek"), "Gojek");
        eq("google ambigu", pick("google"), "?");
        eq("tidak ada", pick("xyzabc"), "-");
        eq("kosong", pick("  "), "-");

        eq("nomor 0812", PhoneFormat.toInternational("0812-3456-7890"), "6281234567890");
        eq("nomor +62", PhoneFormat.toInternational("+62 812 3456 7890"), "6281234567890");
        eq("nomor 62", PhoneFormat.toInternational("6281234567890"), "6281234567890");
        eq("nomor 8", PhoneFormat.toInternational("81234567890"), "6281234567890");
        eq("nomor asing", PhoneFormat.toInternational("+1 (415) 555-0100"), "14155550100");
        eq("nomor 00", PhoneFormat.toInternational("0062 812 3456"), "628123456");
        eq("nomor kosong", PhoneFormat.toInternational(""), "");
        eq("nomor null", PhoneFormat.toInternational(null), "");

        System.out.println("Lulus: " + pass + ", gagal: " + fail);
        if (fail > 0) System.exit(1);
    }
}

package com.asisten.bantu;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;

/** Pengujian logika murni OfflineBrain. Jalankan: lihat README bagian "Menguji logika offline". */
public class OfflineBrainCheck {
    static int fail = 0, pass = 0;

    static void eq(String name, Object actual, Object expected) {
        boolean ok = expected == null ? actual == null : expected.equals(actual);
        if (ok) pass++; else { fail++; System.out.println("GAGAL " + name + ": dapat <" + actual + ">, harapan <" + expected + ">"); }
    }

    static void has(String name, String actual, String part) {
        boolean ok = actual != null && actual.contains(part);
        if (ok) pass++; else { fail++; System.out.println("GAGAL " + name + ": dapat <" + actual + ">, harus memuat <" + part + ">"); }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String path = args.length > 0 ? args[0] : "app/src/main/assets/kobra_kb.txt";
        OfflineBrain b = OfflineBrain.fromText(new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(path)), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        // kalkulator
        eq("tambah", b.answer("berapa 5 tambah 3"), "Hasilnya 8.");
        eq("kali kata", b.answer("dua puluh lima kali empat"), "Hasilnya 100.");
        eq("bagi", b.answer("100 dibagi 4"), "Hasilnya 25.");
        eq("bagi nol", b.answer("10 dibagi 0"), "Tidak bisa dibagi dengan nol.");
        eq("ratus", b.answer("seratus dua puluh tambah tiga ratus"), "Hasilnya 420.");
        eq("kurang negatif", b.answer("dua ribu lima ratus kurang satu juta"), "Hasilnya -997500.");
        eq("kurung", b.answer("(2 + 3) x 4"), "Hasilnya 20.");
        eq("prioritas", b.answer("2 + 3 x 4"), "Hasilnya 14.");
        eq("desimal", b.answer("7 / 2"), "Hasilnya 3,5.");
        eq("belas", b.answer("dua belas tambah tiga"), "Hasilnya 15.");
        eq("hitung kata awal", b.answer("tolong hitung sebelas kali sebelas"), "Hasilnya 121.");
        eq("bukan hitungan 1", OfflineBrain.calculate("dua kali sehari"), null);
        eq("bukan hitungan 2", OfflineBrain.calculate("uang saya kurang"), null);
        eq("bukan hitungan 3", OfflineBrain.calculate("tiga kali"), null);
        eq("bukan hitungan 4", OfflineBrain.calculate("jam tujuh"), null);

        // bilangan
        eq("angka jam", OfflineBrain.numbers("alarm jam 6 30"), Arrays.asList(6, 30));
        eq("kata jam", OfflineBrain.numbers("jam tujuh dua puluh"), Arrays.asList(7, 20));
        eq("timer kata", OfflineBrain.firstNumber("timer lima menit"), 5);
        eq("jam titik dua", OfflineBrain.numbers("bangunkan jam 6:45"), Arrays.asList(6, 45));
        eq("nomor tanpa angka", OfflineBrain.firstNumber("tekan nomor"), null);
        eq("duabelas", OfflineBrain.firstNumber("jam dua belas malam"), 12);

        // pengetahuan
        has("tersedak", b.answer("tolong saya tersedak"), "lima tepukan");
        has("luka", b.answer("ada pendarahan hebat"), "Tekan luka");
        has("bakar", b.answer("tangan saya terbakar"), "dua puluh menit");
        has("darurat", b.answer("nomor darurat berapa"), "112");
        has("sedih", b.answer("aku lagi sedih banget"), "mendengarkan");
        has("sapa pendek", b.answer("halo"), "Ada yang bisa");
        eq("sapa panjang tidak cocok", b.answer("halo saya mau tanya tentang cuaca di jakarta besok"), null);
        eq("tak dikenal", b.answer("siapa presiden amerika"), null);
        eq("kosong", b.answer("   "), null);
        has("p3k", b.answer("panduan p3k"), "tersedak");

        System.out.println("Lulus: " + pass + ", gagal: " + fail);
        if (fail > 0) System.exit(1);
    }
}

## 🌟 What is DeVA?

**DeVA (Device Virtual Assistant)** is a revolutionary AI-powered Android assistant that doesn't just respond to your voice—it **actually operates your phone for you**. Think of it as having a personal assistant sitting next to you, tapping, swiping, and navigating through apps on your behalf.

```
🗣️ "Hey DeVA, send a good morning text to Mom"
📱 *DeVA opens Messages, finds Mom, types & sends the message*
✅ "Done! Message sent to Mom"
```

### Why DeVA is Different

| Traditional Assistants | DeVA |
|----------------------|------|
| ❌ Limited to specific app integrations | ✅ Works with ANY app on your phone |
| ❌ Can only answer questions | ✅ Actually performs actions |
| ❌ Requires API support from each app | ✅ Uses visual UI automation |
| ❌ Closed source, privacy concerns | ✅ 100% Open Source |

## 🎯 Example Commands

| Task | Voice Command |
|------|---------------|
| 📧 Send Messages | "Send a text to John saying I'll be late" |
| 🎵 Play Music | "Open Spotify and play my liked songs" |
| ⏰ Set Alarms | "Set an alarm for 7:30 AM tomorrow" |
| 📸 Take Photos | "Open camera and take a selfie" |
| 🌤️ Check Weather | "What's the weather like today?" |
| 📱 Open Apps | "Open Instagram and go to my messages" |
| 🔍 Search | "Search for nearby restaurants on Google Maps" |
| 💬 LinkedIn | "Send welcome message to all new connections" |

## ✨ Features

<table>

### 🧠 Intelligent UI Automation
DeVA sees your screen through accessibility services, understands the context of UI elements, and performs actions like a human would—tapping, swiping, and typing.

### 🎙️ Natural Voice Interaction
High-quality voice recognition and speech synthesis powered by Google's advanced AI. Just speak naturally, and DeVA understands.

### 👁️ Vision Capability
DeVA can analyze what's on your screen and provide context-aware responses. Ask "What's on my screen?" and get intelligent summaries.

Say "Hey DeVA" to wake up your assistant anytime, anywhere. No need to open the app first.

### 🔐 Privacy First
100% open source. Your voice data stays on your device. No shady data collection.

### 📲 Works with ANY App
Unlike traditional assistants limited to specific integrations, DeVA can interact with any app on your phone through UI automation.

</td>

## 🏗️ Architecture

DeVA is built on a sophisticated multi-agent system that separates responsibilities for reliable reasoning:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     🧠 THE BRAIN (LLM)                      │
│            Gemini-powered reasoning & planning              │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                             │
│  ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐    ┌──────────────┐  │
│  │   👂 EARS    │    │   👁️ EYES    │    │   🖐️ HANDS   │  │
│  │  STT/TTS    │◄──►│ Accessibility │◄──►│   Actions    │  │
│  │   Voice     │    │   Service     │    │  Tap/Swipe   │  │
│  └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘    └──────────────┘  │
│                                                             │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                    📱 YOUR ANDROID DEVICE                   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Core Components

- **ConversationalAgentService** - Handles voice interactions and conversation flow
- **AgentService** - Executes multi-step tasks through UI automation
- **Eyes (Accessibility)** - Reads screen content and UI hierarchy
- **SpeechCoordinator** - Manages STT/TTS for natural voice interaction
- **GeminiApi** - Powers intelligent decision making

---

## ⚡ Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- 📱 Android device with API Level 26+ (Android 8.0+)
- 🛠️ Android Studio (latest version recommended)
- 🔑 Gemini API keys

### Installation

1. **Clone the repository**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/devanshupardeshi/DeVA.git
   cd DeVA
   ```

2. **Configure API Keys**
   
   Create `local.properties` in the project root:
   ```properties
   # Option 1: Direct Gemini API keys (recommended for testing)
   GEMINI_API_KEYS=your_api_key_1,your_api_key_2
   
   # Option 2: Custom proxy server
   GCLOUD_PROXY_URL=your_backend_url
   GCLOUD_PROXY_URL_KEY=your_password
   ```

3. **Build & Run**
   - Open in Android Studio
   - Let Gradle sync dependencies
   - Run on your device

4. **Enable Permissions**
   - Grant Accessibility Service permission
   - Grant Microphone permission
   - Enable Overlay permission (for floating UI)

import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.util.Properties

plugins {
    alias(libs.plugins.android.application)
    alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.android)
    alias(libs.plugins.kotlin.compose)
    id("com.google.gms.google-services")
    alias(libs.plugins.ksp)
    id("org.jetbrains.kotlin.plugin.serialization") version "2.2.10"
    id("com.google.firebase.crashlytics")

}

val localProperties = Properties()
val localPropertiesFile = rootProject.file("local.properties")
if (localPropertiesFile.exists()) {
    localProperties.load(FileInputStream(localPropertiesFile))
}

// Load version properties
val versionProps = Properties()
val versionPropsFile = rootProject.file("version.properties")
if (versionPropsFile.exists()) {
    versionProps.load(FileInputStream(versionPropsFile))
}

android {
    namespace = "com.deva.voice"
    compileSdk = 35

    // Common API keys and configuration - extracted to avoid duplication
    val apiKeys = localProperties.getProperty("GEMINI_API_KEYS") ?: ""
    val tavilyApiKeys = localProperties.getProperty("TAVILY_API") ?: ""
    val mem0ApiKey = localProperties.getProperty("MEM0_API") ?: ""
    val picovoiceApiKey = localProperties.getProperty("PICOVOICE_ACCESS_KEY") ?: ""
    val googleTtsApiKey = localProperties.getProperty("GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY") ?: ""
    val googlecloudGatewayPicovoice =

// Task to increment version for release builds
tasks.register("incrementVersion") {
    doLast {
        val versionFile = rootProject.file("version.properties")
        val props = Properties()
        props.load(FileInputStream(versionFile))

        val currentVersionCode = props.getProperty("VERSION_CODE").toInt()
        val currentVersionName = props.getProperty("VERSION_NAME")

        // Increment version code
        val newVersionCode = currentVersionCode + 1

        // Increment patch version in semantic versioning (x.y.z -> x.y.z+1)
        val versionParts = currentVersionName.split(".")
        val newPatchVersion = if (versionParts.size >= 3) {
            versionParts[2].toInt() + 1
        } else {
            1
        }
        val newVersionName = if (versionParts.size >= 2) {
            "${versionParts[0]}.${versionParts[1]}.$newPatchVersion"
        } else {
            "1.0.$newPatchVersion"
        }

        // Update properties
        props.setProperty("VERSION_CODE", newVersionCode.toString())
        props.setProperty("VERSION_NAME", newVersionName)

        // Save back to file with comments
        val output = FileOutputStream(versionFile)
        output.use { fileOutput ->
            fileOutput.write("# Version configuration for Blurr Android App\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("# This file is automatically updated during release builds\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("# Do not modify manually - use Gradle tasks to update versions\n\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("# Current version code (integer - increments by 1 each release)\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("VERSION_CODE=$newVersionCode\n\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("# Current version name (semantic version - increments patch number each release)\n".toByteArray())
            fileOutput.write("VERSION_NAME=$newVersionName".toByteArray())
        }

        println("Version incremented to: versionCode=$newVersionCode, versionName=$newVersionName")
    }
}

// Make release builds automatically increment version
tasks.whenTaskAdded {
    if (name == "assembleRelease" || name == "bundleRelease") {
        dependsOn("incrementVersion")
    }
}

package com.deva.voice

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class AssistEntryActivity : Activity() {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        handleAssistLaunch(intent)
        // No UI — finish immediately
        finish()
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent?) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        handleAssistLaunch(intent)
        finish()
    }

    private fun handleAssistLaunch(intent: Intent?) {
        Log.d("AssistEntryActivity", "Assistant invoked via ACTION_ASSIST, intent=$intent")

        // If agent already running, you can signal it to focus/show UI instead of starting again
        if (!ConversationalAgentService.isRunning) {
            val serviceIntent = Intent(this, ConversationalAgentService::class.java).apply {
                action = "com.deva.voice.ACTION_START_FROM_ASSIST"
                putExtra("source", "assist_gesture")       // optional metadata
            }
            ContextCompat.startForegroundService(this, serviceIntent)
        } else {
            // e.g., tell the service to bring its overlay/mic UI to front
            sendBroadcast(Intent("com.deva.voice.ACTION_SHOW_OVERLAY"))
        }
    }
}

package com.deva.voice

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.*
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.view.animation.LinearInterpolator
import androidx.core.graphics.toColorInt
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.random.Random

class AudioWaveView @JvmOverloads constructor(
    context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null, defStyleAttr: Int = 0
) : View(context, attrs) {

    // --- Configuration Constants ---
    companion object {
        // Added for converting raw audio dB to a normalized value
        private const val MIN_DB_VALUE = -60f
        private const val MAX_DB_VALUE = -5f
    }

    private val waveCount = 7
    private val minIdleAmplitude = 0.15f
    private val maxWaveHeightScale = 0.25f
    // Corrected and swapped durations for more logical behavior
    private val targetAmplitudeTransitionDuration = 500L
    private val realtimeAmplitudeTransitionDuration = 100L
    private val maxSpeedIncrease = 4.0f
    private val jitterAmount = 0.1f

    private val waveColors = intArrayOf(
        "#8A2BE2".toColorInt(), "#4169E1".toColorInt(), "#FF1493".toColorInt(),
        "#9370DB".toColorInt(), "#00BFFF".toColorInt(), "#FF69B4".toColorInt(),
        "#DA70D6".toColorInt()
    )

    private var amplitudeAnimator: ValueAnimator? = null
    private val wavePaints = mutableListOf<Paint>()
    private val wavePaths = mutableListOf<Path>()
    private val waveFrequencies: FloatArray
    private val wavePhaseShifts: FloatArray
    private val waveSpeeds: FloatArray
    private val waveAmplitudeMultipliers: FloatArray

    private var audioAmplitude = minIdleAmplitude

    init {
        setLayerType(LAYER_TYPE_HARDWARE, null)

        waveFrequencies = FloatArray(waveCount)
        wavePhaseShifts = FloatArray(waveCount)
        waveSpeeds = FloatArray(waveCount)
        waveAmplitudeMultipliers = FloatArray(waveCount)

        val blurFilter = BlurMaskFilter(15f, BlurMaskFilter.Blur.NORMAL)

        for (i in 0 until waveCount) {
            waveFrequencies[i] = Random.nextFloat() * 0.6f + 0.8f
            wavePhaseShifts[i] = Random.nextFloat() * (Math.PI * 2).toFloat()
            waveSpeeds[i] = Random.nextFloat() * 0.02f + 0.01f
            waveAmplitudeMultipliers[i] = Random.nextFloat() * 0.5f + 0.8f

            wavePaints.add(Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                style = Paint.Style.FILL
                color = waveColors[i % waveColors.size]
                alpha = 120
                maskFilter = blurFilter
            })
            wavePaths.add(Path())
        }

        ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
            interpolator = LinearInterpolator()
            duration = 5000
            repeatCount = ValueAnimator.INFINITE
            addUpdateListener {
                val speedFactor = 1.0f + (audioAmplitude * maxSpeedIncrease)
                for (i in 0 until waveCount) {
                    wavePhaseShifts[i] += (waveSpeeds[i] * speedFactor)
                }
                invalidate()
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    /**
     * NEW: Call this from your audio processing code with the raw dB value.
     * It normalizes the value and updates the wave animation in real-time.
     * @param rmsdB The Root Mean Square decibel level of the current audio buffer.
     */
    fun updateAmplitude(rmsdB: Float) {
        // Normalize the decibel level to a 0.0 to 1.0 range
        val normalizedAmplitude = ((rmsdB - MIN_DB_VALUE) / (MAX_DB_VALUE - MIN_DB_VALUE)).coerceIn(0f, 2.0f)

        // Call the existing method to update the wave's appearance
        setRealtimeAmplitude(normalizedAmplitude)
    }


    /**
     * Instantly sets the amplitude for real-time visualization.
     * @param amplitude The raw amplitude from the visualizer (0.0 to 1.0).
     */
    fun setRealtimeAmplitude(amplitude: Float) {
        val scaledAmplitude = amplitude.pow(1.5f).coerceIn(0.0f, 1.0f)
        val targetAmplitude = minIdleAmplitude + (scaledAmplitude * maxWaveHeightScale)
        amplitudeAnimator?.cancel()
        amplitudeAnimator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(audioAmplitude, targetAmplitude).apply {
            duration = realtimeAmplitudeTransitionDuration // Use short duration for responsiveness
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener { animation ->
                audioAmplitude = animation.animatedValue as Float
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Smoothly animates the wave's amplitude to a new target level.
     * Used for non-realtime effects like a "power up" sequence.
     * @param target The target amplitude level (0.0f for idle, 1.0f for full).
     */
    fun setTargetAmplitude(target: Float) {
        val targetAmplitude = minIdleAmplitude + (target * maxWaveHeightScale)
        amplitudeAnimator?.cancel()
        amplitudeAnimator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(audioAmplitude, targetAmplitude).apply {
            duration = targetAmplitudeTransitionDuration // Use longer duration for smooth transitions
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener { animation ->
                audioAmplitude = animation.animatedValue as Float
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
        for(i in 0 until waveCount) {
            val paint = wavePaints[i]
            val color = waveColors[i % waveColors.size]
            paint.shader = LinearGradient(
                0f, h / 2f, 0f, h.toFloat(),
                color, Color.TRANSPARENT, Shader.TileMode.CLAMP
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)

        for (i in 0 until waveCount) {
            wavePaths[i].reset()
            wavePaths[i].moveTo(0f, height.toFloat())
            val waveMaxHeight = height * audioAmplitude * waveAmplitudeMultipliers[i]
            val currentJitter = (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * waveMaxHeight * jitterAmount
            for (x in 0..width step 5) {
                val sineInput = (x * (Math.PI * 2 / width) * waveFrequencies[i]) + wavePhaseShifts[i]
                val sineOutput = (sin(sineInput) * 0.5f + 0.5f)
                val y = height - (waveMaxHeight * sineOutput) + currentJitter
                wavePaths[i].lineTo(x.toFloat(), y.toFloat())
            }
            wavePaths[i].lineTo(width.toFloat(), height.toFloat())
            wavePaths[i].close()
            canvas.drawPath(wavePaths[i], wavePaints[i])
        }
    }
}

package com.deva.voice

import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

abstract class BaseNavigationActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    protected abstract fun getContentLayoutId(): Int
    protected abstract fun getCurrentNavItem(): NavItem

    enum class NavItem {
        HOME, TRIGGERS, MOMENTS, UPGRADE, SETTINGS
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        // Disable any default activity transitions
        disableTransitions()
    }
    
    override fun setContentView(layoutResID: Int) {
        super.setContentView(R.layout.activity_base_navigation)
        
        // Inflate the child activity's content into the content container
        val contentContainer = findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.content_container)
        layoutInflater.inflate(layoutResID, contentContainer, true)
        
        setupBottomNavigation()
    }

    private fun setupBottomNavigation() {
        val currentItem = getCurrentNavItem()
        
        findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.nav_triggers).apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (currentItem != NavItem.TRIGGERS) {
                    navigateToActivity(com.deva.voice.triggers.ui.TriggersActivity::class.java, currentItem)
                }
            }
            alpha = if (currentItem == NavItem.TRIGGERS) 1.0f else 0.7f
        }
        
        findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.nav_moments).apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (currentItem != NavItem.MOMENTS) {
                    navigateToActivity(MomentsActivity::class.java, currentItem)
                }
            }
            alpha = if (currentItem == NavItem.MOMENTS) 1.0f else 0.7f
        }
        
        findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.nav_home).apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (currentItem != NavItem.HOME) {
                    navigateToActivity(MainActivity::class.java, currentItem)
                }
            }
            alpha = if (currentItem == NavItem.HOME) 1.0f else 0.7f
        }
        
        findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.nav_upgrade).apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (currentItem != NavItem.UPGRADE) {
                    navigateToActivity(ProPurchaseActivity::class.java, currentItem)
                }
            }
            alpha = if (currentItem == NavItem.UPGRADE) 1.0f else 0.7f
        }
        
        findViewById<LinearLayout>(R.id.nav_settings).apply {
            setOnClickListener {
                if (currentItem != NavItem.SETTINGS) {
                    navigateToActivity(SettingsActivity::class.java, currentItem)
                }
            }
            alpha = if (currentItem == NavItem.SETTINGS) 1.0f else 0.7f
        }
    }
    
    private fun navigateToActivity(activityClass: Class<*>, currentItem: NavItem) {
        val intent = Intent(this, activityClass)
        startActivity(intent)
        // Disable transition animations
        disableTransitions()
        if (currentItem != NavItem.HOME) {
            finish()
            // Also disable animations when finishing
            disableTransitions()
        }
    }
    
    override fun finish() {
        super.finish()
        // Disable animations when finishing
        disableTransitions()
    }
    
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun disableTransitions() {
        // Use the legacy method for all Android versions since the new API
        // requires more complex setup and this works reliably
        overridePendingTransition(0, 0)
    }
}

package com.deva.voice

import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

class ChatActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var recyclerView: RecyclerView
    private lateinit var editText: EditText
    private lateinit var sendButton: Button
    private val messages = mutableListOf<Message>()
    private lateinit var chatAdapter: ChatAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_chat)

        recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recyclerView)
        editText = findViewById(R.id.editText)
        sendButton = findViewById(R.id.sendButton)

        // Get the custom message from the intent
        val customMessage = intent.getStringExtra("custom_message") ?: "Hello! How can I helpy?"

        // Set up the RecyclerView
        recyclerView.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        chatAdapter = ChatAdapter(messages)
        recyclerView.adapter = chatAdapter

        // Display the custom message or default message
        messages.add(Message(customMessage, isUserMessage = false))
        chatAdapter.notifyItemInserted(messages.size - 1)

        // Handle sending messages
        sendButton.setOnClickListener {
            val messageContent = editText.text.toString()
            if (messageContent.isNotEmpty()) {
                // Add the user's message
                messages.add(Message(messageContent, isUserMessage = true))
                chatAdapter.notifyItemInserted(messages.size - 1)
                recyclerView.scrollToPosition(messages.size - 1) // Scroll to the latest message

                // Clear the input field
                editText.text.clear()

                // Optionally, send a default bot response
                messages.add(Message("This is a default bot response.", isUserMessage = false))
                chatAdapter.notifyItemInserted(messages.size - 1)
                recyclerView.scrollToPosition(messages.size - 1)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.deva.voice

import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import android.graphics.Color
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

data class Message(val content: String, val isUserMessage: Boolean)


class ChatAdapter(private val messages: List<Message>) : RecyclerView.Adapter<ChatAdapter.ChatViewHolder>() {

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ChatViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.item_message, parent, false)
        return ChatViewHolder(view)
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ChatViewHolder, position: Int) {
        val message = messages[position]
        holder.bind(message)
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int = messages.size

    class ChatViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val messageText: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.messageText)

        fun bind(message: Message) {
            messageText.text = message.content
            // Style the text depending on whether it's a user message or not
            if (message.isUserMessage) {
                messageText.setBackgroundColor(Color.LTGRAY)
                messageText.gravity = Gravity.END
            } else {
                messageText.setBackgroundColor(Color.WHITE)
                messageText.gravity = Gravity.START
            }
        }
    }
}

class ConversationalAgentService : Service() {

    private val serviceScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
    private var conversationHistory = listOf<Pair<String, List<Any>>>()

    private val visualFeedbackManager by lazy { VisualFeedbackManager.getInstance(this) }
    private val devaStateManager by lazy { DeVAStateManager.getInstance(this) }
    private var isTextModeActive = false
    private val freemiumManager by lazy { FreemiumManager() }
    private val servicePermissionManager by lazy { ServicePermissionManager(this) }

    private var clarificationAttempts = 0
    private val maxClarificationAttempts = 1
    private var sttErrorAttempts = 0
    private val maxSttErrorAttempts = 2

    private val clarificationAgent = ClarificationAgent()
    private val windowManager by lazy { getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager }
    private val mainHandler by lazy { Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()) }
    private var cachedMemories = listOf<UserMemory>()

    private lateinit var perception: Perception

    companion object {

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.R)

    @RequiresApi(Build.VERSION_CODES.R)
    private fun showInputBoxIfNeeded() {
        visualFeedbackManager.showInputBox(
            onActivated = {
                // This is called when the user taps the EditText
                enterTextMode()
            },
            onSubmit = { submittedText ->
                // This is the existing callback for when text is submitted
                processUserInput(submittedText)
            },
            onOutsideTap = {

                }
