                            ? 'ARMED // Monitoring accelerometer & perimeter'
                            : 'STANDBY // Motion sensors disarmed',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: isArmed ? const Color(0xFFFF5252) : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Switch(
                  value: isArmed,
                  activeThumbColor: const Color(0xFFFF5252),
                  onChanged: (val) async {
                    if (val) {
                      await sentry.armSentry();

                      await sentry.disarmSentry();

                  },
                ),
              ],

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(

                          : 'Telegram Uplink: Not paired. Configure in Settings for photo dispatch.',

          ],
        ),
      ),

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3c. Autonomous "Macro Recorder" (Hermes Skills) Card
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Widget _macroRecorderCard(ThemeData theme) {
    final recorder = MacroRecorderService.instance;

    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            SwitchListTile(
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              title: const Text(
                'Autonomous Macro Recording',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
              ),
              subtitle: const Text(
                'Record user interaction sequences across other apps via accessibility events and codify them into named executable skills in AGENT.md',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
              ),
              value: _settings.macroRecorderEnabled,
              onChanged: (val) async {
                await _settings.setMacroRecorderEnabled(val);
                setState(() {});
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            if (recorder.isRecording) ...[
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: const Color(0xFFFF5252).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: const Color(0xFFFF5252).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        const Icon(
                          Icons.fiber_manual_record,
                          size: 14,
                          color: Color(0xFFFF5252),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          'RECORDING: "${recorder.activeMacroGoal}"',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            color: Color(0xFFFF5252),
                            letterSpacing: 1.1,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    const Text(
                      'Demonstrate actions across any app. Accessibility events are being mapped into TaskSteps.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton.icon(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFFF5252),
                        ),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.stop, size: 16),
                        label: const Text('Stop & Codify into AGENT.md'),
                        onPressed: () async {
                          final skill = await recorder.stopRecording();
                          if (mounted) {
                            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                              SnackBar(
                                content: Text('Codified "${skill?.goal}" into AGENT.md!'),
                                behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                              ),
                            );
                            setState(() {});
                          }
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ] else ...[
              SizedBox(
                width: double.infinity,
                child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.fiber_manual_record_outlined, size: 16),
                  label: const Text('Start Recording Macro Demonstration'),
                  onPressed: () {
                    _showStartMacroDialog();
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'CODIFIED MACRO SKILLS',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    letterSpacing: 1.1,
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                Text(
                  '${recorder.recordedMacros.length} stored',
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            if (recorder.recordedMacros.isEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
                child: Text(
                  'No macros recorded yet. Tap "Start Recording" or say "Jarvis, record macro <name>" to demonstrate an autonomous skill.',
                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontStyle: FontStyle.italic),
                ),
              )
            else
              ...recorder.recordedMacros.take(5).map(
                    (skill) => Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: theme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.bolt_outlined, size: 16, color: Color(0xFFBA68C8)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  skill.goal,
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                                ),
                                Text(
                                  '${skill.steps.length} atomic actions • Used ${skill.successCount}x',
                                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 10.5),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow_outlined, size: 20),
                            tooltip: 'Replay Macro',
                            onPressed: () async {
                              await recorder.replaySkill(skill);
                            },
                          ),
                          IconButton(
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 18),
                            tooltip: 'Delete Macro',
                            onPressed: () async {
                              await recorder.deleteSkill(skill.id);
                              setState(() {});
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showStartMacroDialog() {
    final controller = TextEditingController(text: 'Open Spotify and play workout');
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Record New Autonomous Macro'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'Enter the natural language goal of this macro. Once recording starts, perform the actions in any app on your phone:',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'Macro Goal',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                hintText: 'e.g. Order usual coffee in Starbucks',
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton.icon(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.fiber_manual_record, size: 16),
            label: const Text('Start Recording'),
            onPressed: () async {
              final goal = controller.text.trim();
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
              if (goal.isNotEmpty) {
                await MacroRecorderService.instance.startRecording(goal);
                setState(() {});
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

                          )

                    onPressed: smartHome.isConnecting

                                SnackBar(

                FilledButton.tonal(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                  ),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    await smartHome.turnOff();
                    if (mounted) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        const SnackBar(
                          content: Text('Dispatched Light OFF signal'),
                          duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
                          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                  },
                  child: const Text('Turn OFF', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.directions_car_outlined, size: 16),
                label: Text(commute.isChecking
                    ? 'Calculating Live Route...'
                    : 'Check Live Commute & Traffic'),
                onPressed: commute.isChecking

                        if (mounted) {
                          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                            SnackBar(
                              content: Text(status.spokenSummary),
                              duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
                              behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                            ),
                          );
                          setState(() {});
                        }
                      },
              ),
            ),
            if (commute.lastStatus != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(

                  children: [

                      children: [
                        Icon(
                          Icons.traffic_outlined,
                          size: 15,
                          color: commute.lastStatus!.trafficSeverity == TrafficSeverity.heavy
                              ? const Color(0xFFFF5252)

                                  ? const Color(0xFFFFB300)
                                  : const Color(0xFF00E676)),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          commute.lastStatus!.severityLabel.toUpperCase(),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            letterSpacing: 1.1,
                            color: commute.lastStatus!.trafficSeverity == TrafficSeverity.heavy
                                ? const Color(0xFFFF5252)
                                : (commute.lastStatus!.trafficSeverity == TrafficSeverity.moderate
                                    ? const Color(0xFFFFB300)
                                    : const Color(0xFF00E676)),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const Spacer(),
                        Text(
                          '${commute.lastStatus!.distanceKm} km',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),

                    ),
                  ],

        ),

  void _showMemoryFactsSheet() {
    final addController = TextEditingController();
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (context, setModalState) {
            final memory = ConversationalMemoryService.instance;
            return SafeArea(
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.only(
                  bottom: MediaQuery.of(context).viewInsets.bottom,
                  left: 16,
                  right: 16,
                  top: 16,
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        const Icon(Icons.psychology_outlined),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        const Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            'Remembered Facts & Preferences',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 16,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: TextField(
                            controller: addController,
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              hintText: 'Add a new fact (e.g. "Favorite team is Arsenal")',
                              isDense: true,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        IconButton.filled(
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 20),
                          onPressed: () async {
                            final text = addController.text.trim();
                            if (text.isNotEmpty) {
                              await memory.addFact(text);
                              addController.clear();
                              setModalState(() {});
                              setState(() {});
                            }
                          },
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    ConstrainedBox(
                      constraints: BoxConstraints(
                        maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(context).size.height * 0.45,
                      ),
                      child: memory.facts.isEmpty
                          ? const Center(
                              child: Padding(
                                padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                                child: Text('No facts stored yet.'),
                              ),
                            )
                          : ListView.builder(
                              shrinkWrap: true,
                              itemCount: memory.facts.length,
                              itemBuilder: (context, i) {
                                final f = memory.facts[i];
                                return ListTile(
                                  dense: true,
                                  title: Text(f.fact, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
                                  subtitle: Text(
                                    '${f.category} • ${f.createdAt.toString().split('.').first}',
                                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                                  ),
                                  trailing: IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 18),
                                    onPressed: () async {
                                      await memory.deleteFact(f.id);
                                      setModalState(() {});
                                      setState(() {});
                                    },
                                  ),
                                );
                              },
                            ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _confirmWipeMemory() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Wipe All Memory?'),
        content: const Text(
          'This will permanently delete all cross-session dialogue history, learned preferences, and stored facts. This action cannot be undone.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error,
            ),
            onPressed: () async {
              Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
              await ConversationalMemoryService.instance.wipeAll();
              if (mounted) {
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  const SnackBar(content: Text('All memory wiped successfully.')),
                );
                setState(() {});
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Wipe All'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _hermesFileTile({
    required ThemeData theme,
    required String fileName,
    required String slotBadge,
    required Color badgeColor,
    required IconData icon,
    required String description,
    required String metrics,
    required String content,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    final snippet = content
        .split('\n')
        .where((l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty && !l.startsWith('#'))
        .take(2)
        .join(' ')
        .trim();

    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: theme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          border: Border.all(
            color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
            width: 0.8,
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(icon, size: 18, color: badgeColor),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  fileName,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    fontSize: 13,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1.5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    border: Border.all(color: badgeColor.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 0.6),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    slotBadge,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 9.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                      color: badgeColor,
                      letterSpacing: 0.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                Text(
                  metrics,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              description,
              style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                fontSize: 11.5,
              ),
            ),
            if (snippet.isNotEmpty) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: theme.colorScheme.surface.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  snippet,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                Text(
                  'View & Edit Markdown',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Icon(
                  Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                  size: 11,
                  color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openMarkdownEditor({
    required String fileName,
    required String title,
    required String slotBadge,
    required String initialContent,
    required Future<void> Function(String) onSave,
    required Future<void> Function() onReset,
  }) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(16)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) => _HermesMarkdownEditorSheet(
        fileName: fileName,
        title: title,
        slotBadge: slotBadge,
        initialContent: initialContent,
        onSave: onSave,
        onReset: onReset,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _confirmResetHermesAll() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Reset All Hermes Files?'),
        content: const Text(
          'This will revert SOUL.md, USER.md, and AGENT.md to their default Nous Research templates.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
            child: const Text('Cancel'),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            onPressed: () async {
              Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
              await _hermes.resetAll();
              if (mounted) {
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  const SnackBar(content: Text('All Hermes context files reset to defaults.')),
                );
                setState(() {});
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Reset All'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HermesMarkdownEditorSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final String fileName;
  final String title;
  final String slotBadge;
  final String initialContent;
  final Future<void> Function(String) onSave;
  final Future<void> Function() onReset;

  const _HermesMarkdownEditorSheet({
    required this.fileName,
    required this.title,
    required this.slotBadge,
    required this.initialContent,
    required this.onSave,
    required this.onReset,
  });

  @override
  State<_HermesMarkdownEditorSheet> createState() =>
      _HermesMarkdownEditorSheetState();
}

class _HermesMarkdownEditorSheetState
    extends State<_HermesMarkdownEditorSheet> {
  late final TextEditingController _controller;
  bool _saving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialContent);
    _controller.addListener(() => setState(() {}));
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final text = _controller.text;
    final lines = text.split('\n').length;
    final chars = text.length;

    return DefaultTabController(
      length: 2,
      child: Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          leading: IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
            onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          ),
          title: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    widget.fileName,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                      fontSize: 16,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      widget.slotBadge,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              Text(
                widget.title,
                style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(fontSize: 11),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          bottom: const TabBar(
            tabs: [
              Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.edit_note, size: 18), text: 'Edit Markdown'),
              Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.preview_outlined, size: 18), text: 'Rendered Preview'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        body: Column(
          children: [
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Text(
                    '$lines lines • $chars chars',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                      minimumSize: Size.zero,
                      tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                    ),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.restore, size: 14),
                    label: const Text('Reset File', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                    onPressed: () async {
                      await widget.onReset();
                      if (context.mounted) {
                        Navigator.of(context).pop();
                        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                          SnackBar(content: Text('Reset ${widget.fileName} to default template')),
                        );
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 1),
            Expanded(
              child: TabBarView(
                children: [
                  // Tab 1: Edit
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: TextField(
                      controller: _controller,
                      maxLines: null,
                      expands: true,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'monospace',
                        fontSize: 13,
                        height: 1.4,
                      ),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        border: InputBorder.none,
                        hintText: 'Enter markdown content...',
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  // Tab 2: Rendered Preview
                  SingleChildScrollView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    child: MarkdownBody(
                      data: text,
                      selectable: true,
                      styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet.fromTheme(theme).copyWith(
                        code: const TextStyle(fontFamily: 'monospace'),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            const Divider(height: 1),
            SafeArea(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                child: SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton.icon(
                    icon: _saving
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 16,
                            height: 16,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.save_outlined),
                    label: Text(_saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save Changes to ${widget.fileName}'),
                    onPressed: _saving
                        ? null
                        : () async {
                            setState(() => _saving = true);
                            await widget.onSave(_controller.text);
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              Navigator.of(context).pop();
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('Saved changes to ${widget.fileName}'),
                                  duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../services/permission_manager_service.dart';

/// Centralized permissions management screen for user ease:
/// Audits and requests all required permissions for Voice, SMS, Email, and Device Automation.
class PermissionsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const PermissionsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<PermissionsScreen> createState() => _PermissionsScreenState();
}

class _PermissionsScreenState extends State<PermissionsScreen>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  final _service = PermissionManagerService.instance;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _service.refresh();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      _service.refresh();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('App Permissions'),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Refresh',
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
            onPressed: () => _service.refresh(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: ListenableBuilder(
        listenable: _service,
        builder: (context, _) {
          if (_service.isLoading) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final granted = _service.grantedCount;
          final total = _service.totalCount;
          final ratio = total == 0 ? 0.0 : granted / total;

          return ListView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 36),
            children: [
              // Summary Hub Card
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            child: Icon(
                              Icons.security_rounded,
                              color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                              size: 24,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 14),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  '$granted of $total Permissions Active',
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 16,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                Text(
                                  granted == total
                                      ? 'All systems fully authorized for autonomous operation.'
                                      : 'Some capabilities require user permission to function.',
                                  style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                                    color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                          value: ratio,
                          minHeight: 6,
                          backgroundColor: theme.colorScheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
                          valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(
                            ratio == 1.0 ? Colors.green : theme.colorScheme.primary,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: FilledButton.icon(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.done_all_rounded, size: 18),
                              label: const Text('Grant Core Permissions'),
                              onPressed: () async {
                                await _service.requestAllCorePermissions();
                                if (context.mounted) {
                                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                    const SnackBar(
                                      content: Text('Permissions requested'),
                                      duration: Duration(seconds: 2),
                                    ),
                                  );
                                }
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),

              // Permissions List
              _sectionTitle('Communications & Inboxes'),
              for (final p in _service.permissions.where(
                (p) =>
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.sms ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.notificationListener ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.contacts ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.notifications,
              )) ...[
                _permissionCard(theme, p),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
              ],

              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _sectionTitle('Core Voice & Automation'),
              for (final p in _service.permissions.where(
                (p) =>
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.microphone ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.accessibility ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.overlay ||
                    p.type == AppPermissionType.batteryOptimization,
              )) ...[
                _permissionCard(theme, p),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
              ],

              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined, size: 18),
                label: const Text('Open System App Settings'),
                onPressed: () => _service.openAppInfo(),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _sectionTitle(String text) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 0, 4, 8),
        child: Text(
          text.toUpperCase(),
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 11.5,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
            letterSpacing: 1.1,
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
          ),
        ),
      );

  Widget _permissionCard(ThemeData theme, AppPermissionInfo p) {
    return Card(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: p.isGranted
                    ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                    : theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
              ),
              child: Icon(
                p.icon,
                size: 20,
                color: p.isGranted ? Colors.green : theme.colorScheme.primary,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          p.title,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: p.isGranted
                              ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                              : Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: p.isGranted
                                ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.4)
                                : Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                            width: 0.6,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          p.isGranted ? 'GRANTED' : (p.isSystemSettingsOnly ? 'CONFIGURE' : 'REQUIRED'),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 9.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                            letterSpacing: 0.5,
                            color: p.isGranted ? Colors.green : Colors.amber.shade900,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(
                    p.description,
                    style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (!p.isGranted) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                      child: TextButton.icon(
                        style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                          minimumSize: Size.zero,
                          tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                        ),
                        icon: Icon(
                          p.isSystemSettingsOnly
                              ? Icons.open_in_new_rounded
                              : Icons.check_circle_outline,
                          size: 14,
                        ),
                        label: Text(
                          p.isSystemSettingsOnly ? 'Open Settings' : 'Grant Permission',
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                        ),
                        onPressed: () async {
                          await _service.requestPermission(p.type);
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../services/personality_service.dart';
import '../../services/settings_service.dart';
import '../../services/telegram_service.dart';
import '../../widgets/glass_widgets.dart';
import 'jarvis_settings_screen.dart';
import 'permissions_screen.dart';

/// Next-Generation Liquid Glass Settings Screen.
/// Clean, executive grouped hierarchy with frosted glass translucency and modern controls.
class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  final _settings = SettingsService.instance;
  final _telegram = TelegramService.instance;

  late final TextEditingController _baseUrlController;
  late final TextEditingController _apiKeyController;
  late final TextEditingController _modelController;
  late final TextEditingController _tokenController;
  late final TextEditingController _chatsController;

  bool _obscureKey = true;
  bool _obscureToken = true;

  String _lastSyncedProvider = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _baseUrlController = TextEditingController(text: _settings.baseUrl);
    _apiKeyController = TextEditingController(text: _settings.apiKey);
    _modelController = TextEditingController(text: _settings.model);
    _tokenController = TextEditingController(text: _settings.telegramToken);
    _chatsController =
        TextEditingController(text: _settings.telegramAllowedChats.join(', '));
    _lastSyncedProvider = _settings.provider;

    PersonalityService.instance.init().then((_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    });

    for (final c in [
      _baseUrlController,
      _apiKeyController,
      _modelController,
    ]) {
      c.addListener(_onAiFieldChanged);
    }
    for (final c in [
      _tokenController,
      _chatsController,
    ]) {
      c.addListener(_onTelegramFieldChanged);
    }
    _settings.addListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _telegram.addListener(_onTelegramChanged);
    PersonalityService.instance.addListener(_onServiceChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _settings.removeListener(_onSettingsChanged);
    _telegram.removeListener(_onTelegramChanged);
    PersonalityService.instance.removeListener(_onServiceChanged);
    for (final c in [
      _baseUrlController,
      _apiKeyController,
      _modelController,
    ]) {
      c.removeListener(_onAiFieldChanged);
    }
    for (final c in [
      _tokenController,
      _chatsController,
    ]) {
      c.removeListener(_onTelegramFieldChanged);
    }
    _baseUrlController.dispose();
    _apiKeyController.dispose();
    _modelController.dispose();
    _tokenController.dispose();
    _chatsController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onSettingsChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_settings.provider != _lastSyncedProvider) {
      _lastSyncedProvider = _settings.provider;
      _baseUrlController.text = _settings.baseUrl;
      _modelController.text = _settings.model;
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  void _onTelegramChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onServiceChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onAiFieldChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onTelegramFieldChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  bool get _aiDirty =>
      _baseUrlController.text.trim() != _settings.baseUrl ||
      _apiKeyController.text.trim() != _settings.apiKey ||
      _modelController.text.trim() != _settings.model;

  bool get _telegramDirty =>
      _tokenController.text.trim() != _settings.telegramToken ||
      _chatsController.text.trim() != _settings.telegramAllowedChats.join(', ');

  Future<void> _saveTelegramSettings() async {
    await _settings.setTelegramToken(_tokenController.text.trim());
    await _settings.setTelegramAllowedChats(
      _chatsController.text
          .split(RegExp(r'[,\s]+'))
          .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty)
          .toList(),
    );
    if (_settings.telegramEnabled) {
      await _telegram.restart();
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {});
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: const Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, color: Colors.greenAccent, size: 20),
              SizedBox(width: 10),
              Text('Telegram configuration saved & reloaded'),
            ],
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        ),
      );
  }

  Future<void> _saveAiSettings() async {
    await _settings.setBaseUrl(_baseUrlController.text);
    await _settings.setApiKey(_apiKeyController.text);
    await _settings.setModel(_modelController.text);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() {});
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: const Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.check_circle_outline, color: Colors.greenAccent, size: 20),
              SizedBox(width: 10),
              Text('AI provider settings saved successfully'),
            ],
          ),
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        ),
      );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      extendBodyBehindAppBar: true,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Settings',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, letterSpacing: 0.3),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        elevation: 0,
        flexibleSpace: ClipRect(
          child: BackdropFilter(
            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 16, sigmaY: 16),
            child: Container(
              color: Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark
                  ? const Color(0x60090E17)
                  : const Color(0x60F1F5F9),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          // Ambient background glow
          Positioned(
            top: 40,
            right: -40,
            child: Container(
              width: 250,
              height: 250,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                gradient: RadialGradient(
                  colors: [
                    const Color(0xFF6366F1).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                    Colors.transparent,
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            bottom: 100,
            left: -50,
            child: Container(
              width: 280,
              height: 280,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                gradient: RadialGradient(
                  colors: [
                    const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                    Colors.transparent,
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SafeArea(
            child: ListView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 40),
              children: [
                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.psychology_rounded,
                  title: 'AI Intelligence Engine',
                  color: const Color(0xFF818CF8),
                ),
                _aiProviderCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),

                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.shield_rounded,
                  title: 'Autonomous J.A.R.V.I.S. Core',
                  color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                ),
                _jarvisCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),

                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.security_rounded,
                  title: 'Permissions & Telemetry Inboxes',
                  color: const Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                ),
                _permissionsCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),

                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.smart_toy_rounded,
                  title: 'Device Automation Agent',
                  color: const Color(0xFFA78BFA),
                ),
                _agentCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),

                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  title: 'Telegram Remote Bridge',
                  color: const Color(0xFF0EA5E9),
                ),
                _telegramCard(),
                const SizedBox(height: 22),

                _sectionHeader(
                  icon: Icons.palette_outlined,
                  title: 'Appearance & Visual Theme',
                  color: const Color(0xFFF472B6),

                _appearanceCard(),
              ],

        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _sectionHeader({

  Widget _appearanceCard() {

              Expanded(

                  mode: ThemeMode.light,
                  label: 'Light',
                  icon: Icons.light_mode_rounded,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: _themeOption(

  Widget _themeOption({
    required ThemeMode mode,
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    final isSelected = _settings.themeMode == mode;
    final theme = Theme.of(context);

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _settings.setThemeMode(mode),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.20)
              : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected
                ? theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
            width: isSelected ? 1.4 : 1.0,
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              size: 20,
              color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isSelected ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
