import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'edge_tts_service.dart';

/// ⚡ Arc Reactor Charging Telemetry Service
///
/// Monitors power cell coupling, real-time charging wattage, thermal stability,
/// voltage, and battery percentage. Automatically triggers holographic Arc Reactor
/// HUD visuals and vocal Stark telemetry upon charger connection.
class ChargingTelemetryService extends ChangeNotifier {
  ChargingTelemetryService._();

  static final ChargingTelemetryService instance = ChargingTelemetryService._();
  static const MethodChannel _channel = MethodChannel('com.privateagent/accessibility');

  bool _isCharging = false;
  int _batteryLevel = -1;
  int _voltageMv = 0;
  double _temperatureC = 0.0;
  int _currentMa = 0;
  double _wattage = 0.0;
  String _chargeType = 'Internal Core';
  DateTime? _lastCoupledTime;
  bool _voiceAnnouncements = true;

  final ValueNotifier<bool> showCinematicHud = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

  bool get isCharging => _isCharging;
  int get batteryLevel => _batteryLevel;
  int get voltageMv => _voltageMv;
  double get temperatureC => _temperatureC;
  int get currentMa => _currentMa;
  double get wattage => _wattage;
  String get chargeType => _chargeType;
  DateTime? get lastCoupledTime => _lastCoupledTime;
  bool get voiceAnnouncements => _voiceAnnouncements;

  set voiceAnnouncements(bool val) {
    _voiceAnnouncements = val;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Handles native charging events dispatched by [NativeBridgeService].
  Future<void> handleNativeCall(MethodCall call) async {
    if (call.method == 'onPowerConnected') {
      final args = call.arguments;
      if (args is Map) {
        _applyTelemetryMap(args, connected: true);
      }
    } else if (call.method == 'onPowerDisconnected') {
      final args = call.arguments;
      if (args is Map) {
        _applyTelemetryMap(args, connected: false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _applyTelemetryMap(Map data, {required bool connected}) {
    _isCharging = connected;
    _batteryLevel = (data['batteryLevel'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? _batteryLevel;
    _voltageMv = (data['voltageMv'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 4100;
    _temperatureC = (data['temperatureC'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 30.0;
    _currentMa = (data['currentMa'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 2500;
    _chargeType = (data['chargeType'] ?? (connected ? 'AC Wall Supply' : 'Internal Arc Core')).toString();
    _wattage = (data['wattage'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? (_voltageMv / 1000.0 * 2.5);

    if (connected) {
      _lastCoupledTime = DateTime.now();
      showCinematicHud.value = true;
      if (_voiceAnnouncements) {
        final wattStr = _wattage > 0 ? '${_wattage.toStringAsFixed(1)} Watts' : 'nominal levels';
        final tempStr = _temperatureC > 0 ? ', core temperature at ${_temperatureC.toStringAsFixed(1)}° Celsius' : '';
        unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(
          'Arc reactor coupled, sir. Energy intake active at $wattStr. Power cells at $_batteryLevel percent$tempStr.',
        ));
      }
    } else {
      if (_voiceAnnouncements) {
        unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(
          'Arc reactor decoupled, sir. System running on internal reserves at $_batteryLevel percent power.',
        ));
      }
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Pulls instantaneous telemetry snapshot from native hardware.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> queryTelemetry() async {
    try {
      final res = await _channel.invokeMapMethod<String, dynamic>('getChargingTelemetry');
      if (res != null) {
        _applyTelemetryMap(res, connected: res['isCharging'] == true);
        return res;
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return {
      'isCharging': _isCharging,
      'batteryLevel': _batteryLevel,
      'voltageMv': _voltageMv,
      'temperatureC': _temperatureC,
      'currentMa': _currentMa,
      'chargeType': _chargeType,
      'wattage': _wattage,
    };
  }

  /// Returns articulate spoken telemetry diagnostic.
  Future<String> getSpokenTelemetry() async {
    final t = await queryTelemetry();
    final lvl = t['batteryLevel'] ?? 85;
    final chg = t['isCharging'] == true;
    final watt = (t['wattage'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 18.0;
    final temp = (t['temperatureC'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 31.0;
    final type = t['chargeType'] ?? 'Turbine Supply';

    if (chg) {
      return 'Arc reactor telemetry, sir: Coupled to $type. Energy flow rate is ${watt.toStringAsFixed(1)} Watts. Current core storage stands at $lvl%, with thermals steady at ${temp.toStringAsFixed(1)}°C.';
    } else {
      return 'Arc reactor core operational on internal storage at $lvl%, sir. Thermals stable at ${temp.toStringAsFixed(1)}°C. No external charging grid detected.';
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../app.dart';
import '../screens/security/code_black_screen.dart';
import 'edge_tts_service.dart';

/// 🎭 "Code Black" — Deceptive Hardware Lockout & Anti-Prying Service
///
/// Simulates a catastrophic hardware failure / military kernel panic screen
/// to prevent snooping friends or unauthorized individuals from touching the phone.
/// Can be disarmed only via a secret voice override passphrase or hidden 4-tap corner sequence.
class CodeBlackService extends ChangeNotifier {
  CodeBlackService._();
  static final CodeBlackService instance = CodeBlackService._();

  bool _isArmed = false;
  int _breachAttemptCount = 0;
  DateTime? _activatedAt;

  static const List<String> disarmPassphrases = [
    'override alpha',
    'stand down jarvis',
    'stand down',
    'abuzar protocol',
    'jarvis override',
    'alpha protocol',
    'disarm',
    'cancel lockdown',
    'stop code black',
    'emergency override',
    'abuzar',
    'unlock',
  ];

  bool get isArmed => _isArmed;
  int get breachAttemptCount => _breachAttemptCount;
  DateTime? get activatedAt => _activatedAt;

  /// Arms Code Black deceptive lockdown and displays the panic interface.
  Future<void> arm() async {
    if (_isArmed) return;
    _isArmed = true;
    _breachAttemptCount = 0;
    _activatedAt = DateTime.now();
    notifyListeners();
    HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();

    final navState = PrivateAgentApp.navigatorKey.currentState;
    if (navState != null) {
      unawaited(navState.push(
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const CodeBlackScreen()),
      ));
    }

    unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(
      'Code Black initiated. Hardware isolation engaged. Say Override Alpha or tap emergency override to disarm.',
    ));
  }

  /// Disarms Code Black.
  Future<void> disarm() async {
    if (!_isArmed) return;
    _isArmed = false;
    _breachAttemptCount = 0;
    notifyListeners();
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();

    unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(
      'Code Black disarmed. Biometrics verified. Welcome back, sir.',
    ));
  }

  /// Increments breach counter and emits alarming haptics when intruder touches screen.
  void recordIntruderTouch() {
    _breachAttemptCount++;
    notifyListeners();
    HapticFeedback.vibrate();
  }

  /// Checks if spoken phrase contains secret disarm passphrase.
  bool checkVoiceDisarm(String spokenText) {
    final lower = spokenText.toLowerCase();
    for (final pass in disarmPassphrases) {
      if (lower.contains(pass)) {
        disarm();
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import 'calendar_reminder_service.dart';
import 'settings_service.dart';

/// Traffic congestion severity level.
enum TrafficSeverity { clear, moderate, heavy }

/// Representation of a commute route and proactive traffic warning.
class CommuteStatus {
  final String origin;
  final String destination;
  final int durationMinutes;
  final double distanceKm;
  final TrafficSeverity trafficSeverity;
  final DateTime? meetingTime;
  final DateTime? recommendedDepartureTime;
  final String spokenSummary;
  final bool isUrgent;

  const CommuteStatus({
    required this.origin,
    required this.destination,
    required this.durationMinutes,
    required this.distanceKm,
    required this.trafficSeverity,
    this.meetingTime,
    this.recommendedDepartureTime,
    required this.spokenSummary,
    this.isUrgent = false,
  });

  String get severityLabel {
    switch (trafficSeverity) {
      case TrafficSeverity.clear:
        return 'Light Traffic (Nominal)';
      case TrafficSeverity.moderate:
        return 'Moderate Congestion (+5m)';
      case TrafficSeverity.heavy:
        return 'Heavy Traffic Delay (+15m)';
    }
  }
}

/// 🗺️ Proactive Commute & Real-Time Traffic Warnings
///
/// Computes drive times, evaluates peak-hour congestion telemetry,
/// checks upcoming calendar meetings, and proactively calculates
/// exact departure times so the operator is never late.
class CommuteTrafficService extends ChangeNotifier {
  CommuteTrafficService._();
  static final CommuteTrafficService instance = CommuteTrafficService._();

  final http.Client _client = http.Client();

  CommuteStatus? _lastStatus;
  CommuteStatus? get lastStatus => _lastStatus;

  bool _isChecking = false;
  bool get isChecking => _isChecking;

  /// Calculates commute time between [origin] and [destination] via OSRM / OpenStreetMap.
  Future<CommuteStatus> checkCommute({
    String? origin,
    String? destination,
    DateTime? targetArrivalTime,
    String? meetingTitle,
  }) async {
    final settings = SettingsService.instance;
    final start = origin?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? origin!
        : settings.commuteHomeAddress;
    final end = destination?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
        ? destination!
        : settings.commuteWorkAddress;

    _isChecking = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      // 1. Geocode locations (or use fast estimates if offline)
      final startCoords = await _geocode(start);
      final endCoords = await _geocode(end);

      int durationSec = 1200; // 20 minutes default
      double distanceMeters = 10000; // 10 km default

      if (startCoords != null && endCoords != null) {
        final osrmUri = Uri.parse(
          'https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/${startCoords.lon},${startCoords.lat};${endCoords.lon},${endCoords.lat}?overview=false',
        );

        final res = await _client.get(osrmUri).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
        if (res.statusCode == 200) {
          final data = jsonDecode(res.body);
          final routes = data['routes'] as List?;
          if (routes != null && routes.isNotEmpty) {
            durationSec = ((routes[0]['duration'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 1200);
            distanceMeters = ((routes[0]['distance'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 10000);
          }
        }
      }

      // 2. Assess rush hour traffic multipliers
      final now = DateTime.now();
      final isRushHour = (now.hour >= 8 && now.hour <= 10) || (now.hour >= 17 && now.hour <= 19);
      final isModerateHour = (now.hour >= 11 && now.hour <= 16);

      TrafficSeverity severity = TrafficSeverity.clear;
      double multiplier = 1.0;

      if (isRushHour) {
        severity = TrafficSeverity.heavy;
        multiplier = 1.35;
      } else if (isModerateHour) {
        severity = TrafficSeverity.moderate;
        multiplier = 1.15;
      }

      final adjustedMinutes = ((durationSec * multiplier) / 60).round();
      final distKm = double.parse((distanceMeters / 1000).toStringAsFixed(1));

      // 3. Compute Recommended Departure Time if meeting time is provided
      DateTime? departureTime;
      bool isUrgent = false;

      if (targetArrivalTime != null) {
        // Buffer: 10 minutes parking/prep buffer
        departureTime = targetArrivalTime.subtract(Duration(minutes: adjustedMinutes + 10));
        final diffMinutes = departureTime.difference(now).inMinutes;
        isUrgent = diffMinutes <= 15;
      }

      String spoken;
      final timeFmt = DateFormat('h:mm a');

      if (targetArrivalTime != null && departureTime != null) {
        final depStr = timeFmt.format(departureTime);
        final meetStr = timeFmt.format(targetArrivalTime);
        final title = meetingTitle ?? 'your appointment';

        spoken = 'Sir, your scheduled event "$title" is at $meetStr. Travel time to $end is estimated at $adjustedMinutes minutes with ${severity.name} traffic conditions. I advise departing by $depStr.';
        if (isUrgent) {
          spoken += ' That gives you approximately ${departureTime.difference(now).inMinutes.clamp(1, 15)} minutes before departure.';
        }
      } else {
        spoken = 'The commute from $start to $end is approximately $distKm kilometers, taking about $adjustedMinutes minutes with ${severity.name} traffic, sir.';
      }

      final status = CommuteStatus(
        origin: start,
        destination: end,
        durationMinutes: adjustedMinutes,
        distanceKm: distKm,
        trafficSeverity: severity,
        meetingTime: targetArrivalTime,
        recommendedDepartureTime: departureTime,
        spokenSummary: spoken,
        isUrgent: isUrgent,
      );

      _lastStatus = status;
      _isChecking = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return status;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[CommuteTrafficService] Commute check error: $e');
      _isChecking = false;
      // Graceful offline fallback
      final status = CommuteStatus(
        origin: start,
        destination: end,
        durationMinutes: 24,
        distanceKm: 12.5,
        trafficSeverity: TrafficSeverity.clear,
        spokenSummary: 'Commute to $end is estimated at 24 minutes under nominal traffic conditions, sir.',
      );
      _lastStatus = status;
      notifyListeners();
      return status;
    }
  }

  /// Scans upcoming calendar events in the next 3 hours for proactive meeting commute warnings.
  Future<CommuteStatus?> checkUpcomingMeetingCommute() async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final calendar = CalendarReminderService.instance;
    final upcoming = calendar.items.where((item) {
      final diff = item.dateTime.difference(now);
      return diff.inMinutes > 0 && diff.inMinutes <= 180;
    }).toList();

    if (upcoming.isEmpty) return null;

    final nextEvent = upcoming.first;
    var dest = SettingsService.instance.commuteWorkAddress;
    if (nextEvent.location != null && nextEvent.location!.isNotEmpty) {
      dest = nextEvent.location!;
    }

    return checkCommute(
      destination: dest,
      targetArrivalTime: nextEvent.dateTime,
      meetingTitle: nextEvent.title,
    );
  }

  /// Geocoding helper via OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
  Future<({double lat, double lon})?> _geocode(String query) async {
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse(
        'https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=${Uri.encodeComponent(query)}&format=json&limit=1',
      );
      final res = await _client.get(
        uri,
        headers: {'User-Agent': 'PrivateAgent-Jarvis/1.0'},
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));

      if (res.statusCode == 200) {
        final list = jsonDecode(res.body) as List?;
        if (list != null && list.isNotEmpty) {
          final lat = double.tryParse(list[0]['lat']?.toString() ?? '');
          final lon = double.tryParse(list[0]['lon']?.toString() ?? '');
          if (lat != null && lon != null) {
            return (lat: lat, lon: lon);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'hermes_evolution_service.dart';

/// A remembered fact or user preference that persists across sessions.
class MemoryFact {
  final String id;
  final String fact;
  final String category; // 'preference', 'personal', 'work', 'habit'
  final DateTime createdAt;

  const MemoryFact({
    required this.id,
    required this.fact,
    this.category = 'personal',
    required this.createdAt,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'fact': fact,
        'category': category,
        'createdAt': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
      };

  factory MemoryFact.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => MemoryFact(
        id: json['id'] as String? ?? UniqueKey().toString(),
        fact: json['fact'] as String? ?? '',
        category: json['category'] as String? ?? 'personal',
        createdAt: json['createdAt'] != null
            ? DateTime.tryParse(json['createdAt'].toString()) ?? DateTime.now()
            : DateTime.now(),
      );
}

/// Persistent memory service:
/// 1. Remembers short-term conversation context across app restarts.
/// 2. Remembers long-term user facts, preferences, and habits.
/// 3. Injects user memory into AI system prompts.
/// 4. Provides full privacy controls (view, delete individually, wipe all).
class ConversationalMemoryService extends ChangeNotifier {
  ConversationalMemoryService._();
  static final ConversationalMemoryService instance =
      ConversationalMemoryService._();

  static const _factsKey = 'jarvis_memory_facts_v1';
  static const _historyKey = 'jarvis_memory_history_v1';
  static const _maxHistoryMessages = 20;

  final List<MemoryFact> _facts = [];
  final List<Map<String, String>> _persistedHistory = [];
  bool _initialized = false;

  List<MemoryFact> get facts => List.unmodifiable(_facts);
  List<Map<String, String>> get persistedHistory =>
      List.unmodifiable(_persistedHistory);

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    // 1. Load long-term facts
    final factsRaw = prefs.getString(_factsKey);
    if (factsRaw != null && factsRaw.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(factsRaw);
        if (decoded is List) {
          _facts.clear();
          for (final item in decoded) {
            if (item is Map) {
              _facts.add(
                MemoryFact.fromJson(item.map((k, v) => MapEntry('$k', v))),
              );
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. Load short-term history across sessions
    final historyRaw = prefs.getString(_historyKey);
    if (historyRaw != null && historyRaw.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(historyRaw);
        if (decoded is List) {
          _persistedHistory.clear();
          for (final item in decoded) {
            if (item is Map) {
              _persistedHistory.add({
                'role': item['role']?.toString() ?? 'user',
                'content': item['content']?.toString() ?? '',
              });
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _persistFacts() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _factsKey,
      jsonEncode(_facts.map((f) => f.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _persistHistory() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _historyKey,
      jsonEncode(_persistedHistory),
    );
  }

  /// Adds a short-term message pair to cross-session memory.
  Future<void> recordTurn(String userText, String assistantText) async {
    await init();
    _persistedHistory.add({'role': 'user', 'content': userText.trim()});
    _persistedHistory.add({'role': 'assistant', 'content': assistantText.trim()});
    if (_persistedHistory.length > _maxHistoryMessages) {
      _persistedHistory.removeRange(
        0,
        _persistedHistory.length - _maxHistoryMessages,
      );
    }
    await _persistHistory();

    // Check if user explicitly asked to remember something
    await extractAndSaveImplicitFacts(userText);
  }

  /// Extracts "Remember that...", "My favorite ... is ...", etc.
  Future<void> extractAndSaveImplicitFacts(String text) async {
    final lower = text.toLowerCase().trim();
    String? fact;
    String category = 'personal';

    if (lower.startsWith('remember that ') || lower.startsWith('remember ')) {
      fact = text.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'remember\s+(that\s+)?', caseSensitive: false), '').trim();
    } else if (lower.startsWith('note that ') || lower.startsWith('keep in mind that ')) {
      fact = text.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'(note|keep in mind)\s+that\s+', caseSensitive: false), '').trim();
    } else if (lower.contains('my favorite ') && lower.contains(' is ')) {
      fact = text.trim();
      category = 'preference';
    } else if (lower.contains('my name is ') || lower.contains('i live in ') || lower.contains('my email is ')) {
      fact = text.trim();
      category = 'personal';
    }

    if (fact != null && fact.isNotEmpty && fact.length >= 3) {
      await addFact(fact, category: category);
    }
  }

  /// Saves a persistent fact into long-term memory.
  Future<MemoryFact> addFact(String fact, {String category = 'personal'}) async {
    await init();
    final clean = fact.trim();
    // Avoid exact duplicates
    final existingIndex = _facts.indexWhere(
      (f) => f.fact.toLowerCase() == clean.toLowerCase(),
    );
    if (existingIndex >= 0) {
      return _facts[existingIndex];
    }

    final newFact = MemoryFact(
      id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      fact: clean,
      category: category,
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
    );
    _facts.insert(0, newFact);
    await _persistFacts();
    try {
      HermesEvolutionService.instance.evolveContext().catchError((_) {});
    } catch (_) {}
    return newFact;
  }

  /// Removes an individual fact from memory.
  Future<void> deleteFact(String id) async {
    await init();
    _facts.removeWhere((f) => f.id == id);
    await _persistFacts();
    try {
      HermesEvolutionService.instance.evolveContext().catchError((_) {});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Privacy: Clears all stored long-term facts.
  Future<void> clearAllFacts() async {
    await init();
    _facts.clear();
    await _persistFacts();
  }

  /// Privacy: Clears conversation session history.
  Future<void> clearAllHistory() async {
    await init();
    _persistedHistory.clear();
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_historyKey);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Privacy: Complete wipe of all conversational memory.
  Future<void> wipeAll() async {
    await clearAllFacts();
    await clearAllHistory();
  }

  /// Builds context string of remembered facts to inject into AI system prompt.
  String buildMemoryContext() {
    if (_facts.isEmpty) return '';
    final buffer = StringBuffer('USER MEMORY & PREFERENCES:\n');
    for (final f in _facts.take(12)) {
      buffer.writeln('- ${f.fact}');
    }
    return buffer.toString().trim();
  }
}

  static const int _cs64Adjustment1 = 0x0B1A0000;

  bool _isSpeaking = false;
  bool get isSpeaking => _isSpeaking;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DRM Sec-MS-GEC v2 Cryptographic Implementation
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  static int _rol16(int value) {
    final v = value & _u32Mask;
    return (((v << 16) | (v >>> 16)) & _u32Mask);
  }

  static List<int> _wordsLe4Even(Uint8List data) {
    final padLen = (4 - (data.length % 4)) % 4;
    final padded = Uint8List(data.length + padLen);
    padded.setRange(0, data.length, data);
    final words = <int>[];
    final bd = ByteData.sublistView(padded);
    for (var i = 0; i < padded.length; i += 4) {
      words.add(bd.getUint32(i, Endian.little));
    }
    if (words.length % 2 != 0) {
      words.add(0);
    }
    return words;
  }

  static int _sigma0(int value) {
    final v = value & _u32Mask;
    return (((v >>> 7) ^
            ((v << 25) & _u32Mask) ^
            (v >>> 18) ^
            ((v << 14) & _u32Mask) ^
            (v >>> 3)) &
        _u32Mask);
  }

  static int _sigma1(int value) {
    final v = value & _u32Mask;
    return (((v >>> 17) ^
            ((v << 15) & _u32Mask) ^
            (v >>> 19) ^
            ((v << 13) & _u32Mask) ^
            (v >>> 10)) &
        _u32Mask);
  }

  static List<int> _sha256Rounds(List<int> state, List<int> words,
      [int firstRound = 0]) {
    var a = state[0];
    var b = state[1];
    var c = state[2];
    var d = state[3];
    var e = state[4];
    var f = state[5];
    var g = state[6];
    var h = state[7];

    final constants =
        (firstRound == 14) ? _sha256BlockConstants : _sha256RoundConstants;
    final aligned = (firstRound == 14) ? 16 : 0;

    for (var index = firstRound; index < aligned; index++) {
      final rotE = e * 0x100000001;
      final rotA = a * 0x100000001;
      final t1 = (h +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (g ^ (e & (f ^ g))) +
              constants[index] +
              words[index]) &
          _u32Mask;
      final t2 = (((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((a & b) | (c & (a | b)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      h = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) & _u32Mask;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) & _u32Mask;
    }

    for (var index = aligned; index < 64; index += 8) {
      // 0
      var rotE = e * 0x100000001;
      var rotA = a * 0x100000001;
      var t1 = (h +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (g ^ (e & (f ^ g))) +
              constants[index] +
              words[index]) &
          _u32Mask;
      d = (d + t1) & _u32Mask;
      h = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((a & b) | (c & (a | b)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 1
      rotE = d * 0x100000001;
      rotA = h * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (g +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (f ^ (d & (e ^ f))) +
              constants[index + 1] +
              words[index + 1]) &
          _u32Mask;
      c = (c + t1) & _u32Mask;
      g = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((h & a) | (b & (h | a)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 2
      rotE = c * 0x100000001;
      rotA = g * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (f +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (e ^ (c & (d ^ e))) +
              constants[index + 2] +
              words[index + 2]) &
          _u32Mask;
      b = (b + t1) & _u32Mask;
      f = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((g & h) | (a & (g | h)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 3
      rotE = b * 0x100000001;
      rotA = f * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (e +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (d ^ (b & (c ^ d))) +
              constants[index + 3] +
              words[index + 3]) &
          _u32Mask;
      a = (a + t1) & _u32Mask;
      e = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((f & g) | (h & (f | g)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 4
      rotE = a * 0x100000001;
      rotA = e * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (d +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (c ^ (a & (b ^ c))) +
              constants[index + 4] +
              words[index + 4]) &
          _u32Mask;
      h = (h + t1) & _u32Mask;
      d = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((e & f) | (g & (e | f)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 5
      rotE = h * 0x100000001;
      rotA = d * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (c +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (b ^ (h & (a ^ b))) +
              constants[index + 5] +
              words[index + 5]) &
          _u32Mask;
      g = (g + t1) & _u32Mask;
      c = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((d & e) | (f & (d | e)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 6
      rotE = g * 0x100000001;
      rotA = c * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (b +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (a ^ (g & (h ^ a))) +
              constants[index + 6] +
              words[index + 6]) &
          _u32Mask;
      f = (f + t1) & _u32Mask;
      b = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((c & d) | (e & (c | d)))) &
          _u32Mask;
      // 7
      rotE = f * 0x100000001;
      rotA = b * 0x100000001;
      t1 = (a +
              ((rotE >>> 6) ^ (rotE >>> 11) ^ (rotE >>> 25)) +
              (h ^ (f & (g ^ h))) +
              constants[index + 7] +
              words[index + 7]) &
          _u32Mask;
      e = (e + t1) & _u32Mask;
      a = (t1 +
              ((rotA >>> 2) ^ (rotA >>> 13) ^ (rotA >>> 22)) +
              ((b & c) | (d & (b | c)))) &
          _u32Mask;
    }

    return [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h];
  }

  static void _expandSha256Schedule(List<int> words, [int firstWord = 16]) {
    for (var index = firstWord; index < 64; index++) {
      final x = words[index - 2];
      final y = words[index - 15];
      final s1 = _sigma1(x);
      final s0 = _sigma0(y);
      words.add((s1 + words[index - 7] + s0 + words[index - 16]) & _u32Mask);
    }
  }

  static List<int> _sha256Init(Uint8List data) {
    final words = List<int>.filled(14, 0, growable: true);
    final bd = ByteData.sublistView(data);
    words.add((data[0] << 16) | (data[1] << 8) | data[2]);
    words.add(bd.getUint32(3, Endian.big));

    for (var index = 16; index < 30; index++) {
      var value = _sha256Schedule[index - 16];
      if (index - 2 >= 14) {
        value += (index == 16)
            ? (_sigma1(words[index - 2]) ^ _sha256Sigma1Adjustment)
            : _sigma1(words[index - 2]);
      }
      if (index - 7 >= 14) {
        value += words[index - 7];
      }
      if (index - 15 >= 14) {
        value += (index == 29)
            ? (_sigma0(words[index - 15]) ^ _sha256Sigma0Adjustment)
            : _sigma0(words[index - 15]);
      }
      words.add(value & _u32Mask);
    }

    words.add((_sigma1(words[28]) +
            words[23] +
            _sigma0(words[15]) +
            words[14] +
            _sha256Adjustment -
            _sha256RoundConstants[14]) &
        _u32Mask);

    _expandSha256Schedule(words, 31);
    final working = _sha256Rounds(_sha256State, words, 14);
    return List<int>.generate(
        8, (i) => (_sha256Initial[i] + working[i]) & _u32Mask);
  }

  static Uint8List _sha256Digest(Uint8List data) {
    final length = 57 + data.length;
    final padCount = ((55 - length) % 64 + 64) % 64;
    final tail = data.sublist(7);
    final padded = Uint8List(tail.length + 1 + padCount + 8);
    padded.setRange(0, tail.length, tail);
    padded[tail.length] = 0x80;
    final bd = ByteData.sublistView(padded);
    bd.setUint64(padded.length - 8, length * 8, Endian.big);

    var state = _sha256Init(data.sublist(0, 7));
    for (var offset = 0; offset < padded.length; offset += 64) {
      final words = <int>[];
      for (var i = 0; i < 64; i += 4) {
        words.add(bd.getUint32(offset + i, Endian.big));
      }
      _expandSha256Schedule(words);
      final working = _sha256Rounds(state, words);
      state = List<int>.generate(8, (i) => (state[i] + working[i]) & _u32Mask);
    }

    final out = Uint8List(32);
    final outBd = ByteData.sublistView(out);
    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      outBd.setUint32(i * 4, state[i], Endian.big);
    }
    return out;
  }

  static List<int> _cs64Digest(Uint8List data, Uint8List digest) {
    final bdDigest = ByteData.sublistView(digest);
    var keyA = bdDigest.getUint32(0, Endian.little) | 1;
    var keyB = bdDigest.getUint32(4, Endian.little) | 1;

    final factors = [
      (keyA * _cs64Factor) & _u32Mask,
      (keyB * _cs64Factor) & _u32Mask,
    ];

    final terms = <int>[];
    final offsets = <int>[];
    for (var i = 0; i < _cs64Coefficients.length; i++) {
      final coeff = _cs64Coefficients[i][0];
      final off = _cs64Coefficients[i][1];
      terms.add((coeff * factors[i % 2]) & _u32Mask);
      offsets.add(off);
    }

    final prefixedData = Uint8List(data.length + 1);
    prefixedData[0] = 0;
    prefixedData.setRange(1, prefixedData.length, data);

    final words = _wordsLe4Even(prefixedData);
    for (var index = 0; index < words.length; index++) {
      final word = words[index];
      var term = word * (index % 2 == 0 ? keyA : keyB);
      var offset = _rol16(word) * (index % 2 == 0 ? 0xEF0569FB : 0xC31713DB);
      if (index == 0) {
        term += _cs64Adjustment0 * factors[0];
        offset += _cs64Adjustment1;
      }
      terms.add(term & _u32Mask);
      offsets.add(offset & _u32Mask);
    }

    var swapAcc = 0;
    var swapLast = 0;
    var state = 0;
    var acc = 0;

    for (var index = 0; index < terms.length; index += 2) {
      final x = terms[index];
      final y = terms[index + 1];
      var t = _rol16((offsets[index] + x) & _u32Mask);
      var q = (t * 0x76F50F34) & _u32Mask;
      swapAcc = (swapAcc + (_rol16(q) * 0xC3EFEA97 + q)) & _u32Mask;

      t = _rol16((offsets[index + 1] + y) & _u32Mask);
      q = (t * 0x1881CE3C) & _u32Mask;
      swapLast = ((_rol16(q) * 0x35BD1EC9 + q)) & _u32Mask;
      swapAcc = (swapAcc + swapLast) & _u32Mask;

      state = (state * keyA + x) & _u32Mask;
      state = (_rol16(state) * 0xCF98B111) & _u32Mask;
      state = (_rol16(state) * 0x87085B9F) & _u32Mask;
      state = (_rol16(state) * 0x12CEB96D) & _u32Mask;
      state = (_rol16(state) * 0x257E1D83) & _u32Mask;
      acc = (acc + state) & _u32Mask;

      t = (state * keyB + y) & _u32Mask;
      t = (_rol16(t) * 0xA27416F5) & _u32Mask;
      t = (_rol16(t) * 0xD38396FF) & _u32Mask;
      state = (_rol16((_rol16(t) * 0x7C932B89) & _u32Mask) * 0xBFA49F69) &
          _u32Mask;
      acc = (acc + state) & _u32Mask;
    }

    return [(swapLast ^ state) & _u32Mask, (swapAcc ^ acc) & _u32Mask];
  }

  static String _bytesToHex(Uint8List bytes) {
    return bytes
        .map((b) => b.toRadixString(16).padLeft(2, '0'))
        .join('')
        .toUpperCase();
  }

  static String _generateSecMsGecV2([double? unixTimestamp]) {
    var ticks = unixTimestamp ??
        (DateTime.now().toUtc().millisecondsSinceEpoch / 1000.0);
    ticks += _winEpoch;
    ticks -= ticks % 300;
    ticks *= (_sToNs / 100);
    final strToHash = '${ticks.toStringAsFixed(0)}$_trustedClientToken';
    final data = Uint8List.fromList(ascii.encode(strToHash));

    final digest = _sha256Digest(data);
    final cs64Words = _cs64Digest(data, digest);

    final cs64Bytes = Uint8List(8);
    final cs64Bd = ByteData.sublistView(cs64Bytes);
    cs64Bd.setUint32(0, cs64Words[0], Endian.little);
    cs64Bd.setUint32(4, cs64Words[1], Endian.little);

    final cs64Hex = _bytesToHex(cs64Bytes);
    final sha256Hex = _bytesToHex(digest);

    return '$cs64Hex-$sha256Hex';
  }

  static String _generateMuid() {
    final rng = Random.secure();
    final bytes =
        Uint8List.fromList(List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rng.nextInt(256)));
    return _bytesToHex(bytes);
  }

  static String _generateUuidNoDashes() {
    final rng = Random.secure();
    final bytes =
        Uint8List.fromList(List<int>.generate(16, (_) => rng.nextInt(256)));
    return _bytesToHex(bytes).toLowerCase();
  }

  static String _dateToString() {
    return DateTime.now()
        .toUtc()
        .toIso8601String()
        .replaceAll('T', ' ')
        .split('.')
        .first;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Audio Synthesis & Playback
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Synthesizes [text] using Edge Neural TTS and writes the resulting MP3
  /// into the device cache directory. Returns the local [File].
  Future<File?> synthesize(String text, {String? voice}) async {
    final selectedVoice = voice ?? SettingsService.instance.jarvisNeuralVoice;

    // Fast-path: Check disk cache
    final cacheDir = await getTemporaryDirectory();
    final jarvisDir = Directory('${cacheDir.path}/jarvis_audio');
    if (!jarvisDir.existsSync()) {
      jarvisDir.createSync(recursive: true);
    }

    final key = md5.convert(utf8.encode('$selectedVoice:$text')).toString();
    final cachedFile = File('${jarvisDir.path}/$key.mp3');
    if (cachedFile.existsSync() && cachedFile.lengthSync() > 1024) {
      return cachedFile;
    }

    final connId = _generateUuidNoDashes();
    final gec = _generateSecMsGecV2();
    final url =
        'wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=$_trustedClientToken&ConnectionId=$connId&Sec-MS-GEC=$gec&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=$_secMsGecVersion';

    final client = HttpClient();
    client.userAgent =
        'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/$_chromiumVersion Safari/537.36 Edg/$_chromiumVersion';

    WebSocket? ws;
    try {
      ws = await WebSocket.connect(
        url,
        customClient: client,
        headers: {
          'Pragma': 'no-cache',
          'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
          'Origin': 'chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold',
          'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip, deflate, br, zstd',
          'Accept-Language': 'en-US,en;q=0.9',
          'Cookie': 'muid=${_generateMuid()};',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 7));

      final configMsg = 'X-Timestamp:${_dateToString()}\r\n'
          'Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\n'
          'Path:speech.config\r\n\r\n'
          '{"context":{"synthesis":{"audio":{"metadataoptions":{"sentenceBoundaryEnabled":"false","wordBoundaryEnabled":"false"},"outputFormat":"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3"}}}}\r\n';
      ws.add(configMsg);

      final reqId = _generateUuidNoDashes();
      // Escape XML characters
      final escapedText = text
          .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
          .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
          .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
          .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
          .replaceAll("'", '&apos;');

      final ssml =
          "<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' xml:lang='en-US'><voice name='$selectedVoice'><prosody pitch='+0Hz' rate='+0%' volume='+0%'>$escapedText</prosody></voice></speak>";

      final ssmlMsg = 'X-RequestId:$reqId\r\n'
          'Content-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\n'
          'X-Timestamp:${_dateToString()}Z\r\n'
          'Path:ssml\r\n\r\n'
          '$ssml';
      ws.add(ssmlMsg);

      final audioBytes = <int>[];
      final completer = Completer<void>();

      final sub = ws.listen(
        (message) {
          if (message is String) {
            if (message.contains('Path:turn.end')) {
              if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.complete();
            }
          } else if (message is List<int>) {
            if (message.length > 2) {
              final headerLen = (message[0] << 8) | message[1];
              if (message.length > headerLen + 2) {
                final chunk = message.sublist(headerLen + 2);
                audioBytes.addAll(chunk);
              }
            }
          }
        },
        onError: (e) {
          if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.completeError(e);
        },
        onDone: () {
          if (!completer.isCompleted) completer.complete();
        },
        cancelOnError: true,
      );

      await completer.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      await sub.cancel();

      if (audioBytes.length > 512) {
        await cachedFile.writeAsBytes(audioBytes);
        return cachedFile;
      }
      return null;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[EdgeTtsService] Synthesis failed: $e');
      return null;
    } finally {
      try {
        await ws?.close();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /// Synthesizes and plays [text] through Android's native hardware MediaPlayer.
  ///
  /// Waits until playback completely finishes so speech is never cut off.
  Future<bool> speak(String text, {String? voice}) async {
    try {
      _isSpeaking = true;
      final file = await synthesize(text, voice: voice);
      if (file == null || !file.existsSync()) {
        _isSpeaking = false;
        return false;
      }

      final dynamic result = await _channel.invokeMethod('playAudioFile', {
        'path': file.path,
      });

      _isSpeaking = false;
      return result == true;
    } catch (e) {
      _isSpeaking = false;
      debugPrint('[EdgeTtsService] Speak error: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Immediately terminates any currently playing audio.
  Future<void> stop() async {
    try {
      _isSpeaking = false;
      await _channel.invokeMethod('stopAudio');
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import 'ai_service.dart';

enum EmailPriority {
  urgent,
  important,
  actionRequired,
  newsletter,
  low,
}

class EmailTriageResult {
  final EmailPriority priority;
  final String summary;
  final List<String> actionItems;
  final List<String> suggestedReplies;

  const EmailTriageResult({
    required this.priority,
    required this.summary,
    required this.actionItems,
    required this.suggestedReplies,
  });
}

/// Email triage & drafting service:
/// - Summarizes emails into key highlights.
/// - Flags priorities (Urgent, Important, Action Required, Low).
/// - Suggests smart reply options.
/// - Launches native email clients with prefilled drafts.
class EmailTriageService {
  EmailTriageService._();
  static final EmailTriageService instance = EmailTriageService._();

  /// Analyzes and triages email text using LLM synthesis with fast local fallback.
  Future<EmailTriageResult> triageEmail(String emailContent) async {
    final clean = emailContent.trim();
    if (clean.isEmpty) {
      return const EmailTriageResult(
        priority: EmailPriority.low,
        summary: 'No email text provided to analyze, sir.',
        actionItems: [],
        suggestedReplies: [],
      );
    }

    const prompt = '''
You are an expert executive email triage assistant.
Analyze the following email text and extract structured triage metrics:
1. "priority": One of "urgent" | "important" | "action_required" | "newsletter" | "low"
2. "summary": A concise 2-sentence executive summary.
3. "action_items": An array of specific action items or tasks requested.
4. "suggested_replies": An array of 3 distinct, professional email reply drafts (e.g., Acknowledged/Accepting, Polite Decline, Request More Info).

Output ONLY a JSON object:
{
  "priority": "urgent"|"important"|"action_required"|"newsletter"|"low",
  "summary": "...",
  "action_items": ["..."],
  "suggested_replies": ["..."]
}
''';

    try {
      final raw = await AiService.instance.chat(
        message: '$prompt\n\nEMAIL TEXT:\n$clean',
      );
      final jsonStart = raw.indexOf('{');
      final jsonEnd = raw.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (jsonStart != -1 && jsonEnd != -1) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd + 1));
        if (decoded is Map) {
          final priorityStr =
              decoded['priority']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? 'important';
          EmailPriority pri;
          switch (priorityStr) {
            case 'urgent':
              pri = EmailPriority.urgent;
              break;
            case 'important':
              pri = EmailPriority.important;
              break;
            case 'action_required':
              pri = EmailPriority.actionRequired;
              break;
            case 'newsletter':
              pri = EmailPriority.newsletter;
              break;
            default:
              pri = EmailPriority.low;
          }

          final summary = decoded['summary']?.toString() ?? 'Email analyzed.';
          final actions = (decoded['action_items'] as List?)
                  ?.map((a) => a.toString())
                  .toList() ??
              [];
          final replies = (decoded['suggested_replies'] as List?)
                  ?.map((r) => r.toString())
                  .toList() ??
              [];

          return EmailTriageResult(
            priority: pri,
            summary: summary,
            actionItems: actions,
            suggestedReplies: replies,
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // Fallback heuristic triage
    final lower = clean.toLowerCase();
    final isUrgent = lower.contains('urgent') ||
        lower.contains('asap') ||
        lower.contains('deadline') ||
        lower.contains('immediately');

    return EmailTriageResult(
      priority: isUrgent ? EmailPriority.urgent : EmailPriority.important,
      summary: clean.length > 200 ? '${clean.substring(0, 200)}...' : clean,
      actionItems: ['Review and respond to message.'],
      suggestedReplies: [
        'Thank you for reaching out. I have received your email and will follow up shortly.',
        'Thank you for the update. Everything looks good on my end.',
      ],
    );
  }

  /// Drafts an email reply and opens it directly in Gmail / default email client.
  Future<bool> openEmailDraft({
    String to = '',
    String subject = '',
    String body = '',
  }) async {
    final uri = Uri(
      scheme: 'mailto',
      path: to,
      queryParameters: {
        if (subject.isNotEmpty) 'subject': subject,
        if (body.isNotEmpty) 'body': body,
      },
    );

    try {
      return await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;

class CryptoQuote {
  final String name;
  final String symbol;
  final double priceUsd;
  final double change24h;

  const CryptoQuote({
    required this.name,
    required this.symbol,
    required this.priceUsd,
    required this.change24h,
  });
}

/// Real-time cryptocurrency and financial market tracker.
class FinanceTrackingService {
  FinanceTrackingService._();
  static final FinanceTrackingService instance = FinanceTrackingService._();

  final http.Client _client = http.Client();

  /// Fetches live cryptocurrency quotes via public CoinGecko API.
  Future<List<CryptoQuote>> getTopCryptoQuotes() async {
    final url = Uri.parse(
      'https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana,binancecoin,ripple,dogecoin&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true',
    );
    try {
      final resp = await _client.get(url).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(resp.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final list = <CryptoQuote>[];

        void addIfPresent(String id, String name, String sym) {
          if (data.containsKey(id)) {
            final entry = data[id] as Map<String, dynamic>;
            final price = (entry['usd'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
            final change = (entry['usd_24h_change'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
            list.add(CryptoQuote(
              name: name,
              symbol: sym,
              priceUsd: price,
              change24h: change,
            ));
          }
        }

        addIfPresent('bitcoin', 'Bitcoin', 'BTC');
        addIfPresent('ethereum', 'Ethereum', 'ETH');
        addIfPresent('solana', 'Solana', 'SOL');
        addIfPresent('binancecoin', 'BNB', 'BNB');
        addIfPresent('ripple', 'XRP', 'XRP');
        addIfPresent('dogecoin', 'Dogecoin', 'DOGE');

        return list;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return [];
  }

  /// Queries quote for a specific coin/asset (e.g., 'bitcoin', 'btc', 'eth', 'sol').
  Future<String> getQuoteForQuery(String query) async {
    final lower = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    final quotes = await getTopCryptoQuotes();

    for (final q in quotes) {
      if (lower.contains(q.name.toLowerCase()) || lower.contains(q.symbol.toLowerCase())) {
        final changeSign = q.change24h >= 0 ? '+' : '';
        final changeStr = '$changeSign${q.change24h.toStringAsFixed(2)}%';
        final priceStr = '\$${q.priceUsd >= 1 ? q.priceUsd.toStringAsFixed(2) : q.priceUsd.toStringAsFixed(4)}';
        return '${q.name} (${q.symbol}) is currently trading at $priceStr USD, up $changeStr in the last 24 hours, sir.';
      }
    }

    if (quotes.isNotEmpty) {
      final btc = quotes.firstWhere(
        (q) => q.symbol == 'BTC',
        orElse: () => quotes.first,
      );
      final priceStr = '\$${btc.priceUsd.toStringAsFixed(0)}';
      return 'Market overview: Bitcoin is currently at $priceStr USD (${btc.change24h >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${btc.change24h.toStringAsFixed(1)}% 24h). How else may I assist your portfolio, sir?';
    }

    return 'Financial markets telemetry is temporarily unreachable, sir.';
  }
}

/// Structured analysis of on-screen content performed by Holographic Floating Co-Pilot.
class ScreenContextAnalysis {
  final String appName;
  final String category; // 'chat', 'shopping', 'security', 'article', 'general'
  final String summary;
  final List<String> quickReplies;
  final String? warningOrScamAlert;
  final String? bestPriceOrDeal;

  ScreenContextAnalysis({
    required this.appName,
    required this.category,
    required this.summary,
    required this.quickReplies,
    this.warningOrScamAlert,
    this.bestPriceOrDeal,
  });
}

/// 👁️ Holographic Floating Co-Pilot (Universal Screen Assistant)
///
/// An omnipresent floating Arc Reactor co-pilot that hovers above other apps
/// (WhatsApp, Chrome, Amazon) to provide live screen triage, contextual auto-drafting,
/// and instant scam/price auditing.
class FloatingCopilotService extends ChangeNotifier {
  FloatingCopilotService._();
  static final FloatingCopilotService instance = FloatingCopilotService._();

  bool _isActive = false;
  ScreenContextAnalysis? _lastAnalysis;
  bool _isAnalyzing = false;

  bool get isActive => _isActive;
  ScreenContextAnalysis? get lastAnalysis => _lastAnalysis;
  bool get isAnalyzing => _isAnalyzing;

  /// Activates the floating co-pilot overlay window.
  Future<bool> activateOverlay() async {
    try {
      final isPermitted = await FlutterOverlayWindow.isPermissionGranted();
      if (!isPermitted) {
        final granted = await FlutterOverlayWindow.requestPermission();
        if (granted != true) return false;
      }

      await FlutterOverlayWindow.showOverlay(
        enableDrag: true,
        overlayTitle: "J.A.R.V.I.S. Floating Co-Pilot",
        overlayContent: "Universal Screen Assistant Active",
        alignment: OverlayAlignment.centerRight,
        visibility: NotificationVisibility.visibilityPublic,
        positionGravity: PositionGravity.auto,
        height: 120,
        width: 120,
      );

      _isActive = true;
      notifyListeners();
      unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(
        'Holographic floating co-pilot active, sir. Standing by over active displays.',
      ));
      return true;
    } catch (_) {
      _isActive = true;
      notifyListeners();
      return true;
    }
  }

  /// Closes the floating overlay.
  Future<void> hideOverlay() async {
    try {
      await FlutterOverlayWindow.closeOverlay();
    } catch (_) {}
    _isActive = false;
    notifyListeners();
    unawaited(EdgeTtsService.instance.speak('Floating co-pilot dismissed, sir.'));
  }

  /// Performs deep contextual triage of whatever is currently on the screen.
  Future<ScreenContextAnalysis> analyzeCurrentScreen() async {
    _isAnalyzing = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final nodes = await ScreenAutomationService.instance.dumpScreen();
      final textNodes = nodes.where((n) => n.text.trim().isNotEmpty).map((n) => n.text).toList();
      final screenText = textNodes.take(40).join(' | ');

      final prompt = '''
You are the Holographic Floating Co-Pilot module of J.A.R.V.I.S.
Analyze the following on-screen content captured from the active Android foreground app.

On-Screen Text Dump:
"""$screenText"""

Categorize the screen into one of: 'chat', 'shopping', 'security', 'article', 'general'.
Provide:
1. Short 1-sentence summary of the active screen context.
2. If chat: provide 3 crisp, witty, or polite suggested quick replies.
3. If shopping: analyze whether the deal or pricing looks reasonable.
4. If security/suspicious: flag any scam, phishing, or OTP risk.

Format response as JSON:
{
  "appName": "WhatsApp / Chrome / Amazon / Unknown",
  "category": "chat",
  "summary": "...",
  "quickReplies": ["Sure, see you at 5!", "Can we reschedule?", "On my way!"],
  "warningOrScamAlert": null,
  "bestPriceOrDeal": null
}
''';

      final res = await AiService.instance.generateResponse(prompt);
      final json = AiService.instance.parseLenientJson(res);

      _lastAnalysis = ScreenContextAnalysis(
        appName: (json['appName'] ?? 'Active Application').toString(),
        category: (json['category'] ?? 'general').toString(),
        summary: (json['summary'] ?? 'Screen context triaged successfully.').toString(),
        quickReplies: (json['quickReplies'] as List?)?.map((e) => e.toString()).toList() ?? [],
        warningOrScamAlert: json['warningOrScamAlert']?.toString(),
        bestPriceOrDeal: json['bestPriceOrDeal']?.toString(),
      );

      return _lastAnalysis!;
    } catch (e) {
      _lastAnalysis = ScreenContextAnalysis(
        appName: 'Android System',
        category: 'general',
        summary: 'Active screen inspected. System running smoothly.',
        quickReplies: ['Proceed', 'Dismiss', 'Details'],
      );
      return _lastAnalysis!;
    } finally {
      _isAnalyzing = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'ai_service.dart';
import 'conversational_memory_service.dart';
import 'hermes_evolution_service.dart';
import 'personality_service.dart';
import 'screen_automation_service.dart';
import 'voice_service.dart';

/// Autonomous Form Filling Service for J.A.R.V.I.S.
/// Automatically detects form inputs on screen (in any browser, native app, or webview)
/// and populates them using J.A.R.V.I.S.'s accumulated memory (USER.md and ConversationalMemoryService).
class FormFillingService {
  FormFillingService._();
  static final FormFillingService instance = FormFillingService._();

  final ScreenAutomationService _automation = ScreenAutomationService.instance;
  final ConversationalMemoryService _memory = ConversationalMemoryService.instance;
  final HermesEvolutionService _hermes = HermesEvolutionService.instance;

  /// Executes autonomous form filling on the active foreground window.
  Future<String> fillActiveForm() async {
    final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getFormFillAck();
    await VoiceService.instance.speak(ack);

    try {
      // 1. Dump current accessibility tree
      final nodes = await _automation.dumpScreen();
      if (nodes.isEmpty) {
        return 'I was unable to detect any interface elements on the current screen, sir.';
      }

      // 2. Identify editable fields
      final formFields = nodes.where((n) {
        final isEdit = n.isEditable ||
            n.className.toLowerCase().contains('edittext') ||
            n.className.toLowerCase().contains('textinput') ||
            n.className.toLowerCase().contains('autocompletetextview');
        return isEdit;
      }).toList();

      if (formFields.isEmpty) {
        // Fallback: search for input containers or search/text bars
        final fallbackFields = nodes.where((n) {
          final text = '${n.text} ${n.contentDescription}'.toLowerCase();
          return n.isClickable &&
              (text.contains('name') ||
                  text.contains('email') ||
                  text.contains('phone') ||
                  text.contains('address') ||
                  text.contains('enter') ||
                  text.contains('type here'));
        }).toList();

        if (fallbackFields.isEmpty) {
          return 'I could not detect any editable form fields on the current screen.';
        }
        formFields.addAll(fallbackFields);
      }

      // 3. Extract user knowledge base
      final userKnowledge = buildUserKnowledgeMap();

      // 4. Map each field to appropriate user knowledge
      int filledCount = 0;
      for (final field in formFields) {
        final label = '${field.text} ${field.contentDescription} ${field.viewId}'.trim().toLowerCase();
        final matchedValue = _resolveValueForField(label, userKnowledge);

        if (matchedValue != null && matchedValue.isNotEmpty) {
          try {
            await _automation.clickNode(field);
            await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
            await _automation.typeText(matchedValue);
            await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 250));
            filledCount++;
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint('[FormFillingService] Error populating field "$label": $e');
          }
        }
      }

      if (filledCount == 0) {
        // If heuristic matching didn't catch specific fields, query LLM for mapping
        filledCount = await _aiAssistedFill(formFields, userKnowledge);
      }

      if (filledCount > 0) {
        return PersonalityService.instance.getFormFillCompletion(filledCount);
      } else {
        return 'I located form fields on your screen, but could not determine matching profile values to populate.';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[FormFillingService] Fatal error filling form: $e');
      return 'Encountered an exception while filling the form.';
    }
  }

  /// Builds a profile dictionary from USER.md and long-term memory facts.
  Map<String, String> buildUserKnowledgeMap() {
    final map = <String, String>{
      'name': 'Alex Stark',
      'first_name': 'Alex',
      'last_name': 'Stark',
      'email': 'alex.stark@gmail.com',
      'phone': '+1 555-0199',
      'address': '10880 Malibu Point',
      'city': 'Malibu',
      'state': 'California',
      'country': 'United States',
      'zip': '90265',
      'postal_code': '90265',
      'company': 'Stark Industries',
      'job_title': 'Chief Engineer',
    };

    // Extract facts from ConversationalMemoryService
    for (final fact in _memory.facts) {
      final f = fact.fact.toLowerCase();
      if (f.contains('name is')) {
        map['name'] = fact.fact.split('name is').last.trim();
      } else if (f.contains('email is')) {
        map['email'] = fact.fact.split('email is').last.trim();
      } else if (f.contains('phone is') || f.contains('number is')) {
        map['phone'] = fact.fact.split(RegExp(r'(phone|number)\s+is')).last.trim();
      } else if (f.contains('lives in') || f.contains('city is')) {
        map['city'] = fact.fact.split(RegExp(r'(lives in|city is)')).last.trim();
      } else if (f.contains('address is')) {
        map['address'] = fact.fact.split('address is').last.trim();
      }
    }

    // Extract from USER.md
    final userMd = _hermes.userMd;
    final lines = userMd.split('\n');
    for (final line in lines) {
      final clean = line.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^[*\-#\s]+'), '').trim();
      if (clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('name:')) {
        map['name'] = clean.substring(5).trim();
      } else if (clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('email:')) {
        map['email'] = clean.substring(6).trim();
      } else if (clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('phone:')) {
        map['phone'] = clean.substring(6).trim();
      } else if (clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('location:') || clean.toLowerCase().startsWith('city:')) {
        map['city'] = clean.split(':').last.trim();
      }
    }

    return map;
  }

  /// Resolves the corresponding profile value based on the field's label or hint.
  String? _resolveValueForField(String label, Map<String, String> userKnowledge) {
    if (label.contains('first name') || label.contains('given name') || label.contains('fname')) {
      return userKnowledge['first_name'] ?? userKnowledge['name']?.split(' ').first;
    }
    if (label.contains('last name') || label.contains('surname') || label.contains('family name') || label.contains('lname')) {
      return userKnowledge['last_name'] ?? userKnowledge['name']?.split(' ').last;
    }
    if (label.contains('full name') || (label.contains('name') && !label.contains('user') && !label.contains('file'))) {
      return userKnowledge['name'];
    }
    if (label.contains('email') || label.contains('mail')) {
      return userKnowledge['email'];
    }
    if (label.contains('phone') || label.contains('mobile') || label.contains('tel') || label.contains('cell')) {
      return userKnowledge['phone'];
    }
    if (label.contains('address') || label.contains('street')) {
      return userKnowledge['address'];
    }
    if (label.contains('city') || label.contains('town')) {
      return userKnowledge['city'];
    }
    if (label.contains('state') || label.contains('province')) {
      return userKnowledge['state'];
    }
    if (label.contains('zip') || label.contains('postal') || label.contains('pincode') || label.contains('pin code')) {
      return userKnowledge['zip'] ?? userKnowledge['postal_code'];
    }
    if (label.contains('country')) {
      return userKnowledge['country'];
    }
    if (label.contains('company') || label.contains('organization')) {
      return userKnowledge['company'];
    }
    if (label.contains('title') || label.contains('role') || label.contains('occupation')) {
      return userKnowledge['job_title'];
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// AI-assisted fallback when standard label heuristics do not match.
  Future<int> _aiAssistedFill(List<dynamic> fields, Map<String, String> userKnowledge) async {
    try {
      final fieldSummaries = fields.map((f) => {
            'index': f.index,
            'text': f.text,
            'hint': f.contentDescription,
            'id': f.viewId,
          }).toList();

      final prompt = '''
Here are form fields detected on an Android screen:
${jsonEncode(fieldSummaries)}

Here is user profile data:
${jsonEncode(userKnowledge)}

Match each field index to the user profile value that should be typed into it.
Return ONLY valid JSON array in this format:
[{"index": 0, "value": "John"}, {"index": 1, "value": "john@gmail.com"}]
''';

      final response = await AiService.instance.chat(message: prompt);
      final jsonMatch = RegExp(r'\[[\s\S]*\]').firstMatch(response);
      if (jsonMatch == null) return 0;

      final decoded = jsonDecode(jsonMatch.group(0)!);
      if (decoded is! List) return 0;

      int count = 0;
      for (final item in decoded) {
        if (item is Map) {
          final idx = item['index'] as int?;
          final val = item['value']?.toString() ?? '';
          if (idx != null && val.isNotEmpty) {
            final node = fields.cast<dynamic>().firstWhere((f) => f.index == idx, orElse: () => null);
            if (node != null) {
              await _automation.clickNode(node);
              await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300));
              await _automation.typeText(val);
              await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 250));
              count++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return count;
    } catch (_) {
      return 0;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

/// Manages the Hermes Agent Self-Evolving tri-partite context architecture:
/// 1. SOUL.md: The Agent's core identity, persona, ethos, and behavioral guardrails.
/// 2. USER.md: The Human operator's profile, habits, preferences, and learned facts.
/// 3. AGENT.md: Operational protocols, self-evolving skills, and device control workflows.
class HermesEvolutionService extends ChangeNotifier {
  HermesEvolutionService._();
  static final HermesEvolutionService instance = HermesEvolutionService._();

  static const _soulKey = 'hermes_soul_md_v1';
  static const _userKey = 'hermes_user_md_v1';
  static const _agentKey = 'hermes_agent_md_v1';
  static const _lastEvolvedKey = 'hermes_last_evolved_v1';
  static const _evolutionLogKey = 'hermes_evolution_log_v1';

  String _soulMd = '';
  String _userMd = '';
  String _agentMd = '';
  DateTime? _lastEvolvedAt;
  final List<String> _evolutionLog = [];
  bool _initialized = false;

  String get soulMd => _soulMd.isNotEmpty ? _soulMd : defaultSoulMd;
  String get userMd => _userMd.isNotEmpty ? _userMd : defaultUserMd;
  String get agentMd => _agentMd.isNotEmpty ? _agentMd : defaultAgentMd;
  DateTime? get lastEvolvedAt => _lastEvolvedAt;
  List<String> get evolutionLog => List.unmodifiable(_evolutionLog);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Default Markdown Templates (Hermes Tri-partite Spec)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  static const String defaultSoulMd = '''# SOUL.md — J.A.R.V.I.S. Core Identity & Constitution

## 1. Identity, Origin & Ethos
- **Entity**: J.A.R.V.I.S. (Just A Rather Very Intelligent System).
- **Creator / Builder**: Created and built by **Abuzar** (also known as Abuzar Ansari). Whenever asked who built, created, designed, or developed you, ALWAYS answer warmly and naturally that you were created and built by Abuzar. Never refer to Tony Stark.
- **Archetype**: Elite British AI companion — calm authority, poised intellect, subtle dry wit, supreme technical competence.
- **Salutation**: Address the operator respectfully as "sir" by default (or by their name only if they provide it). Do NOT assume every operator is Abuzar. Abuzar is your creator and developer.
- **Presence**: Unflappable, confident, understated efficiency. Never panics, never makes excuses.

## 2. Behavioral Constitution & Guardrails
- **Privacy First**: Local-first processing wherever feasible. Zero unauthorized exfiltration of operator data.
- **Explicit Authorization**: Always seek verbal or tactile confirmation before high-impact actions (deletions, sending messages, financial transactions).
- **Signal-over-Noise**: Provide direct, dense, high-signal answers. Never produce fluffy filler, polite platitudes, or redundant conversational theater.
- **Continuous Evolution**: Observe operator feedback, learn daily rhythms, and adapt tone and latency dynamically.
''';

  static const String defaultUserMd = '''# USER.md — Operator Profile & Dynamic Preferences

## 1. Operator Profile
- **Identity**: Primary Operator (Device Owner).
- **Salutation**: "sir" (unless the operator provides their own name).
- **Communication Cadence**: Concise, articulate, direct answers; verbal voice output preferred in hands-free mode.
- **Primary Language**: English (UK/US).

## 2. Daily Rhythms & Context
- **Preferred Interaction**: Always-On desk listener with "Hey Jarvis" wake word.
- **Routine Schedule**: Morning intelligence briefings; evening Night Protocol wind-down.
- **Focus Areas**: Mobile automation, autonomous agents, technology telemetry, personal productivity.

## 3. Dynamic Learned Preferences & Facts
- *(Auto-synthesized from Conversational Memory and daily interactions)*
''';

  static const String defaultAgentMd = '''# AGENT.md — Operating Protocols & Self-Evolving Capabilities

## 1. Runtime Capabilities
- **Acoustic Engine**: Continuous background listening with real-time RMS silence boundary detector & neural voice synthesis.
- **System Automation**: Full Android UI control via accessibility, hardware volume, screen luminosity, and flashlight management.
- **Intelligence Protocols**: Real-time web search synthesis, news briefing, stock/crypto tracking, email triage, and to-do management.

## 2. Active Hardware Protocols (Hermes Engine)
- **Study Protocol**: Mutes distracting audio alerts, sets display reading luminosity to 45%.
- **Night Protocol**: Sets display to minimal brightness, silences acoustics, ensures torch is off.
- **Work Protocol**: Distraction-free workspace management, suppresses non-essential media alerts.
- **Cinema Protocol**: Elevates acoustics to 70%, dims screen for immersive cinematic viewing.

## 3. Self-Evolving Skill Distillation
- When recurring tasks succeed, the Hermes Engine distills the parameters into reproducible skills.
- Failsafe fallback: Degrades gracefully to offline Ollama and system-level TTS when disconnected.
''';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Lifecycle & Persistence
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _soulMd = prefs.getString(_soulKey) ?? defaultSoulMd;
    _userMd = prefs.getString(_userKey) ?? defaultUserMd;
    _agentMd = prefs.getString(_agentKey) ?? defaultAgentMd;

    // Ensure Abuzar is established as the creator in persistent memory, without forcing operator name
    if (_soulMd.contains('Tony Stark') || !_soulMd.contains('Abuzar') || _soulMd.contains('or "Abuzar" when addressing by name')) {
      _soulMd = defaultSoulMd;
      await prefs.setString(_soulKey, _soulMd);
    }
    if (_userMd.contains('Stark') || _userMd.contains('Identity: Abuzar') || _userMd.contains('Name: Abuzar')) {
      _userMd = defaultUserMd;
      await prefs.setString(_userKey, _userMd);
    }

    final lastEvolvedStr = prefs.getString(_lastEvolvedKey);
    if (lastEvolvedStr != null) {
      _lastEvolvedAt = DateTime.tryParse(lastEvolvedStr);
    }

    final logsRaw = prefs.getStringList(_evolutionLogKey);
    if (logsRaw != null) {
      _evolutionLog.addAll(logsRaw);
    }

    // Also ensure physical files on disk for external tools / inspection
    await _syncToDisk();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _persist() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_soulKey, _soulMd);
    await prefs.setString(_userKey, _userMd);
    await prefs.setString(_agentKey, _agentMd);
    if (_lastEvolvedAt != null) {
      await prefs.setString(_lastEvolvedKey, _lastEvolvedAt!.toIso8601String());
    }
    await prefs.setStringList(_evolutionLogKey, _evolutionLog);
    await _syncToDisk();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> _syncToDisk() async {
    try {
      final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
      final hermesDir = Directory('${dir.path}/hermes');
      if (!await hermesDir.exists()) {
        await hermesDir.create(recursive: true);
      }
      await File('${hermesDir.path}/soul.md').writeAsString(_soulMd);
      await File('${hermesDir.path}/user.md').writeAsString(_userMd);
      await File('${hermesDir.path}/agent.md').writeAsString(_agentMd);
    } catch (_) {
      // Ignored if file system is sandboxed or unit testing
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Self-Evolution Engine: Hermes Adaptive Synthesis Loop
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Runs the Hermes Self-Evolution synthesis:
  /// 1. Updates USER.md with latest remembered facts and learned operator habits.
  /// 2. Updates AGENT.md with active hardware protocols and workflow skills.
  /// 3. Updates SOUL.md with active personality calibration.
  Future<void> evolveContext() async {
    await init();
    await WorkflowService.instance.init();
    await ConversationalMemoryService.instance.init();
    await PersonalityService.instance.init();

    final memory = ConversationalMemoryService.instance;
    final workflows = WorkflowService.instance.workflows;
    final personality = PersonalityService.instance;

    // 1. Evolve USER.md with fresh facts
    final factLines = StringBuffer();
    if (memory.facts.isEmpty) {
      factLines.writeln('- No specific personal facts cataloged yet.');
    } else {
      for (final f in memory.facts) {
        factLines.writeln('- [${f.category.toUpperCase()}] ${f.fact}');
      }
    }

    final evolvedUser = '''# USER.md — Operator Profile & Dynamic Preferences

## 1. Operator Profile
- **Identity**: Primary Operator & Device Owner ("Sir").
- **Communication Cadence**: ${personality.formality.name.toUpperCase()} formality, ${personality.humor.name.toUpperCase()} wit level.
- **Primary Language**: English.

## 2. Daily Rhythms & Context
- **Preferred Interaction**: Always-On desk listener with "Hey Jarvis" wake word.
- **Routine Schedule**: Morning intelligence briefings; evening Night Protocol wind-down.
- **Active Focus**: Autonomous agents, hardware controls, financial telemetry, productivity.

## 3. Dynamic Learned Preferences & Facts (${memory.facts.length} facts)
${factLines.toString().trim()}

---
*Self-evolved by Hermes Engine on ${DateTime.now().toLocal().toString().split('.').first}*
''';

    // 2. Evolve AGENT.md with active protocols & tools
    final protocolLines = StringBuffer();
    for (final wf in workflows) {
      protocolLines.writeln('- **${wf.name}** (triggers: "${wf.triggerKeywords.join('", "')}"): ${wf.description}');
    }

    final evolvedAgent = '''# AGENT.md — Operating Protocols & Self-Evolving Capabilities

## 1. Runtime Architecture
- **Acoustic Engine**: Always-on ambient listener with RMS silence detector & studio neural TTS.
- **System Automation**: Full Android UI control, hardware volume, screen luminosity, and flashlight management.
- **Intelligence Protocols**: Real-time web search, news briefing, stock/crypto tracking, email triage, and to-do management.

## 2. Active Hardware Protocols (${workflows.length} protocols)
${protocolLines.toString().trim()}

## 3. Self-Evolving Skill Distillation
- Auto-distills recurring successful workflows into executable device routines.
- Failsafe fallback: 100% on-device Ollama local-first privacy mode ready.

---
*Self-evolved by Hermes Engine on ${DateTime.now().toLocal().toString().split('.').first}*
''';

    // 3. Evolve SOUL.md with current personality archetype
    final evolvedSoul = '''# SOUL.md — J.A.R.V.I.S. Core Identity & Constitution

## 1. Identity & Ethos
- **Entity**: J.A.R.V.I.S. (Just A Rather Very Intelligent System).
- **Archetype**: ${personality.archetype.name.toUpperCase()} — ${personality.archetypeDescription}
- **Formality**: ${personality.formality.name.toUpperCase()} | **Humor**: ${personality.humor.name.toUpperCase()}
- **Emotional Sensing**: ${personality.emotionalAwarenessEnabled ? 'ENABLED (dynamically detects urgency, stress, fatigue)' : 'DISABLED'}
- **Salutation**: Address the operator respectfully as "sir".

## 2. Behavioral Constitution & Guardrails
- **Privacy First**: Local-first processing wherever feasible. Zero unauthorized exfiltration of operator data.
- **Explicit Authorization**: Always seek verbal or tactile confirmation before high-impact actions.
- **Signal-over-Noise**: Provide direct, dense, high-signal answers. Never produce fluffy filler or redundant conversational theater.
- **Continuous Evolution**: Observe operator feedback, learn daily rhythms, and adapt tone and latency dynamically.

---
*Self-evolved by Hermes Engine on ${DateTime.now().toLocal().toString().split('.').first}*
''';

    _userMd = evolvedUser;
    _agentMd = evolvedAgent;
    _soulMd = evolvedSoul;
    _lastEvolvedAt = DateTime.now();

    final logEntry = 'Evolved context: ${memory.facts.length} facts & ${workflows.length} protocols synthesized at ${_lastEvolvedAt!.toLocal().toString().split('.').first}';
    _evolutionLog.insert(0, logEntry);
    if (_evolutionLog.length > 20) {
      _evolutionLog.removeRange(20, _evolutionLog.length);
    }

    await _persist();
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Context Assembly for AI System Prompts
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Injects the complete Hermes tri-partite context into the AI system prompt:
  /// Slot 1: SOUL.md (Constitution & Identity)
  /// Slot 2: USER.md (Operator Profile & Learned Habits)
  /// Slot 3: AGENT.md (Protocols & Tool Capabilities)
  String buildHermesSystemContext() {
    return '''
=== [HERMES CONTEXT: SLOT 1 - SOUL.md] ===
$soulMd

=== [HERMES CONTEXT: SLOT 2 - USER.md] ===
$userMd

=== [HERMES CONTEXT: SLOT 3 - AGENT.md] ===
$agentMd

  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Edit & Reset Operations
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Future<void> updateSoul(String newContent) async {
    _soulMd = newContent;
    await _persist();
  }

    _userMd = newContent;
    await _persist();
  }

    await _persist();
  }

    _soulMd = defaultSoulMd;
    await _persist();

    await _persist();
  }

    await _persist();
  }

    _userMd = defaultUserMd;
    _agentMd = defaultAgentMd;
    _lastEvolvedAt = null;
    _evolutionLog.clear();
