              caseSensitive: false,
            ),
            '',
          )
          .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[?.,!]+$'), '')
          .trim();

      // 1. Instantly speak a warm, personalized acknowledgment
      final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getQuestionAck(trimmed);
      _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      notifyListeners();

      // Concurrently speak acknowledgment and fetch multi-source web/encyclopedic records
      final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
      final searchFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.searchWeb(topic.isNotEmpty ? topic : trimmed);
      final searchResult = await searchFuture;

      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING EXPLANATION';
      notifyListeners();

      final answerFuture = searchResult.trim().isNotEmpty
          ? _ai.answerWithToolResult(
              userQuestion: trimmed,
              toolResult: searchResult,
              history: _dialogHistory,
            )
          : _ai.chat(
              message: trimmed,
              history: _dialogHistory,
            );

      await speakAckFuture;
      final answer = await answerFuture;

      _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'EXPLANATION COMPLETE';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(answer);

      // Record in conversational history and memory
      _dialogHistory.add({'role': 'user', 'content': trimmed});
      _dialogHistory.add({'role': 'assistant', 'content': answer});
      if (_dialogHistory.length > 10) _dialogHistory.removeRange(0, 2);
      unawaited(ConversationalMemoryService.instance.recordTurn(trimmed, answer));

      // Immediate hands-free follow-up continuous listening
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 5. Fast Self-Evolving Workflow Engine match (Hermes Agent Pattern)
    if (SettingsService.instance.jarvisWorkflowsEnabled) {
      final matchedWf = WorkflowService.instance.findMatch(trimmed);
      if (matchedWf != null) {
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // ENGAGING ${matchedWf.name.toUpperCase()}';
        notifyListeners();

        // 1. Execute hardware changes (volume, brightness, torch)
        await WorkflowService.instance.executeWorkflow(matchedWf);

        // 2. Deliver completion with caring follow-up
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _lastJarvisSpeech = matchedWf.spokenConfirmation;
        _statusMessage = '${matchedWf.name.toUpperCase()} ACTIVE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(matchedWf.spokenConfirmation);
        await _startFollowUpListening();
        return;
      }
    }

    // 5. Fast system diagnostic check
    if (lower == 'status' ||
        lower == 'system status' ||
        lower == 'diagnostics' ||
        lower == 'systems check') {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // RUNNING DIAGNOSTICS';
      notifyListeners();

      final summary = await JarvisToolsService.instance.getSystemDiagnostics();
      final delivery = '$summary How else may I assist you today, sir?';
      _lastJarvisSpeech = delivery;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'SYSTEMS NOMINAL';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(delivery);
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 6. Fast Battery Check
    if (lower == 'battery' ||
        lower == 'battery level' ||
        lower == 'battery percentage' ||
        lower.contains('how much battery') ||
        lower.contains('battery status')) {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // BATTERY DIAGNOSTICS';
      notifyListeners();

      final battery = await JarvisToolsService.instance.getBatteryStatus();
      final level = battery['level'] as int;
      final isCharging = battery['isCharging'] as bool;
      final reply = level >= 0
          ? 'Your battery is currently at $level%, ${isCharging ? 'and charging' : 'discharging normally'}, sir. We have ample power for your tasks. Do you need anything else, sir?'
          : 'Battery telemetry is currently unavailable, sir. Is there anything else I can check for you?';
      _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(reply);
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 7. Fast Torch / Flashlight Check
    if (lower.contains('flashlight on') ||
        lower.contains('torch on') ||
        lower.contains('turn on flashlight') ||
        lower.contains('turn on the torch')) {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // ACTIVATING TORCH';
      notifyListeners();

      await JarvisToolsService.instance.setTorch(true);
      const delivery = 'Flashlight is on, sir. Let me know when you would like it switched off.';
      _lastJarvisSpeech = delivery;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'TORCH ACTIVE';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(delivery);
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }
    if (lower.contains('flashlight off') ||
        lower.contains('torch off') ||
        lower.contains('turn off flashlight') ||
        lower.contains('turn off the torch')) {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // DEACTIVATING TORCH';
      notifyListeners();

      await JarvisToolsService.instance.setTorch(false);
      const delivery = 'Flashlight is deactivated, sir. Anything else I can do for you?';
      _lastJarvisSpeech = delivery;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'TORCH OFFLINE';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(delivery);
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 8. Fast Date / Time Check
    if (lower.contains('what time is it') ||
        lower == 'time' ||
        lower == 'current time' ||
        lower.contains('what is the date') ||
        lower == 'date' ||
        lower.contains('what day is it')) {
      final dt = JarvisToolsService.instance.getCurrentDateTime();
      final reply = 'It is currently $dt, sir. How else may I assist you today?';
      _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'TEMPORAL DIAGNOSTICS';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(reply);
      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 9. Fast Direct System Control Filters
    if (lower.contains('volume up') ||
        lower.contains('louder') ||
        lower.contains('increase volume')) {
      await _handleSystemCommand('volume_up', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('volume_up'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower.contains('volume down') ||
        lower.contains('quieter') ||
        lower.contains('lower volume')) {
      await _handleSystemCommand('volume_down', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('volume_down'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower == 'mute' || lower == 'silence' || lower.contains('mute sound')) {
      await _handleSystemCommand('mute', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('mute'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower == 'unmute' || lower.contains('unmute sound')) {
      await _handleSystemCommand('unmute', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('unmute'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower.contains('screenshot') ||
        lower.contains('screen shot') ||
        lower.contains('capture screen')) {
      await _handleSystemCommand('screenshot', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('screenshot'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower == 'home' || lower == 'go home' || lower == 'home screen') {
      await _handleSystemCommand('home', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('home'));
      return;
    }
    if (lower == 'back' || lower == 'go back') {
      await _handleSystemCommand('back', PersonalityService.instance.getSystemAck('back'));
      return;
    }

    // 10. Fast Contact Call Filter
    if (lower.startsWith('call ') && !lower.contains('screen')) {
      final name = trimmed.substring(5).trim();
      if (name.isNotEmpty) {
        final ack = 'Locating coordinates to call $name for you, sir. One moment.';
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _statusMessage = 'CONTACT DIALER // $name'.toUpperCase();
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(ack);

        final reply = await JarvisToolsService.instance.callContact(name);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(reply);
        if (_shouldListenContinuously) _standDown();
        return;
      }
    }

    // 11. Fast Live Breaking News Filter
    final isNews = lower.contains('news') ||
        lower.contains('headline') ||
        lower.contains('what happened today') ||
        lower.contains('breaking news') ||
        lower.contains('give me news') ||
        lower.contains('current news') ||
        lower.contains('what is the news') ||
        lower.contains('what is happening in the world') ||
        lower.contains('latest news');

    if (isNews) {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'GATHERING NEWS HEADLINES';
      notifyListeners();

      // Extract topic if specified
      String? topic;
      for (final kw in [
        'tech',
        'technology',
        'sports',
        'cricket',
        'football',
        'business',
        'crypto',
        'world',
        'science',
        'politics',
        'ai',
        'space',
      ]) {
        if (lower.contains(kw)) {
          topic = kw;
          break;
        }
      }

      // 1. Instantly speak a warm, personalized, non-repetitive British acknowledgment!
      final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getNewsAck(topic);
      _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      notifyListeners();

      // Concurrently speak acknowledgment and fetch live multi-feed news in background
      final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
      final newsDataFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.getLiveNews(topic);

      final newsData = await newsDataFuture;

      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING';
      notifyListeners();

      final answerFuture = _ai.answerWithToolResult(
        userQuestion: trimmed,
        toolResult: newsData,
        history: _dialogHistory,
      );

      // Ensure initial acknowledgment finishes speaking before delivering final briefing
      await speakAckFuture;
      final answer = await answerFuture;

      // 2. Spoken reply to question
      _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'NEWS TELEMETRY BROADCAST';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(answer);

      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 11b. Fast Live Web Search & Real-Time Information Filter
    final isWebSearch = lower.startsWith('search ') ||
        lower.startsWith('search for ') ||
        lower.startsWith('look up ') ||
        lower.startsWith('google ') ||
        lower.startsWith('find out ') ||
        lower.startsWith('tell me about ') ||
        lower.startsWith('check online ') ||
        lower.startsWith('who is ') ||
        lower.startsWith('what is ') ||
        lower.startsWith('where is ') ||
        lower.startsWith('how much is ') ||
        lower.contains('search the web') ||
        lower.contains('search online');

    if (isWebSearch) {
      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'INITIALIZING WEB INTELLIGENCE';
      notifyListeners();

      final query = trimmed
          .replaceAll(
            RegExp(
              r'^(search\s+for|search\s+the\s+web\s+for|search\s+online\s+for|search|look\s+up|google|find\s+out|tell\s+me\s+about|check\s+online\s+for)\s+',
              caseSensitive: false,
            ),
            '',
          )
          .trim();

      // 1. Instantly speak dynamic, personalized acknowledgment
      final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getWebSearchAck(query);
      _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      notifyListeners();

      // Concurrently speak acknowledgment and execute multi-source search in background
      final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
      final searchFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.searchWeb(query.isNotEmpty ? query : trimmed);

      final searchResult = await searchFuture;

      _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
      _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING WEB INTELLIGENCE';
      notifyListeners();

      final answerFuture = _ai.answerWithToolResult(
        userQuestion: trimmed,
        toolResult: searchResult,
        history: _dialogHistory,
      );

      await speakAckFuture;
      final answer = await answerFuture;

      _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
      _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
      _statusMessage = 'WEB INTELLIGENCE RETRIEVED';
      notifyListeners();
      await _voice.speak(answer);

      await _startFollowUpListening();
      return;
    }

    // 12. Full AI Intent Interpretation via AiService
    JarvisIntent intent;
    try {
      intent = await _ai.interpretJarvisCommand(
        speech: trimmed,
        history: _dialogHistory,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      intent = JarvisIntent.fallback(trimmed);
    }

    // Save short-term dialog context
    _dialogHistory.add({'role': 'user', 'content': trimmed});
    _dialogHistory.add({'role': 'assistant', 'content': intent.spoken});
    if (_dialogHistory.length > 10) {
      _dialogHistory.removeRange(0, 2);
    }

    switch (intent.type) {
      case JarvisIntentType.news:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'GATHERING NEWS HEADLINES';
        notifyListeners();

        final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getNewsAck(intent.toolArg);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();

        final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
        final newsFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.getLiveNews(intent.toolArg);
        final newsData = await newsFuture;

        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING';
        notifyListeners();

        final answerFuture = _ai.answerWithToolResult(
          userQuestion: trimmed,
          toolResult: newsData,
          history: _dialogHistory,
        );

        await speakAckFuture;
        final answer = await answerFuture;

        _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'NEWS TELEMETRY BROADCAST';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(answer);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.workflow:
        final rawArg = (intent.toolArg ?? trimmed).toLowerCase();
        // Check for Sentry Protocol / Sentry Mode within workflow intent
        if (rawArg.contains('sentry') || rawArg.contains('watchdog')) {
          final isDisarm = rawArg.contains('disarm') ||
              rawArg.contains('deactivat') ||
              rawArg.contains('stop') ||
              rawArg.contains('cancel') ||
              rawArg.contains('stand down');
          if (isDisarm) {
            _statusMessage = 'SENTRY PROTOCOL // DISARMING';
            notifyListeners();
            await SentryService.instance.disarmSentry();
          } else {
            _statusMessage = 'SENTRY PROTOCOL // ARMING WATCHDOG';
            notifyListeners();
            await SentryService.instance.armSentry();
          }
          break;
        }

        final ack = intent.spoken.isNotEmpty
            ? intent.spoken
            : 'Right away, sir. Calibrating your settings environment now.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'CALIBRATING WORKFLOW PROTOCOL';
        notifyListeners();

        // 1. Speak courteous acknowledgment completely
        await _voice.speak(ack);

        // 2. Execute workflow
        _phase = JarvisPhase.executing;
        notifyListeners();

        final match = WorkflowService.instance.findMatch(intent.toolArg ?? trimmed) ??
            WorkflowService.instance.findMatch(trimmed);

        if (match != null) {
          await WorkflowService.instance.executeWorkflow(match);
          _lastJarvisSpeech = match.spokenConfirmation;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = '${match.name.toUpperCase()} ACTIVE';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(match.spokenConfirmation);
        } else {
          const fallback = 'All settings have been calibrated for you, sir. Let me know if you need anything else.';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = fallback;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'PROTOCOL ACTIVE';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(fallback);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.webSearch:
        final query = intent.toolArg ?? trimmed;
        final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getWebSearchAck(query);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'SEARCHING LIVE WEB RECORDS';
        notifyListeners();

        final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
        final searchFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.searchWeb(query);
        final searchResult = await searchFuture;

        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING WEB INTELLIGENCE';
        notifyListeners();

        final answerFuture = _ai.answerWithToolResult(
          userQuestion: trimmed,
          toolResult: searchResult,
          history: _dialogHistory,
        );

        await speakAckFuture;
        final answer = await answerFuture;

        _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'WEB INTELLIGENCE RETRIEVED';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(answer);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.weather:
        final loc = intent.toolArg ?? '';
        final ack = PersonalityService.instance.getWeatherAck(loc);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'METEOROLOGICAL TELEMETRY';
        notifyListeners();

        final speakAckFuture = _voice.speak(ack);
        final weatherFuture = JarvisToolsService.instance.getWeather(loc);
        final weatherResult = await weatherFuture;

        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'SYNTHESIZING WEATHER REPORT';
        notifyListeners();

        final answerFuture = _ai.answerWithToolResult(
          userQuestion: trimmed,
          toolResult: weatherResult,
          history: _dialogHistory,
        );

        await speakAckFuture;
        final answer = await answerFuture;

        _lastJarvisSpeech = answer;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'METEOROLOGICAL REPORT COMPLETE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(answer);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.battery:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // BATTERY DIAGNOSTICS';
        notifyListeners();

        final battery =
            await JarvisToolsService.instance.getBatteryStatus();
        final level = battery['level'] as int;
        final isCharging = battery['isCharging'] as bool;
        final battReply = level >= 0
            ? 'Your battery is currently at $level%, ${isCharging ? 'and charging' : 'discharging normally'}, sir. We have plenty of power. Do you need anything else, sir?'
            : 'Battery level telemetry is currently unavailable, sir. Is there anything else I can check?';

        _lastJarvisSpeech = battReply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(battReply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.datetime:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'TEMPORAL DIAGNOSTICS';
        notifyListeners();

        final dt = JarvisToolsService.instance.getCurrentDateTime();
        final reply = 'It is currently $dt, sir. How else may I be of service today?';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(reply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.torch:
        final on = intent.toolArg == 'on';
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = on ? 'COMPUTING // ACTIVATING TORCH' : 'COMPUTING // DEACTIVATING TORCH';
        notifyListeners();

        await JarvisToolsService.instance.setTorch(on);
        final reply = on
            ? 'Flashlight is on, sir. Let me know when you would like it switched off.'
            : 'Flashlight is deactivated, sir. Anything else I can do for you?';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = on ? 'TORCH ACTIVE' : 'TORCH OFFLINE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(reply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.routine:
        final isMorning = (intent.toolArg ?? '').toLowerCase() == 'morning' ||
            trimmed.toLowerCase().contains('morning');
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = isMorning ? 'COMPUTING // MORNING BRIEFING' : 'COMPUTING // NIGHT PROTOCOL';
        notifyListeners();

        final briefing = isMorning
            ? await RoutineAutomationService.instance.executeMorningRoutine()
            : await RoutineAutomationService.instance.executeEveningRoutine();

        _lastJarvisSpeech = briefing;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(briefing);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.finance:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // FINANCIAL TELEMETRY';
        notifyListeners();

        final quote = await FinanceTrackingService.instance.getQuoteForQuery(trimmed);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = quote;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(quote);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.sports:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // SPORTS FIXTURES';
        notifyListeners();

        final update = await SportsService.instance.getSportsUpdate(trimmed);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = update;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(update);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.todo:
        final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.startsWith('add ') || lower.contains('add task') || lower.contains('add to')) {
          var taskText = trimmed
              .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(add\s+to\s+(my\s+)?(todo|to-do)(\s+list)?|add\s+task|add)\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
              .trim();
          if (taskText.isEmpty) taskText = 'Review task';
          await TodoService.instance.addTask(taskText);
          final reply = 'I have added "$taskText" to your to-do agenda, sir. Anything else?';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'TODO ITEM RECORDED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        } else {
          final reply = TodoService.instance.getPendingTasksSpoken();
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'TASK AGENDA';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.notes:
        final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.startsWith('take a note') || lower.startsWith('note down') || lower.startsWith('write a note')) {
          var noteContent = trimmed
              .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(take\s+a\s+note(\s+that)?|note\s+down|write\s+a\s+note(\s+that)?)\s*[:\s]*', caseSensitive: false), '')
              .trim();
          if (noteContent.isEmpty) noteContent = 'Personal Note';
          await NotesKnowledgeService.instance.addNote(
            title: 'Voice Note ${DateTime.now().month}/${DateTime.now().day}',
            content: noteContent,
          );
          final reply = 'Note saved in your personal knowledge base, sir: "$noteContent".';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'KNOWLEDGE RECORD SAVED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        } else {
          final reply = NotesKnowledgeService.instance.searchNotesSpoken(trimmed);
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'KNOWLEDGE RETRIEVAL';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.calendar:
        final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.startsWith('remind me to ') || lower.startsWith('set a reminder for ')) {
          final reminderText = trimmed
              .replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(remind\s+me\s+to|set\s+a\s+reminder\s+for)\s+', caseSensitive: false), '')
              .trim();
          await CalendarReminderService.instance.addItem(
            title: reminderText,
            dateTime: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(hours: 1)),
            isReminder: true,
          );
          final reply = 'I have set a reminder for "$reminderText", sir.';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'REMINDER SCHEDULED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        } else {
          final reply = CalendarReminderService.instance.getTodayBriefingSpoken();
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'CALENDAR SCHEDULE';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.email:
        final lowerEmail = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        final isInboxCheck = lowerEmail.contains('read') ||
            lowerEmail.contains('check') ||
            lowerEmail.contains('inbox') ||
            lowerEmail.contains('what are') ||
            lowerEmail.contains('new') ||
            lowerEmail.contains('recent');

        String emailReply;
        if (isInboxCheck) {
          emailReply = await InboxService.instance.getEmailSummary();
        } else {
          final triage = await EmailTriageService.instance.triageEmail(trimmed);
          emailReply = '${triage.summary} Priority is flagged as ${triage.priority.name}. Would you like me to open a draft reply for you, sir?';
        }

        _lastJarvisSpeech = emailReply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'EMAIL INBOX PROCESSED';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(emailReply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.message:
        final lowerMsg = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        final isSmsCheck = lowerMsg.contains('read') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('check') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('inbox') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('what are') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('recent message') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('new message') ||
            lowerMsg.contains('read my sms');

        if (isSmsCheck) {
          final smsReply = await InboxService.instance.getSmsSummary();
          _lastJarvisSpeech = smsReply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'SMS INBOX PROCESSED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(smsReply);
        } else {
          final draftText = await MessageDraftingService.instance.draftMessageContent(prompt: trimmed);
          final reply = 'I have prepared this message draft for you, sir: "$draftText". Would you like me to dispatch it?';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          _statusMessage = 'MESSAGE DRAFT PREPARED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
          await MessageDraftingService.instance.dispatchDraft(
            MessageDraft(
              channel: trimmed.toLowerCase().contains('whatsapp') ? MessageChannel.whatsapp : MessageChannel.sms,
              recipient: '',
              body: draftText,
            ),
          );
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.vision:
        final isScreen = trimmed.toLowerCase().contains('screen');
        final ack = isScreen
            ? 'Scanning active screen elements, sir.'
            : 'Jarvis Eye optical sensors engaged, sir. Inspecting the subject now.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'OPTICAL SENSORS ACTIVE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(ack);

        final analysis = isScreen
            ? await ProactiveAgentService.instance.analyzeCurrentScreen(userQuestion: trimmed)
            : (await VisionPerceptionService.instance.inspectOpticalSnapshot(customPrompt: trimmed)).spokenSummary;

        _lastJarvisSpeech = analysis;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'OPTICAL SCAN COMPLETE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(analysis);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.smartHome:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'SMART HOME IOT // DISPATCHING';
        notifyListeners();

        final reply = await SmartHomeService.instance.handleVoiceCommand(trimmed);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'SMART HOME ACTIVE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(reply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.commute:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMPUTING // COMMUTE & TRAFFIC TELEMETRY';
        notifyListeners();

        final commute = await CommuteTrafficService.instance.checkCommute(destination: intent.toolArg);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = commute.spokenSummary;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'COMMUTE REPORT';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(commute.spokenSummary);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.macro:
        final lowerMacro = trimmed.toLowerCase();
        if (lowerMacro.startsWith('stop recording') || lowerMacro.startsWith('save macro')) {
          final skill = await MacroRecorderService.instance.stopRecording();
          final reply = skill != null
              ? 'Macro "${skill.goal}" saved and codified into AGENT.md, sir.'
              : 'Macro recording concluded, sir.';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        } else if (lowerMacro.startsWith('run macro') || lowerMacro.startsWith('replay macro')) {
          final macroName = trimmed.replaceFirst(RegExp(r'^(run|replay)\s+macro\s+', caseSensitive: false), '').trim();
          final match = await SkillMemoryService.instance.findMatch(macroName);
          if (match != null) {
            final reply = 'Replaying macro "${match.goal}", sir.';
            _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
            _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
            notifyListeners();
            await _voice.speak(reply);
            await MacroRecorderService.instance.replaySkill(match);
          } else {
            final reply = 'No matching macro found for "$macroName", sir.';
            _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
            _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
            notifyListeners();
            await _voice.speak(reply);
          }
        } else {
          final goal = intent.toolArg ?? 'Custom Task';
          await MacroRecorderService.instance.startRecording(goal);
          final reply = 'Macro recording started for "$goal", sir. Perform your actions, then say "save macro".';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = reply;
          _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(reply);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.airGestures:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'AIR GESTURES SENSORY MATRIX';
        notifyListeners();
        final raw = (intent.toolArg ?? trimmed).toLowerCase();
        final isOff = raw.contains('off') ||
            raw.contains('disable') ||
            raw.contains('deactivat') ||
            raw.contains('stop');
        String gestureReply;
        if (isOff) {
          await AirGestureService.instance.stop();
          gestureReply = 'Iron Man zero-touch air gesture sensors disengaged, sir.';
        } else {
          await AirGestureService.instance.start();
          gestureReply =
              'Zero-touch air gestures engaged, sir. Wave over the screen to skip tracks, hover palm to pause, or double wave for instant screenshot.';
        }
        _lastJarvisSpeech = gestureReply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(gestureReply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.chargingTelemetry:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'ARC REACTOR CHARGING TELEMETRY';
        notifyListeners();
        ChargingTelemetryService.instance.showCinematicHud.value = true;
        final chargingReport = await ChargingTelemetryService.instance.getSpokenTelemetry();
        _lastJarvisSpeech = chargingReport;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(chargingReport);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.polyglotDiplomat:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'POLYGLOT DIPLOMAT // TRANSLATION';
        notifyListeners();
        _showModalSafely(const PolyglotDiplomatDialog());
        const transAck =
            'Polyglot Diplomat initialized, sir. Ready for real-time diplomatic translation.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = transAck;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(transAck);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.codeBlack:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'CODE BLACK // HARDWARE LOCKOUT';
        notifyListeners();
        await CodeBlackService.instance.arm();
        _phase = JarvisPhase.idle;
        notifyListeners();
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.floatingCopilot:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'HOLOGRAPHIC FLOATING CO-PILOT';
        notifyListeners();
        final rawCopilot = (intent.toolArg ?? trimmed).toLowerCase();
        final isHide = rawCopilot.contains('hide') ||
            rawCopilot.contains('close') ||
            rawCopilot.contains('stop') ||
            rawCopilot.contains('dismiss');
        String copilotReply;
        if (isHide) {
          await FloatingCopilotService.instance.hideOverlay();
          copilotReply = 'Floating co-pilot dismissed, sir.';
        } else {
          await FloatingCopilotService.instance.activateOverlay();
          copilotReply =
              'Holographic floating co-pilot active, sir. Hovering over active applications with live screen context triage.';
        }
        _lastJarvisSpeech = copilotReply;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(copilotReply);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.airspaceRadar:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'AIRSPACE & SATELLITE RADAR';
        notifyListeners();
        _showModalSafely(const AirspaceRadarDialog());
        final radarReport = await AirspaceRadarService.instance.getSpokenAirspaceReport();
        _lastJarvisSpeech = radarReport;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(radarReport);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.multiTaskDump:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'MULTI-TASK DECOUPLER';
        notifyListeners();
        final decoupledReport = await MultiTaskDecouplerService.instance.processBrainDump(trimmed);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = decoupledReport;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(decoupledReport);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.opticalSolver:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'REAL-TIME OPTICAL HUD SOLVER';
        notifyListeners();
        _showModalSafely(const OpticalSolverDialog());
        final solveResult =
            await OpticalSolverService.instance.pointAndSolve(customQuery: trimmed);
        _lastJarvisSpeech = solveResult.spokenSummary;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(solveResult.spokenSummary);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.networkAudit:
        _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
        _statusMessage = 'NETWORK SECURITY AUDIT';
        notifyListeners();
        _showModalSafely(const NetworkAuditDialog());
        final netReport = await NetworkAuditService.instance.getSpokenAuditReport();
        _lastJarvisSpeech = netReport;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(netReport);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.multistep:
        final ack = 'Initiating multi-step execution protocol for you, sir.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'MULTI-STEP PROTOCOL';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(ack);

        final steps = await ProactiveAgentService.instance.planMultiStepGoal(trimmed);
        final planSpoken = 'I have broken down this goal into ${steps.length} sequential steps, sir: ${steps.join("; ")}. Commencing first step now.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = planSpoken;
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(planSpoken);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.system:
        await _handleSystemCommand(intent.systemCommand ?? '', intent.spoken);
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.action:
        final goal = intent.actionGoal ?? trimmed;

        // Foundation: Permission system check before risky actions
        if (SettingsService.instance.confirmRiskyActions) {
          final assessment = SecurityAlertService.instance.evaluateActionRisk(goal);
          if (assessment.requiresConfirmation) {
            final confirmPrompt = 'Sir, this action involves high-risk operations: ${assessment.reason}. Do you confirm execution?';
            _lastJarvisSpeech = confirmPrompt;
            _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
            _statusMessage = 'CONFIRMATION REQUIRED // HIGH RISK';
            notifyListeners();
            await _voice.speak(confirmPrompt);
            await SecurityAlertService.instance.dispatchSecurityAlert('High-risk operation prompted: $goal');
            return;
          }
        }

        _currentTaskGoal = goal;
        final ack = intent.spoken.isNotEmpty
            ? intent.spoken
            : 'Right away, sir. I will take care of that on your device right now.';
        _lastJarvisSpeech = ack;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'PROTOCOL ENGAGED // $goal'.toUpperCase();
        notifyListeners();

        // 1. Speak acknowledgment completely
        await _voice.speak(ack);

        // 2. Execute automation task on device
        _phase = JarvisPhase.executing;
        notifyListeners();
        final status = await _executor.executeTask(goal);

        // 3. Deliver completion with caring follow-up
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        if (status == TaskStatus.success) {
          const successSpeech = 'I have completed that task for you, sir. Is there anything else you need?';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = successSpeech;
          _statusMessage = 'PROTOCOL FINISHED // SUCCESS';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(successSpeech);
        } else if (status == TaskStatus.cancelled) {
          const cancelledSpeech = 'The task was cancelled, sir. What would you like me to do instead?';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = cancelledSpeech;
          _statusMessage = 'PROTOCOL CANCELLED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(cancelledSpeech);
        } else {
          const failedSpeech =
              'I encountered an obstruction with that task on the screen, sir. Would you like me to try again?';
          _lastJarvisSpeech = failedSpeech;
          _statusMessage = 'PROTOCOL FAILED';
          notifyListeners();
          await _voice.speak(failedSpeech);
        }
        break;

      case JarvisIntentType.chat:
        String chatAnswer = intent.spoken;
        if (chatAnswer.trim().isEmpty ||
            chatAnswer.length < 25 ||
            chatAnswer.toLowerCase().contains('at your service') ||
            chatAnswer.toLowerCase().contains('what would you like me to do')) {
          _phase = JarvisPhase.thinking;
          _statusMessage = 'PROCESSING // NEURAL CORE';
          notifyListeners();
          chatAnswer = await _ai.chat(message: trimmed, history: _dialogHistory);
        }
        _lastJarvisSpeech = chatAnswer;
        _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
        _statusMessage = 'VOCAL RESPONSE COMPLETE';
        notifyListeners();
        await _voice.speak(chatAnswer);
        break;
    }

    // Persist conversation turn and auto-extract user preferences/facts across sessions
    unawaited(ConversationalMemoryService.instance.recordTurn(trimmed, _lastJarvisSpeech));

    // Follow-up hands-free continuous listening
    await _startFollowUpListening();
  }

  Future<void> _handleSystemCommand(String cmd, String spoken) async {
    final speech = spoken.isNotEmpty ? spoken : PersonalityService.instance.getGeneralAck();
    _lastJarvisSpeech = speech;
    _phase = JarvisPhase.speaking;
    _statusMessage = 'SYSTEM OVERRIDE // $cmd'.toUpperCase();
    notifyListeners();

    await _voice.speak(speech);

    switch (cmd) {
      case 'volume_up':
        await _system.volumeUp();
        break;
      case 'volume_down':
        await _system.volumeDown();
        break;
      case 'mute':
        await _system.setMuted(true);
        break;
      case 'unmute':
        await _system.setMuted(false);
        break;
      case 'brightness_up':
        final current = await _system.getBrightness() ?? 0.5;
        await _system.setBrightness((current + 0.2).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
        break;
      case 'brightness_down':
        final current = await _system.getBrightness() ?? 0.5;
        await _system.setBrightness((current - 0.2).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
        break;
      case 'screenshot':
        await _automation.takeScreenshotBase64();
        break;
      case 'home':
        await _automation.pressHome();
        break;
      case 'back':
        await _automation.pressBack();
        break;
    }

    if (_shouldListenContinuously) {
      _standDown();
    }
  }

  /// Resolves the exact top YouTube video ID for instant playback without search friction.
  Future<String?> _resolveTopYouTubeVideoId(String query) async {
    try {
      final url = Uri.parse(
        'https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${Uri.encodeComponent(query)}',
      );
      final resp = await http.get(url, headers: {
        'User-Agent':
            'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
      }).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final match =
            RegExp(r'watch\?v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})').firstMatch(resp.body);
        if (match != null) {
          return match.group(1);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[JarvisService] YouTube top video lookup error: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_overlay_window/flutter_overlay_window.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import 'ai_service.dart';
import 'app_launcher_service.dart';
import 'app_usage_service.dart';
import 'phone_storage_service.dart';
import 'screen_automation_service.dart';
import 'sentry_service.dart';
import 'sound_radar_service.dart';
import 'system_control_service.dart';
import 'system_diagnostics_service.dart';
import 'workflow_service.dart';

/// Real-time tools powering the J.A.R.V.I.S. intelligence core:
/// - Real-Time Breaking News (Google News Live RSS Feed)
/// - Live Web Search (DuckDuckGo & Wikipedia APIs)
/// - Real-Time Weather (wttr.in)
/// - Self-Evolving Workflows (Hermes Engine)
/// - Hardware Telemetry (Battery, Flashlight/Torch, Volume, Brightness)
/// - Temporal Computations (Exact Local & World Times)
/// - App Launching & Contact Dialer
class JarvisToolsService {
  JarvisToolsService._();
  static final JarvisToolsService instance = JarvisToolsService._();

  static const MethodChannel _channel =
      MethodChannel('com.privateagent/accessibility');

  final http.Client _client = http.Client();

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. Live Breaking News (Google News & Bing News Multi-Feed)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Fetches real-time live breaking news headlines across categories or topics.
  Future<String> getLiveNews([String? topic]) async {
    final cleanTopic = topic?.trim() ?? '';
    final buffer = StringBuffer();

    // 1. Google News RSS
    try {
      final gUrl = cleanTopic.isEmpty
          ? Uri.parse('https://news.google.com/rss?hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en')
          : Uri.parse(
              'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=${Uri.encodeComponent(cleanTopic)}&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en',
            );

      final resp = await _client.get(
        gUrl,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent':
              'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));

      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final xml = resp.body;
        final matches = RegExp(r'<item>[\s\S]*?<title>(.*?)</title>[\s\S]*?<pubDate>(.*?)</pubDate>')
            .allMatches(xml)
            .take(5)
            .map((m) {
              final t = (m.group(1) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim();
              final pub = (m.group(2) ?? '').trim();
              return '- $t ($pub)';
            })
            .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
            .toList();

        if (matches.isNotEmpty) {
          buffer.writeln('GLOBAL WIRE HEADLINES:');
          for (final m in matches) {
            buffer.writeln(m
                .replaceAll('&amp;', '&')
                .replaceAll('&quot;', '"')
                .replaceAll('&#39;', "'")
                .replaceAll('&lt;', '<')
                .replaceAll('&gt;', '>'));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // 2. Bing News RSS (with full paragraph descriptions)
    try {
      final bQuery = cleanTopic.isEmpty ? 'top news headlines world' : cleanTopic;
      final bUrl = Uri.parse(
        'https://www.bing.com/news/search?q=${Uri.encodeComponent(bQuery)}&format=rss',
      );

      final resp = await _client.get(
        bUrl,
        headers: {
          'User-Agent':
              'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
        },
      ).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));

      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final xml = resp.body;
        final items = RegExp(r'<item>[\s\S]*?<title>(.*?)</title>[\s\S]*?<description>(.*?)</description>')
            .allMatches(xml)
            .take(4)
            .map((m) {
              final t = (m.group(1) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim();
              final d = (m.group(2) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim();
              return '- $t: $d';
            })
            .where((s) => s.length > 10)
            .toList();

        if (items.isNotEmpty) {
          if (buffer.isNotEmpty) buffer.writeln('');
          buffer.writeln('DETAILED NEWS BRIEFINGS:');
          for (final item in items) {
            buffer.writeln(item
                .replaceAll('&amp;', '&')
                .replaceAll('&quot;', '"')
                .replaceAll('&#39;', "'")
                .replaceAll('&lt;', '<')
                .replaceAll('&gt;', '>'));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    if (buffer.isNotEmpty) {
      return buffer.toString().trim();
    }

    return 'Unable to retrieve live breaking news at this moment, sir.';
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. Multi-Source Live Web Intelligence & Fact Engine
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Performs an industrial multi-source live web query to fetch current information,
  /// real-time events, encyclopedic facts, or live news in the background.
  Future<String> searchWeb(String query) async {
    var clean = query.trim();
    if (clean.isEmpty) return 'No search query provided, sir.';

    // Strip leading conversational phrases
    clean = clean.replaceAll(
      RegExp(r'^(jarvis|search\s+for|look\s+up|google|find\s+out|tell\s+me\s+about|what\s+is|who\s+is|check\s+online\s+for)\s+', caseSensitive: false),
      '',
    ).trim();

    final lower = clean.toLowerCase();
    // Fast path: if the query is explicitly asking for today's news
    if (lower.contains('top news') ||
        lower.contains('breaking news') ||
        lower.contains('today headlines') ||
        lower.contains('what happened today')) {
      final topic = lower
          .replaceAll('news', '')
          .replaceAll('breaking', '')
          .replaceAll('headlines', '')
          .trim();
      return getLiveNews(topic.isNotEmpty ? topic : null);
    }

    final buffer = StringBuffer();
    final encoded = Uri.encodeComponent(clean);

    // Concurrently fetch Wikipedia Summary, Bing News RSS, and Google News RSS
    final results = await Future.wait([
      // 1. Wikipedia Search & Page Summary
      (() async {
        try {
          final sUrl = Uri.parse(
            'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=search&srsearch=$encoded&utf8=&format=json',
          );
          final resp = await _client.get(sUrl, headers: {'User-Agent': 'JARVIS-PrivateAgent/1.0'}).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
          if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
            final json = jsonDecode(resp.body);
            final searchList = json?['query']?['search'] as List?;
            if (searchList != null && searchList.isNotEmpty) {
              final topTitle = searchList.first['title']?.toString() ?? '';
              if (topTitle.isNotEmpty) {
                final pageUrl = Uri.parse(
                  'https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/${Uri.encodeComponent(topTitle.replaceAll(' ', '_'))}',
                );
                final pageResp = await _client.get(pageUrl, headers: {'User-Agent': 'JARVIS-PrivateAgent/1.0'}).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
                if (pageResp.statusCode == 200) {
                  final pageData = jsonDecode(pageResp.body);
                  final extract = pageData?['extract']?.toString() ?? '';
                  if (extract.isNotEmpty) {
                    return 'FACTUAL OVERVIEW ($topTitle):\n$extract';
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        return null;
      })(),

      // 2. Bing News RSS (Titles & Summaries)
      (() async {
        try {
          final bUrl = Uri.parse('https://www.bing.com/news/search?q=$encoded&format=rss');
          final resp = await _client.get(bUrl, headers: {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
          if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
            final xml = resp.body;
            final items = RegExp(r'<item>[\s\S]*?<title>(.*?)</title>[\s\S]*?<description>(.*?)</description>')
                .allMatches(xml)
                .take(3)
                .map((m) {
                  final t = (m.group(1) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim();
                  final d = (m.group(2) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim();
                  return '- $t: $d';
                })
                .where((s) => s.length > 10)
                .toList();
            if (items.isNotEmpty) {
              return 'RECENT WEB NEWS & UPDATES:\n${items.join('\n')}';
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        return null;
      })(),

      // 3. Google News RSS Headlines
      (() async {
        try {
          final gUrl = Uri.parse('https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=$encoded&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en');
          final resp = await _client.get(gUrl, headers: {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'}).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
          if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
            final xml = resp.body;
            final titles = RegExp(r'<item>[\s\S]*?<title>(.*?)</title>')
                .allMatches(xml)
                .take(3)
                .map((m) => '- ${(m.group(1) ?? '').replaceAll(RegExp(r'<[^>]*>'), '').trim()}')
                .where((t) => t.length > 5)
                .toList();
            if (titles.isNotEmpty) {
              return 'LIVE ONLINE HEADLINES:\n${titles.join('\n')}';
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        return null;
      })(),

      // 4. DuckDuckGo Instant Answer
      (() async {
        try {
          final ddgUrl = Uri.parse('https://api.duckduckgo.com/?q=$encoded&format=json&no_html=1&skip_disambig=1');
          final resp = await _client.get(ddgUrl).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
          if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
            final data = jsonDecode(resp.body);
            if (data is Map) {
              final answer = data['Answer']?.toString() ?? '';
              final abstractText = data['AbstractText']?.toString() ?? '';
              if (answer.isNotEmpty) return 'DIRECT ANSWER: $answer';
              if (abstractText.isNotEmpty) return 'DIRECT ABSTRACT: $abstractText';
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}
        return null;
      })(),
    ]);

    for (final r in results) {
      if (r != null && r.trim().isNotEmpty) {
        if (buffer.isNotEmpty) buffer.writeln('\n');
        buffer.write(r
            .replaceAll('&amp;', '&')
            .replaceAll('&quot;', '"')
            .replaceAll('&#39;', "'")
            .replaceAll('&lt;', '<')
            .replaceAll('&gt;', '>'));
      }
    }

    if (buffer.isNotEmpty) {
      return buffer.toString().trim();
    }

    return 'No verified live web records found for "$clean", sir.';
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. Real-Time Meteorological Telemetry
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Retrieves real-time weather and temperature for [location].
  Future<String> getWeather(String location) async {
    final loc = location.trim();
    try {
      final url = Uri.parse(
        'https://wttr.in/${Uri.encodeComponent(loc)}?format=%l:+%c+%t,+%C,+wind+%w,+humidity+%h',
      );
      final resp = await _client.get(url).timeout(
            const Duration(seconds: 6),
          );
      if (resp.statusCode == 200) {
        final body = resp.body.trim();
        if (body.isNotEmpty && !body.contains('Unknown location')) {
          return body;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return 'Unable to retrieve meteorological telemetry for "$location".';
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------

  Future<String?> triggerWorkflowIfMatched(String speech) async {

    final match = engine.findMatch(speech);
    if (match != null) {
      await engine.executeWorkflow(match);
      return match.spokenConfirmation;
    }
    return null;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------

  /// Dumps foreground screen text nodes (e.g. from Chrome or article reader),
  /// generates an articulate executive briefing, updates the Floating HUD,
  /// and returns the spoken summary.
  Future<String> summarizeForegroundScreen() async {
    try {
      final nodes = await ScreenAutomationService.instance.dumpScreen();
      final texts = nodes
          .map((n) => n.text.isNotEmpty ? n.text : n.contentDescription)
          .map((t) => t.trim())
          .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
          .toSet()
          .toList();

      if (texts.isEmpty) {
        return 'I could not detect any readable text on the current screen, sir.';
      }

      final joinedText = texts.take(40).join('\n');
      final summary = await AiService.instance.summarizeScreenContent(joinedText);

      // Broadcast summary to Floating Overlay HUD
      try {
        FlutterOverlayWindow.shareData(jsonEncode({
          'type': 'screen_summary',
          'title': 'Article Summary',
          'summary': summary,
        }));
      } catch (_) {}

      return summary;
    } catch (e) {
      return 'Unable to analyze the foreground screen article at this moment, sir.';
    }
  }

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import '../models/skill.dart';
import '../models/task_step.dart';
import 'hermes_evolution_service.dart';
import 'skill_memory_service.dart';
import 'task_executor.dart';

/// 🪄 Autonomous "Macro Recorder" (Self-Creating Hermes Skills)
///
/// Records user interaction sequences across any application via Android
/// Accessibility events and distills them into replayable [Skill]s codified
/// in Hermes `AGENT.md`.
class MacroRecorderService extends ChangeNotifier {
  MacroRecorderService._();
  static final MacroRecorderService instance = MacroRecorderService._();

  static const _channel = MethodChannel('com.privateagent/accessibility');

  bool _isRecording = false;
  bool get isRecording => _isRecording;

  String? _activeMacroGoal;
  String? get activeMacroGoal => _activeMacroGoal;

  DateTime? _recordingStartedAt;
  DateTime? get recordingStartedAt => _recordingStartedAt;

  final List<Skill> _recordedMacros = [];
  List<Skill> get recordedMacros => List.unmodifiable(_recordedMacros);

  Future<void> init() async {
    await refreshMacros();
  }

  Future<void> refreshMacros() async {
    final all = await SkillMemoryService.instance.all();
    _recordedMacros.clear();
    _recordedMacros.addAll(all);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Begins recording user actions across apps.
  Future<bool> startRecording(String macroGoal) async {
    try {
      _activeMacroGoal = macroGoal.trim();
      _recordingStartedAt = DateTime.now();

      final started = await _channel.invokeMethod<bool>('startMacroRecording');
      _isRecording = started ?? true;
      notifyListeners();
      return _isRecording;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[MacroRecorderService] Start recording error: $e');
      _isRecording = true; // Fallback state for simulators/tests
      _activeMacroGoal = macroGoal;
      _recordingStartedAt = DateTime.now();
      notifyListeners();
      return true;
    }
  }

  /// Stops recording, synthesizes a [Skill], updates `AGENT.md`, and persists.
  Future<Skill?> stopRecording({List<Map<String, dynamic>>? mockEvents}) async {
    if (!_isRecording && mockEvents == null) return null;

    final goal = _activeMacroGoal ?? 'Custom Macro';
    _isRecording = false;
    _activeMacroGoal = null;
    notifyListeners();

    List<Map<dynamic, dynamic>> rawEvents = [];
    if (mockEvents != null) {
      rawEvents = mockEvents;
    } else {
      try {
        final list = await _channel.invokeListMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('stopMacroRecording');
        rawEvents = list ?? [];
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('[MacroRecorderService] Stop recording channel error: $e');
      }
    }

    final steps = distillEventsIntoSteps(rawEvents);
    if (steps.isEmpty) {
      // Provide at least a placeholder click step if user stopped immediately
      steps.add(const TaskStep(
        action: TaskStep.actionWait,
        params: {'ms': 500},
        reasoning: 'Autonomous macro initial wait',
      ));
    }

    // 1. Save into SkillMemoryService
    final skill = await SkillMemoryService.instance.saveOrUpdate(goal, steps);

    // 2. Self-Evolve: Codify into Hermes AGENT.md
    await _codifyIntoAgentMd(skill);

    await refreshMacros();
    return skill;
  }

  /// Converts raw accessibility events into high-level [TaskStep]s.
  List<TaskStep> distillEventsIntoSteps(List<Map<dynamic, dynamic>> events) {
    final steps = <TaskStep>[];

    for (final e in events) {
      final type = e['type']?.toString();
      final pkg = e['package']?.toString();

      if (steps.isEmpty && pkg != null && pkg.isNotEmpty) {
        steps.add(TaskStep(
          action: TaskStep.actionOpenApp,
          params: {'app': pkg},
          reasoning: 'Macro launch target application "$pkg"',
        ));
      }

      if (type == 'click') {
        final label = e['label']?.toString().trim() ?? '';
        final x = (e['x'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
        final y = (e['y'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;

        if (label.isNotEmpty) {
          steps.add(TaskStep(
            action: TaskStep.actionClickText,
            params: {'text': label},
            reasoning: 'Macro click on "$label"',
          ));
        } else if (x > 0 && y > 0) {
          steps.add(TaskStep(
            action: TaskStep.actionClickAt,
            params: {'x': x, 'y': y},
            reasoning: 'Macro click at coordinates ($x, $y)',
          ));
        }
      } else if (type == 'type') {
        final text = e['text']?.toString() ?? '';
        if (text.isNotEmpty) {
          steps.add(TaskStep(
            action: TaskStep.actionTypeText,
            params: {'text': text},
            reasoning: 'Macro enter text "$text"',
          ));
          steps.add(const TaskStep(
            action: TaskStep.actionPressEnter,
            params: {},
            reasoning: 'Macro submit input',
          ));
        }
      } else if (type == 'scroll') {
        final dir = e['direction']?.toString() ?? 'down';
        steps.add(TaskStep(
          action: TaskStep.actionScroll,
          params: {'direction': dir},
          reasoning: 'Macro scroll $dir',
        ));
      }
    }

    return steps;
  }

  /// Codifies the newly created macro skill into Hermes `AGENT.md`.
  Future<void> _codifyIntoAgentMd(Skill skill) async {
    try {
      final hermes = HermesEvolutionService.instance;
      final currentAgentMd = hermes.agentMd;

      final skillEntry = '''

### Macro: ${skill.goal}
- Created: ${DateTime.now().toIso8601String().split('T').first}
- Step Count: ${skill.steps.length}
- Replayable Actions:
${skill.steps.asMap().entries.map((entry) => '  ${entry.key + 1}. ${entry.value.action} ${entry.value.params}').join('\n')}
''';

      String updated;
      if (currentAgentMd.contains('## Learned Skills & Autonomous Macros')) {
        updated = currentAgentMd.replaceFirst(
          '## Learned Skills & Autonomous Macros',
          '## Learned Skills & Autonomous Macros$skillEntry',
        );
      } else {
        updated = '$currentAgentMd\n\n## Learned Skills & Autonomous Macros$skillEntry';
      }

      await hermes.updateAgent(updated);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[MacroRecorderService] Error updating AGENT.md: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Replays a recorded macro skill through [TaskExecutor].
  Future<void> replaySkill(Skill skill) async {
    final executor = TaskExecutor.instance;
    await executor.executeTask(skill.goal);
  }

  /// Deletes a recorded macro skill.
  Future<void> deleteSkill(String skillId) async {
    await SkillMemoryService.instance.delete(skillId);
    await refreshMacros();
  }
}

import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';

import 'ai_service.dart';

enum MessageChannel { whatsapp, sms, email }

class MessageDraft {
  final MessageChannel channel;
  final String recipient;
  final String subject;
  final String body;

  const MessageDraft({
    required this.channel,
    required this.recipient,
    this.subject = '',
    required this.body,
  });
}

/// Message drafting and instant dispatch service for WhatsApp, SMS, and Email.
class MessageDraftingService {
  MessageDraftingService._();
  static final MessageDraftingService instance = MessageDraftingService._();

  /// Uses AI to craft a polished, tone-appropriate message draft.
  Future<String> draftMessageContent({
    required String prompt,
    String tone = 'friendly and professional',
  }) async {
    final aiPrompt = '''
You are an expert communication assistant.
Draft a concise, natural message based on this request:
"$prompt"
Tone requirement: $tone.
Write ONLY the exact message text to be sent — no greeting to the user, no explanations, no quotation marks.
''';

    try {
      final reply = await AiService.instance.chat(message: aiPrompt);
      return reply.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'^"|"$'), '');
    } catch (_) {
      return prompt;
    }
  }

  /// Helper to prepare and launch drafted message intent directly.
  Future<MessageDraft> prepareDraft({
    required String recipient,
    required String platform,
    required String draftText,
  }) async {
    final channel = platform.toLowerCase() == 'sms'
        ? MessageChannel.sms
        : (platform.toLowerCase() == 'email'
            ? MessageChannel.email
            : MessageChannel.whatsapp);
    final draft = MessageDraft(
      channel: channel,
      recipient: recipient,
      body: draftText,
      subject: 'Draft for $recipient: $draftText',
    );
    await dispatchDraft(draft);
    return draft;
  }

  /// Dispatches the drafted message through the selected platform intent.
  Future<bool> dispatchDraft(MessageDraft draft) async {
    Uri uri;
    switch (draft.channel) {
      case MessageChannel.whatsapp:
        final cleanPhone = draft.recipient.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d+]'), '');
        final encodedBody = Uri.encodeComponent(draft.body);
        uri = cleanPhone.isNotEmpty
            ? Uri.parse('https://wa.me/$cleanPhone?text=$encodedBody')
            : Uri.parse('whatsapp://send?text=$encodedBody');
        break;

      case MessageChannel.sms:
        final cleanPhone = draft.recipient.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d+]'), '');
        final encodedBody = Uri.encodeComponent(draft.body);
        uri = Uri.parse('sms:$cleanPhone?body=$encodedBody');
        break;

      case MessageChannel.email:
        uri = Uri(
          scheme: 'mailto',
          path: draft.recipient,
          queryParameters: {
            if (draft.subject.isNotEmpty) 'subject': draft.subject,
            if (draft.body.isNotEmpty) 'body': draft.body,
          },
        );
        break;
    }

    try {
      return await launchUrl(uri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'ai_service.dart';
import 'calendar_reminder_service.dart';
import 'jarvis_tools_service.dart';
import 'message_drafting_service.dart';
import 'notes_knowledge_service.dart';
import 'system_control_service.dart';
import 'todo_service.dart';

/// Single atomic task extracted from a chaotic user brain dump.
class DecoupledTask {
  final String type; // reminder, draft, todo, note, calculate, system
  final String description;
  final Map<String, dynamic> params;
  String executionStatus;
  String? resultSummary;

  DecoupledTask({
    required this.type,
    required this.description,
    required this.params,
    this.executionStatus = 'pending',
    this.resultSummary,
  });
}

/// 🧠 "Chaotic Brain Dump" Multi-Task Decoupler Service (The 30-Second Life Sorter)
///
/// Disassembles rambling, unstructured streams of multiple simultaneous requests
/// into discrete parallel tasks, dispatches them across system services,
/// and returns a unified executive resolution summary.
class MultiTaskDecouplerService extends ChangeNotifier {
  MultiTaskDecouplerService._();
  static final MultiTaskDecouplerService instance = MultiTaskDecouplerService._();

  bool _isProcessing = false;
  List<DecoupledTask> _lastExecutedTasks = [];

  bool get isProcessing => _isProcessing;
  List<DecoupledTask> get lastExecutedTasks => List.unmodifiable(_lastExecutedTasks);

  /// Checks if query is likely a chaotic multi-task brain dump.
  bool isMultiTaskDump(String text) {
    final lower = text.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.startsWith('brain dump') ||
        lower.startsWith('process this dump') ||
        lower.startsWith('decouple:') ||
        lower.startsWith('multitask:') ||
        lower.startsWith('multi-task:') ||
        lower.startsWith('multi task ')) {
      return true;
    }

    // Check for multiple distinct imperative verbs
    int verbCount = 0;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(remind|schedule|calendar)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(draft|text|whatsapp|email|message)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(todo|to-do|task|buy|list)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(note|write down|remember that)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(calculate|math|percent|tip)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;
    if (RegExp(r'\b(flashlight|torch|volume|brightness|mute|screenshot)\b').hasMatch(lower)) verbCount++;

    return verbCount >= 2 && (lower.contains(' and ') || lower.contains(', '));
  }

  /// Deconstructs and executes chaotic voice dump in parallel.
  Future<String> processBrainDump(String rawInput) async {
    _isProcessing = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final prompt = '''
You are the Chaotic Brain Dump Multi-Task Decoupler module of J.A.R.V.I.S.
Deconstruct the following rambling user statement into discrete atomic tasks.

Allowed task types:
1. "reminder": { "title": "Call Jack", "time": "4:00 PM" }
2. "draft": { "recipient": "Sarah", "platform": "whatsapp", "message": "I'll be 15 minutes late" }
3. "todo": { "title": "Buy milk and eggs", "priority": "medium" }
4. "note": { "title": "Meeting points", "body": "Discuss Q3 goals" }
5. "calculate": { "expression": "25% of 140", "answer": "35 (total 175)" }
6. "system": { "action": "turn on flashlight" }

Input:
"""$rawInput"""

Respond ONLY with valid JSON array:
[
  {
    "type": "reminder",
    "description": "Set reminder for Jack at 4:00 PM",
    "params": { "title": "Call Jack", "time": "16:00" }
  },
  ...
]
''';

      final response = await AiService.instance.generateResponse(prompt);
      final parsed = AiService.instance.parseLenientJsonArray(response);

      final tasks = parsed.map((item) {
        final map = item is Map ? item : <String, dynamic>{};
        return DecoupledTask(
          type: (map['type'] ?? 'general').toString().toLowerCase(),
          description: (map['description'] ?? 'Atomic task').toString(),
          params: map['params'] is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(map['params'] as Map) : {},
        );
      }).toList();

      _lastExecutedTasks = tasks;

      // Execute all decoupled tasks in parallel
      final executionFutures = tasks.map((task) async {
        try {
          switch (task.type) {
            case 'reminder':
              final title = (task.params['title'] ?? task.description).toString();
              await CalendarReminderService.instance.addReminder(title);
              task.executionStatus = 'success';
              task.resultSummary = 'Reminder scheduled: $title';
              break;

            case 'draft':
              final recipient = (task.params['recipient'] ?? 'Contact').toString();
              final msg = (task.params['message'] ?? '').toString();
              await MessageDraftingService.instance.prepareDraft(
                recipient: recipient,
                platform: (task.params['platform'] ?? 'whatsapp').toString(),
                draftText: msg,
              );
              task.executionStatus = 'success';
              task.resultSummary = 'Draft prepped for $recipient: "$msg"';
              break;

            case 'todo':
              final title = (task.params['title'] ?? task.description).toString();
              await TodoService.instance.addTodo(title, priority: 'medium');
              task.executionStatus = 'success';
              task.resultSummary = 'Added to todo list: $title';
              break;

            case 'note':
              final title = (task.params['title'] ?? 'Quick Note').toString();
              final body = (task.params['body'] ?? task.description).toString();
              await NotesKnowledgeService.instance.addNote(title: title, content: body);
              task.executionStatus = 'success';
              task.resultSummary = 'Note saved: $title';
              break;

            case 'calculate':
              final ans = (task.params['answer'] ?? task.params['expression'] ?? 'Solved').toString();
              task.executionStatus = 'success';
              task.resultSummary = 'Calculation resolved: $ans';
              break;

            case 'system':
            case 'device':
              final act = (task.params['action'] ?? task.params['command'] ?? task.description).toString().toLowerCase();
              if (act.contains('torch') || act.contains('flashlight')) {
                final turnOn = !act.contains('off') && !act.contains('disable');
                await JarvisToolsService.instance.setTorch(turnOn);
                task.executionStatus = 'success';
                task.resultSummary = turnOn ? 'Flashlight illuminated' : 'Flashlight deactivated';
              } else if (act.contains('volume up') || act.contains('louder') || act.contains('increase volume')) {
                await SystemControlService.instance.volumeUp();
                task.executionStatus = 'success';
                task.resultSummary = 'Volume increased';
              } else if (act.contains('volume down') || act.contains('quieter') || act.contains('lower volume')) {
                await SystemControlService.instance.volumeDown();
                task.executionStatus = 'success';
                task.resultSummary = 'Volume decreased';
              } else if (act.contains('mute') || act.contains('silence')) {
                await SystemControlService.instance.setMuted(true);
                task.executionStatus = 'success';
                task.resultSummary = 'Acoustics muted';
              } else if (act.contains('screenshot')) {
                await SystemControlService.instance.takeScreenshot();
                task.executionStatus = 'success';
                task.resultSummary = 'Screenshot captured';
              } else {
                task.executionStatus = 'completed';
                task.resultSummary = 'Directive acknowledged: $act';
              }
              break;

            default:
              task.executionStatus = 'completed';
              task.resultSummary = task.description;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          task.executionStatus = 'failed';
          task.resultSummary = 'Execution error on: ${task.description}';
        }
      });

      await Future.wait(executionFutures);

      final sb = StringBuffer();
      sb.write('Multi-task dump decoupled and executed, sir: ');
      for (int i = 0; i < tasks.length; i++) {
        sb.write('${i + 1}) ${tasks[i].resultSummary}. ');
      }

      return sb.toString().trim();
    } catch (e) {
      return 'Disassembled your input, sir, but encountered an execution hiccup: $e';
    } finally {
      _isProcessing = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'air_gesture_service.dart';
import 'charging_telemetry_service.dart';
import 'sentry_service.dart';

/// Centralized Native Bridge Dispatcher for MethodChannel callbacks.
///
/// Prevents handler collisions where multiple services overwrite
/// `setMethodCallHandler` on `'com.privateagent/accessibility'`.
class NativeBridgeService {
  NativeBridgeService._();
  static final NativeBridgeService instance = NativeBridgeService._();

  static const MethodChannel _channel =
      MethodChannel('com.privateagent/accessibility');

  bool _initialized = false;

  void init() {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;
    _channel.setMethodCallHandler(_dispatchCall);
    debugPrint('[NativeBridgeService] Initialized unified method call handler.');
  }

  Future<void> _dispatchCall(MethodCall call) async {
    try {
      switch (call.method) {
        case 'onAirGesture':
          await AirGestureService.instance.handleNativeCall(call);
          break;

        case 'onPowerConnected':
        case 'onPowerDisconnected':
          await ChargingTelemetryService.instance.handleNativeCall(call);
          break;

        case 'onSentryMovementDetected':
          await SentryService.instance.handleNativeCall(call);
          break;

        default:
          debugPrint('[NativeBridgeService] Unhandled native call: ${call.method}');
      }
    } catch (e, stack) {
      debugPrint('[NativeBridgeService] Error routing ${call.method}: $e\n$stack');
    }
  }
}
