import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'ai_service.dart';

/// Structured inspection result from Jarvis Eye optical perception.
class VisionAnalysisResult {
  final String description;
  final String spokenSummary;
  final String? imagePath;
  final DateTime timestamp;
  final bool isSuccess;

  String get summary => description;

  const VisionAnalysisResult({
    required this.description,
    required this.spokenSummary,
    this.imagePath,
    required this.timestamp,
    this.isSuccess = true,
  });

  factory VisionAnalysisResult.failure(String message) => VisionAnalysisResult(
        description: message,
        spokenSummary: message,
        timestamp: DateTime.now(),
        isSuccess: false,
      );
}

/// 👁️ "Jarvis Eye" — Multimodal Camera & Optical Perception
///
/// Captures high-resolution optical snapshots via native camera or intent,
/// synthesizes visual telemetry through multimodal LLM inference, and
/// delivers articulate, conversational insights in Tony Stark's assistant style.
class VisionPerceptionService extends ChangeNotifier {
  VisionPerceptionService._();
  static final VisionPerceptionService instance = VisionPerceptionService._();

  static const _channel = MethodChannel('com.privateagent/accessibility');

  VisionAnalysisResult? _lastResult;
  VisionAnalysisResult? get lastResult => _lastResult;

  bool _isInspecting = false;
  bool get isInspecting => _isInspecting;

  /// Captures an optical snapshot using the device camera and analyzes it.
  Future<VisionAnalysisResult> inspectPhysicalEnvironment({String? query}) =>
      inspectOpticalSnapshot(customPrompt: query);

  /// [customPrompt] can specify what to look for (e.g. "read the total on this receipt", "identify this component").
  Future<VisionAnalysisResult> inspectOpticalSnapshot({
    String? customPrompt,
    String? mockBase64,
  }) async {
    _isInspecting = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      String? base64Data = mockBase64;
      String? photoPath;

      if (base64Data == null) {
        // Call native camera capture
        final raw = await _channel.invokeMethod<Map<dynamic, dynamic>>('captureCameraPhoto');
        if (raw == null) {
          throw Exception('Optical sensor capture returned empty data.');
        }
        base64Data = raw['base64'] as String?;
        photoPath = raw['path'] as String?;
      }

      if (base64Data == null || base64Data.isEmpty) {
        throw Exception('Optical capture did not contain valid image bytes.');
      }

      final prompt = customPrompt?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
          ? customPrompt!
          : 'Inspect this image thoroughly. Identify key objects, text, errors, components, or documents, and summarize your observations in 2 to 3 natural sentences for the operator.';

      final analysis = await AiService.instance.completeMultimodal(
        prompt: prompt,
        base64Image: base64Data,
      );

      final result = VisionAnalysisResult(
        description: analysis,
        spokenSummary: analysis,
        imagePath: photoPath,
        timestamp: DateTime.now(),
        isSuccess: true,
      );

      _lastResult = result;
      _isInspecting = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return result;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[VisionPerceptionService] Capture error: $e');
      final errorMsg = 'Optical sensor scan was interrupted: ${e.toString().replaceAll('Exception:', '').trim()}, sir.';
      final result = VisionAnalysisResult.failure(errorMsg);
      _lastResult = result;
      _isInspecting = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return result;
    }
  }

  /// Manually set inspection result (useful for tests or simulated feeds)
  void setAnalysisResult(VisionAnalysisResult result) {
    _lastResult = result;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';
import 'package:permission_handler/permission_handler.dart';

import 'edge_tts_service.dart';
import 'settings_service.dart';

/// Voice interaction: native continuous speech-to-text for commands,
/// and high-quality studio text-to-speech for vocal responses.
class VoiceService {
  VoiceService._() {
    _initNativeSpeechChannel();
  }
  static final VoiceService instance = VoiceService._();

  static const MethodChannel _nativeSpeechChannel =
      MethodChannel('com.privateagent/speech');
  final FlutterTts _tts = FlutterTts();

  bool _speechReady = false;
  bool _ttsReady = false;
  bool _listening = false;
  Completer<void>? _speakCompleter;

  final ValueNotifier<bool> isSpeaking = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);
  final ValueNotifier<double> soundLevel = ValueNotifier<double>(0.0);
  final ValueNotifier<bool> listeningNotifier = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

  void Function(bool isListening)? onListeningChanged;
  void Function(String status)? onSpeechStatus;
  void Function(String words, bool isFinal, List<String> candidates)? onSpeechResult;

  bool get isListening => _listening;
  bool get isAvailable => _speechReady;

  void _initNativeSpeechChannel() {
    _nativeSpeechChannel.setMethodCallHandler((call) async {
      switch (call.method) {
        case 'onSpeechResult':
          final args = call.arguments as Map?;
          final text = (args?['text'] ?? '').toString();
          final isFinal = args?['isFinal'] == true;
          final candidates = (args?['candidates'] as List?)
                  ?.map((e) => e.toString())
                  .toList() ??
              (text.isNotEmpty ? [text] : <String>[]);
          if (text.isNotEmpty || candidates.isNotEmpty) {
            onSpeechResult?.call(text, isFinal, candidates);
          }
          break;
        case 'onSpeechStatus':
          final status = call.arguments.toString();
          onSpeechStatus?.call(status);
          if (status == 'listening') {
            _listening = true;
            listeningNotifier.value = true;
            onListeningChanged?.call(true);
          } else if (status == 'notListening') {
            _listening = false;
            listeningNotifier.value = false;
            onListeningChanged?.call(false);
          }
          break;
        case 'onSoundLevel':
          final level = (call.arguments as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0;
          soundLevel.value = level;
          break;
      }
    });
  }

  Future<bool> _ensureMicPermission() async {
    try {
      final status = await Permission.microphone.request();
      return status.isGranted;
    } catch (_) {
      // Gracefully allow mock/headless testing environments where permission channel is unmocked
      return true;
    }
  }

  Future<bool> initSpeech() async {
    if (_speechReady) return true;
    if (!await _ensureMicPermission()) return false;
    try {
      final available =
          await _nativeSpeechChannel.invokeMethod<bool>('isAvailable') ?? true;
      _speechReady = available;
    } catch (_) {
      _speechReady = true;
    }
    return _speechReady;
  }

  Future<void> initTts({String? voiceProfile}) async {
    final profile = voiceProfile ?? SettingsService.instance.jarvisVoice;
    try {
      switch (profile) {
        case 'friday':
          await _tts.setLanguage('en-IE');
          await _tts.setPitch(1.05);
          await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.52);
          break;
        case 'stark':
          await _tts.setLanguage('en-US');
          await _tts.setPitch(0.95);
          await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.55);
          break;
        case 'kip':
          await _tts.setLanguage('en-GB');
          await _tts.setPitch(0.78);
          await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.48);
          break;
        case 'cortana':
          await _tts.setLanguage('en-US');
          await _tts.setPitch(1.10);
          await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.52);
          break;
        case 'paul':
        default:
          await _tts.setLanguage('en-GB');
          await _tts.setPitch(0.86);
          await _tts.setSpeechRate(0.48);

          try {
            final dynamic voices = await _tts.getVoices;
            if (voices is List && voices.isNotEmpty) {
              for (final v in voices) {
                if (v is Map) {
                  final name = (v['name'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
                  final locale = (v['locale'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
                  if (locale.contains('en-gb') || locale.contains('en_gb')) {
                    if (name.contains('gbd') ||
                        name.contains('gbb') ||
                        name.contains('male') ||
                        name.contains('-r-') ||
                        name.contains('language') && name.contains('b')) {
                      await _tts.setVoice({
                        'name': v['name'].toString(),
                        'locale': v['locale'].toString(),
                      });
                      break;
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}
          break;
      }

      await _tts.awaitSpeakCompletion(true);

      _tts.setStartHandler(() {
        isSpeaking.value = true;
      });
      _tts.setCompletionHandler(() {
        isSpeaking.value = false;
        if (_speakCompleter != null && !_speakCompleter!.isCompleted) {
          _speakCompleter!.complete();
        }
      });
      _tts.setErrorHandler((_) {
        isSpeaking.value = false;
        if (_speakCompleter != null && !_speakCompleter!.isCompleted) {
          _speakCompleter!.complete();
        }
      });
      _tts.setCancelHandler(() {
        isSpeaking.value = false;
        if (_speakCompleter != null && !_speakCompleter!.isCompleted) {
          _speakCompleter!.complete();
        }
      });

      _ttsReady = true;
    } catch (_) {
      try {
        await _tts.setLanguage('en-US');
        _ttsReady = true;
      } catch (_) {
        _ttsReady = false;
      }
    }
  }

  /// Forces re-initialization of TTS with a new voice profile.
  Future<void> reconfigureVoice([String? profile]) async {
    _ttsReady = false;
    await initTts(voiceProfile: profile);
  }

  /// Starts native continuous speech recognition.
  /// [onResult] receives primary recognized words, isFinal, and N-best candidates.
  Future<bool> startListening({
    required void Function(String words, bool isFinal, List<String> candidates) onResult,
    bool continuous = true,
    bool manual = false,
  }) async {
    if (!await initSpeech()) return false;
    onSpeechResult = onResult;
    if (_listening && continuous && !manual) {
      // Already running continuous listening loop
      return true;
    }
    try {
      await _nativeSpeechChannel.invokeMethod('startListening', {
        'continuous': continuous,
        'manual': manual,
      });
      _listening = true;
      listeningNotifier.value = true;
      onListeningChanged?.call(true);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[VoiceService] startListening error: $e');
      _listening = false;
      listeningNotifier.value = false;
      onListeningChanged?.call(false);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Notifies the native audio engine that media/music playback has started
  /// so that speech recognition yields audio focus to YouTube/Spotify.
  Future<void> notifyMediaPlaybackStarted({Duration duration = const Duration(seconds: 45)}) async {
    try {
      await _nativeSpeechChannel.invokeMethod('notifyMediaStarted', {
        'durationMs': duration.inMilliseconds,
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Stops speech recognition immediately.
  Future<void> stopListening() async {
    _listening = false;
    listeningNotifier.value = false;
    onListeningChanged?.call(false);
    try {
      await _nativeSpeechChannel.invokeMethod('stopListening');
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Sanitizes text so speech synthesizers pronounce acronyms like Jarvis naturally
  /// instead of spelling out letters like "J dot A dot R dot V dot I dot S".
  String sanitizeForSpeech(String text) {
    return text
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'J\.A\.R\.V\.I\.S\.?', caseSensitive: false), 'Jarvis')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\bJ\.A\.R\.V\.I\.S\b', caseSensitive: false), 'Jarvis')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'J\s*\.\s*A\s*\.\s*R\s*\.\s*V\s*\.\s*I\s*\.\s*S\.?', caseSensitive: false), 'Jarvis')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\bJARVIS\b'), 'Jarvis')
        .replaceAll('*', '')
        .replaceAll('#', '')
        .replaceAll('`', '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\r\n]+'), ' ')
        .trim();
  }

  Future<void> speak(String text) async {
    final clean = sanitizeForSpeech(text);
    if (clean.isEmpty) return;

    // Temporarily pause microphone while speaking to eliminate echo and feedback
    final wasListening = _listening;
    if (wasListening) {
      await stopListening();
    }

    await stopSpeaking();
    isSpeaking.value = true;

    try {
      // 1. Try Ultra-Realistic Studio Neural Voice if enabled
      if (SettingsService.instance.useNeuralVoice) {
        try {
          final played = await EdgeTtsService.instance.speak(clean);
          if (played) {
            return;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          debugPrint('[VoiceService] Neural voice error, falling back to local TTS: $e');
        }
      }

      // 2. Fall back to local FlutterTts (offline safe)
      await initTts();
      if (!_ttsReady) {
        return;
      }
      try {
        _speakCompleter = Completer<void>();
        await _tts.speak(clean);
        // Wait for audio synthesis and speaker playback to finish completely
        await _speakCompleter?.future;
      } catch (_) {
      } finally {
        _speakCompleter = null;
      }
    } finally {
      isSpeaking.value = false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> stopSpeaking() async {
    try {
      await EdgeTtsService.instance.stop();
      await _tts.stop();
      isSpeaking.value = false;
      if (_speakCompleter != null && !_speakCompleter!.isCompleted) {
        _speakCompleter!.complete();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import 'screen_automation_service.dart';

/// An autonomous workflow/protocol evolved by J.A.R.V.I.S. (Hermes Agent pattern).
/// Sets system settings, hardware parameters, and executes routines.
class JarvisWorkflow {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final List<String> triggerKeywords;
  final String description;
  final double? volume; // 0.0 to 1.0, null if unchanged
  final double? brightness; // 0.0 to 1.0, null if unchanged
  final bool? torch; // true = on, false = off, null = unchanged
  final String spokenConfirmation;

  const JarvisWorkflow({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.triggerKeywords,
    required this.description,
    this.volume,
    this.brightness,
    this.torch,
    required this.spokenConfirmation,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
        'id': id,
        'name': name,
        'triggerKeywords': triggerKeywords,
        'description': description,
        'volume': volume,
        'brightness': brightness,
        'torch': torch,
        'spokenConfirmation': spokenConfirmation,
      };

  factory JarvisWorkflow.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => JarvisWorkflow(
        id: json['id'] as String,
        name: json['name'] as String,
        triggerKeywords: (json['triggerKeywords'] as List?)
                ?.map((e) => e.toString().toLowerCase())
                .toList() ??
            [],
        description: json['description'] as String? ?? '',
        volume: (json['volume'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
        brightness: (json['brightness'] as num?)?.toDouble(),
        torch: json['torch'] as bool?,
        spokenConfirmation: json['spokenConfirmation'] as String? ?? '',
      );

  JarvisWorkflow copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? name,
    List<String>? triggerKeywords,
    String? description,
    double? volume,
    double? brightness,
    bool? torch,
    String? spokenConfirmation,
  }) {
    return JarvisWorkflow(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      name: name ?? this.name,
      triggerKeywords: triggerKeywords ?? this.triggerKeywords,
      description: description ?? this.description,
      volume: volume ?? this.volume,
      brightness: brightness ?? this.brightness,
      torch: torch ?? this.torch,
      spokenConfirmation: spokenConfirmation ?? this.spokenConfirmation,
    );
  }
}

/// Self-Evolving Workflow Engine (Hermes Pattern):
/// Autonomously manages and triggers multi-parameter device protocols
/// such as Study Mode, Night Mode, Focus Mode, and custom user routines.
class WorkflowService extends ChangeNotifier {
  WorkflowService._();
  static final WorkflowService instance = WorkflowService._();

  static const _storageKey = 'jarvis_workflows_v1';
  final List<JarvisWorkflow> _workflows = [];
  bool _initialized = false;

  List<JarvisWorkflow> get workflows => List.unmodifiable(_workflows);

  Future<void> init() async {
    if (_initialized) return;
    _initialized = true;

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_storageKey);

    if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
        if (decoded is List) {
          _workflows.clear();
          for (final item in decoded) {
            if (item is Map) {
              _workflows.add(
                JarvisWorkflow.fromJson(
                  item.map((k, v) => MapEntry('$k', v)),
                ),
              );
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    if (_workflows.isEmpty || !_workflows.any((w) => w.id == 'sentry')) {
      _seedDefaults();
      await _persist();
    } else {
      // Sanitize any existing cached workflows to eliminate false-positive collision keywords
      var modified = false;
      for (var i = 0; i < _workflows.length; i++) {
        final w = _workflows[i];
        if (w.id == 'study') {
          final cleaned = w.triggerKeywords
              .where((k) => k != 'learn' && k != 'read' && k != 'reading')
              .toList();
          if (cleaned.length != w.triggerKeywords.length) {
            _workflows[i] = w.copyWith(triggerKeywords: cleaned);
            modified = true;
          }
        }
      }
      if (modified) {
        await _persist();
      }
    }
  }

  void _seedDefaults() {
    _workflows.addAll([
      const JarvisWorkflow(
        id: 'study',
        name: 'Study Protocol',
        triggerKeywords: ['study', 'studying', 'exam', 'exams', 'study mode', 'study protocol', 'study session', 'start studying'],
        description: 'Mutes distracting audio and tunes screen luminosity to 45% for reading.',
        volume: 0.0,
        brightness: 0.45,
        torch: false,
        spokenConfirmation:
            'Study Protocol is now active, sir. Screen brightness is calibrated to 45 percent and distracting audio is muted so you can focus completely. Best of luck with your study session, sir. Let me know if you need anything else.',
      ),
      const JarvisWorkflow(
        id: 'night',
        name: 'Night / Sleep Protocol',
        triggerKeywords: ['sleep', 'sleeping', 'bedtime', 'goodnight', 'night mode', 'night protocol', 'sleep mode', 'sleep protocol', 'go to sleep'],
        description: 'Sets display to minimal brightness, silences audio, and turns off torch.',
        volume: 0.0,
        brightness: 0.05,
        torch: false,
        spokenConfirmation:
            'Night Protocol engaged, sir. Display is dimmed to minimum luminosity, audio is silenced, and flashlight is deactivated. Have a restful night, sir. Sleep well.',
      ),
      const JarvisWorkflow(
        id: 'work',
        name: 'Work / Focus Protocol',
        triggerKeywords: ['work mode', 'work protocol', 'focus mode', 'focus protocol', 'meeting mode', 'deep work'],
        description: 'Silences media alerts and balances workspace display brightness.',
        volume: 0.05,
        brightness: 0.65,
        spokenConfirmation:
            'Focus Protocol is active, sir. Alerts are muted and display is balanced for your workspace. Let me know if you need anything else, sir.',
      ),
      const JarvisWorkflow(
        id: 'cinema',
        name: 'Cinema Protocol',
        triggerKeywords: ['cinema', 'cinema mode', 'cinema protocol', 'movie mode', 'theatre mode', 'theater mode'],
        description: 'Elevates acoustics to 70% and dims screen for immersive viewing.',
        volume: 0.70,
        brightness: 0.20,
        spokenConfirmation:
            'Cinema Protocol is engaged, sir. Display is dimmed and acoustics elevated to 70 percent. Enjoy your film, sir. I will be right here if you need anything.',
      ),
      const JarvisWorkflow(
        id: 'sentry',
        name: 'Sentry Protocol (Tactical Watchdog)',
        triggerKeywords: [
          'sentry',
          'sentry mode',
          'sentry protocol',
          'sentry protocal',
          'century protocol',
          'century mode',
          'centry protocol',
          'centry mode',
          'watchdog',
          'anti theft',
          'anti-theft',
          'guard my phone',
          'watch my phone',
        ],
        description: 'Arms hardware motion sensors and front-camera security watchdog perimeter.',
        spokenConfirmation:
            'Sentry Protocol active, sir. Motion sensors armed. Security perimeter established.',
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Future<void> _persist() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(
      _storageKey,
      jsonEncode(_workflows.map((w) => w.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Evaluates user speech to find a matching evolved workflow.
  JarvisWorkflow? findMatch(String speech) {
    final trimmed = speech.trim();
    if (trimmed.isEmpty) return null;
    final lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();

    // Guard: Questions or educational inquiries MUST NEVER trigger a hardware workflow!
    final isQuestion = RegExp(
      r'^(what|who|where|when|why|how|explain|tell\s+me|search|lookup|define|is\s+it|can\s+you|could\s+you|do\s+you)\b',
      caseSensitive: false,
    ).hasMatch(lower);
    if (isQuestion) return null;

    for (final w in _workflows) {
      for (final kw in w.triggerKeywords) {
        final kwLower = kw.toLowerCase().trim();
        if (kwLower.isEmpty) continue;
        // Whole-word or whole-phrase boundary match
        final pattern = RegExp(r'\b' + RegExp.escape(kwLower) + r'\b', caseSensitive: false);
        if (pattern.hasMatch(lower)) {
          return w;
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Executes a matched workflow on device hardware.
  Future<bool> executeWorkflow(JarvisWorkflow workflow) async {
    final system = SystemControlService.instance;

    // 1. Audio volume
    if (workflow.volume != null) {
      if (workflow.volume! <= 0.0) {
        await system.setMuted(true);
      } else {
        await system.setMuted(false);
        await system.setVolume(workflow.volume!);
      }
    }

    // 2. Screen brightness
    if (workflow.brightness != null) {
      await system.setBrightness(workflow.brightness!);
    }

    // 3. Torch
    if (workflow.torch != null) {
      try {
        await ScreenAutomationService.instance.isServiceEnabled();
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 4. Smart Home & IoT Automation Integration
    try {
      if (workflow.id == 'sentry') {
        await SentryService.instance.armSentry();
      } else if (workflow.id == 'night') {
        await SmartHomeService.instance.turnOff();
      } else if (workflow.id == 'cinema') {
        await SmartHomeService.instance.turnOn(brightnessPct: 15);
      } else if (workflow.id == 'study') {
        await SmartHomeService.instance.turnOn(brightnessPct: 80);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    return true;
  }

  /// Self-evolves: adds a newly learned user workflow.
  Future<void> learnWorkflow(JarvisWorkflow newWorkflow) async {
    _workflows.removeWhere((w) => w.id == newWorkflow.id);
    _workflows.add(newWorkflow);
    await _persist();
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// PrivateAgent design system — a premium "Slate" deep theme with indigo
/// accents, in both dark and light variants.
class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();

  // Slate palette
  static const slate50 = Color(0xFFF8FAFC);
  static const slate100 = Color(0xFFF1F5F9);
  static const slate200 = Color(0xFFE2E8F0);
  static const slate300 = Color(0xFFCBD5E1);
  static const slate400 = Color(0xFF94A3B8);
  static const slate500 = Color(0xFF64748B);
  static const slate600 = Color(0xFF475569);
  static const slate700 = Color(0xFF334155);
  static const slate800 = Color(0xFF1E293B);
  static const slate900 = Color(0xFF0F172A);
  static const slate950 = Color(0xFF020617);

  // Brand accents
  static const indigo = Color(0xFF6366F1);
  static const indigoLight = Color(0xFF818CF8);
  static const success = Color(0xFF22C55E);
  static const danger = Color(0xFFEF4444);
  static const warning = Color(0xFFF59E0B);

  static ThemeData dark() {
    final scheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
      seedColor: indigo,
      brightness: Brightness.dark,
      surface: slate900,
    ).copyWith(
      primary: indigoLight,
      onPrimary: slate950,
      surface: slate900,
      surfaceContainerHighest: slate800,
      onSurface: slate100,
      onSurfaceVariant: slate400,
      outline: slate700,
    );
    return _base(scheme).copyWith(
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: slate950,
      cardColor: slate900,
    );
  }

  static ThemeData light() {
    final scheme = ColorScheme.fromSeed(
      seedColor: indigo,
      brightness: Brightness.light,
      surface: slate50,
    ).copyWith(
      primary: const Color(0xFF4F46E5),
      surface: slate50,
      surfaceContainerHighest: Colors.white,
      onSurface: slate900,
      onSurfaceVariant: slate600,
      outline: slate300,
    );
    return _base(scheme).copyWith(
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: slate50,
      cardColor: Colors.white,
    );
  }

  static ThemeData _base(ColorScheme scheme) {
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: scheme,
      appBarTheme: AppBarTheme(
        centerTitle: false,
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        foregroundColor: scheme.onSurface,
        titleTextStyle: TextStyle(
          color: scheme.onSurface,
          fontSize: 20,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          letterSpacing: -0.3,
        ),
      ),
      cardTheme: CardThemeData(
        elevation: 0,
        margin: EdgeInsets.zero,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
        ),
      ),
      inputDecorationTheme: InputDecorationTheme(
        filled: true,
        fillColor: scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide.none,
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: scheme.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          borderSide: BorderSide(color: scheme.primary, width: 1.6),
        ),
        contentPadding:
            const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
      ),
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          shape:
              RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 14),
        ),
      ),
      chipTheme: ChipThemeData(
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
        side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outline.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
      ),
      snackBarTheme: SnackBarThemeData(

class _RadarScopePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final double angle;
  final int aircraftCount;
  _RadarScopePainter({required this.angle, required this.aircraftCount});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final radius = min(size.width, size.height) / 2 - 12;

    final gridPaint = Paint()
      ..color = const Color(0xFF00E676).withValues(alpha: 0.18)
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 1.0;

    // Rings
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, gridPaint);
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius * 0.66, gridPaint);
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius * 0.33, gridPaint);

    // Crosshairs
    canvas.drawLine(Offset(center.dx - radius, center.dy), Offset(center.dx + radius, center.dy), gridPaint);
    canvas.drawLine(Offset(center.dx, center.dy - radius), Offset(center.dx, center.dy + radius), gridPaint);

    // Sweep line
    final sweepEnd = Offset(center.dx + radius * cos(angle), center.dy + radius * sin(angle));
    final sweepPaint = Paint()
      ..color = const Color(0xFF00E676).withValues(alpha: 0.7)
      ..strokeWidth = 1.8;
    canvas.drawLine(center, sweepEnd, sweepPaint);

    // Sweep trail
    final trailPaint = Paint()
      ..shader = SweepGradient(
        startAngle: 0.0,
        endAngle: 2 * pi,
        colors: [
          Colors.transparent,
          const Color(0xFF00E676).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
        ],
        transform: GradientRotation(angle - 0.5),
      ).createShader(Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius));
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, trailPaint);
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant _RadarScopePainter oldDelegate) => true;
}

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import '../services/multi_task_service.dart';
import '../services/voice_service.dart';

/// 🧠 Interactive HUD Dialog for the "Chaotic Brain Dump" Multi-Task Decoupler
/// Allows typing or dictating compound rambling instructions, disassembling them
/// into discrete atomic tasks, executing them concurrently, and inspecting real-time results.
class BrainDumpDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const BrainDumpDialog({super.key});

  @override
  State<BrainDumpDialog> createState() => _BrainDumpDialogState();
}

class _BrainDumpDialogState extends State<BrainDumpDialog> {
  final MultiTaskDecouplerService _service = MultiTaskDecouplerService.instance;
  final TextEditingController _textController = TextEditingController();
  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();
  bool _isDictating = false;
  String? _lastSummary;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _textController.dispose();
    _scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _startDictation() {
    setState(() => _isDictating = true);
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();

    VoiceService.instance.startListening(
      manual: true,
      onResult: (text, isFinal, candidates) {
        if (!mounted) return;
        if (text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
          _textController.text = text;
        }
        if (isFinal) {
          setState(() => _isDictating = false);
        }
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _processDump() async {
    final text = _textController.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty) return;

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();

    final summary = await _service.processBrainDump(text);
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _lastSummary = summary;
    });

    VoiceService.instance.speak(summary);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    const cyan = Color(0xFF00E5FF);

    return BackdropFilter(
      filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 16, sigmaY: 16),
      child: Dialog(
        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
        insetPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 24),
        child: Container(
          height: 600,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: const Color(0xFF0A1522).withValues(alpha: 0.94),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
            border: Border.all(color: cyan.withValues(alpha: 0.45), width: 1.4),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: cyan.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
                blurRadius: 32,
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: ListenableBuilder(
            listenable: _service,
            builder: (context, _) {
              final isProcessing = _service.isProcessing;
              final tasks = _service.lastExecutedTasks;

              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  // Header
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          color: cyan.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                          border: Border.all(color: cyan.withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(Icons.alt_route_rounded, color: cyan, size: 20),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            const Text(
                              'MULTI-TASK DECOUPLER',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: cyan,
                                fontSize: 13.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                letterSpacing: 1.5,
                                fontFamily: 'monospace',
                              ),
                            ),

                              'Chaotic Brain Dump Parallel Engine',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.6),

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_markdown_plus/flutter_markdown_plus.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import '../models/chat_message.dart';
import '../theme/app_theme.dart';

/// Next-Generation Liquid Glass Transcript Bubble for user / agent / system / error messages.
class ChatBubble extends StatelessWidget {
  final ChatMessage message;
  const ChatBubble({super.key, required this.message});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final isDark = theme.brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final time = DateFormat.Hm().format(message.time);

    switch (message.role) {
      case ChatRole.user:
        return _bubble(
          context,
          alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: [
              const Color(0xFF6366F1).withValues(alpha: 0.65),
              const Color(0xFF4F46E5).withValues(alpha: 0.40),
            ],
          ),
          borderColor: const Color(0xFF818CF8).withValues(alpha: 0.50),
          textColor: Colors.white,
          child: Text(
            message.text,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, height: 1.35, fontSize: 14),
          ),
          time: time,
        );

      case ChatRole.agent:
        return _bubble(
          context,
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: isDark
                ? [
                    Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.09),
                    Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                  ]
                : [
                    Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                    Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.60),
                  ],
          ),
          borderColor: isDark
              ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
              : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
          textColor: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
          header: message.step != null
              ? _stepChip(context, 'Step ${message.step}')
              : null,
          child: message.text.isEmpty
              ? Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    SizedBox(
                      width: 12,
                      height: 12,
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        strokeWidth: 1.8,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      'Thinking…',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        color: theme.colorScheme.onSurface.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                )
              : MarkdownBody(
                  data: message.text,
                  selectable: true,
                  styleSheet: MarkdownStyleSheet.fromTheme(theme).copyWith(
                    p: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(height: 1.4, fontSize: 14),
                    code: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      fontFamily: 'monospace',
                      backgroundColor: isDark
                          ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
                          : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
          time: time,
        );

      case ChatRole.system:
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
          child: Center(
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              child: BackdropFilter(
                filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 10, sigmaY: 10),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 6),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark
                        ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.06)
                        : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: isDark
                          ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                          : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    message.text,
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(
                      color: theme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                      fontSize: 12,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );

      case ChatRole.error:
        return _bubble(
          context,
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: [
              AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.22),
              AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
            ],
          ),
          borderColor: AppTheme.danger.withValues(alpha: 0.40),
          textColor: theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
          header: _stepChip(context, 'Error', color: AppTheme.danger),
          child: Text(
            message.text,
            style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
              color: AppTheme.danger,
              height: 1.35,
            ),
          ),
          time: time,
        );
    }
  }

  Widget _stepChip(BuildContext context, String label, {Color? color}) {
    final c = color ?? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary;
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2.5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: c.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
        border: Border.all(color: c.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 0.8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          color: c,
          letterSpacing: 0.3,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _bubble(
    BuildContext context, {
    required Alignment alignment,
    required Gradient gradient,
    required Color borderColor,
    required Color textColor,
    required Widget child,
    required String time,
    Widget? header,
  }) {
    return Align(
      alignment: alignment,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 5),
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 340),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
              blurRadius: 12,
              offset: const Offset(0, 4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          child: BackdropFilter(
            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 14, sigmaY: 14),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 11, 14, 9),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: gradient,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 1.0),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  ?header,
                  child,
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Align(
                    alignment: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    child: Text(
                      time,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        color: textColor.withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Reusable Liquid Glass UI Components
/// Provides frosted translucency, specular border highlights, and ambient glow.

/// Frosted liquid glass card container.
class GlassCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget child;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry? margin;
  final double borderRadius;
  final double blur;
  final Color? backgroundColor;
  final Color? borderColor;
  final double borderWidth;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final Gradient? gradient;
  final List<BoxShadow>? shadows;
  final double? width;
  final double? height;

  const GlassCard({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.all(16),
    this.margin,
    this.borderRadius = 20,
    this.blur = 16,
    this.backgroundColor,
    this.borderColor,
    this.borderWidth = 1.0,
    this.onTap,
    this.gradient,
    this.shadows,
    this.width,
    this.height,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final defaultBg = isDark
        ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.05)
        : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.65);
    final defaultBorder = isDark
        ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.14)
        : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.08);

    final cardContent = Container(
      width: width,
      height: height,
      padding: padding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: gradient == null ? (backgroundColor ?? defaultBg) : null,
        gradient: gradient ??
            (backgroundColor == null
                ? LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: isDark
                        ? [
                            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.09),
                            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
                          ]
                        : [
                            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.85),
                            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.50),
                          ],
                  )
                : null),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        border: Border.all(
          color: borderColor ?? defaultBorder,
          width: borderWidth,
        ),
        boxShadow: shadows ??
            [
              BoxShadow(
                color: isDark
                    ? Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.35)
                    : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                blurRadius: 20,
                offset: const Offset(0, 8),
              ),
            ],
      ),
      child: child,
    );

    Widget result = ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
      child: BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: blur, sigmaY: blur),
        child: cardContent,
      ),
    );

    if (margin != null) {
      result = Padding(padding: margin!, child: result);
    }

    if (onTap != null) {
      result = InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(borderRadius),
        onTap: onTap,
        child: result,
      );
    }

    return result;
  }
}

/// Compact glowing glass pill tag/badge.
class GlassPill extends StatelessWidget {
  final Widget? icon;
  final String label;
  final Color? color;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final bool isSelected;
  final EdgeInsetsGeometry padding;

  const GlassPill({
    super.key,
    this.icon,
    required this.label,
    this.color,
    this.onTap,
    this.isSelected = false,
    this.padding = const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final accent = color ?? theme.colorScheme.primary;

    final child = Container(
      padding: padding,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isSelected
            ? accent.withValues(alpha: 0.22)
            : accent.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isSelected
              ? accent.withValues(alpha: 0.60)
              : accent.withValues(alpha: 0.20),
          width: isSelected ? 1.2 : 0.8,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          if (icon != null) ...[
            icon!,
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
          ],
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11.5,
              fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w600,
              color: isSelected ? accent : theme.colorScheme.onSurface,
              letterSpacing: 0.2,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (onTap != null) {
      return GestureDetector(
        onTap: onTap,
        child: child,
      );
    }
    return child;
  }
}

/// Translucent Liquid Glass text field.
class GlassTextField extends StatelessWidget {
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final String labelText;
  final String? hintText;
  final Widget? prefixIcon;
  final Widget? suffixIcon;
  final bool obscureText;
  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
  final bool enabled;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
  final int minLines;
  final int maxLines;

  const GlassTextField({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    required this.labelText,
    this.hintText,
    this.prefixIcon,
    this.suffixIcon,
    this.obscureText = false,
    this.keyboardType,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.onChanged,
    this.minLines = 1,
    this.maxLines = 1,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark
            ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.04)
            : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.03),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(
          color: isDark
              ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
              : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
          width: 1.0,
        ),
      ),
      child: TextField(
        controller: controller,
        obscureText: obscureText,
        keyboardType: keyboardType,
        enabled: enabled,
        onChanged: onChanged,
        minLines: minLines,
        maxLines: maxLines,
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: labelText,
          labelStyle: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
          ),
          hintText: hintText,
          hintStyle: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
          ),
          prefixIcon: prefixIcon,
          suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
          border: InputBorder.none,
          enabledBorder: InputBorder.none,
          focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            borderSide: BorderSide(
              color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
              width: 1.5,
            ),
          ),
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Sleek liquid glass slider row with current value badge.
class GlassSliderRow extends StatelessWidget {

  final double value;
  final double min;
  final double max;
  final int divisions;

  final ValueChanged<double> onChanged;

    required this.onChanged,

                  border: Border.all(

                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  displayValue,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: theme.colorScheme.primary,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SliderTheme(
            data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
              trackHeight: 4,
              activeTrackColor: theme.colorScheme.primary,
              inactiveTrackColor: isDark
                  ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.12)
                  : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.10),
              thumbColor: theme.colorScheme.primary,
              thumbShape: const RoundSliderThumbShape(enabledThumbRadius: 7),
              overlayColor: theme.colorScheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
              overlayShape: const RoundSliderOverlayShape(overlayRadius: 14),

            child: Slider(
              value: value.clamp(min, max),
              min: min,
              max: max,
              divisions: divisions,
              onChanged: onChanged,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),

import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Next-Generation Stark Industries J.A.R.V.I.S. 3D Hologram Consciousness Core.
///
/// Features:
/// - Movie-accurate floating 3D spherical AI consciousness matrix from Iron Man / Avengers (jarvi.jpg).
/// - Zero floor pedestal / zero bottom light: floats freely in zero-gravity space.
/// - Pure OLED Obsidian Black void backdrop with subtle celestial quantum field.
/// - Mid-Screen Tap-to-Talk activation with tactile haptic and holographic sonic ripple feedback.
/// - Zero on-screen chat message clutter or bottom mic docks — pure cinematic holographic entity.
/// - Dynamic real-time color shifting:
///   * LISTENING / IDLE: Electric Arc-Reactor Cyan (0xFF00E5FF).
///   * SPEAKING: Radiant Stark Amber / Solar Gold (0xFFFFB300) directly matching jarvi.jpg.
///   * COMPUTING / THINKING: High-Energy Quantum Fusion Violet-Gold (0xFFBA68C8).
/// - Ultra-cool, interesting 3D live animation:
///   * Multi-axis gyroscopic 3D rotation with precession & perspective depth.
///   * 360-degree circular radial audio equalizer frequency spectrum dancing around the sphere.
///   * Triple-ring 3D armillary gyroscope orbital bands with degree tick notches and orbiting satellite photons.
///   * Pulsating white-hot quantum singularity core with concentric acoustic shockwaves and multi-ray coronal flares.
///   * Orbiting quantum data nodes and floating photon spark particles.
///   * Organic spatial floating & pacing, plus full interactive touch drag anywhere on screen.
class JarvisHudWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const JarvisHudWidget({super.key});

  @override
  State<JarvisHudWidget> createState() => _JarvisHudWidgetState();
}

class _JarvisHudWidgetState extends State<JarvisHudWidget>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  final _jarvis = JarvisService.instance;

  late final AnimationController _pacingController;
  late final AnimationController _ringsController;
  late final AnimationController _pulseController;
  late final AnimationController _waveController;
  late final AnimationController _sparkController;
  late final AnimationController _colorController;
  late final AnimationController _rippleController;

  Offset _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
  Offset _panStartPosition = Offset.zero;
  bool _hasPanned = false;
  Offset? _tapPosition;
  DateTime _lastTapTime = DateTime.fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(0);

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // Smooth conversational pacing across the screen
    _pacingController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 14),
    )..repeat();

    // Multi-axis 3D spherical data rings & core gyroscopic rotation
    _ringsController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 12),
    )..repeat();

    // Breathing aura back-glow
    _pulseController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1800),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);

    // High-frequency live vocal equalizer, acoustic ripples & radial spikes
    _waveController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
    )..repeat(reverse: true);

    // Rising energy spark particles
    _sparkController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
    )..repeat();

    // Dynamic color transition between Cyan (0.0) and Gold (1.0)
    _colorController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
      value: _jarvis.phase == JarvisPhase.speaking ? 1.0 : 0.0,
    );

    // Sonic ripple expanding from mid-screen tap location
    _rippleController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 650),
    );

    _jarvis.addListener(_onJarvisUpdate);
    SettingsService.instance.addListener(_onSettingsUpdate);
    ProactiveAgentService.instance.addListener(_onProactiveUpdate);
    ProactiveAgentService.instance.evaluateProactiveNeeds();
    _jarvis.onEnterJarvisMode();
  }

  void _onSettingsUpdate() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _jarvis.removeListener(_onJarvisUpdate);
    SettingsService.instance.removeListener(_onSettingsUpdate);
    ProactiveAgentService.instance.removeListener(_onProactiveUpdate);
    _jarvis.onExitJarvisMode();
    _pacingController.dispose();
    _ringsController.dispose();
    _pulseController.dispose();
    _waveController.dispose();
    _sparkController.dispose();
    _colorController.dispose();
    _rippleController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _handleMidScreenTap(Offset localPosition) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (now.difference(_lastTapTime).inMilliseconds < 350) return;
    _lastTapTime = now;
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    setState(() {
      _tapPosition = localPosition;
    });
    _rippleController.forward(from: 0.0);
    _jarvis.toggleListening();
  }

  void _onProactiveUpdate() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _onJarvisUpdate() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final phase = _jarvis.phase;

    // Smoothly morph color based on current state
    if (phase == JarvisPhase.speaking) {
      _colorController.animateTo(
        1.0,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    } else if (phase == JarvisPhase.listening) {
      _colorController.animateTo(
        0.0,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    } else if (phase == JarvisPhase.thinking) {
      _colorController.animateTo(
        0.5,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    } else {
      _colorController.animateTo(
        0.0,
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 400),
        curve: Curves.easeInOut,
      );
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  /// Interpolates the theme color smoothly between Cyan and Gold
  Color _getDynamicThemeColor(double goldFactor) {
    const cyanColor = Color(0xFF00E5FF);
    const purpleColor = Color(0xFFBA68C8);
    const goldColor = Color(0xFFFFB300);

    if (goldFactor <= 0.5) {
      return Color.lerp(cyanColor, purpleColor, goldFactor * 2.0)!;
    } else {
      return Color.lerp(purpleColor, goldColor, (goldFactor - 0.5) * 2.0)!;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _colorController,
      builder: (context, _) {
        final goldFactor = _colorController.value;
        final themeColor = _getDynamicThemeColor(goldFactor);
        final isListening = _jarvis.phase == JarvisPhase.listening;

        return Container(
          color: const Color(0xFF000000),
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              // 1. Quantum Holographic Starfield / Matrix Grid
              Positioned.fill(
                child: CustomPaint(
                  painter: JarvisCyberGridPainter(color: themeColor),
                ),
              ),

              // 2. Corner HUD Brackets
              Positioned.fill(
                child: IgnorePointer(
                  child: CustomPaint(
                    painter: JarvisCornerBracketsPainter(color: themeColor),
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              // 3. Subtle Corner Telemetry
              Positioned(
                left: 16,
                top: 18,
                child: _buildSideTelemetryLeft(themeColor),
              ),
              Positioned(
                right: 16,
                top: 18,
                child: _buildSideTelemetryRight(themeColor),
              ),

              // 4. Main Arena Column
              SafeArea(
                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    // Top status badge (listening / computing / executing)
                    _buildDynamicStatusPill(),

                    // Proactive intelligent recommendation banner
                    _buildProactiveBanner(themeColor),

                    // Mid-air gesture detection banner
                    ValueListenableBuilder<String?>(
                      valueListenable: AirGestureService.instance.activeGestureBanner,
                      builder: (context, banner, _) {
                        if (banner == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
                        return Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 4),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 7),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                            border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF), width: 1.4),
                            boxShadow: [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: const Color(0xFF00E5FF).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                                blurRadius: 14,
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              const Icon(Icons.pan_tool, color: Color(0xFF00E5FF), size: 15),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Flexible(
                                child: Text(
                                  banner,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                    color: Color(0xFF00E5FF),
                                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                    letterSpacing: 1.1,
                                  ),
                                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),

                    // Central Zero-Gravity Floating Hologram Stage
                    Expanded(
                      child: LayoutBuilder(
                        builder: (context, constraints) {
                          final arenaWidth = constraints.maxWidth;
                          final arenaHeight = constraints.maxHeight;

                          // Cinematic 3D sphere diameter
                          final sphereDiameter =
                              (arenaWidth * 0.78).clamp(280.0, 360.0);

                          return GestureDetector(
                            behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                            onTapUp: (details) {
                              _handleMidScreenTap(details.localPosition);
                            },
                            onPanStart: (details) {
                              _panStartPosition = details.localPosition;
                              _hasPanned = false;
                            },
                            onPanUpdate: (details) {
                              final dist =
                                  (details.localPosition - _panStartPosition)
                                      .distance;
                              if (dist > 8.0) {
                                _hasPanned = true;
                                setState(() {
                                  _dragOffset += details.delta;
                                  final maxX = arenaWidth * 0.45;
                                  final maxY = arenaHeight * 0.40;
                                  _dragOffset = Offset(
                                    _dragOffset.dx.clamp(-maxX, maxX),
                                    _dragOffset.dy.clamp(-maxY, maxY),
                                  );
                                });
                              }
                            },
                            onPanEnd: (details) {
                              if (!_hasPanned) {
                                _handleMidScreenTap(_panStartPosition);
                              }
                            },
                            onDoubleTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                              setState(() {
                                _dragOffset = Offset.zero;
                              });
                            },
                            child: AnimatedBuilder(
                              animation: Listenable.merge([
                                _pacingController,
                                _ringsController,
                                _pulseController,
                                _waveController,
                                _sparkController,
                                _colorController,
                                _rippleController,
                              ]),
                              builder: (context, _) {
                                return CustomPaint(
                                  foregroundPainter: JarvisTapRipplePainter(
                                    tapPosition: _tapPosition,
                                    progress: _rippleController.value,
                                    color: themeColor,

                                      ? _buildHologramSuitStage(

                                final offColor = Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.45);

                                    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();

                                    } else {

                                    }

                                          : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.05),

                                            ? onColor.withValues(alpha: 0.8)

                                                color: onColor.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
